```ts
  'france', 'french', 'paris', 'germany', 'german', 'europe', 'european', 'spain', 'spanish', 'italy', 'italian',
  'russia', 'russian', 'india', 'indian', 'africa', 'african', 'greece', 'greek', 'rome', 'roman', 'latin', 'arab',
  'arabic', 'arabian', 'jew', 'jewish', 'christian', 'christ', 'jesus', 'muslim', 'islam', 'islamic', 'catholic',
  'protestant', 'buddhist', 'buddha', 'buddhism', 'hindu', 'bible', 'biblical', 'easter', 'christmas', 'halloween',
  'monday', 'tuesday', 'wednesday', 'thursday', 'friday', 'saturday', 'sunday', 'january', 'february', 'march',
  'april', 'june', 'july', 'august', 'september', 'october', 'november', 'december', 'atlantic', 'pacific', 'texas',
  'california', 'york', 'washington', 'boston', 'chicago', 'florida', 'virginia', 'georgia', 'victoria', 'elizabeth',
  'mary', 'john', 'james', 'george', 'david', 'michael', 'peter', 'paul', 'jack', 'henry', 'tom', 'bill', 'bob',
  'mark', 'sam', 'joe', 'jim', 'harry', 'alice', 'anna', 'anne', 'ann', 'jane', 'jean', 'joan', 'sarah', 'emma',
  'alexander', 'charles', 'william', 'richard', 'robert', 'thomas', 'edward', 'martin', 'smith', 'jones', 'brown',
  'johnson', 'williams', 'taylor', 'nato', 'nasa', 'olympic', 'olympics', 'oscar', 'nobel', 'hollywood', 'disney',
  'google', 'facebook', 'microsoft', 'ford', 'toyota',
]);

/** The primary part of speech of a gloss, or null when the entry is not a content word (or has no POS tag). */
export function contentPos(gloss: string): ItemPos | null {
  const lines = parseGloss(gloss);
  for (const line of lines) {
    const p = line.pos.toLowerCase();
    if (!p || p.startsWith('[') || p.startsWith('<')) continue;
    if (/^(n|pl)\./.test(p)) return 'n';
    if (/^(v|vt|vi|vbl)\./.test(p)) return 'v';
    if (/^(a|adj)\./.test(p)) return 'adj';
    if (/^adv\./.test(p)) return 'adv';
    // the first tagged sense is a function word, abbreviation, interjection ...
    return null;
  }
  return null;
}

/** Derivational suffixes beyond the inflectional ones `suffixCandidates` already proposes. */
const DERIV_SUFFIXES: readonly [string, string[]][] = [
  ['ness', ['', 'e', 'y']], ['ment', ['', 'e']], ['ful', ['', 'e']], ['less', ['', 'e']], ['ish', ['', 'e']],
  ['able', ['', 'e']], ['ible', ['', 'e']], ['ity', ['', 'e']], ['ist', ['', 'e', 'y']], ['ism', ['', 'e']],
  ['ous', ['', 'e']], ['ive', ['', 'e']], ['ly', ['', 'e']],
];

/** Stems that would make `word` a transparent derivation (quickly -> quick, happiness -> happy). */
export function derivationStems(word: string): string[] {
  const out = new Set<string>(suffixCandidates(word));
  for (const [suf, restores] of DERIV_SUFFIXES) {
    if (!word.endsWith(suf) || word.length - suf.length < 3) continue;
    const stem = word.slice(0, -suf.length);
    for (const r of restores) out.add(stem + r);
    if (stem.endsWith('i')) out.add(stem.slice(0, -1) + 'y');       // happi-ness -> happy
    if (stem.length >= 3 && stem[stem.length - 1] === stem[stem.length - 2]) out.add(stem.slice(0, -1));
  }
  out.delete(word);
  return [...out];
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * Pool construction
 * ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

export function buildItemPools(data: DictData, opts: PoolOptions = {}): ItemPools {
  const words = new Map<string, DictRaw>(Object.entries(data.w));
  const forms = new Map<string, string>(Object.entries(data.f));
  const exclude = new Set<string>(opts.exclude ? Array.from(opts.exclude, (w) => w.toLowerCase()) : []);
  const rejected: Record<string, number> = {};
  const reject = (why: string): null => { rejected[why] = (rejected[why] ?? 0) + 1; return null; };

  const bandOfWord = (w: string): number => {
    const raw = words.get(w);
    return raw ? bandOfRank(rankOf(raw)) : -1;
  };

  const classify = (word: string, raw: DictRaw): PoolItem | null => {
    if (!WORD_RE.test(word)) return null;                                   // not counted: phrases, hyphens, case
    const rank = rankOf(raw);
    const band = bandOfRank(rank);
    if (band < 0) return reject('rank');
    if (exclude.has(word)) return reject('excluded');
    const base = forms.get(word);
    if (base !== undefined && base !== word) return reject('inflection');
    const gloss = raw.t ?? '';
    if (INFLECTION_GLOSS_RE.test(gloss)) return reject('inflection');
    if (!raw.i || ABBREV_GLOSS_RE.test(gloss) || /^abbr\./i.test(gloss)) return reject('abbreviation');
    const pos = contentPos(gloss);
    if (!pos) return reject('pos');
    const tagged = raw.s === 'cefrj' || raw.s === 'oct';
    // untagged entries with no exam tag, Collins stars or Oxford flag are mostly lower-cased names ("fred", "aberdeen")
    if (!tagged && !(raw.g && raw.g.trim()) && !((raw.c | 0) > 0) && raw.o !== 1) return reject('unattested');
    if (PROPER_WORDS.has(word) || PROPER_GLOSS_RE.test(gloss.split('\n')[0])) return reject('proper');
    if (SWEAR_WORDS.has(word)) return reject('swear');
    if (CHINESE_LOANS.has(word)) return reject('loan');
    for (const stem of derivationStems(word)) {
      const sb = bandOfWord(stem);
      if (sb >= 0 && sb < band) return reject('derivation');
    }
    return {
      word, rank, band, pos,
      level: tagged ? (raw.l as CefrLevel) : null,
      textbook: raw.o === 1 || (raw.c | 0) >= 3,
    };
  };

  const bands: PoolItem[][] = BANDS.map(() => []);
  const keys = [...words.keys()].sort();
  for (const word of keys) {
    const item = classify(word, words.get(word)!);
    if (item) bands[item.band].push(item);
  }
  return { bands, rejected };
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * Selection
 * ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

export interface PickOptions {
  /** words not to pick (already used in this or an earlier run); ignored when the pool would otherwise run dry */
  avoid?: ReadonlySet<string>;
  /** minimum share of nouns / verbs in the picked set (defaults 0.4 / 0.25, spec section 4.3) */
  minNounShare?: number;
  minVerbShare?: number;
  /** maximum share of textbook (Oxford/Collins) words when enough others exist (default 0.6) */
  maxTextbookShare?: number;
}

/**
 * Picks `n` items from one band's pool: CEFR-tagged words first, stratified by POS (>= 40% nouns, >= 25% verbs
 * when the pool allows) and capped on textbook words so the sample is not all Oxford-3000 entries. Deterministic
 * for a given rng.
 */
export function pickItems(pool: readonly PoolItem[], n: number, rng: Rng, opts: PickOptions = {}): PoolItem[] {
  if (n <= 0 || pool.length === 0) return [];
  const minNoun = Math.ceil(n * (opts.minNounShare ?? 0.4));
  const minVerb = Math.ceil(n * (opts.minVerbShare ?? 0.25));
  const maxTextbook = Math.max(1, Math.floor(n * (opts.maxTextbookShare ?? 0.6)));

  let candidates = pool;
  if (opts.avoid && opts.avoid.size) {
    const fresh = pool.filter((p) => !opts.avoid!.has(p.word));
    if (fresh.length >= n) candidates = fresh;
  }
  // tagged words first, each group shuffled
  const tagged = shuffle(candidates.filter((p) => p.level !== null), rng);
  const untagged = shuffle(candidates.filter((p) => p.level === null), rng);
  const ordered = tagged.concat(untagged);

  const picked: PoolItem[] = [];
  const used = new Set<string>();
  let textbook = 0;
  const take = (pred: (p: PoolItem) => boolean, count: number, strict: boolean): void => {
    for (const p of ordered) {
      if (picked.length >= n || count <= 0) return;
      if (used.has(p.word) || !pred(p)) continue;
      if (strict && p.textbook && textbook >= maxTextbook) continue;
      used.add(p.word); picked.push(p); count--;
      if (p.textbook) textbook++;
    }
  };
  // quotas with the textbook cap, then quotas without it, then fill
  take((p) => p.pos === 'n', minNoun, true);
  take((p) => p.pos === 'v', minVerb, true);
  take((p) => p.pos === 'n', minNoun - picked.filter((p) => p.pos === 'n').length, false);
  take((p) => p.pos === 'v', minVerb - picked.filter((p) => p.pos === 'v').length, false);
  take(() => true, n - picked.length, true);
  take(() => true, n - picked.length, false);
  return shuffle(picked, rng);
}
```

### `src/core/level/pseudowords.ts` (201 lines)

```ts
import type { DictData } from '@shared/api';
import { createDictionary } from '@core/dict/dictionary';
import type { Dictionary } from '@core/dict/types';
import type { ItemPools } from './items';
import { SWEAR_SUBSTRINGS, buildItemPools } from './items';
import type { Rng } from './rng';
import { randInt, seededRng } from './rng';

/**
 * Wuggy-style pseudowords (Keuleers & Brysbaert 2010) for the yes/no test: a real word of the 3-8k band is split
 * into syllables, each syllable into onset / nucleus / coda, and one of those sub-syllabic segments is replaced
 * by a segment other real words use in the same position (*district* -> *dastrict*, *plenty* -> *plenture*).
 * The result keeps English spelling patterns (every trigram occurs in a real word) but is not a word, not an
 * inflection, not reachable through the dictionary's suffix rules, at least two edits away from every headword
 * (so it does not read as a typo of a known word), and not offensive.
 *
 * Sources are the CEFR-tagged item-pool words of rank 3,000-8,000 (so names, abbreviations and inflections
 * never seed a pseudoword). The pool is deterministic for a seed.
 */

export interface PseudowordOptions {
  seed?: number | string;
  /** pool size to aim for (default 300); the generator stops early only when the source words are exhausted */
  count?: number;
  /** rank range of the real words the pseudowords are built from (default 3,000-8,000) */
  minRank?: number;
  maxRank?: number;
  /** item pools built from `data`, when the caller already has them */
  pools?: ItemPools;
  /** a dictionary built from `data`, when the caller already has one */
  dict?: Dictionary;
}

export const MIN_PSEUDO_LENGTH = 5;
export const MAX_PSEUDO_LENGTH = 9;

const VOWELS = new Set('aeiou');
/** Clusters that may start a syllable; anything else between vowels is split before its last consonant. */
const ONSETS = new Set([
  'bl', 'br', 'cl', 'cr', 'dr', 'fl', 'fr', 'gl', 'gr', 'pl', 'pr', 'sc', 'sk', 'sl', 'sm', 'sn', 'sp', 'st', 'sw',
  'tr', 'tw', 'th', 'sh', 'ch', 'wh', 'ph', 'wr', 'kn', 'gn', 'qu', 'scr', 'str', 'spr', 'spl', 'thr', 'shr', 'chr',
  'sch', 'squ', 'sph',
]);

export interface Syllable { onset: string; nucleus: string; coda: string }
type Part = keyof Syllable;
type Position = 'first' | 'mid' | 'last';
const PARTS: readonly Part[] = ['onset', 'nucleus', 'coda'];

function isVowel(ch: string, i: number, w: string): boolean {
  if (VOWELS.has(ch)) return true;
  // 'y' is a vowel when it is not followed by a vowel (fly, system, happy) and not word-initial (yes)
  return ch === 'y' && i > 0 && !(i + 1 < w.length && VOWELS.has(w[i + 1]));
}

/** Splits a lower-case word into syllables; null for words without a vowel or with a vowel run longer than 3 letters. */
export function syllabify(w: string): Syllable[] | null {
  const runs: { v: boolean; s: string }[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < w.length; i++) {
    const v = isVowel(w[i], i, w);
    const last = runs[runs.length - 1];
    if (last && last.v === v) last.s += w[i];
    else runs.push({ v, s: w[i] });
  }
  const vowelRuns = runs.filter((r) => r.v);
  if (vowelRuns.length === 0 || vowelRuns.some((r) => r.s.length > 3)) return null;
  const syl: Syllable[] = [];
  let onset = '';
  for (let i = 0; i < runs.length; i++) {
    const r = runs[i];
    if (!r.v) {
      if (i === 0) onset = r.s;
      continue;
    }
    const next = runs[i + 1];
    let coda = '';
    if (next && !next.v) {
      if (i + 2 >= runs.length) coda = next.s;                       // final consonants
      else {
        const c = next.s;
        let split = c.length - 1;                                      // default: last consonant starts the next syllable
        for (const len of [3, 2]) if (c.length > len && ONSETS.has(c.slice(-len))) { split = c.length - len; break; }
        if (c.length === 1) split = 0;
        if (c.length === 2 && ONSETS.has(c)) split = 0;
        coda = c.slice(0, split);
        next.s = c.slice(split);
      }
    }
    syl.push({ onset, nucleus: r.s, coda });
    onset = next && !next.v && i + 2 < runs.length ? next.s : '';
  }
  return syl;
}

function position(i: number, n: number): Position {
  return n === 1 ? 'first' : i === 0 ? 'first' : i === n - 1 ? 'last' : 'mid';
}

/** a segment is exchangeable only with segments from the same position; nuclei also by whether the syllable has an onset */
function inventoryKey(s: Syllable, i: number, n: number, part: Part): string {
  return part === 'nucleus' ? `${position(i, n)}:nucleus:${s.onset ? 'on' : 'bare'}` : `${position(i, n)}:${part}`;
}

const MIN_SEGMENT_COUNT = 3;
const MIN_NUCLEUS_COUNT = 5;

function join(syl: readonly Syllable[]): string {
  return syl.map((s) => s.onset + s.nucleus + s.coda).join('');
}

/** All strings one edit (substitution, deletion, insertion, adjacent transposition) away from `w`. */
function* neighbours(w: string): Generator<string> {
  const letters = 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz';
  for (let i = 0; i < w.length; i++) {
    yield w.slice(0, i) + w.slice(i + 1);
    for (const ch of letters) if (ch !== w[i]) yield w.slice(0, i) + ch + w.slice(i + 1);
    if (i + 1 < w.length && w[i] !== w[i + 1]) yield w.slice(0, i) + w[i + 1] + w[i] + w.slice(i + 2);
  }
  for (let i = 0; i <= w.length; i++) for (const ch of letters) yield w.slice(0, i) + ch + w.slice(i);
}

export function buildPseudowords(data: DictData, opts: PseudowordOptions = {}): string[] {
  const target = opts.count ?? 300;
  const minRank = opts.minRank ?? 3000;
  const maxRank = opts.maxRank ?? 8000;
  const rng: Rng = seededRng(opts.seed ?? 0);
  const headwords = new Set<string>();
  const forms = new Set<string>(Object.keys(data.f));
  const dict = opts.dict ?? createDictionary(data);
  const pools = opts.pools ?? buildItemPools(data);

  // spelling-pattern inventory from every alphabetic headword
  const trigrams = new Set<string>();
  for (const w of Object.keys(data.w)) {
    if (!/^[a-z]+$/.test(w)) continue;
    headwords.add(w);
    for (let i = 0; i + 2 < w.length; i++) trigrams.add(w.slice(i, i + 3));
  }

  // source words and the sub-syllabic segment inventory
  const sources: { word: string; syl: Syllable[] }[] = [];
  const inventory = new Map<string, Map<string, number>>();   // `${position}:${part}` -> segment -> count
  for (const band of pools.bands) {
    for (const item of band) {
      const w = item.word;
      if (item.level === null || item.rank < minRank || item.rank > maxRank) continue;
      if (w.length < MIN_PSEUDO_LENGTH || w.length > MAX_PSEUDO_LENGTH) continue;
      const syl = syllabify(w);
      if (!syl || syl.length < 2 || syl.length > 3) continue;
      sources.push({ word: w, syl });
      syl.forEach((s, i) => {
        for (const part of PARTS) {
          const key = inventoryKey(s, i, syl.length, part);
          let m = inventory.get(key);
          if (!m) { m = new Map(); inventory.set(key, m); }
          m.set(s[part], (m.get(s[part]) ?? 0) + 1);
        }
      });
    }
  }
  sources.sort((a, b) => (a.word < b.word ? -1 : a.word > b.word ? 1 : 0));
  // replacement segments: seen often enough in that position to be productive patterns, not oddities
  const choices = new Map<string, string[]>();
  for (const [key, m] of inventory) {
    const min = key.includes(':nucleus') ? MIN_NUCLEUS_COUNT : MIN_SEGMENT_COUNT;
    choices.set(key, [...m.entries()].filter(([, c]) => c >= min).map(([s]) => s).sort());
  }

  const isOk = (cand: string, base: string): boolean => {
    if (cand === base || cand.length < MIN_PSEUDO_LENGTH || cand.length > MAX_PSEUDO_LENGTH) return false;
    if (/(.)\1\1/.test(cand) || /[aeiou]{3}/.test(cand) || /[^aeiouy]{4}/.test(cand)) return false;
    if (!/[aeiouy]/.test(cand)) return false;
    for (let i = 0; i + 2 < cand.length; i++) if (!trigrams.has(cand.slice(i, i + 3))) return false;
    if (headwords.has(cand) || forms.has(cand)) return false;
    if (dict.lookup(cand)) return false;
    for (const sub of SWEAR_SUBSTRINGS) if (cand.includes(sub)) return false;
    for (const nb of neighbours(cand)) if (headwords.has(nb) || forms.has(nb)) return false;
    return true;
  };

  const out: string[] = [];
  const seen = new Set<string>();
  if (sources.length === 0) return out;
  const maxAttempts = Math.max(20000, target * 300);
  for (let attempt = 0; attempt < maxAttempts && out.length < target; attempt++) {
    const src = sources[randInt(rng, sources.length)];
    const i = randInt(rng, src.syl.length);
    const part = PARTS[randInt(rng, PARTS.length)];
    const list = choices.get(inventoryKey(src.syl[i], i, src.syl.length, part));
    if (!list || list.length < 2) continue;
    const seg = list[randInt(rng, list.length)];
    if (seg === src.syl[i][part]) continue;
    const syl = src.syl.map((s) => ({ ...s }));
    syl[i][part] = seg;
    const cand = join(syl);
    if (seen.has(cand) || !isOk(cand, src.word)) continue;
    seen.add(cand);
    out.push(cand);
  }
  return out;
}
```

### `src/core/level/rng.ts` (77 lines)

```ts
/**
 * Small deterministic PRNG for the level test: the same seed always yields the same items, the same
 * pseudowords and the same bootstrap interval, so a run can be reproduced from its stored seed.
 */

export type Rng = () => number;

/** FNV-1a over the string form of the seed, so string seeds and large numbers both work. */
export function hashSeed(seed: number | string): number {
  const s = typeof seed === 'number' && Number.isInteger(seed) && seed >= 0 && seed < 0x100000000 ? null : String(seed);
  if (s === null) return seed as number;
  let h = 0x811c9dc5;
  for (let i = 0; i < s.length; i++) {
    h ^= s.charCodeAt(i);
    h = Math.imul(h, 0x01000193);
  }
  return h >>> 0;
}

/** mulberry32: fast, 32-bit state, good enough for shuffling and bootstraps. Returns floats in [0, 1). */
export function seededRng(seed: number | string): Rng {
  let a = hashSeed(seed) >>> 0;
  return () => {
    a = (a + 0x6d2b79f5) >>> 0;
    let t = a;
    t = Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 15), t | 1);
    t ^= t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), t | 61);
    return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
  };
}

/** Fisher–Yates on a copy. */
export function shuffle<T>(items: readonly T[], rng: Rng): T[] {
  const out = items.slice();
  for (let i = out.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
    const j = Math.floor(rng() * (i + 1));
    const tmp = out[i]; out[i] = out[j]; out[j] = tmp;
  }
  return out;
}

/** Integer in [0, n). */
export function randInt(rng: Rng, n: number): number {
  return Math.floor(rng() * n);
}

/** A sample from Beta(a, b) via two gamma draws (Marsaglia–Tsang; a, b > 0). */
export function randBeta(rng: Rng, a: number, b: number): number {
  const x = randGamma(rng, a);
  const y = randGamma(rng, b);
  return x + y === 0 ? 0.5 : x / (x + y);
}

function randNormal(rng: Rng): number {
  let u = 0; let v = 0;
  while (u === 0) u = rng();
  while (v === 0) v = rng();
  return Math.sqrt(-2 * Math.log(u)) * Math.cos(2 * Math.PI * v);
}

function randGamma(rng: Rng, shape: number): number {
  if (shape < 1) {
    // boost: Gamma(a) = Gamma(a + 1) * U^(1/a)
    const u = rng();
    return randGamma(rng, shape + 1) * Math.pow(u === 0 ? 1e-12 : u, 1 / shape);
  }
  const d = shape - 1 / 3;
  const c = 1 / Math.sqrt(9 * d);
  for (;;) {
    let x: number; let v: number;
    do { x = randNormal(rng); v = 1 + c * x; } while (v <= 0);
    v = v * v * v;
    const u = rng();
    if (u < 1 - 0.0331 * x * x * x * x) return d * v;
    if (Math.log(u === 0 ? 1e-12 : u) < 0.5 * x * x + d * (1 - v + Math.log(v))) return d * v;
  }
}
```

### `src/core/level/score.ts` (239 lines)

```ts
import type { CefrLevel } from '@core/model';
import { CEFR_LEVELS, levelIndex } from '@core/model';
import { BANDS } from './items';

/**
 * Scoring for the yes/no vocabulary test (spec section 3) and the daily model (section 5).
 *
 *  - f  = yes-rate on pseudowords (false-alarm rate)
 *  - h_b = yes-rate on the real words of band b; k_b = max(0, (h_b - f) / (1 - f))  (cfg correction)
 *  - k_b is shrunk toward a logistic curve in log(rank) fitted across bands, with Beta(1,1) pseudo-counts
 *    (two observations' worth), then made monotone non-increasing in rank
 *  - V = sum of k_b x band width (lemmas); families = V / 1.6
 */

export interface BandCounts {
  /** observations (may be fractional for the Beta model) */
  n: number;
  /** "yes" / "known" observations */
  yes: number;
}

export interface LevelResult {
  /** estimated lemmas known in the first 20,000, rounded to 250 */
  sizeLemmas: number;
  /** sizeLemmas / 1.6, rounded to 250 */
  sizeFamilies: number;
  /** CEFR level from the size (CEFR_LEMMA_FLOORS) */
  cefr: CefrLevel;
  /** levels of the 80% bootstrap interval's ends (always contains `cefr`) */
  cefrRange: [CefrLevel, CefrLevel];
  /** 80% bootstrap interval on the lemma count, rounded to 250 */
  sizeRange: [number, number];
  /** false when the false-alarm rate is above 0.3: "unreliable, retake" */
  reliable: boolean;
  perBand: { band: number; k: number; n: number }[];
  /** corrected knowledge of the CEFR-tagged items shown, per level (empty for the daily model) */
  levels: { level: CefrLevel; n: number; k: number }[];
  falseAlarmRate: number;
}

export const FAMILY_RATIO = 1.6;
/** Beta(1,1) pseudo-counts: the curve counts as two observations. */
export const PRIOR_WEIGHT = 2;
export const UNRELIABLE_FALSE_ALARM = 0.3;
/** mastery needed on CEFR-tagged items for the cross-check */
export const MASTERY = 0.8;
/** tagged items needed before the cross-check is allowed to demote */
export const MIN_CROSS_CHECK_ITEMS = 6;
export const ROUND_STEP = 250;

/**
 * Lower bound in lemmas for each level: Nation's word-family scale (A2 < 2,000 families, B1 2,000-3,500,
 * B2 3,500-5,000, C1 5,000-7,000, C2 > 7,000; A1 below 1,000) x 1.6 lemmas per family. Milton's X_Lex lemma
 * scale (B2 from 3,250 lemmas) is not used: the app's own CEFR-J/Octanove tags put the median B1 word at COCA
 * rank 3,900 and the median B2 word at 6,900, which matches Nation's bands (B1 = 3,200-5,600 lemmas,
 * B2 = 5,600-8,000) and not Milton's.
 */
export const CEFR_LEMMA_FLOORS: Record<CefrLevel, number> = {
  A1: 0, A2: 1000 * FAMILY_RATIO, B1: 2000 * FAMILY_RATIO, B2: 3500 * FAMILY_RATIO, C1: 5000 * FAMILY_RATIO, C2: 7000 * FAMILY_RATIO,
};

export function falseAlarmRate(pseudoYes: number, pseudoN: number): number {
  return pseudoN > 0 ? pseudoYes / pseudoN : 0;
}

/** cfg correction: max(0, (h - f) / (1 - f)). */
export function correctedRate(h: number, f: number): number {
  if (f >= 1) return 0;
  return Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (h - f) / (1 - f)));
}

export function roundTo(x: number, step = ROUND_STEP): number {
  return Math.round(x / step) * step;
}

export function familiesOf(lemmas: number): number {
  return lemmas / FAMILY_RATIO;
}

export function cefrForLemmas(lemmas: number): CefrLevel {
  let level: CefrLevel = 'A1';
  for (const l of CEFR_LEVELS) if (lemmas >= CEFR_LEMMA_FLOORS[l]) level = l;
  return level;
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * Per-band knowledge
 * ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

/** Ranks at which a band's curve value is sampled: its mean over the band is the share of the band's lemmas known. */
const BAND_SAMPLES = 16;
const bandSamples = (b: number): number[] => {
  const { lo, hi } = BANDS[b];
  return Array.from({ length: BAND_SAMPLES }, (_, i) => lo + ((hi - lo) * (i + 0.5)) / BAND_SAMPLES);
};

/** Mean of k(rank) over the ranks of band b. */
export function bandAverage(curve: (rank: number) => number, b: number): number {
  const xs = bandSamples(b);
  return xs.reduce((s, r) => s + curve(r), 0) / xs.length;
}

/** The (mu, s) grid the logistic fit searches, with each curve's mean over every band precomputed once. */
interface GridPoint { mu: number; s: number; avg: number[] }
let GRID: GridPoint[] | null = null;
const logistic = (mu: number, s: number) => (rank: number): number => 1 / (1 + Math.exp((Math.log(rank) - mu) / s));
function grid(): GridPoint[] {
  if (GRID) return GRID;
  const out: GridPoint[] = [];
  const muLo = Math.log(50); const muHi = Math.log(100000); const steps = 120;
  for (const s of [0.05, 0.1, 0.15, 0.2, 0.3, 0.4, 0.55, 0.7, 0.9, 1.2, 1.6]) {
    for (let i = 0; i <= steps; i++) {
      const mu = muLo + ((muHi - muLo) * i) / steps;
      const c = logistic(mu, s);
      out.push({ mu, s, avg: BANDS.map((b) => bandAverage(c, b.index)) });
    }
  }
  GRID = out;
  return out;
}

/**
 * Fits k(rank) = 1 / (1 + exp((ln rank - mu) / s)) across bands by weighted least squares on a grid (the curve
 * is monotone decreasing in rank by construction), comparing each band's k with the curve's mean over the band.
 * Returns the fitted curve's mean per band; all zeros when there is nothing to fit.
 */
export function fitLogistic(points: { band: number; k: number; w: number }[]): number[] {
  const pts = points.filter((p) => p.w > 0);
  if (pts.length === 0) return BANDS.map(() => 0);
  let best: GridPoint | null = null; let bestErr = Infinity;
  for (const g of grid()) {
    let err = 1e-6 / g.s;                         // tiny preference for gentler curves so ties resolve smoothly
    for (const p of pts) { const d = p.k - g.avg[p.band]; err += p.w * d * d; }
    if (err < bestErr) { bestErr = err; best = g; }
  }
  return best!.avg.slice();
}

/** Pool-adjacent-violators: weighted isotonic regression, non-increasing. */
export function monotoneDecreasing(values: readonly number[], weights: readonly number[]): number[] {
  const blocks: { v: number; w: number; len: number }[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < values.length; i++) {
    blocks.push({ v: values[i], w: Math.max(weights[i], 1e-9), len: 1 });
    while (blocks.length >= 2 && blocks[blocks.length - 2].v < blocks[blocks.length - 1].v) {
      const b = blocks.pop()!; const a = blocks.pop()!;
      const w = a.w + b.w;
      blocks.push({ v: (a.v * a.w + b.v * b.w) / w, w, len: a.len + b.len });
    }
  }
  const out: number[] = [];
  for (const b of blocks) for (let i = 0; i < b.len; i++) out.push(b.v);
  return out;
}

/**
 * Corrected, shrunk, monotone knowledge estimate per band. `counts` has one entry per band (BANDS order);
 * bands with n = 0 take the fitted curve's value. `f` is the false-alarm rate to correct with (0 when the
 * counts are already corrected, as in the Beta model).
 */
export function bandKnowledge(counts: readonly BandCounts[], f: number): number[] {
  const raw = counts.map((c) => (c.n > 0 ? correctedRate(c.yes / c.n, f) : null));
  const curve = fitLogistic(raw.map((k, b) => ({ band: b, k: k ?? 0, w: k === null ? 0 : counts[b].n })));
  const shrunk = raw.map((k, b) => {
    const c = curve[b];
    const n = counts[b].n;
    return k === null ? c : (n * k + PRIOR_WEIGHT * c) / (n + PRIOR_WEIGHT);
  });
  return monotoneDecreasing(shrunk, counts.map((c) => c.n + PRIOR_WEIGHT)).map((k) => Math.max(0, Math.min(1, k)));
}

/** V = sum of k_b x band width. */
export function sizeFromKnowledge(k: readonly number[]): number {
  let v = 0;
  for (let b = 0; b < BANDS.length && b < k.length; b++) v += k[b] * BANDS[b].width;
  return v;
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * CEFR cross-check and result assembly
 * ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

export type LevelCounts = Partial<Record<CefrLevel, BandCounts>>;

/**
 * The spec's CEFR cross-check (VLT-style mastery): award a level only if the learner knows, corrected for
 * guessing, at least 80% of the CEFR-tagged words of that level; demote while that fails. Exported for callers
 * that want it, but NOT applied by the session: the test samples words by frequency band, so the tagged words
 * it shows are not representative of their level (CEFR-J B1 words span COCA ranks 2.4k-6.9k interquartile, and
 * stage 2 of a 15k-lemma learner shows the few A2 words ranked above 14k), and on the real dictionary the check
 * demotes simulated learners of every size by two to four levels. The per-level knowledge is reported in
 * `LevelResult.levels` instead.
 */
export function crossCheck(level: CefrLevel, counts: LevelCounts, f: number): CefrLevel {
  let idx = levelIndex(level);
  while (idx > 0) {
    const c = counts[CEFR_LEVELS[idx]];
    if (!c || c.n < MIN_CROSS_CHECK_ITEMS) break;
    if (correctedRate(c.yes / c.n, f) >= MASTERY) break;
    idx--;
  }
  return CEFR_LEVELS[idx];
}

export function buildResult(args: {
  k: readonly number[];
  counts: readonly BandCounts[];
  f: number;
  /** 80% interval on V (lemmas), unrounded */
  interval: [number, number];
  levelCounts?: LevelCounts;
}): LevelResult {
  const v = sizeFromKnowledge(args.k);
  const cefr = cefrForLemmas(v);
  const lo = Math.max(0, Math.min(args.interval[0], v));
  const hi = Math.min(sizeFromKnowledge(BANDS.map(() => 1)), Math.max(args.interval[1], v));
  const lowLevel = CEFR_LEVELS[Math.min(levelIndex(cefr), levelIndex(cefrForLemmas(lo)))];
  const highLevel = CEFR_LEVELS[Math.max(levelIndex(cefr), levelIndex(cefrForLemmas(hi)))];
  return {
    sizeLemmas: roundTo(v),
    sizeFamilies: roundTo(familiesOf(v)),
    cefr,
    cefrRange: [lowLevel, highLevel],
    sizeRange: [roundTo(lo), roundTo(hi)],
    reliable: args.f <= UNRELIABLE_FALSE_ALARM,
    perBand: args.k.map((k, band) => ({ band, k: Math.round(k * 1000) / 1000, n: Math.round((args.counts[band]?.n ?? 0) * 1000) / 1000 })),
    levels: CEFR_LEVELS.flatMap((level) => {
      const c = args.levelCounts?.[level];
      return c && c.n > 0 ? [{ level, n: c.n, k: Math.round(correctedRate(c.yes / c.n, args.f) * 1000) / 1000 }] : [];
    }),
    falseAlarmRate: Math.round(args.f * 1000) / 1000,
  };
}

/** Percentile of a sorted numeric array (p in [0, 1]). */
export function percentile(sorted: readonly number[], p: number): number {
  if (sorted.length === 0) return 0;
  const i = Math.min(sorted.length - 1, Math.max(0, Math.round(p * (sorted.length - 1))));
  return sorted[i];
}
```

### `src/core/level/test.ts` (267 lines)

```ts
import type { CefrLevel } from '@core/model';
import type { DictData } from '@shared/api';
import type { ItemPools, PoolItem } from './items';
import { BANDS, bandOfSize, buildItemPools, pickItems } from './items';
import { buildPseudowords } from './pseudowords';
import type { Rng } from './rng';
import { hashSeed, seededRng, shuffle } from './rng';
import type { BandCounts, LevelCounts, LevelResult } from './score';
import { bandKnowledge, buildResult, falseAlarmRate, percentile, sizeFromKnowledge } from './score';

/**
 * The two-stage yes/no level test (spec section 3).
 *
 *  Stage 1: 5 real words per band (8 bands) + 10 pseudowords = 50 items, shuffled; gives a provisional size.
 *  Stage 2: 40 real words from the three bands around the provisional size + 10 pseudowords = 50 items.
 *  Result:  all 80 real + 20 pseudowords scored together (score.ts), with an 80% bootstrap interval over the
 *           real items. Items are drawn from the pools with the session seed, so a run can be reproduced,
 *           and words/pseudowords of earlier runs are avoided when `previous` is given.
 */

export const STAGE1_PER_BAND = 5;
export const STAGE1_PSEUDO = 10;
export const STAGE2_REAL = 40;
export const STAGE2_PSEUDO = 10;
export const BOOTSTRAP_RESAMPLES = 1000;
/** Pseudowords are generated with a fixed seed so the pool is stable across sessions and runs can avoid repeats. */
export const PSEUDOWORD_POOL_SEED = 'readalong-pseudowords-v1';

export type Stage = 1 | 2;

export interface TestItem {
  id: string;
  word: string;
  /** the learner never sees this */
  kind: 'real' | 'pseudo';
  /** band index for real words, -1 for pseudowords */
  band: number;
  /** CEFR-J/Octanove level of a real word, null when untagged or pseudo */
  level: CefrLevel | null;
  stage: Stage;
}

/** Item pools and pseudoword pool, built once per dictionary (a few tens of ms for 50k entries). */
export interface LevelMaterials {
  pools: ItemPools;
  pseudowords: string[];
}

export interface SessionOptions {
  seed: number | string;
  /** words and pseudowords shown in earlier runs; avoided while the pools allow */
  previous?: { words?: readonly string[]; pseudowords?: readonly string[] };
  /** lemmas to leave out of the item pools altogether (e.g. met in the last 30 days of reading) */
  exclude?: Iterable<string>;
}

export interface SessionState {
  seed: number | string;
  stage: Stage;
  items: TestItem[];
  answers: Record<string, boolean>;
  previous: { words: string[]; pseudowords: string[] };
}

export interface LevelTestSession {
  readonly seed: number | string;
  /** current stage (1 until nextStage() is called) */
  readonly stage: Stage;
  /** items of a stage (default: the current one), in presentation order */
  items(stage?: Stage): TestItem[];
  /** records the learner's answer; answering again overwrites */
  answer(itemId: string, yes: boolean): void;
  answers(): Record<string, boolean>;
  /** every item of the current stage has an answer */
  stageComplete(): boolean;
  /** lemma estimate from the answers so far (unrounded) */
  provisionalSize(): number;
  /** builds stage 2 from the provisional size and returns its items; throws when already in stage 2 */
  nextStage(): TestItem[];
  /** scores the answers given so far (both stages) */
  result(): LevelResult;
  /** words / pseudowords used in this session (for `previous` of the next run) */
  usedWords(): string[];
  usedPseudowords(): string[];
  /** plain state for persistence; restore with `restoreSession` */
  toJSON(): SessionState;
}

export function prepareMaterials(data: DictData, opts: { exclude?: Iterable<string> } = {}): LevelMaterials {
  const pools = buildItemPools(data, { exclude: opts.exclude });
  return { pools, pseudowords: buildPseudowords(data, { seed: PSEUDOWORD_POOL_SEED, pools }) };
}

const isMaterials = (x: DictData | LevelMaterials): x is LevelMaterials => 'pools' in x && 'pseudowords' in x;

export function createSession(dict: DictData | LevelMaterials, opts: SessionOptions): LevelTestSession {
  const materials = isMaterials(dict) ? dict : prepareMaterials(dict, { exclude: opts.exclude });
  const previous = {
    words: [...(opts.previous?.words ?? [])],
    pseudowords: [...(opts.previous?.pseudowords ?? [])],
  };
  const session = new Session(materials, { seed: opts.seed, stage: 1, items: [], answers: {}, previous });
  session.buildStage1();
  return session;
}

export function restoreSession(materials: LevelMaterials, state: SessionState): LevelTestSession {
  return new Session(materials, {
    seed: state.seed, stage: state.stage, items: state.items.map((i) => ({ ...i })),
    answers: { ...state.answers },
    previous: { words: [...(state.previous?.words ?? [])], pseudowords: [...(state.previous?.pseudowords ?? [])] },
  });
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ */

class Session implements LevelTestSession {
  private readonly state: SessionState;

  constructor(private readonly materials: LevelMaterials, state: SessionState) {
    this.state = state;
  }

  get seed(): number | string { return this.state.seed; }
  get stage(): Stage { return this.state.stage; }

  items(stage: Stage = this.state.stage): TestItem[] {
    return this.state.items.filter((i) => i.stage === stage);
  }

  answer(itemId: string, yes: boolean): void {
    if (!this.state.items.some((i) => i.id === itemId)) throw new Error(`unknown item ${itemId}`);
    this.state.answers[itemId] = yes;
  }

  answers(): Record<string, boolean> { return { ...this.state.answers }; }

  stageComplete(): boolean {
    return this.items().every((i) => i.id in this.state.answers);
  }

  provisionalSize(): number {
    const { counts, f } = this.counts();
    return sizeFromKnowledge(bandKnowledge(counts, f));
  }

  nextStage(): TestItem[] {
    if (this.state.stage !== 1) throw new Error('stage 2 already built');
    const centre = bandOfSize(this.provisionalSize());
    const first = Math.max(0, Math.min(BANDS.length - 3, centre - 1));
    const bands = [first, first + 1, first + 2];
    const per = Math.floor(STAGE2_REAL / 3);
    const extra = STAGE2_REAL - per * 3;
    const rng = seededRng(`${hashSeed(this.state.seed)}:stage2`);
    const avoid = this.avoidWords();
    const real: PoolItem[] = [];
    for (const b of bands) {
      const n = b === Math.max(first, Math.min(first + 2, centre)) ? per + extra : per;
      real.push(...pickItems(this.materials.pools.bands[b], n, rng, { avoid }));
    }
    // top up from the same bands if one of them ran short
    for (const b of bands) {
      if (real.length >= STAGE2_REAL) break;
      const have = new Set(real.map((p) => p.word));
      for (const p of pickItems(this.materials.pools.bands[b], STAGE2_REAL - real.length, rng, { avoid: new Set([...avoid, ...have]) })) {
        if (real.length < STAGE2_REAL && !have.has(p.word)) { real.push(p); have.add(p.word); }
      }
    }
    const pseudo = this.pickPseudowords(STAGE2_PSEUDO, rng);
    this.state.items.push(...this.compose(2, real, pseudo, rng));
    this.state.stage = 2;
    return this.items(2);
  }

  result(): LevelResult {
    const { counts, f, answered } = this.counts();
    const k = bandKnowledge(counts, f);
    const real = answered.filter((a) => a.item.kind === 'real');
    // CEFR-tagged items for the cross-check
    const levelCounts: LevelCounts = {};
    for (const a of real) {
      if (!a.item.level) continue;
      const c = levelCounts[a.item.level] ?? (levelCounts[a.item.level] = { n: 0, yes: 0 });
      c.n++; if (a.yes) c.yes++;
    }
    // 80% bootstrap interval over the real items (f fixed)
    const rng = seededRng(`${hashSeed(this.state.seed)}:bootstrap`);
    const sizes: number[] = [];
    if (real.length > 0) {
      for (let r = 0; r < BOOTSTRAP_RESAMPLES; r++) {
        const c: BandCounts[] = BANDS.map(() => ({ n: 0, yes: 0 }));
        for (let i = 0; i < real.length; i++) {
          const a = real[Math.floor(rng() * real.length)];
          c[a.item.band].n++; if (a.yes) c[a.item.band].yes++;
        }
        sizes.push(sizeFromKnowledge(bandKnowledge(c, f)));
      }
      sizes.sort((x, y) => x - y);
    }
    const v = sizeFromKnowledge(k);
    const interval: [number, number] = sizes.length ? [percentile(sizes, 0.1), percentile(sizes, 0.9)] : [v, v];
    return buildResult({ k, counts, f, interval, levelCounts });
  }

  usedWords(): string[] { return this.state.items.filter((i) => i.kind === 'real').map((i) => i.word); }
  usedPseudowords(): string[] { return this.state.items.filter((i) => i.kind === 'pseudo').map((i) => i.word); }

  toJSON(): SessionState {
    return {
      seed: this.state.seed, stage: this.state.stage, items: this.state.items.map((i) => ({ ...i })),
      answers: { ...this.state.answers },
      previous: { words: [...this.state.previous.words], pseudowords: [...this.state.previous.pseudowords] },
    };
  }

  /* ---- internals ---- */

  buildStage1(): void {
    const rng = seededRng(`${hashSeed(this.state.seed)}:stage1`);
    const avoid = this.avoidWords();
    const real: PoolItem[] = [];
    for (const band of BANDS) real.push(...pickItems(this.materials.pools.bands[band.index], STAGE1_PER_BAND, rng, { avoid }));
    const pseudo = this.pickPseudowords(STAGE1_PSEUDO, rng);
    this.state.items.push(...this.compose(1, real, pseudo, rng));
  }

  private avoidWords(): Set<string> {
    return new Set([...this.state.previous.words, ...this.usedWords()]);
  }

  private pickPseudowords(n: number, rng: Rng): string[] {
    const pool = this.materials.pseudowords;
    const avoid = new Set([...this.state.previous.pseudowords, ...this.usedPseudowords()]);
    const order = shuffle(pool, rng);
    const fresh = order.filter((w) => !avoid.has(w));
    const chosen = fresh.slice(0, n);
    if (chosen.length < n) {
      // pool exhausted for this learner: fall back to repeats rather than fewer pseudowords
      const used = new Set(this.usedPseudowords());
      for (const w of order) { if (chosen.length >= n) break; if (!chosen.includes(w) && !used.has(w)) chosen.push(w); }
    }
    return chosen;
  }

  private compose(stage: Stage, real: PoolItem[], pseudo: string[], rng: Rng): TestItem[] {
    const items: TestItem[] = [
      ...real.map((p): TestItem => ({ id: '', word: p.word, kind: 'real', band: p.band, level: p.level, stage })),
      ...pseudo.map((w): TestItem => ({ id: '', word: w, kind: 'pseudo', band: -1, level: null, stage })),
    ];
    return shuffle(items, rng).map((it, i) => ({ ...it, id: `s${stage}-${String(i + 1).padStart(2, '0')}` }));
  }

  private counts(): { counts: BandCounts[]; f: number; answered: { item: TestItem; yes: boolean }[] } {
    const answered: { item: TestItem; yes: boolean }[] = [];
    for (const item of this.state.items) {
      const yes = this.state.answers[item.id];
      if (yes !== undefined) answered.push({ item, yes });
    }
    const counts: BandCounts[] = BANDS.map(() => ({ n: 0, yes: 0 }));
    let pseudoN = 0; let pseudoYes = 0;
    for (const a of answered) {
      if (a.item.kind === 'pseudo') { pseudoN++; if (a.yes) pseudoYes++; }
      else { counts[a.item.band].n++; if (a.yes) counts[a.item.band].yes++; }
    }
    return { counts, f: falseAlarmRate(pseudoYes, pseudoN), answered };
  }
}
```
