### `src/core/vocab/review.ts` (126 lines)

```ts
/**
 * The spoken review class after a listening session (pure; the voice layer speaks the plan later).
 *
 * Which words: the ones explained this session, then the ones due again on a simple spaced schedule
 * (1, 3, 7, 14, 30 days after the last time they were seen, one step per explanation). How many: about one
 * review item per 300 words read, at least 3, at most 20. Two parts: the vocabulary items (word, sentence,
 * Chinese) and a context review, the sentences grouped by book and chapter in reading order.
 */
import type { VocabEntry } from '@shared/api';

export const REVIEW_INTERVALS_DAYS: readonly number[] = [1, 3, 7, 14, 30];
export const WORDS_PER_REVIEW_ITEM = 300;
export const MIN_REVIEW_ITEMS = 3;
export const MAX_REVIEW_ITEMS = 20;

export interface ReviewItem {
  lemma: string;
  word: string;
  sentence: string;
  chinese: string;
  explanation: string;
  /** why it is in the class */
  reason: 'session' | 'due';
}

export interface ContextGroup {
  bookId: string;
  bookTitle: string;
  chapter: string;
  /** reading order within the chapter */
  sentences: { lemma: string; word: string; sentence: string }[];
}

export interface ReviewPlan {
  /** how many items the session size asked for (before running out of words) */
  target: number;
  items: ReviewItem[];
  context: ContextGroup[];
  sessionCount: number;
  dueCount: number;
}

export interface ReviewOptions {
  now?: Date;
  /** lemmas explained in this session (else: entries seen since `sessionStart`) */
  sessionLemmas?: Iterable<string>;
  /** ISO time the session started; entries with lastSeenAt at or after it count as this session's */
  sessionStart?: string;
}

/** Days until the next review after the n-th explanation (1-based): 1, 3, 7, 14, 30, then 30 again. */
export function intervalDays(timesExplained: number): number {
  const i = Math.max(0, Math.min(REVIEW_INTERVALS_DAYS.length - 1, (timesExplained | 0) - 1));
  return REVIEW_INTERVALS_DAYS[i];
}

/** ISO time of the next review, or null for a known word (nothing to review). */
export function nextDue(entry: Pick<VocabEntry, 'lastSeenAt' | 'timesExplained' | 'status'>): string | null {
  if (entry.status === 'known') return null;
  const last = Date.parse(entry.lastSeenAt);
  if (Number.isNaN(last)) return null;
  return new Date(last + intervalDays(entry.timesExplained) * 86400_000).toISOString();
}

export function isDue(entry: Pick<VocabEntry, 'lastSeenAt' | 'timesExplained' | 'status'>, now: Date = new Date()): boolean {
  const due = nextDue(entry);
  return due !== null && Date.parse(due) <= now.getTime();
}

/** About one item per 300 words read, between 3 and 20. */
export function reviewSize(sessionWords: number): number {
  const n = Math.round(Math.max(0, sessionWords) / WORDS_PER_REVIEW_ITEM);
  return Math.max(MIN_REVIEW_ITEMS, Math.min(MAX_REVIEW_ITEMS, n));
}

function toItem(e: VocabEntry, reason: ReviewItem['reason']): ReviewItem {
  return { lemma: e.lemma, word: e.word || e.lemma, sentence: e.sentence, chinese: e.chinese, explanation: e.explanation, reason };
}

/** Sentences grouped by book and chapter, in reading order (position), groups in the order they were met. */
export function groupByChapter(entries: VocabEntry[]): ContextGroup[] {
  const groups = new Map<string, ContextGroup>();
  const sorted = [...entries].filter((e) => e.sentence).sort((a, b) => a.createdAt.localeCompare(b.createdAt));
  for (const e of sorted) {
    const key = `${e.bookId}\u0000${e.chapter}`;
    let g = groups.get(key);
    if (!g) { g = { bookId: e.bookId, bookTitle: e.bookTitle, chapter: e.chapter, sentences: [] }; groups.set(key, g); }
    if (!g.sentences.some((s) => s.sentence === e.sentence)) g.sentences.push({ lemma: e.lemma, word: e.word || e.lemma, sentence: e.sentence });
  }
  const pos = (e: VocabEntry) => e.position ? [e.position.chapter, e.position.paragraph, e.position.sentence] : null;
  for (const g of groups.values()) {
    const byLemma = new Map(entries.map((e) => [e.lemma, e]));
    g.sentences.sort((a, b) => {
      const pa = pos(byLemma.get(a.lemma)!), pb = pos(byLemma.get(b.lemma)!);
      if (!pa || !pb) return 0;
      return pa[0] - pb[0] || pa[1] - pb[1] || pa[2] - pb[2];
    });
  }
  return [...groups.values()];
}

/**
 * Builds the review class. Session words come first (the ones the learner said "I don't know" about before the
 * others, then the most recent), then due words, the most overdue first, up to the target size.
 */
export function buildReviewPlan(entries: VocabEntry[], sessionWords: number, opts: ReviewOptions = {}): ReviewPlan {
  const now = opts.now ?? new Date();
  const target = reviewSize(sessionWords);
  const sessionSet = new Set(opts.sessionLemmas ?? []);
  const start = opts.sessionStart ? Date.parse(opts.sessionStart) : NaN;
  const inSession = (e: VocabEntry) => sessionSet.has(e.lemma) || (!Number.isNaN(start) && Date.parse(e.lastSeenAt) >= start);
  const learning = entries.filter((e) => e.status !== 'known');
  const session = learning.filter(inSession).sort((a, b) => b.again - a.again || b.lastSeenAt.localeCompare(a.lastSeenAt));
  const due = learning.filter((e) => !inSession(e) && isDue(e, now)).sort((a, b) => Date.parse(nextDue(a)!) - Date.parse(nextDue(b)!));
  const items: ReviewItem[] = [];
  for (const e of session) { if (items.length >= target) break; items.push(toItem(e, 'session')); }
  for (const e of due) { if (items.length >= target) break; items.push(toItem(e, 'due')); }
  const chosen = new Set(items.map((i) => i.lemma));
  return {
    target,
    items,
    context: groupByChapter(entries.filter((e) => chosen.has(e.lemma))),
    sessionCount: items.filter((i) => i.reason === 'session').length,
    dueCount: items.filter((i) => i.reason === 'due').length,
  };
}
```

### `src/core/vocab/reviewScript.ts` (84 lines)

```ts
/**
 * The spoken script of the review class (pure): turns a ReviewPlan (src/core/vocab/review.ts) into a friendly
 * intro line, an ordered list of explain requests for the AI/voice layer, and a duration estimate.
 *
 * Order: one 'word' request per vocabulary item (plan order), then one 'passage' request per context group
 * (book/chapter order as in the plan) asking for a short retelling plus one question for the learner.
 */
import type { ExplainRequest } from '@shared/api';
import type { ContextGroup, ReviewPlan } from './review';

export const MINUTES_PER_WORD = 0.75;
export const MINUTES_PER_CONTEXT_GROUP = 1;

/** The instruction sent with each context group: retell, ask one question, pause, then give the answer. */
export const PASSAGE_REVIEW_QUESTION =
  'Retell briefly, in two or three simple sentences, what happened in this part of the story. ' +
  'Then ask the learner one short question about it. End with [PAUSE] followed by the answer.';

export interface ReviewScriptOptions {
  /** title of the book being read; used when a group or item has no title of its own */
  bookTitle: string;
}

const plural = (n: number, word: string): string => `${n} ${word}${n === 1 ? '' : 's'}`;

/** One friendly sentence opening the class, e.g. "Let's review 6 words from today, then the story so far." */
export function reviewIntro(plan: ReviewPlan): string {
  const n = plan.items.length;
  const story = plan.context.length > 0;
  if (n === 0) return story ? "Let's go over the story so far." : 'Nothing to review right now. Well done!';
  const session = plan.items.filter((i) => i.reason === 'session').length;
  const due = n - session;
  let what: string;
  if (due === 0) what = `${plural(n, 'word')} from today`;
  else if (session === 0) what = `${plural(n, 'word')} from earlier sessions`;
  else what = `${plural(n, 'word')}: ${session} from today and ${due} from earlier`;
  return `Let's review ${what}${story ? ', then the story so far' : ''}.`;
}

/** The context group a vocabulary item's sentence belongs to (for its chapter), if any. */
function groupOf(plan: ReviewPlan, lemma: string): ContextGroup | undefined {
  return plan.context.find((g) => g.sentences.some((s) => s.lemma === lemma));
}

/** The ordered explain requests of the class: every word item, then every context group as a passage. */
export function buildReviewRequests(plan: ReviewPlan, opts: ReviewScriptOptions): ExplainRequest[] {
  const out: ExplainRequest[] = [];
  for (const item of plan.items) {
    const g = groupOf(plan, item.lemma);
    out.push({
      kind: 'word',
      target: item.word || item.lemma,
      sentence: item.sentence,
      before: '',
      after: '',
      book: { title: opts.bookTitle || g?.bookTitle || '', chapter: g?.chapter ?? '' },
      ...(item.chinese ? { dict: { zh: item.chinese } } : {}),
      history: [],
      again: false,
    });
  }
  for (const g of plan.context) {
    const passage = g.sentences.map((s) => s.sentence.trim()).filter(Boolean).join(' ');
    if (!passage) continue;
    out.push({
      kind: 'passage',
      target: passage,
      sentence: passage,
      before: '',
      after: '',
      book: { title: g.bookTitle || opts.bookTitle, chapter: g.chapter },
      question: PASSAGE_REVIEW_QUESTION,
      history: [],
      again: false,
    });
  }
  return out;
}

/** About 0.75 minutes per word item plus 1 minute per context group, rounded up to whole minutes. */
export function estimateReviewMinutes(plan: ReviewPlan): number {
  const groups = plan.context.filter((g) => g.sentences.some((s) => s.sentence.trim())).length;
  return Math.ceil(plan.items.length * MINUTES_PER_WORD + groups * MINUTES_PER_CONTEXT_GROUP);
}
```

### `src/core/voice/audio.ts` (123 lines)

```ts
/**
 * Small PCM helpers for the voice pipeline (pure TypeScript, no dependencies): sample-format conversion, a
 * stateful linear resampler for streaming frames, and a ring buffer addressed by absolute sample index so a
 * VAD segment [start, end) can be sliced out after the fact.
 */

/** Int16 PCM → Float32 in -1..1. */
export function int16ToFloat32(pcm: Int16Array): Float32Array {
  const out = new Float32Array(pcm.length);
  for (let i = 0; i < pcm.length; i++) out[i] = pcm[i] / 32768;
  return out;
}

/** Float32 in -1..1 → Int16 PCM (clamped). */
export function float32ToInt16(pcm: Float32Array): Int16Array {
  const out = new Int16Array(pcm.length);
  for (let i = 0; i < pcm.length; i++) {
    const s = Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, pcm[i]));
    out[i] = Math.round(s < 0 ? s * 32768 : s * 32767);
  }
  return out;
}

/** Whole-buffer linear resampling (good enough for speech going into a 16 kHz recogniser). */
export function resampleLinear(x: Float32Array, from: number, to: number): Float32Array {
  if (from === to) return x;
  const r = new Resampler(from, to);
  const a = r.process(x);
  const b = r.flush();
  if (!b.length) return a;
  const out = new Float32Array(a.length + b.length);
  out.set(a); out.set(b, a.length);
  return out;
}

/**
 * Stateful linear resampler: feed frames of any size, get frames back; the last input sample is kept as the
 * interpolation context for the next call so there is no seam between frames.
 */
export class Resampler {
  private readonly ratio: number; // input samples per output sample
  private last: number | null = null;
  private pos = 0; // position of the next output sample in input-sample units, relative to `last`
  constructor(readonly from: number, readonly to: number) {
    if (!(from > 0) || !(to > 0)) throw new Error('Resampler: sample rates must be positive');
    this.ratio = from / to;
  }

  process(x: Float32Array): Float32Array {
    if (this.from === this.to) return x;
    if (!x.length) return new Float32Array(0);
    // Virtual input: [last, ...x]; index 0 is `last` (or x[0] on the very first call).
    const first = this.last === null;
    const n = x.length + (first ? 0 : 1);
    const at = (i: number): number => (first ? x[i] : i === 0 ? (this.last as number) : x[i - 1]);
    const out: number[] = [];
    let p = this.pos;
    while (p + 1 < n) {
      const j = Math.floor(p), f = p - j;
      out.push(at(j) * (1 - f) + at(j + 1) * f);
      p += this.ratio;
    }
    // Keep the last input sample as context; rebase p onto it.
    this.last = x[x.length - 1];
    this.pos = p - (n - 1);
    return Float32Array.from(out);
  }

  /** Emit the final sample(s) that are still waiting for a next frame and reset. */
  flush(): Float32Array {
    const out: number[] = [];
    if (this.last !== null && this.pos <= 0) out.push(this.last);
    this.reset();
    return Float32Array.from(out);
  }

  reset(): void { this.last = null; this.pos = 0; }
}

/**
 * Fixed-capacity Float32 ring buffer addressed by absolute sample index: `write` appends, `slice(start, end)`
 * returns a copy of the samples at those absolute positions (clamped to what is still in the buffer).
 */
export class RingBuffer {
  private readonly buf: Float32Array;
  /** absolute index of the next sample to be written */
  private _end = 0;
  constructor(readonly capacity: number) { this.buf = new Float32Array(capacity); }

  get end(): number { return this._end; }
  /** oldest absolute index still available */
  get start(): number { return Math.max(0, this._end - this.capacity); }

  write(x: Float32Array): void {
    let src = x;
    if (src.length > this.capacity) src = src.subarray(src.length - this.capacity);
    const at = this._end % this.capacity;
    const firstPart = Math.min(src.length, this.capacity - at);
    this.buf.set(src.subarray(0, firstPart), at);
    if (firstPart < src.length) this.buf.set(src.subarray(firstPart), 0);
    this._end += x.length;
  }

  slice(start: number, end: number): Float32Array {
    const s = Math.max(start, this.start), e = Math.min(end, this._end);
    if (e <= s) return new Float32Array(0);
    const out = new Float32Array(e - s);
    const at = s % this.capacity;
    const firstPart = Math.min(out.length, this.capacity - at);
    out.set(this.buf.subarray(at, at + firstPart));
    if (firstPart < out.length) out.set(this.buf.subarray(0, out.length - firstPart), firstPart);
    return out;
  }

  reset(): void { this._end = 0; }
}

/** Root-mean-square level of a frame (0..1), handy for silence checks in tests and benches. */
export function rms(x: Float32Array): number {
  let s = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < x.length; i++) s += x[i] * x[i];
  return x.length ? Math.sqrt(s / x.length) : 0;
}
```

### `src/core/voice/commands.ts` (266 lines)

```ts
/**
 * Voice-command detection for the listening loop (see docs/research/research-voice.md,
 * "Voice-command detection"). Runs on every STT partial/final and must never wait for the LLM.
 *
 * Pipeline: normalize → word-count gate (> 6 words is conversation) → per-intent phrase grammar with
 * Mandarin-L1 accent variants, tested DONT_KNOW → KNOW → BYE (substring collision) → fuzzy accept on the
 * whole utterance (Levenshtein ratio ≥ minRatio OR phonetic-key equality) → prefix rule ("I don't know this
 * word") → otherwise QUESTION for the AI.
 *
 * Pure TypeScript: Levenshtein and a Metaphone-style phonetic key are implemented here, no dependencies.
 */

export type CommandIntent = 'know' | 'dont_know' | 'bye';
export type Intent = CommandIntent | 'question' | 'none';

export interface DetectOptions {
  /** STT confidence for the utterance (0..1). Below 0.6 the fuzzy threshold is raised to ≥ 0.85. */
  confidence?: number;
  /** Levenshtein ratio needed on the whole utterance (default 0.80). */
  minRatio?: number;
}

export interface Detection {
  intent: Intent;
  /** Best Levenshtein ratio seen against the matched phrase (1 = exact); 0 for 'none'. */
  score: number;
  /** The grammar phrase that matched, when intent is a command. */
  matched?: string;
}

/** Utterances longer than this many words are conversation for the AI, never a command. */
export const MAX_COMMAND_WORDS = 6;
/** Prefix rule: a command phrase at the start of the utterance may be followed by at most this many words. */
export const MAX_TAIL_WORDS = 3;
/** Report rule: utterance.length ≤ phrase.length + this many characters for a whole-utterance match. */
const MAX_EXTRA_CHARS = 6;
const DEFAULT_MIN_RATIO = 0.8;
const LOW_CONFIDENCE = 0.6;
const LOW_CONFIDENCE_MIN_RATIO = 0.85;

/** Phrase grammar per intent, including Mandarin-L1 accent variants (final-consonant drop, th→d/s, v→w). */
export const PHRASES: Record<CommandIntent, readonly string[]> = {
  dont_know: [
    "i don't know", 'i dont know', 'i don no', 'i do not know', 'dunno', "don't know", 'dont know', 'don no',
    'no idea', 'not sure', "i'm not sure", 'i am not sure', 'i not sure',
    'what', 'again', 'explain again', 'say again', 'say it again', 'one more time', "i don't understand", 'i dont understand', 'i don understand',
  ],
  know: ['i know', 'i knew', 'i no', 'i now', 'i know it', 'yes i know', 'yeah i know', 'ya i know', 'got it', 'i got it', 'i understand', 'understood'],
  bye: ['bye bye', 'bye', 'goodbye', 'good bye', 'bai bai', 'by by', 'bai', 'see you', 'see ya', "that's all", 'thats all', 'that is all', 'the end', 'go on', 'go ahead', 'keep going', 'continue', 'carry on', 'next', 'skip', 'skip it', 'move on'],
};

/** Order matters: DONT_KNOW first because "i know" is a substring of "i don't know". */
const ORDER: readonly CommandIntent[] = ['dont_know', 'know', 'bye'];

/** Standalone filler tokens dropped during normalisation. */
const FILLERS = new Set(['um', 'uh', 'uhm', 'umm', 'hmm', 'hm', 'mm', 'mhm', 'er', 'erm', 'ah', 'eh', 'oh', 'okay', 'ok', 'well']);

/** Apostrophe-less spellings STT engines often emit → canonical contraction. */
const CONTRACTIONS: Record<string, string> = {
  dont: "don't", im: "i'm", thats: "that's", whats: "what's", cant: "can't", didnt: "didn't", isnt: "isn't", wont: "won't", youre: "you're", ive: "i've",
};

/**
 * Lowercase, straighten quotes, strip punctuation (apostrophes kept), collapse whitespace, canonicalise
 * contractions ("dont" → "don't"), drop filler tokens ("um", "okay"). Returns '' for nothing usable.
 */
export function normalize(text: string): string {
  const words = text
    .toLowerCase()
    .replace(/[‘’ʼ`´]/g, "'")
    .replace(/[^\p{L}\p{N}']+/gu, ' ')
    .split(' ')
    .map((w) => w.replace(/^'+|'+$/g, ''))
    .filter((w) => w.length > 0)
    .map((w) => CONTRACTIONS[w] ?? w)
    .filter((w) => !FILLERS.has(w));
  return words.join(' ');
}

/** Classic Levenshtein edit distance (two-row DP). */
export function levenshtein(a: string, b: string): number {
  if (a === b) return 0;
  if (a.length === 0) return b.length;
  if (b.length === 0) return a.length;
  let prev = new Array<number>(b.length + 1);
  let cur = new Array<number>(b.length + 1);
  for (let j = 0; j <= b.length; j++) prev[j] = j;
  for (let i = 1; i <= a.length; i++) {
    cur[0] = i;
    const ca = a.charCodeAt(i - 1);
    for (let j = 1; j <= b.length; j++) {
      const cost = ca === b.charCodeAt(j - 1) ? 0 : 1;
      cur[j] = Math.min(prev[j] + 1, cur[j - 1] + 1, prev[j - 1] + cost);
    }
    [prev, cur] = [cur, prev];
  }
  return prev[b.length];
}

/** Similarity ratio in 0..1: 1 - distance / max(len). Two empty strings are identical (1). */
export function ratio(a: string, b: string): number {
  const n = Math.max(a.length, b.length);
  return n === 0 ? 1 : 1 - levenshtein(a, b) / n;
}

const VOWELS = 'aeiou';
const isVowel = (c: string): boolean => c.length === 1 && VOWELS.includes(c);

/**
 * Metaphone-1 style key for one word, with one accent fold: "th" → T (Mandarin-L1 speakers say d/t), and
 * "ye" at word end treated as a vowel so "bye" / "bai" / "by" / "buy" all key to "B". Vowels survive only
 * at the start of a word (as "A").
 */
export function phoneticWord(word: string): string {
  let w = word.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z]/g, '');
  if (!w) return '';
  if (/^(kn|gn|pn|wr|ae)/.test(w)) w = w.slice(1);
  else if (w.startsWith('x')) w = 's' + w.slice(1);
  else if (w.startsWith('wh')) w = 'w' + w.slice(2);
  const out: string[] = [];
  const last = w.length - 1;
  for (let i = 0; i < w.length; i++) {
    const c = w[i], prev = i > 0 ? w[i - 1] : '', next = i < last ? w[i + 1] : '', next2 = i + 1 < last ? w[i + 2] : '';
    if (c === prev && c !== 'c') continue;
    switch (c) {
      case 'a': case 'e': case 'i': case 'o': case 'u':
        if (i === 0) out.push('A');
        break;
      case 'b':
        if (!(prev === 'm' && i === last)) out.push('B');
        break;
      case 'c':
        if (next === 'i' && next2 === 'a') out.push('X');
        else if (next === 'h') { out.push('X'); i++; }
        else if (next === 'i' || next === 'e' || next === 'y') { if (prev !== 's') out.push('S'); }
        else out.push('K');
        break;
      case 'd':
        if (next === 'g' && (next2 === 'e' || next2 === 'i' || next2 === 'y')) { out.push('J'); i += 2; }
        else out.push('T');
        break;
      case 'g':
        if (next === 'h') {
          if (i === 0) { out.push('K'); i++; }
          else i++; // silent gh ("night", "though")
        } else if (next === 'n' && (i + 1 === last || (next2 === 'e' && i + 2 === last))) {
          // silent g in "sign", "signed"
        } else if (next === 'e' || next === 'i' || next === 'y') out.push('J');
        else out.push('K');
        break;
      case 'h':
        if (isVowel(next) && !'csptg'.includes(prev)) out.push('H');
        break;
      case 'k':
        if (prev !== 'c') out.push('K');
        break;
      case 'p':
        if (next === 'h') { out.push('F'); i++; } else out.push('P');
        break;
      case 'q':
        out.push('K');
        break;
      case 's':
        if (next === 'h') { out.push('X'); i++; }
        else if (next === 'i' && (next2 === 'o' || next2 === 'a')) out.push('X');
        else out.push('S');
        break;
      case 't':
        if (next === 'h') { out.push('T'); i++; } // accent fold: th → T
        else if (next === 'i' && (next2 === 'o' || next2 === 'a')) out.push('X');
        else if (!(next === 'c' && next2 === 'h')) out.push('T');
        break;
      case 'v':
        out.push('F');
        break;
      case 'w':
        if (isVowel(next)) out.push('W');
        break;
      case 'x':
        out.push('K', 'S');
        break;
      case 'y':
        if (isVowel(next) && !(next === 'e' && i + 1 === last)) out.push('Y');
        break;
      case 'z':
        out.push('S');
        break;
      default:
        out.push(c.toUpperCase()); // f j l m n r
    }
  }
  return out.join('');
}

/** Phonetic key of a normalised utterance: per-word keys joined by spaces (word count must match to be equal). */
export function phoneticKey(text: string): string {
  return text.split(' ').map(phoneticWord).filter((k) => k.length > 0).join(' ');
}

interface Candidate { intent: CommandIntent; score: number; matched: string }

/**
 * Classify an utterance as a voice command, a question for the AI, or nothing.
 *
 * - '' after normalisation → 'none'
 * - more than MAX_COMMAND_WORDS words → 'question'
 * - whole-utterance match: utterance ≤ phrase + 6 chars AND (ratio ≥ minRatio OR phonetic keys equal)
 * - prefix match: the first N words match a phrase of N words the same way, and the tail is ≤ 3 words and
 *   no longer than the phrase itself ("i don't know this word" → dont_know; "i know that word already" → question)
 * - confidence < 0.6 → the ratio threshold is raised to 0.85 and phonetic-only matches are not accepted
 * - otherwise 'question'
 */
export function detectCommand(text: string, opts: DetectOptions = {}): Detection {
  const norm = normalize(text);
  if (!norm) return { intent: 'none', score: 0 };
  const words = norm.split(' ');
  if (words.length > MAX_COMMAND_WORDS) return { intent: 'question', score: 0 };

  let minRatio = opts.minRatio ?? DEFAULT_MIN_RATIO;
  const lowConfidence = opts.confidence !== undefined && opts.confidence < LOW_CONFIDENCE;
  if (lowConfidence) minRatio = Math.max(minRatio, LOW_CONFIDENCE_MIN_RATIO);

  const wholeKey = phoneticKey(norm);
  const headKeys = new Map<number, string>();
  const headText = new Map<number, string>();
  const headOf = (n: number): [string, string] => {
    let t = headText.get(n), k = headKeys.get(n);
    if (t === undefined || k === undefined) { t = words.slice(0, n).join(' '); k = phoneticKey(t); headText.set(n, t); headKeys.set(n, k); }
    return [t, k];
  };

  let bestOverall = 0;
  for (const intent of ORDER) {
    let best: Candidate | null = null;
    for (const phrase of PHRASES[intent]) {
      // Whole-utterance match.
      const r = ratio(norm, phrase);
      bestOverall = Math.max(bestOverall, r);
      if (norm.length <= phrase.length + MAX_EXTRA_CHARS) {
        const phon = !lowConfidence && wholeKey === phoneticKey(phrase);
        if (r >= minRatio || phon) {
          const score = phon ? Math.max(r, minRatio) : r;
          if (!best || score > best.score) best = { intent, score, matched: phrase };
          continue;
        }
      }
      // Prefix rule: command phrase at the start, short tail.
      const n = phrase.split(' ').length;
      const tail = words.length - n;
      if (tail <= 0 || tail > MAX_TAIL_WORDS || tail > n) continue;
      const [head, headKey] = headOf(n);
      const hr = ratio(head, phrase);
      const hphon = !lowConfidence && headKey === phoneticKey(phrase);
      if (hr >= minRatio || hphon) {
        const score = hphon ? Math.max(hr, minRatio) : hr;
        if (!best || score > best.score) best = { intent, score, matched: phrase };
      }
    }
    if (best) return best;
  }
  return { intent: 'question', score: bestOverall };
}

export function isCommandIntent(intent: Intent): intent is CommandIntent {
  return intent === 'know' || intent === 'dont_know' || intent === 'bye';
}
```

### `src/core/voice/session.ts` (120 lines)

```ts
/**
 * VoiceSession: joins the STT event stream (main process `stt:event`), the CommandListener and the app's
 * listening modes. Pure TypeScript; the event source is injected so the renderer can pass the IPC
 * subscription and tests can pass fake events.
 *
 * Modes:
 *  - 'commands'     the 5 s commands window at a hard word or after an explanation: "I know" / "I don't know" / "bye bye" fire as
 *                   commands; any other final transcript becomes a `question` for the AI.
 *  - 'conversation' the learner is talking with the tutor: finals become `question`s (including "I know",
 *                   which may be part of an answer); only "bye bye" is still a command.
 *  - 'off'          nothing is emitted (the mic may stay open; events are dropped).
 * "bye bye" switches the mode to 'off' in both active modes.
 * `speechStart` is re-emitted in any active mode so the caller can interrupt the tutor's speech (barge-in).
 */
import { Emitter, CommandListener, type CommandEvent, type CommandListenerOptions, type QuestionEvent } from './turns';

export type VoiceMode = 'commands' | 'conversation' | 'off';

/** One event from the STT engine (main process), as broadcast on the `stt:event` channel. */
export type SttEngineEvent =
  | { type: 'partial' | 'final'; text: string; confidence?: number; segmentId: string; sessionId: string }
  | { type: 'speechStart' | 'speechEnd'; sessionId: string; segmentId: string }
  | { type: 'error'; sessionId: string; message: string };

/** Subscribes `listener`, returns the unsubscribe function (what `window.api.onSttEvent` would return). */
export type SttEventSource = (listener: (ev: SttEngineEvent) => void) => () => void;

export interface VoiceSessionEvents {
  command: (e: CommandEvent) => void;
  question: (e: QuestionEvent) => void;
  speechStart: (e: { sessionId: string; segmentId: string }) => void;
  speechEnd: (e: { sessionId: string; segmentId: string }) => void;
  /** live transcript for the UI */
  partial: (e: { text: string; segmentId: string; sessionId: string }) => void;
  mode: (to: VoiceMode, from: VoiceMode) => void;
  error: (e: { sessionId: string; message: string }) => void;
}

export interface VoiceSessionOptions {
  /** initial mode (default 'off') */
  mode?: VoiceMode;
  /** only events of this STT session are handled (default: all) */
  sessionId?: string;
  /** passed to the CommandListener (debounce, clock, classifier) */
  listener?: CommandListenerOptions;
}

export class VoiceSession extends Emitter<VoiceSessionEvents> {
  readonly listener: CommandListener;
  private _mode: VoiceMode;
  private readonly sessionId: string | undefined;
  private unsubscribe: (() => void) | null = null;

  constructor(opts: VoiceSessionOptions = {}) {
    super();
    this._mode = opts.mode ?? 'off';
    this.sessionId = opts.sessionId;
    this.listener = new CommandListener(opts.listener);
    this.listener.on('command', (cmd) => this.onCommand(cmd));
    this.listener.on('question', (q) => this.emit('question', q));
  }

  get mode(): VoiceMode { return this._mode; }

  setMode(mode: VoiceMode): void {
    const from = this._mode;
    if (from === mode) return;
    this._mode = mode;
    // partials pending from the previous mode must not fire a command in the new one
    this.listener.reset();
    this.emit('mode', mode, from);
  }

  /** Start consuming an event source; returns (and remembers) the unsubscribe function. */
  attach(source: SttEventSource): () => void {
    this.detach();
    const off = source((ev) => this.handle(ev));
    this.unsubscribe = off;
    return () => this.detach();
  }

  detach(): void {
    this.unsubscribe?.();
    this.unsubscribe = null;
  }

  /** Feed one STT engine event (what `attach` does for every event of the source). */
  handle(ev: SttEngineEvent): void {
    if (this.sessionId !== undefined && ev.sessionId !== this.sessionId) return;
    if (ev.type === 'error') { this.emit('error', { sessionId: ev.sessionId, message: ev.message }); return; }
    if (this._mode === 'off') return;
    switch (ev.type) {
      case 'speechStart': this.emit('speechStart', { sessionId: ev.sessionId, segmentId: ev.segmentId }); return;
      case 'speechEnd': this.emit('speechEnd', { sessionId: ev.sessionId, segmentId: ev.segmentId }); return;
      case 'partial':
        if (ev.text.trim()) this.emit('partial', { text: ev.text, segmentId: ev.segmentId, sessionId: ev.sessionId });
        // In conversation mode commands may only come from finals (a partial-fired "I know" would otherwise
        // swallow the segment's final, which has to become a question).
        if (this._mode === 'commands') this.listener.push({ type: 'partial', text: ev.text, confidence: ev.confidence, segmentId: ev.segmentId });
        return;
      case 'final':
        this.listener.push({ type: 'final', text: ev.text, confidence: ev.confidence, segmentId: ev.segmentId });
        return;
    }
  }

  private onCommand(cmd: CommandEvent): void {
    if (cmd.intent === 'bye') {
      this.emit('command', cmd);
      this.setMode('off');
      return;
    }
    if (this._mode === 'conversation') {
      // "I know" while talking with the tutor is an answer, not a command.
      if (cmd.via === 'final') this.emit('question', { text: cmd.text, segmentId: cmd.segmentId });
      return;
    }
    this.emit('command', cmd);
  }
}
```

### `src/core/voice/turns.ts` (235 lines)

```ts
/**
 * Turn-taking glue for the voice loop: a CommandListener that debounces STT partials/finals into at most one
 * command per VAD segment, and a tiny ConversationTurn state machine (idle → listening → thinking → speaking)
 * with barge-in. Pure TypeScript; timing comes from an injectable clock so tests can use fake timers.
 */
import { detectCommand, isCommandIntent, type CommandIntent, type DetectOptions, type Detection } from './commands';

type Listener = (...args: never[]) => void;

/** Minimal typed on/off/emit. */
export class Emitter<E extends { [K in keyof E]: (...args: never[]) => void }> {
  private listeners = new Map<keyof E, Set<Listener>>();

  on<K extends keyof E>(event: K, fn: E[K]): () => void {
    let set = this.listeners.get(event);
    if (!set) { set = new Set(); this.listeners.set(event, set); }
    set.add(fn as Listener);
    return () => this.off(event, fn);
  }

  off<K extends keyof E>(event: K, fn: E[K]): void {
    this.listeners.get(event)?.delete(fn as Listener);
  }

  once<K extends keyof E>(event: K, fn: E[K]): () => void {
    const off = this.on(event, ((...args: Parameters<E[K]>) => { off(); (fn as (...a: Parameters<E[K]>) => void)(...args); }) as E[K]);
    return off;
  }

  protected emit<K extends keyof E>(event: K, ...args: Parameters<E[K]>): void {
    const set = this.listeners.get(event);
    if (!set) return;
    for (const fn of [...set]) (fn as (...a: Parameters<E[K]>) => void)(...args);
  }

  removeAllListeners(): void { this.listeners.clear(); }
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// CommandListener
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

export interface SttEvent {
  type: 'partial' | 'final';
  text: string;
  /** Utterance/word confidence 0..1 when the engine provides one (Deepgram, Parakeet); absent for Whisper/Moonshine. */
  confidence?: number;
  /** VAD segment this transcript belongs to; a command fires at most once per segment. */
  segmentId: string | number;
}

export interface CommandEvent {
  intent: CommandIntent;
  /** Raw transcript text that triggered the command. */
  text: string;
  score: number;
  matched?: string;
  segmentId: string | number;
  /** Whether a final transcript or two agreeing partials fired it. */
  via: 'final' | 'partials';
}

export interface QuestionEvent {
  text: string;
  segmentId: string | number;
  confidence?: number;
}

export interface CommandListenerEvents {
  /** A command was recognised (once per segment, debounced). */
  command: (e: CommandEvent) => void;
  /** A final transcript that is not a command: free conversation for the AI. */
  question: (e: QuestionEvent) => void;
  /** A command was recognised but dropped by the debounce window. */
  suppressed: (e: CommandEvent) => void;
}

export interface CommandListenerOptions {
  /** Minimum gap between two emitted commands in ms (default 1000). */
  debounceMs?: number;
  /** Clock in ms; defaults to Date.now so vitest fake timers work. */
  now?: () => number;
  /** Classifier, defaults to detectCommand (injectable for tests). */
  detect?: (text: string, opts?: DetectOptions) => Detection;
  /** Passed through to the classifier. */
  minRatio?: number;
  /** How many finished segment ids to remember (default 64). */
  remember?: number;
}

/**
 * Consumes STT events and emits `command` once per segment: a `final` fires immediately, partials need two
 * consecutive agreeing partials (same intent in the same segment). A 1 s debounce drops commands that arrive
 * too soon after the previous one. Non-command finals are emitted as `question` so the caller can hand them to
 * the AI; empty finals emit nothing.
 */
export class CommandListener extends Emitter<CommandListenerEvents> {
  private readonly debounceMs: number;
  private readonly now: () => number;
  private readonly detect: (text: string, opts?: DetectOptions) => Detection;
  private readonly minRatio: number | undefined;
  private readonly remember: number;
  private lastFiredAt = Number.NEGATIVE_INFINITY;
  private pending: { segmentId: string; intent: CommandIntent } | null = null;
  private done: string[] = [];

  constructor(opts: CommandListenerOptions = {}) {
    super();
    this.debounceMs = opts.debounceMs ?? 1000;
    this.now = opts.now ?? (() => Date.now());
    this.detect = opts.detect ?? detectCommand;
    this.minRatio = opts.minRatio;
    this.remember = opts.remember ?? 64;
  }

  /** Feed one STT event. Returns the command that was emitted, or null. */
  push(ev: SttEvent): CommandEvent | null {
    const seg = String(ev.segmentId);
    if (this.done.includes(seg)) return null;
    if (this.pending && this.pending.segmentId !== seg) this.pending = null;

    const det = this.detect(ev.text, { confidence: ev.confidence, minRatio: this.minRatio });

    if (isCommandIntent(det.intent)) {
      const agreeing = this.pending !== null && this.pending.segmentId === seg && this.pending.intent === det.intent;
      if (ev.type === 'final' || agreeing) {
        const cmd: CommandEvent = { intent: det.intent, text: ev.text, score: det.score, matched: det.matched, segmentId: ev.segmentId, via: ev.type === 'final' ? 'final' : 'partials' };
        return this.fire(seg, cmd);
      }
      this.pending = { segmentId: seg, intent: det.intent };
      return null;
    }

    this.pending = null;
    if (ev.type === 'final') {
      this.finish(seg);
      if (det.intent === 'question') this.emit('question', { text: ev.text, segmentId: ev.segmentId, confidence: ev.confidence });
    }
    return null;
  }

  /** Forget pending partials and finished segments (e.g. when the mic window closes). */
  reset(): void {
    this.pending = null;
    this.done = [];
  }

  private fire(seg: string, cmd: CommandEvent): CommandEvent | null {
    this.finish(seg);
    const t = this.now();
    if (t - this.lastFiredAt < this.debounceMs) {
      this.emit('suppressed', cmd);
      return null;
    }
    this.lastFiredAt = t;
    this.emit('command', cmd);
    return cmd;
  }

  private finish(seg: string): void {
    this.pending = null;
    this.done.push(seg);
    if (this.done.length > this.remember) this.done.splice(0, this.done.length - this.remember);
  }
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// ConversationTurn
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

export type TurnState = 'idle' | 'listening' | 'thinking' | 'speaking';

export interface ConversationTurnEvents {
  state: (to: TurnState, from: TurnState) => void;
  /** The user started talking while the assistant was thinking/speaking: stop TTS and listen. */
  interrupt: (from: TurnState) => void;
  /** The conversation ended (bye command or caller). */
  bye: (from: TurnState) => void;
}

const TRANSITIONS: Record<TurnState, readonly TurnState[]> = {
  idle: ['listening'],
  listening: ['thinking', 'idle'],
  thinking: ['speaking', 'listening', 'idle'],
  speaking: ['listening', 'idle'],
};

/**
 * idle → listening (mic open) → thinking (AI working) → speaking (TTS) → listening … ; `interrupt()` is the
 * barge-in path when VAD detects speech while the assistant is speaking (or still thinking); `bye()` ends
 * the conversation from any state. Invalid transitions are ignored and return false.
 */
export class ConversationTurn extends Emitter<ConversationTurnEvents> {
  private _state: TurnState = 'idle';

  get state(): TurnState { return this._state; }

  /** Open the mic for the user's turn. From idle, thinking (cancelled) or speaking (finished). */
  listen(): boolean { return this.go('listening'); }
  /** The user's turn ended; the AI is working on a reply. */
  think(): boolean { return this.go('thinking'); }
  /** The reply is being spoken. */
  speak(): boolean { return this.go('speaking'); }
  /** TTS finished naturally: back to listening. */
  done(): boolean { return this._state === 'speaking' && this.go('listening'); }

  /** VAD speech start while the assistant has the floor: cancel and listen. No-op in other states. */
  interrupt(): boolean {
    const from = this._state;
    if (from !== 'speaking' && from !== 'thinking') return false;
    this.go('listening');
    this.emit('interrupt', from);
    return true;
  }

  /** Convenience for wiring a VAD: only interrupts, never starts a turn. */
  onSpeechStart(): boolean { return this.interrupt(); }

  /** End the conversation from any state. */
  bye(): boolean {
    const from = this._state;
    if (from === 'idle') return false;
    this.go('idle');
    this.emit('bye', from);
    return true;
  }

  private go(to: TurnState): boolean {
    const from = this._state;
    if (from === to || !TRANSITIONS[from].includes(to)) return false;
    this._state = to;
    this.emit('state', to, from);
    return true;
  }
}
```

### `src/core/voice/vad.ts` (157 lines)

```ts
/**
 * Speech segmentation on top of a frame-level voice-activity model (Silero): pure TypeScript, fed one speech
 * probability per fixed window (512 samples = 32 ms at 16 kHz) and producing speech start/end events with
 * absolute sample positions. The audio itself is kept elsewhere (see RingBuffer in ./audio.ts).
 *
 * Rules (defaults in the options):
 *  - speech starts when prob ≥ threshold; it is confirmed (speechStart emitted) once it has lasted minSpeechMs,
 *    with padMs of audio before the first speech window included in the segment;
 *  - it ends when prob has stayed < negThreshold (hysteresis) for minSilenceMs; the end is padded by padMs
 *    after the last speech window;
 *  - a segment longer than maxSpeechMs is cut ('max') and, as speech is still going on, a new segment starts
 *    right away;
 *  - flush() ends any open segment ('flush').
 */

export interface SegmenterOptions {
  sampleRate?: number;
  /** samples per probability window (Silero: 512 at 16 kHz) */
  windowSamples?: number;
  /** speech starts at or above this probability (default 0.5) */
  threshold?: number;
  /** speech continues while at or above this (default threshold - 0.15) */
  negThreshold?: number;
  /** shorter bursts are ignored (default 200 ms) */
  minSpeechMs?: number;
  /** silence needed to end a segment (default 600 ms) */
  minSilenceMs?: number;
  /** longest segment (default 15 000 ms) */
  maxSpeechMs?: number;
  /** audio kept before the first / after the last speech window (default 300 ms) */
  padMs?: number;
}

export type SegmentEndReason = 'silence' | 'max' | 'flush';

export type SegmenterEvent =
  | { type: 'speechStart'; segmentId: number; start: number }
  | { type: 'speechEnd'; segmentId: number; start: number; end: number; reason: SegmentEndReason };

type State = 'silence' | 'maybe' | 'speech';

export class SpeechSegmenter {
  readonly windowSamples: number;
  readonly threshold: number;
  readonly negThreshold: number;
  readonly minSpeechSamples: number;
  readonly minSilenceSamples: number;
  readonly maxSpeechSamples: number;
  readonly padSamples: number;
  private state: State = 'silence';
  /** absolute index of the next window's first sample */
  private pos = 0;
  /** unpadded start of the tentative/current segment */
  private speechAt = 0;
  /** padded start of the current segment */
  private segStart = 0;
  /** end of the last window that was speech */
  private lastSpeechEnd = 0;
  /** end of the previous segment (padding never reaches back into it) */
  private prevEnd = 0;
  private nextId = 1;
  private currentId = 0;

  constructor(opts: SegmenterOptions = {}) {
    const sr = opts.sampleRate ?? 16000;
    const ms = (v: number): number => Math.round((v / 1000) * sr);
    this.windowSamples = opts.windowSamples ?? 512;
    this.threshold = opts.threshold ?? 0.5;
    this.negThreshold = opts.negThreshold ?? Math.max(0.01, this.threshold - 0.15);
    this.minSpeechSamples = ms(opts.minSpeechMs ?? 200);
    this.minSilenceSamples = ms(opts.minSilenceMs ?? 600);
    this.maxSpeechSamples = ms(opts.maxSpeechMs ?? 15000);
    this.padSamples = ms(opts.padMs ?? 300);
  }

  /** samples consumed so far (absolute index of the next window) */
  get position(): number { return this.pos; }

  /** The confirmed segment in progress, for partial decodes of [start, position). */
  get active(): { segmentId: number; start: number } | null {
    return this.state === 'speech' ? { segmentId: this.currentId, start: this.segStart } : null;
  }

  get inSpeech(): boolean { return this.state === 'speech'; }

  /** Feed the speech probability of the next window. */
  push(prob: number): SegmenterEvent[] {
    const events: SegmenterEvent[] = [];
    const winStart = this.pos;
    const winEnd = winStart + this.windowSamples;
    this.pos = winEnd;
    const speech = prob >= this.threshold;
    const stillSpeech = prob >= this.negThreshold;

    switch (this.state) {
      case 'silence':
        if (speech) {
          this.state = 'maybe';
          this.speechAt = winStart;
          this.lastSpeechEnd = winEnd;
          if (winEnd - this.speechAt >= this.minSpeechSamples) this.confirm(events);
        }
        break;
      case 'maybe':
        if (stillSpeech) {
          this.lastSpeechEnd = winEnd;
          if (winEnd - this.speechAt >= this.minSpeechSamples) this.confirm(events);
        } else {
          this.state = 'silence';
        }
        break;
      case 'speech':
        if (stillSpeech) this.lastSpeechEnd = winEnd;
        if (winEnd - this.lastSpeechEnd >= this.minSilenceSamples) {
          this.end(events, Math.min(this.lastSpeechEnd + this.padSamples, winEnd), 'silence');
        } else if (winEnd - this.segStart >= this.maxSpeechSamples) {
          this.end(events, winEnd, 'max');
          if (stillSpeech) {
            // speech goes on: open the next segment immediately, without padding into the cut one
            this.state = 'maybe';
            this.speechAt = winEnd;
            this.lastSpeechEnd = winEnd;
            this.confirm(events);
          }
        }
        break;
    }
    return events;
  }

  /** End an open segment at the current position (mic closed, stream stopped). */
  flush(): SegmenterEvent[] {
    const events: SegmenterEvent[] = [];
    if (this.state === 'speech') this.end(events, this.pos, 'flush');
    this.state = 'silence';
    return events;
  }

  /** Forget everything, including the sample position. */
  reset(): void {
    this.state = 'silence';
    this.pos = 0; this.speechAt = 0; this.segStart = 0; this.lastSpeechEnd = 0; this.prevEnd = 0; this.currentId = 0;
  }

  private confirm(events: SegmenterEvent[]): void {
    this.state = 'speech';
    this.currentId = this.nextId++;
    this.segStart = Math.max(this.prevEnd, this.speechAt - this.padSamples);
    events.push({ type: 'speechStart', segmentId: this.currentId, start: this.segStart });
  }

  private end(events: SegmenterEvent[], end: number, reason: SegmentEndReason): void {
    events.push({ type: 'speechEnd', segmentId: this.currentId, start: this.segStart, end, reason });
    this.prevEnd = end;
    this.state = 'silence';
  }
}
```

## 9.6 Mac main process (src/main) and bridge (src/preload)

### `src/main/ai.ts` (294 lines)

```ts
import { ipcMain, BrowserWindow } from 'electron';
import Anthropic from '@anthropic-ai/sdk';
import OpenAI from 'openai';
import { SECRET_NAMES, SECRET_LABELS, type ExplainRequest, type AiEvent, type AiErrorCode, type SecretName, type ProviderTestResult } from '@shared/api';
import { buildPrompt, buildStyledPrompt } from '@core/ai/prompts';
import { resolveStyle } from '@shared/styles';
import type { StyleId } from '@shared/styles';
import type { AiProviderId } from '@shared/settings';
import { getSettings, addUsage, getUsage, usdSpent } from './settings';
import { getSecret, hasSecret, formatWarning, getAzureCredentials } from './secrets';

/** Approximate list prices in USD per million tokens (input, output, cache read). Used only for the in-app cost meter. */
const PRICES: Record<string, [number, number, number]> = {
  'claude-haiku-5-5': [0.10, 0.50, 0.01],
  'claude-sonnet-5-5': [2, 10, 0.20],
  'claude-opus-5-5': [4, 20, 0.20],
  'claude-fable-5-1': [10, 50, 0.25],
  'claude-haiku-4-5': [1, 5, 0.10],
  'gpt-5.4-mini': [0.75, 4.50, 0.075],
  'gpt-5.6-luna': [0.20, 1.20, 0.02],
  'gpt-5.6-terra': [2, 12, 0.20],
  'gpt-5-mini': [0.25, 2, 0.025],
  'gpt-4o-mini': [0.15, 0.60, 0.075],
};

export function estimateUsd(model: string, inputTokens: number, outputTokens: number, cachedTokens: number): number {
  const p = PRICES[model] ?? Object.entries(PRICES).find(([k]) => model.startsWith(k))?.[1] ?? [2, 10, 0.2];
  return ((inputTokens - cachedTokens) * p[0] + outputTokens * p[1] + cachedTokens * p[2]) / 1_000_000;
}

const streams = new Map<string, AbortController>();
let counter = 0;

/** Usage records carry UTC instants; the budgets are per local day and local month, so compare against local midnight. */
export function periodStarts(now = new Date()): { day: string; month: string } {
  return { day: new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), now.getDate()).toISOString(), month: new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), 1).toISOString() };
}

export function registerAiHandlers(getWindow: () => BrowserWindow | null): void {
  const send = (ev: AiEvent) => {
    const win = getWindow();
    if (!win || win.isDestroyed()) return;
    try { win.webContents.send('ai:event', ev); } catch { /* window closed while streaming */ }
  };

  ipcMain.handle('ai:explain', async (_e, req: ExplainRequest) => {
    const streamId = `s${++counter}`;
    const ctrl = new AbortController();
    streams.set(streamId, ctrl);
    // run after returning the id so the renderer can subscribe
    setTimeout(() => runExplain(streamId, req, ctrl, send).finally(() => streams.delete(streamId)), 0);
    return { streamId };
  });
  ipcMain.handle('ai:cancel', async (_e, id: string) => { streams.get(id)?.abort(); });
  ipcMain.handle('ai:usage', async () => getUsage());
  ipcMain.handle('ai:test', async (_e, provider: SecretName) => testProvider(provider));
}

async function runExplain(streamId: string, req: ExplainRequest, ctrl: AbortController, send: (ev: AiEvent) => void): Promise<void> {
  // Everything is inside the try: the renderer waits for a 'done' or 'error' event and nothing else may end the stream.
  try {
    const s = getSettings();
    // word/phrase/sentence explanations use the active explanation style (its own prompt, provider and model)
    const styled = req.kind === 'word' || req.kind === 'phrase' || req.kind === 'sentence';
    const style = styled ? resolveStyle((req.styleId as StyleId) ?? s.ai.activeStyle, s.ai.styles) : null;
    const provider = style?.provider ?? s.ai.provider;
    const model = style?.model ?? (provider === 'anthropic' ? s.ai.anthropicModel : s.ai.openaiModel);
    const key = getSecret(provider);
    if (!key) { send({ type: 'error', streamId, message: provider === 'anthropic' ? 'Add your Anthropic API key in Settings.' : 'Add your OpenAI API key in Settings.', code: 'no_key' }); return; }
    const monthly = usdSpent(periodStarts().month);
    if (s.ai.monthlyStopUsd > 0 && monthly >= s.ai.monthlyStopUsd) {
      send({ type: 'error', streamId, message: `Monthly AI budget of $${s.ai.monthlyStopUsd} reached. Raise it in Settings to continue.`, code: 'budget' });
      return;
    }
    const prompt = style
      ? buildStyledPrompt(req, { style, contextRules: s.ai.contextRules, level: s.learnerLevel, native: 'Chinese' })
      : buildPrompt(req, { level: s.learnerLevel, instructions: s.ai.instructions, length: s.ai.explanationLength });
    const result = provider === 'anthropic'
      ? await streamAnthropic(key, model, prompt, ctrl.signal, (t) => send({ type: 'delta', streamId, text: t }))
      : await streamOpenAI(key, model, prompt, ctrl.signal, (t) => send({ type: 'delta', streamId, text: t }));
    const usd = estimateUsd(model, result.inputTokens, result.outputTokens, result.cachedTokens);
    // a failed usage write must not lose the reply the learner is waiting for
    try { addUsage({ date: new Date().toISOString(), provider, model, inputTokens: result.inputTokens, outputTokens: result.outputTokens, cachedTokens: result.cachedTokens, usd }); } catch (e) { console.error('usage not recorded', e); }
    const { day, month } = periodStarts();
    send({ type: 'done', streamId, text: result.text, usage: { inputTokens: result.inputTokens, outputTokens: result.outputTokens, cachedTokens: result.cachedTokens, usd, dailyUsd: usdSpent(day), monthlyUsd: usdSpent(month), model } });
  } catch (e) {
    send({ type: 'error', streamId, ...classifyError(e) });
  }
}

export interface StreamResult { text: string; inputTokens: number; outputTokens: number; cachedTokens: number }

/**
 * One non-streaming completion with an explicit provider and model (background jobs such as the chapter
 * hints; nothing is shown while it runs). Same request shape and usage accounting as the explanations;
 * the caller records the usage and classifies errors.
 */
export async function runCompletion(provider: AiProviderId, model: string, prompt: { system: string; user: string; maxTokens: number }, signal: AbortSignal = new AbortController().signal): Promise<StreamResult> {
  const key = getSecret(provider);
  if (!key) throw Object.assign(new Error(provider === 'anthropic' ? 'Add your Anthropic API key in Settings.' : 'Add your OpenAI API key in Settings.'), { code: 'no_key' });
  const noop = (): void => { /* nothing is streamed */ };
  return provider === 'anthropic' ? streamAnthropic(key, model, prompt, signal, noop) : streamOpenAI(key, model, prompt, signal, noop);
}

async function streamAnthropic(apiKey: string, model: string, prompt: { system: string; user: string; maxTokens: number }, signal: AbortSignal, onText: (t: string) => void): Promise<StreamResult> {
  const client = new Anthropic({ apiKey, maxRetries: 1, timeout: 60_000 });
  const params = {
    model,
    max_tokens: prompt.maxTokens,
    system: [{ type: 'text' as const, text: prompt.system, cache_control: { type: 'ephemeral' as const } }],
    messages: [{ role: 'user' as const, content: prompt.user }],
    output_config: { effort: 'low' as const },
  };
  // Opus 5.5 / Sonnet 5.5 / Fable: opt into server-side refusal fallbacks so a rare safety decline still yields an answer.
  const wantsFallback = /^claude-(opus-5-5|sonnet-5-5|fable)/.test(model);
  let final: Anthropic.Message | Anthropic.Beta.BetaMessage;
  if (wantsFallback) {
    const stream = client.beta.messages.stream({ ...params, betas: ['server-side-fallback-2026-07-01'], fallbacks: 'default' } as never, { signal });
    stream.on('text', (t: string) => onText(t));
    final = await stream.finalMessage();
  } else {
    const stream = client.messages.stream(params, { signal });
    stream.on('text', (t: string) => onText(t));
    final = await stream.finalMessage();
  }
  const text = (final.content as { type: string; text?: string }[]).filter((b) => b.type === 'text').map((b) => b.text ?? '').join('');
  if (final.stop_reason === 'refusal') throw Object.assign(new Error('The AI declined to answer this request.'), { code: 'other' });
  const u = final.usage;
  return { text, inputTokens: (u.input_tokens ?? 0) + (u.cache_read_input_tokens ?? 0) + (u.cache_creation_input_tokens ?? 0), outputTokens: u.output_tokens ?? 0, cachedTokens: u.cache_read_input_tokens ?? 0 };
}

async function streamOpenAI(apiKey: string, model: string, prompt: { system: string; user: string; maxTokens: number }, signal: AbortSignal, onText: (t: string) => void): Promise<StreamResult> {
  const client = new OpenAI({ apiKey, maxRetries: 1, timeout: 60_000 });
  const stream = await client.chat.completions.create({
    model,
    messages: [{ role: 'system', content: prompt.system }, { role: 'user', content: prompt.user }],
    stream: true,
    stream_options: { include_usage: true },
    max_completion_tokens: prompt.maxTokens + 800,
    ...(/^(gpt-5|o[1-9])/.test(model) ? { reasoning_effort: 'low' as const } : {}),
  }, { signal });
  let text = '';
  let usage = { prompt_tokens: 0, completion_tokens: 0, cached: 0 };
  for await (const chunk of stream) {
    const delta = chunk.choices?.[0]?.delta?.content;
    if (delta) { text += delta; onText(delta); }
    if (chunk.usage) usage = { prompt_tokens: chunk.usage.prompt_tokens, completion_tokens: chunk.usage.completion_tokens, cached: chunk.usage.prompt_tokens_details?.cached_tokens ?? 0 };
  }
  return { text, inputTokens: usage.prompt_tokens, outputTokens: usage.completion_tokens, cachedTokens: usage.cached };
}

export function classifyError(e: unknown, ctx?: { model?: string }): { message: string; code: AiErrorCode } {
  const err = e as { name?: string; status?: number; message?: string; code?: string; cause?: { code?: string; name?: string; message?: string } };
  const msg = err?.message ?? '';
  const causeCode = err?.cause?.code ?? '';
  // AbortSignal.timeout() rejects with a DOMException named TimeoutError whose message also says "aborted": test it first
  if (e instanceof Anthropic.APIConnectionTimeoutError || e instanceof OpenAI.APIConnectionTimeoutError || err?.name === 'TimeoutError' || /timed? ?out|ETIMEDOUT/i.test(msg) || causeCode === 'ETIMEDOUT' || causeCode === 'UND_ERR_CONNECT_TIMEOUT' || causeCode === 'UND_ERR_HEADERS_TIMEOUT') {
    return { message: 'The service did not answer in time. Check your internet connection and try again.', code: 'timeout' };
  }
  if (err?.name === 'AbortError' || err?.code === 'cancelled' || /abort/i.test(msg)) return { message: 'Cancelled', code: 'cancelled' };
  if (e instanceof Anthropic.AuthenticationError || e instanceof OpenAI.AuthenticationError || err?.status === 401) return { message: 'The API key was rejected. Check it in Settings.', code: 'auth' };
  if (e instanceof Anthropic.PermissionDeniedError || e instanceof OpenAI.PermissionDeniedError || err?.status === 403) return { message: 'The API key is not allowed to use this service (permission denied). Check the key\'s permissions in your provider account.', code: 'auth' };
  if (e instanceof Anthropic.RateLimitError || e instanceof OpenAI.RateLimitError || err?.status === 429) {
    const spend = /spend|usage limit|billing|quota|insufficient|credit/i.test(msg);
    return { message: spend ? 'Your API account has no credit left or reached its spending limit.' : 'Too many requests right now; try again in a moment.', code: spend ? 'spend_limit' : 'rate_limit' };
  }
  // Anthropic reports an empty prepaid balance as a 400 ("credit balance is too low")
  if (err?.status === 400 && /usage limit|spend|credit balance|insufficient/i.test(msg)) return { message: 'Your API account has no credit left or reached its spending limit.', code: 'spend_limit' };
  if (e instanceof Anthropic.NotFoundError || e instanceof OpenAI.NotFoundError || err?.status === 404) {
    if (ctx?.model || /model/i.test(msg)) return { message: `Model ${ctx?.model ?? ''} is not available for your key; pick another model.`.replace('Model  is', 'The chosen model is'), code: 'model' };
    return { message: `The service reported "not found" (HTTP 404): ${msg || 'no details'}`, code: 'other' };
  }
  if (err?.status === 529 || err?.status === 503 || err?.status === 502 || /overloaded/i.test(msg)) return { message: 'The AI service is overloaded right now; try again in a moment.', code: 'rate_limit' };
  if (e instanceof Anthropic.APIConnectionError || e instanceof OpenAI.APIConnectionError || /fetch failed|ENOTFOUND|ECONN|EAI_AGAIN|network/i.test(msg) || /ENOTFOUND|ECONN|EAI_AGAIN/.test(causeCode)) return { message: 'No internet connection, or the AI service is unreachable.', code: 'network' };
  return { message: msg || 'Unknown AI error', code: 'other' };
}

const TEST_TIMEOUT_MS = 15_000;

function noKeyMessage(name: SecretName): string { return `No ${SECRET_LABELS[name]} API key is saved yet. Paste it in Settings and click Save.`; }

/**
 * Checks the saved key of any provider with a tiny request. Messages are written for the learner and
 * distinguish: no key saved, key looks wrong, key rejected, no credit, model unavailable, offline,
 * timeout, service overloaded, and anything else (with the raw message in `detail`).
 */
export async function testProvider(provider: SecretName): Promise<ProviderTestResult> {
  if (!SECRET_NAMES.includes(provider)) return { ok: false, message: `Unknown provider "${provider}".` };
  const key = getSecret(provider);
  if (!key) return { ok: false, message: hasSecret(provider) ? `The ${SECRET_LABELS[provider]} key is saved but cannot be decrypted; remove it and paste it again.` : noKeyMessage(provider) };
  const looksWrong = formatWarning(provider, key);
  const result = await runTest(provider, key);
  if (!result.ok && looksWrong && result.code === 'auth') {
    return { ok: false, message: `The key looks wrong: ${looksWrong.replace(/ It was saved anyway; use Test to check it\.$/, '')} Check that you pasted the whole key.`, detail: result.detail ?? result.message };
  }
  return { ok: result.ok, message: result.message, ...(result.detail ? { detail: result.detail } : {}) };
}

type TestOutcome = ProviderTestResult & { code?: AiErrorCode };

async function runTest(provider: SecretName, key: string): Promise<TestOutcome> {
  const s = getSettings();
  try {
    if (provider === 'anthropic') {
      const model = s.ai.anthropicModel;
      const client = new Anthropic({ apiKey: key, maxRetries: 0, timeout: 30_000 });
      const res = await client.messages.create({ model, max_tokens: 20, messages: [{ role: 'user', content: 'Reply with the single word OK.' }] });
      const text = res.content.filter((b): b is Anthropic.TextBlock => b.type === 'text').map((b) => b.text).join('').trim();
      return { ok: true, message: `Connected. ${res.model} replied: ${text.slice(0, 40)}` };
    }
    if (provider === 'openai') {
      const model = s.ai.openaiModel;
      const client = new OpenAI({ apiKey: key, maxRetries: 0, timeout: 30_000 });
      const res = await client.chat.completions.create({ model, messages: [{ role: 'user', content: 'Reply with the single word OK.' }], max_completion_tokens: 20 });
      return { ok: true, message: `Connected. ${res.model} replied: ${(res.choices[0]?.message?.content ?? '').trim().slice(0, 40)}` };
    }
    if (provider === 'elevenlabs') return await testElevenLabs(key);
    if (provider === 'azure') return await testAzure(key);
    return await testGoogle(key);
  } catch (e) {
    const model = provider === 'anthropic' ? s.ai.anthropicModel : provider === 'openai' ? s.ai.openaiModel : undefined;
    const c = classifyError(e, { model });
    const raw = (e as { message?: string })?.message;
    return { ok: false, message: c.code === 'other' ? `Unexpected error from ${SECRET_LABELS[provider]}: ${raw || 'no details'}` : c.message, code: c.code, ...(raw ? { detail: raw } : {}) };
  }
}

async function readBody(res: Response): Promise<string> { try { return (await res.text()).slice(0, 2000); } catch { return ''; } }

/** Shared HTTP outcomes for the voice services; `specific` handles the provider's own status meanings first. */
function httpFailure(label: string, status: number, body: string): TestOutcome {
  const detail = body ? `HTTP ${status}: ${body}` : `HTTP ${status}`;
  if (status === 401) return { ok: false, message: `${label} rejected the key (HTTP 401). Check it and paste it again.`, code: 'auth', detail };
  if (status === 403) return { ok: false, message: `${label} says this key is not allowed to use the service (HTTP 403). Check the key's permissions or quota in your ${label} account.`, code: 'auth', detail };
  if (status === 429) {
    const spend = /quota|credit|billing|limit|exhausted/i.test(body);
    return { ok: false, message: spend ? `Your ${label} account has no credit left or reached its usage limit.` : `${label} is receiving too many requests right now; try again in a moment.`, code: spend ? 'spend_limit' : 'rate_limit', detail };
  }
  if (status === 402) return { ok: false, message: `Your ${label} account has no credit left or reached its spending limit.`, code: 'spend_limit', detail };
  if (status === 404) return { ok: false, message: `${label} replied "not found" (HTTP 404); the service address may have changed. Update the app or try again later.`, code: 'other', detail };
  if (status === 502 || status === 503 || status === 529) return { ok: false, message: `${label} is overloaded or down for maintenance right now; try again in a moment.`, code: 'rate_limit', detail };
  if (status >= 500) return { ok: false, message: `${label} reported a server error (HTTP ${status}); try again in a moment.`, code: 'rate_limit', detail };
  return { ok: false, message: `Unexpected reply from ${label} (HTTP ${status}): ${body.slice(0, 200) || 'no details'}`, code: 'other', detail };
}

async function testElevenLabs(key: string): Promise<TestOutcome> {
  const res = await fetch('https://api.elevenlabs.io/v1/user', { headers: { 'xi-api-key': key }, signal: AbortSignal.timeout(TEST_TIMEOUT_MS) });
  const body = await readBody(res);
  if (!res.ok) return httpFailure('ElevenLabs', res.status, body);
  let sub: { tier?: string; character_count?: number; character_limit?: number } = {};
  try { sub = (JSON.parse(body) as { subscription?: typeof sub }).subscription ?? {}; } catch { /* unexpected shape; still connected */ }
  const used = sub.character_count ?? 0, limit = sub.character_limit ?? 0;
  if (limit > 0 && used >= limit) return { ok: false, message: `The ElevenLabs key works, but the monthly character allowance is used up (${used.toLocaleString()} of ${limit.toLocaleString()}). Voices will fail until it resets or you upgrade the plan.`, code: 'spend_limit' };
  const facts = [sub.tier ? `${sub.tier} plan` : '', limit > 0 ? `${used.toLocaleString()} of ${limit.toLocaleString()} characters used this month` : ''].filter(Boolean);
  return { ok: true, message: `Connected to ElevenLabs${facts.length ? ` (${facts.join(', ')})` : ''}.` };
}

async function testAzure(value: string): Promise<TestOutcome> {
  const creds = getAzureCredentials();
  if (!creds) return { ok: false, message: 'The Azure entry could not be read. Paste the key and region again.', code: 'auth', detail: value.startsWith('{') ? 'JSON could not be parsed' : 'empty' };
  const host = `${creds.region}.api.cognitive.microsoft.com`;
  let res: Response;
  try {
    res = await fetch(`https://${host}/sts/v1.0/issueToken`, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key': creds.key, 'Content-Length': '0' }, signal: AbortSignal.timeout(TEST_TIMEOUT_MS) });
  } catch (e) {
    const err = e as { cause?: { code?: string; hostname?: string } };
    if (err?.cause?.code === 'ENOTFOUND' && err.cause.hostname === host) return { ok: false, message: `Azure region "${creds.region}" does not exist. Check the region of your Speech resource (for example "uksouth").`, code: 'auth', detail: `ENOTFOUND ${host}` };
    throw e;
  }
  const body = await readBody(res);
  if (res.ok) return { ok: true, message: `Connected to Azure Speech in region "${creds.region}".` };
  if (res.status === 401) return { ok: false, message: `Azure rejected the key (HTTP 401). Check the key, and that the region "${creds.region}" matches your Speech resource.`, code: 'auth', detail: `HTTP 401: ${body}` };
  if (res.status === 403) return { ok: false, message: 'Azure says this key is out of quota or the resource is disabled (HTTP 403). Check the Speech resource in the Azure portal.', code: 'spend_limit', detail: `HTTP 403: ${body}` };
  return httpFailure('Azure Speech', res.status, body);
}

async function testGoogle(key: string): Promise<TestOutcome> {
  const res = await fetch(`https://texttospeech.googleapis.com/v1/voices?key=${encodeURIComponent(key)}&languageCode=en-GB`, { signal: AbortSignal.timeout(TEST_TIMEOUT_MS) });
  const body = await readBody(res);
  if (res.ok) {
    let n = 0;
    try { n = ((JSON.parse(body) as { voices?: unknown[] }).voices ?? []).length; } catch { /* still connected */ }
    return { ok: true, message: `Connected to Google Cloud Text-to-Speech (${n} British English voices available).` };
  }
  const detail = `HTTP ${res.status}: ${body}`;
  let reason = '', message = '';
  try { const err = (JSON.parse(body) as { error?: { message?: string; status?: string; details?: { reason?: string }[] } }).error; reason = err?.details?.map((d) => d.reason ?? '').join(' ') ?? ''; message = err?.message ?? ''; if (!reason) reason = err?.status ?? ''; } catch { message = body; }
  if (res.status === 400 && /API key not valid|API_KEY_INVALID/i.test(`${reason} ${message}`)) return { ok: false, message: 'Google rejected the key (API key not valid). Check it and paste it again.', code: 'auth', detail };
  if (res.status === 403 && /SERVICE_DISABLED|has not been used|is disabled|not enabled/i.test(`${reason} ${message}`)) return { ok: false, message: 'The Cloud Text-to-Speech API is not enabled for this key\'s project. Enable it in the Google Cloud console, wait a minute, then test again.', code: 'auth', detail };
  if (res.status === 403 && /BILLING|billing/i.test(`${reason} ${message}`)) return { ok: false, message: 'Google says billing is not enabled or has no credit for this project. Enable billing in the Google Cloud console.', code: 'spend_limit', detail };
  if (res.status === 403) return { ok: false, message: 'Google says this key may not call the Text-to-Speech API (permission denied). Edit the key\'s API restrictions in the Google Cloud console.', code: 'auth', detail };
  if (res.status === 429) return { ok: false, message: 'Google says the quota for this project is used up (HTTP 429). Check quotas and billing in the Google Cloud console.', code: 'spend_limit', detail };
  return httpFailure('Google Cloud', res.status, body);
}
```
