```ts
/**
 * Text preparation for Kokoro: splits the original text into word / punctuation pieces that keep their
 * character offsets, and normalises each word the way kokoro-js does (titles, currency, decimals, years,
 * clock times) so espeak-ng reads them naturally. Offsets stay those of the ORIGINAL text, which is what
 * the renderer highlights.
 */

export interface Piece {
  /** 'word' pieces are spoken; 'punct' pieces become prosody tokens; 'break' separates chunks (sentence end) */
  kind: 'word' | 'punct';
  /** text to phonemize (normalised); for punct: the vocab character(s) */
  spoken: string;
  /** offsets in the original text (UTF-16 units) */
  charIndex: number;
  charLength: number;
}

/** Punctuation characters Kokoro's vocabulary knows (prosody tokens). */
const VOCAB_PUNCT = new Set([';', ':', ',', '.', '!', '?', '—', '…', '"', '«', '»', '“', '”', '(', ')', '{', '}', '[', ']']);

const PUNCT_MAP: Record<string, string> = { '‘': '', '’': '', '(': '«', ')': '»', '[': '«', ']': '»', '{': '«', '}': '»', '“': '"', '”': '"', '«': '"', '»': '"', '、': ',', '。': '.', '！': '!', '，': ',', '：': ':', '；': ';', '？': '?', '–': '—', '-': '—', ';': ';' };

const TITLES: Record<string, string> = { mr: 'Mister', mrs: 'Missus', ms: 'Miss', dr: 'Doctor', st: 'Saint', prof: 'Professor', jr: 'Junior', sr: 'Senior', vs: 'versus', etc: 'etcetera' };

/** Words (letters/digits with inner apostrophes/hyphens, optional currency prefix, decimals and clock times) or single punctuation marks. */
const PIECE_RE = /[$£]?\p{N}[\p{N},]*(?:[.:]\p{N}+)?(?:s\b)?|[\p{L}\p{N}][\p{L}\p{N}'’]*(?:-[\p{L}\p{N}][\p{L}\p{N}'’]*)*\.?|[;:,.!?¡¿—–…"«»“”(){}\[\]]/gu;

export function splitPieces(text: string): Piece[] {
  const out: Piece[] = [];
  let m: RegExpExecArray | null;
  PIECE_RE.lastIndex = 0;
  while ((m = PIECE_RE.exec(text))) {
    const raw = m[0];
    if (/^[\p{L}\p{N}$£]/u.test(raw)) {
      let word = raw;
      let len = raw.length;
      // a trailing full stop belongs to the sentence unless the word is an abbreviation (Mr. Dr. etc.)
      if (word.endsWith('.')) {
        const base = word.slice(0, -1);
        if (TITLES[base.toLowerCase()] || /^(?:[A-Za-z]\.)+[A-Za-z]$/.test(base)) { word = base; }
        else { word = base; len -= 1; PIECE_RE.lastIndex -= 1; }
      }
      const spoken = normalizeWord(word, text.slice(m.index + raw.length, m.index + raw.length + 2));
      if (spoken) out.push({ kind: 'word', spoken, charIndex: m.index, charLength: len });
      continue;
    }
    const mapped = PUNCT_MAP[raw] ?? raw;
    if (mapped && VOCAB_PUNCT.has(mapped)) {
      const last = out[out.length - 1];
      // collapse runs of sentence punctuation ("?!", "...") into one token so the model sees a single pause
      if (last && last.kind === 'punct' && last.charIndex + last.charLength === m.index && /[.!?…]/.test(mapped) && /[.!?…]/.test(last.spoken)) { last.charLength += raw.length; if (mapped !== '.') last.spoken = mapped; continue; }
      out.push({ kind: 'punct', spoken: mapped, charIndex: m.index, charLength: raw.length });
    }
  }
  return out;
}

/** Expands a single word the way a reader would say it. `after` is the next two characters (for "Dr. X"). */
export function normalizeWord(word: string, after = ''): string {
  const w = word.replace(/[’]/g, "'");
  const lower = w.toLowerCase();
  if (TITLES[lower] && (lower !== 'st' || /^ [A-Z]/.test(after))) return TITLES[lower];
  if (/^[$£]/.test(w)) return money(w);
  if (/^\d+:\d\d$/.test(w)) return clock(w);
  if (/^\d[\d,]*(?:\.\d+)?s?$/.test(w)) return w.includes(',') ? w.replace(/,/g, '') : number(w);
  if (/^(?:[A-Za-z]\.)+[A-Za-z]\.?$/.test(w)) return w.replace(/\./g, ' ').trim().split(' ').join(' ');
  if (/^[A-Z]{2,5}$/.test(w) && !/^(?:OK|TV|UK|USA|US|UN|EU|NATO|NASA|BBC|CNN|DNA|FBI|CIA|GPS|PhD|AM|PM)$/.test(w)) return w.split('').join(' ');
  return w;
}

function number(w: string): string {
  const plural = w.endsWith('s') ? 's' : '';
  const n = plural ? w.slice(0, -1) : w;
  if (n.includes('.')) { const [a, b] = n.split('.'); return `${a} point ${b.split('').join(' ')}${plural}`; }
  const v = parseInt(n, 10);
  // years: 1100..1999 and 2010..2099 read in pairs ("nineteen ninety-nine", "twenty twenty")
  if (n.length === 4 && ((v >= 1100 && v <= 1999) || (v >= 2010 && v <= 2099)) && v % 100 !== 0) {
    const hi = n.slice(0, 2), lo = parseInt(n.slice(2), 10);
    return lo < 10 ? `${hi} oh ${lo}${plural}` : `${hi} ${lo}${plural}`;
  }
  if (n.length === 4 && v >= 1100 && v <= 1999 && v % 100 === 0) return `${n.slice(0, 2)} hundred${plural}`;
  return n + (plural ? ' s' : '');
}

function clock(w: string): string {
  const [h, m] = w.split(':').map(Number);
  if (m === 0) return `${h} o'clock`;
  if (m < 10) return `${h} oh ${m}`;
  return `${h} ${m}`;
}

function money(w: string): string {
  const unit = w[0] === '$' ? 'dollar' : 'pound';
  const cents = w[0] === '$' ? ['cent', 'cents'] : ['penny', 'pence'];
  const rest = w.slice(1).replace(/,/g, '');
  if (!/^\d/.test(rest)) return w;
  if (!rest.includes('.')) return `${rest} ${unit}${rest === '1' ? '' : 's'}`;
  const [a, b] = rest.split('.');
  const c = parseInt(b.padEnd(2, '0').slice(0, 2), 10);
  return `${a} ${unit}${a === '1' ? '' : 's'}${c ? ` and ${c} ${c === 1 ? cents[0] : cents[1]}` : ''}`;
}

/** Sentence-end punctuation, where long texts are cut into model-sized chunks. */
export function isBreak(piece: Piece): boolean { return piece.kind === 'punct' && /[.!?…]/.test(piece.spoken); }
```

```ts
/** 16-bit PCM WAV encoding/decoding (mono). */
export function encodeWav(pcm: Float32Array, sampleRate: number): Buffer {
  const buf = Buffer.alloc(44 + pcm.length * 2);
  buf.write('RIFF', 0); buf.writeUInt32LE(36 + pcm.length * 2, 4); buf.write('WAVE', 8);
  buf.write('fmt ', 12); buf.writeUInt32LE(16, 16); buf.writeUInt16LE(1, 20); buf.writeUInt16LE(1, 22);
  buf.writeUInt32LE(sampleRate, 24); buf.writeUInt32LE(sampleRate * 2, 28); buf.writeUInt16LE(2, 32); buf.writeUInt16LE(16, 34);
  buf.write('data', 36); buf.writeUInt32LE(pcm.length * 2, 40);
  for (let i = 0; i < pcm.length; i++) {
    const s = Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, pcm[i]));
    buf.writeInt16LE(Math.round(s < 0 ? s * 32768 : s * 32767), 44 + i * 2);
  }
  return buf;
}

export function decodeWav(buf: Buffer): { pcm: Int16Array; sampleRate: number } {
  if (buf.toString('ascii', 0, 4) !== 'RIFF' || buf.toString('ascii', 8, 12) !== 'WAVE') throw new Error('not a WAV file');
  let pos = 12; let sampleRate = 24000; let data: Buffer | null = null;
  while (pos + 8 <= buf.length) {
    const id = buf.toString('ascii', pos, pos + 4); const size = buf.readUInt32LE(pos + 4);
    if (id === 'fmt ') sampleRate = buf.readUInt32LE(pos + 12);
    if (id === 'data') { data = buf.subarray(pos + 8, pos + 8 + size); break; }
    pos += 8 + size + (size & 1);
  }
  if (!data) throw new Error('WAV without data chunk');
  const pcm = new Int16Array(data.length >> 1);
  for (let i = 0; i < pcm.length; i++) pcm[i] = data.readInt16LE(i * 2);
  return { pcm, sampleRate };
}

/** Joins mono 16-bit PCM WAV files (same sample rate) into one. */
export function concatWav(parts: Buffer[], sampleRate: number): { wav: Buffer; pcm: Int16Array } {
  const pcms = parts.map((p) => decodeWav(p).pcm);
  const pcm = new Int16Array(pcms.reduce((n, p) => n + p.length, 0));
  let off = 0;
  for (const p of pcms) { pcm.set(p, off); off += p.length; }
  const wav = Buffer.alloc(44 + pcm.length * 2);
  wav.write('RIFF', 0); wav.writeUInt32LE(36 + pcm.length * 2, 4); wav.write('WAVE', 8);
  wav.write('fmt ', 12); wav.writeUInt32LE(16, 16); wav.writeUInt16LE(1, 20); wav.writeUInt16LE(1, 22);
  wav.writeUInt32LE(sampleRate, 24); wav.writeUInt32LE(sampleRate * 2, 28); wav.writeUInt16LE(2, 32); wav.writeUInt16LE(16, 34);
  wav.write('data', 36); wav.writeUInt32LE(pcm.length * 2, 40);
  Buffer.from(pcm.buffer, pcm.byteOffset, pcm.byteLength).copy(wav, 44);
  return { wav, pcm };
}
```

```ts
import { dialog, BrowserWindow } from 'electron';
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { createHash } from 'node:crypto';
import zlib from 'node:zlib';
import type { Book, Position } from '@core/model';
import type { LibraryItem } from '@shared/settings';
import type { DictData } from '@shared/api';
import type { Dictionary } from '@core/dict/types';
import { JsonStore, booksDir, writeAtomic, readJsonFile } from './storage';
import { loadTextModules } from './text-modules';
import { resourcesDir } from './paths';

const libraryStore = new JsonStore<{ items: LibraryItem[] }>('library', () => ({ items: [] }));

let dictData: DictData | null = null;
let dictionary: Dictionary | null = null;

export async function getDictData(): Promise<DictData> {
  if (dictData) return dictData;
  const file = path.join(resourcesDir(), 'dict', 'dict.json.gz');
  const raw = zlib.gunzipSync(fs.readFileSync(file)).toString('utf8');
  dictData = JSON.parse(raw) as DictData;
  return dictData;
}

export async function getDictionary(): Promise<Dictionary> {
  if (dictionary) return dictionary;
  const mods = await loadTextModules();
  dictionary = mods.createDictionary(await getDictData());
  return dictionary;
}

export function listLibrary(): LibraryItem[] {
  return [...libraryStore.get().items].sort((a, b) => (b.lastOpenedAt > a.lastOpenedAt ? 1 : -1));
}

function bookFile(id: string): string { return path.join(booksDir(), `${id}.json.gz`); }

export function loadBook(id: string): Book | null {
  try {
    const raw = zlib.gunzipSync(fs.readFileSync(bookFile(id))).toString('utf8');
    const book = JSON.parse(raw) as Book;
    libraryStore.update((lib) => ({ items: lib.items.map((it) => (it.id === id ? { ...it, lastOpenedAt: new Date().toISOString() } : it)) }));
    return book;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

export function removeBook(id: string): void {
  try { fs.unlinkSync(bookFile(id)); } catch { /* ignore */ }
  libraryStore.update((lib) => ({ items: lib.items.filter((it) => it.id !== id) }));
}

export function saveProgress(id: string, position: Position, percent: number): void {
  libraryStore.update((lib) => ({ items: lib.items.map((it) => (it.id === id ? { ...it, position, percent, lastOpenedAt: new Date().toISOString() } : it)) }));
}

async function finishImport(book: Book): Promise<Book> {
  const mods = await loadTextModules();
  const dict = await getDictionary();
  book.names = mods.detectNames(book, dict);
  writeAtomic(bookFile(book.id), zlib.gzipSync(Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(book), 'utf8')));
  const item: LibraryItem = {
    id: book.id, title: book.title, author: book.author, kind: book.source.kind,
    addedAt: book.source.importedAt, lastOpenedAt: new Date().toISOString(), position: null, percent: 0, words: book.stats.words,
  };
  libraryStore.update((lib) => ({ items: [...lib.items.filter((it) => it.id !== book.id), item] }));
  return book;
}

export async function importFile(filePath: string): Promise<Book> {
  const mods = await loadTextModules();
  const bytes = fs.readFileSync(filePath);
  const id = createHash('sha256').update(bytes).digest('hex').slice(0, 24);
  const existing = loadBook(id);
  if (existing) return existing;
  const ext = path.extname(filePath).toLowerCase();
  const importer = ext === '.epub' ? mods.importers.epub : ext === '.pdf' ? mods.importers.pdf : mods.importers.text;
  const ctx = { segmenter: mods.createSegmenter(), id, sourcePath: filePath };
  const book = await importer.importBytes(new Uint8Array(bytes), ctx);
  if (!book.title) book.title = path.basename(filePath, ext);
  return finishImport(book);
}

export async function importText(title: string, text: string): Promise<Book> {
  const mods = await loadTextModules();
  const id = createHash('sha256').update(text).digest('hex').slice(0, 24);
  const existing = loadBook(id);
  if (existing) return existing;
  const book = await mods.textToBook(title || 'Pasted text', text, { segmenter: mods.createSegmenter(), id });
  return finishImport(book);
}

export async function importBookDialog(win: BrowserWindow | null): Promise<Book | null> {
  const opts: Electron.OpenDialogOptions = { title: 'Open a book', properties: ['openFile'], filters: [{ name: 'Books', extensions: ['epub', 'pdf', 'txt', 'md'] }] };
  const res = win ? await dialog.showOpenDialog(win, opts) : await dialog.showOpenDialog(opts);
  if (res.canceled || res.filePaths.length === 0) return null;
  return importFile(res.filePaths[0]);
}

export function libraryFileFor(id: string): string | null { return readJsonFile(bookFile(id)) ? bookFile(id) : null; }
```

```ts
import { app } from 'electron';
import path from 'node:path';
import fs from 'node:fs';

/** resources/ (dictionary data) lives next to the app in development and under process.resourcesPath when packaged. */
export function resourcesDir(): string {
  const candidates = [
    path.join(process.resourcesPath ?? '', 'resources'),
    path.join(app.getAppPath(), 'resources'),
    path.join(__dirname, '..', '..', 'resources'),
  ];
  for (const c of candidates) if (c && fs.existsSync(path.join(c, 'dict', 'dict.json.gz'))) return c;
  return candidates[1];
}

export function rendererDir(): string { return path.join(__dirname, '..', 'renderer'); }
export function preloadPath(): string { return path.join(__dirname, '..', 'preload', 'index.js'); }

/** Name of the data folder the app used before it was renamed to Dream Read. */
export const LEGACY_APP_NAME = 'ReadAlong';

/**
 * The product rename moved userData from ".../ReadAlong" to ".../Dream Read". On the first start with the new
 * name, when the new folder has no data/ yet and the old one does, the old data/ (settings, library, books,
 * vocab, usage, secrets.json and secret.key) is copied over once. The old folder is left untouched.
 * Returns the source folder when a copy happened, null otherwise.
 */
export function migrateLegacyUserData(): string | null {
  try {
    const target = path.join(app.getPath('userData'), 'data');
    if (fs.existsSync(target)) return null;
    const legacy = path.join(app.getPath('appData'), LEGACY_APP_NAME, 'data');
    if (!fs.existsSync(legacy) || path.resolve(legacy) === path.resolve(target)) return null;
    fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(target), { recursive: true });
    fs.cpSync(legacy, target, { recursive: true, errorOnExist: false, force: false });
    try { fs.chmodSync(path.join(target, 'secret.key'), 0o600); } catch { /* no key file */ }
    console.log(`data: copied the ${LEGACY_APP_NAME} data folder to ${target}`);
    return legacy;
  } catch (e) {
    console.error('data: could not copy the old data folder', e);
    return null;
  }
}

/** ~/Documents/Dream Read: where exports (vocabulary CSV) are written. Created on demand. */
export function exportDir(): string {
  const dir = path.join(app.getPath('documents'), 'Dream Read');
  fs.mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
  return dir;
}
```

```ts
import { net, protocol } from 'electron';
import path from 'node:path';
import { pathToFileURL } from 'node:url';

export const APP_SCHEME = 'app';

/** Must run before app.whenReady(). Serves dist/renderer as app://-/ with a secure, fetch-capable origin. */
export function registerAppScheme(): void {
  protocol.registerSchemesAsPrivileged([
    { scheme: APP_SCHEME, privileges: { standard: true, secure: true, supportFetchAPI: true, corsEnabled: true, stream: true } },
  ]);
}

/** Must run after app.whenReady(). */
export function installAppProtocol(rendererDir: string): void {
  protocol.handle(APP_SCHEME, (request) => {
    const url = new URL(request.url);
    let rel = decodeURIComponent(url.pathname);
    if (rel === '/' || rel === '') rel = '/index.html';
    const target = path.normalize(path.join(rendererDir, rel));
    if (!target.startsWith(rendererDir)) return new Response('forbidden', { status: 403 });
    return net.fetch(pathToFileURL(target).toString());
  });
}
```

```ts
import { safeStorage } from 'electron';
import crypto from 'node:crypto';
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { SECRET_NAMES, SECRET_LABELS, type SecretName, type SecretStatus, type SecretStatusMap } from '@shared/api';
import { dataDir, writeAtomic } from './storage';

export type { SecretName, SecretStatus, SecretStatusMap };

/**
 * API keys are encrypted with AES-256-GCM under a random key that lives next to them in the app's own
 * data folder (`<userData>/data/secret.key`, mode 0600). This deliberately does not use Electron's
 * safeStorage: that ties the Keychain item to the app's code signature, and this app is unsigned and
 * re-signed ad hoc, so every re-sign or update made the saved keys unreadable ("the app forgets my key").
 *
 * File layout (secrets.json): { [name]: { v: 2, iv, tag, data } } with base64 fields.
 * Records in the pre-v2 format ({ enc: true|false, data }) are migrated on first load: those that still
 * decrypt with safeStorage are re-encrypted, the others are dropped and reported through
 * secretStatus().lostAtStartup so the UI can ask for the key again, once.
 *
 * The azure secret is a JSON string {"key": "...", "region": "..."}; a plain key string is tolerated
 * and then the region defaults to DEFAULT_AZURE_REGION. See getAzureCredentials().
 */

interface RecordV2 { v: 2; iv: string; tag: string; data: string }
interface RecordV1 { enc: boolean; data: string }
type AnyRecord = RecordV2 | RecordV1;

interface State {
  records: Partial<Record<SecretName, RecordV2>>;
  lost: Set<SecretName>;
  /** cached contents of secret.key */
  key: Buffer | null;
}

const DEFAULT_AZURE_REGION = 'uksouth';
const KEY_BYTES = 32;

let state: State | null = null;

export function secretsFilePath(): string { return path.join(dataDir(), 'secrets.json'); }
export function keyFilePath(): string { return path.join(dataDir(), 'secret.key'); }

/** Forgets the in-memory cache so the next call re-reads the files (tests, or after userData changes). */
export function resetSecretsCache(): void { state = null; }

function isV2(rec: AnyRecord | undefined): rec is RecordV2 {
  return !!rec && (rec as RecordV2).v === 2 && typeof (rec as RecordV2).iv === 'string' && typeof (rec as RecordV2).tag === 'string' && typeof (rec as RecordV2).data === 'string';
}

function readRawFile(): Partial<Record<string, AnyRecord>> {
  try {
    const parsed = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(secretsFilePath(), 'utf8'));
    return parsed && typeof parsed === 'object' ? parsed : {};
  } catch { return {}; }
}

/** Loads (or creates) the 32-byte master key. The file is created with mode 0600 and the mode is re-asserted on every load. */
function loadKey(st: State): Buffer {
  if (st.key) return st.key;
  const file = keyFilePath();
  let key: Buffer | null = null;
  try {
    const existing = fs.readFileSync(file);
    if (existing.length === KEY_BYTES) key = existing;
    else console.error(`secrets: ${file} has an unexpected size (${existing.length} bytes); a new key will be generated and stored keys will not decrypt`);
  } catch { /* no key yet */ }
  if (!key) {
    key = crypto.randomBytes(KEY_BYTES);
    const tmp = `${file}.${process.pid}.tmp`;
    fs.writeFileSync(tmp, key, { mode: 0o600 });
    fs.renameSync(tmp, file);
  }
  try { if (process.platform !== 'win32') fs.chmodSync(file, 0o600); } catch { /* best effort */ }
  st.key = key;
  return key;
}

function encrypt(st: State, plain: string): RecordV2 {
  const iv = crypto.randomBytes(12);
  const cipher = crypto.createCipheriv('aes-256-gcm', loadKey(st), iv);
  const data = Buffer.concat([cipher.update(plain, 'utf8'), cipher.final()]);
  return { v: 2, iv: iv.toString('base64'), tag: cipher.getAuthTag().toString('base64'), data: data.toString('base64') };
}

function decrypt(st: State, rec: RecordV2): string | null {
  try {
    const decipher = crypto.createDecipheriv('aes-256-gcm', loadKey(st), Buffer.from(rec.iv, 'base64'));
    decipher.setAuthTag(Buffer.from(rec.tag, 'base64'));
    return Buffer.concat([decipher.update(Buffer.from(rec.data, 'base64')), decipher.final()]).toString('utf8');
  } catch { return null; }
}

function persist(st: State): void {
  writeAtomic(secretsFilePath(), JSON.stringify(st.records, null, 1));
}

/** Reads secrets.json once, migrating pre-v2 records. Never logs or returns key values. */
function load(): State {
  if (state) return state;
  const st: State = { records: {}, lost: new Set(), key: null };
  const raw = readRawFile();
  let changed = false;
  for (const name of SECRET_NAMES) {
    const rec = raw[name];
    if (!rec) continue;
    if (isV2(rec)) { st.records[name] = rec; continue; }
    changed = true;
    const old = rec as RecordV1;
    let plain: string | null = null;
    try {
      plain = old.enc ? safeStorage.decryptString(Buffer.from(old.data, 'base64')) : Buffer.from(old.data, 'base64').toString('utf8');
    } catch { plain = null; }
    if (plain) {
      st.records[name] = encrypt(st, plain);
      console.log(`secrets: migrated the ${name} key from the Keychain format`);
    } else {
      st.lost.add(name);
      console.error(`secrets: the ${name} key could not be read from the Keychain (app re-signed?); it was dropped and must be pasted again`);
    }
  }
  state = st;
  if (changed) persist(st);
  return st;
}

/**
 * Decrypts every stored key, drops the unreadable ones (reported as lostAtStartup) and logs a one-line summary.
 * Called once after app ready; safe to call again.
 */
export function checkSecrets(): SecretStatusMap {
  const st = load();
  let changed = false;
  const parts: string[] = [];
  for (const name of SECRET_NAMES) {
    const rec = st.records[name];
    if (!rec) { parts.push(`${name}=${st.lost.has(name) ? 'lost' : 'none'}`); continue; }
    if (decrypt(st, rec) === null) {
      delete st.records[name];
      st.lost.add(name);
      changed = true;
      parts.push(`${name}=lost`);
    } else parts.push(`${name}=ok`);
  }
  if (changed) persist(st);
  console.log(`secrets: ${parts.join(' ')} (${secretsFilePath()})`);
  return secretStatus();
}

/** Removes leading/trailing whitespace; inside a plain key (not JSON) also removes line breaks a PDF or email wrap may have added. */
export function normalizeSecret(value: string): string {
  const t = (value ?? '').trim();
  if (t.startsWith('{')) return t;
  return t.replace(/\s+/g, '');
}

/** A short, user-facing warning when a key does not look like what the service issues; null when it looks fine. */
export function formatWarning(name: SecretName, value: string): string | null {
  const v = normalizeSecret(value);
  switch (name) {
    case 'anthropic':
      return v.startsWith('sk-ant-') ? null : 'This does not look like an Anthropic key: they start with "sk-ant-". It was saved anyway; use Test to check it.';
    case 'openai':
      if (v.startsWith('sk-ant-')) return 'This looks like an Anthropic key, not an OpenAI key. It was saved anyway; use Test to check it.';
      return v.startsWith('sk-') ? null : 'This does not look like an OpenAI key: they start with "sk-". It was saved anyway; use Test to check it.';
    case 'elevenlabs':
      return /^(sk_)?[0-9a-f]{32,}$/i.test(v) ? null : 'This does not look like an ElevenLabs key: they are 32 or more hexadecimal characters (newer ones start with "sk_"). It was saved anyway; use Test to check it.';
    case 'azure': {
      const creds = parseAzure(v);
      if (!creds) return 'The Azure entry could not be read. Paste the key, or a JSON object {"key": "...", "region": "uksouth"}. It was saved anyway; use Test to check it.';
      if (!/^[A-Za-z0-9]{32,}$/.test(creds.key)) return 'This does not look like an Azure Speech key: they are 32 or more letters and digits. It was saved anyway; use Test to check it.';
      if (!/^[a-z0-9]+$/.test(creds.region)) return `"${creds.region}" does not look like an Azure region (for example "uksouth" or "westeurope"). It was saved anyway; use Test to check it.`;
      return null;
    }
    case 'google':
      return /^AIza[0-9A-Za-z_-]{35}$/.test(v) ? null : 'This does not look like a Google Cloud API key: they start with "AIza" and are 39 characters long. It was saved anyway; use Test to check it.';
  }
}

function parseAzure(value: string): { key: string; region: string } | null {
  const v = value.trim();
  if (!v) return null;
  if (v.startsWith('{')) {
    try {
      const o = JSON.parse(v) as { key?: unknown; region?: unknown };
      const key = typeof o.key === 'string' ? o.key.trim() : '';
      const region = typeof o.region === 'string' && o.region.trim() ? o.region.trim().toLowerCase() : DEFAULT_AZURE_REGION;
      return key ? { key, region } : null;
    } catch { return null; }
  }
  return { key: v, region: DEFAULT_AZURE_REGION };
}

/** The Azure Speech key and region, or null when no Azure secret is saved. */
export function getAzureCredentials(): { key: string; region: string } | null {
  const v = getSecret('azure');
  return v ? parseAzure(v) : null;
}

/**
 * Saves a key (an empty value removes it). The value is written, read back from disk and decrypted; a
 * mismatch throws so the UI never shows "saved" for a key that would be forgotten. Resolves with a
 * warning string when the key does not look like what the service issues (it is still saved).
 */
export function setSecret(name: SecretName, value: string): { warning: string | null } {
  if (!SECRET_NAMES.includes(name)) throw new Error(`Unknown secret "${name}"`);
  const st = load();
  const v = normalizeSecret(value);
  if (!v) {
    delete st.records[name];
    st.lost.delete(name);
    persist(st);
    return { warning: null };
  }
  const rec = encrypt(st, v);
  st.records[name] = rec;
  persist(st);
  // verify: fresh read from disk, decrypt, compare
  const onDisk = readRawFile()[name];
  const back = isV2(onDisk) ? decrypt(st, onDisk) : null;
  if (back !== v) {
    delete st.records[name];
    try { persist(st); } catch { /* the folder is probably unwritable; nothing more to do */ }
    throw new Error(`The ${SECRET_LABELS[name]} key was written but could not be read back from ${secretsFilePath()}. Check that the folder is writable and not synced or locked by another program, then try again.`);
  }
  st.lost.delete(name);
  return { warning: formatWarning(name, v) };
}

export function getSecret(name: SecretName): string | null {
  const st = load();
  const rec = st.records[name];
  return rec ? decrypt(st, rec) : null;
}

export function hasSecret(name: SecretName): boolean { return !!load().records[name]; }

export function secretStatus(): SecretStatusMap {
  const st = load();
  const out = {} as SecretStatusMap;
  for (const name of SECRET_NAMES) {
    const rec = st.records[name];
    out[name] = { saved: !!rec, verified: !!rec && decrypt(st, rec) !== null, lostAtStartup: st.lost.has(name) };
  }
  return out;
}

/** The user has seen the "could not be recovered" notices; stop reporting them for this session. */
export function dismissLostKeys(): void { load().lost.clear(); }
```

```ts
import type { Settings, VocabState, WordStatus, MarkedRange, UsageRecord } from '@shared/settings';
import { DEFAULT_SETTINGS, migrateSettings } from '@shared/settings';
import { JsonStore } from './storage';

const settingsStore = new JsonStore<Settings>('settings', () => structuredClone(DEFAULT_SETTINGS));
const vocabStore = new JsonStore<VocabState>('vocab', () => ({ words: {}, marked: {} }));
const usageStore = new JsonStore<{ records: UsageRecord[] }>('usage', () => ({ records: [] }));

/** Recursively merges patch over base: nested plain objects merge, arrays and scalars replace. Exported for tests. */
export function deepMerge<T>(base: T, patch: Partial<T>): T {
  const out: Record<string, unknown> = { ...(base as Record<string, unknown>) };
  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(patch as Record<string, unknown>)) {
    const cur = out[k];
    if (v && typeof v === 'object' && !Array.isArray(v) && cur && typeof cur === 'object' && !Array.isArray(cur)) out[k] = deepMerge(cur, v as never);
    else out[k] = v;
  }
  return out as T;
}

/** Stored settings over the defaults, so every field added in a later version has a value; old theme ids are migrated. */
export function getSettings(): Settings { return migrateSettings(deepMerge(structuredClone(DEFAULT_SETTINGS), migrateSettings(settingsStore.get()))); }
export function setSettings(patch: Partial<Settings>): Settings {
  const next = migrateSettings(deepMerge(getSettings(), migrateSettings(patch)));
  settingsStore.set(next);
  return next;
}

export function getVocab(): VocabState { return vocabStore.get(); }
export function setWordStatus(lemma: string, status: WordStatus | null): void {
  vocabStore.update((v) => {
    const words = { ...v.words };
    if (status) words[lemma] = status; else delete words[lemma];
    return { ...v, words };
  });
}
export function setMarkedRanges(bookId: string, ranges: MarkedRange[]): void {
  vocabStore.update((v) => ({ ...v, marked: { ...v.marked, [bookId]: ranges } }));
}

export function addUsage(rec: UsageRecord): void {
  usageStore.update((u) => ({ records: [...u.records.slice(-5000), rec] }));
}
export function getUsage(): UsageRecord[] { return usageStore.get().records; }
export function usdSpent(sinceIso: string): number {
  return usageStore.get().records.filter((r) => r.date >= sinceIso).reduce((s, r) => s + r.usd, 0);
}
```

### `src/main/storage.ts` (52 lines)

```ts
import { app } from 'electron';
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';

/** Small JSON-file store under userData with atomic writes. One file per collection. */
export class JsonStore<T> {
  private cache: T | null = null;
  constructor(private name: string, private defaults: () => T) {}
  /** resolved lazily: stores are created at import time, before main/index.ts may redirect userData */
  private get file(): string { return path.join(dataDir(), `${this.name}.json`); }
  get(): T {
    if (this.cache) return this.cache;
    try {
      const raw = fs.readFileSync(this.file, 'utf8');
      this.cache = { ...this.defaults(), ...JSON.parse(raw) } as T;
    } catch {
      this.cache = this.defaults();
    }
    return this.cache;
  }
  set(value: T): void {
    this.cache = value;
    writeAtomic(this.file, JSON.stringify(value, null, 1));
  }
  update(fn: (current: T) => T): T {
    const next = fn(this.get());
    this.set(next);
    return next;
  }
}

export function dataDir(): string {
  const dir = path.join(app.getPath('userData'), 'data');
  fs.mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
  return dir;
}

export function booksDir(): string {
  const dir = path.join(dataDir(), 'books');
  fs.mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
  return dir;
}

export function writeAtomic(file: string, contents: string | Buffer): void {
  const tmp = `${file}.${process.pid}.tmp`;
  fs.writeFileSync(tmp, contents);
  fs.renameSync(tmp, file);
}

export function readJsonFile<T>(file: string): T | null {
  try { return JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(file, 'utf8')) as T; } catch { return null; }
}
```

```ts
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import crypto from 'node:crypto';
import { pipeline } from 'node:stream/promises';
import { Readable, Transform } from 'node:stream';
import unbzip2 from 'unbzip2-stream';
import { extractTar } from './tar';

/**
 * Speech-to-text model files, downloaded on first use into <userData>/models/stt/. All of them are GitHub
 * release assets of k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx (tag "asr-models"), pinned by size and sha256 (computed from the
 * assets downloaded on 2026-10-19). The archives are .tar.bz2 (bzip2 is not in Node's zlib, so a pure-JS
 * decoder streams them: ~4 MB/s, i.e. ~35 s for the default model, once).
 *
 * Variants (measured on a 4-core x86 Xeon 2.8 GHz, sherpa-onnx 1.13.8 / its onnxruntime 1.28, 3 threads):
 *  - moonshine-base  Moonshine v2 base, int8 "quantized" (2026-02-27 release): 111 MB download, 135 MB on
 *                    disk, ~300 MB RSS, RTF ≈ 0.06 (a 6 s sentence decodes in ~0.35 s). English only.
 *                    No token confidences. DEFAULT.
 *  - moonshine-tiny  30 MB download, 43 MB on disk, ~170 MB RSS, RTF ≈ 0.04; noticeably weaker on accents.
 *  - parakeet-v3     NVIDIA Parakeet TDT 0.6B v3 int8 (25 European languages, best accented-English
 *                    accuracy, per-token log-probs → confidence): 487 MB download, 641 MB on disk, ~930 MB
 *                    RSS, RTF ≈ 0.3 on the 4-core Intel (a 6 s sentence takes ~1.8 s), fine on Apple Silicon.
 */
export type SttVariant = 'moonshine-base' | 'moonshine-tiny' | 'parakeet-v3';

export interface ModelFile { name: string; url: string; size: number; sha256: string }

export interface SttModelSpec {
  variant: SttVariant;
  kind: 'moonshine' | 'nemo_transducer';
  archive: ModelFile;
  /** the directory inside the archive (and under the model dir) */
  dir: string;
  /** files needed at runtime, relative to `dir`, with their sizes */
  files: { name: string; size: number }[];
  /** bytes on disk after extraction */
  diskBytes: number;
}

const RELEASE = 'https://github.com/k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx/releases/download/asr-models';

export const VAD_FILE: ModelFile = { name: 'silero_vad.onnx', url: `${RELEASE}/silero_vad.onnx`, size: 643854, sha256: '9e2449e1087496d8d4caba907f23e0bd3f78d91fa552479bb9c23ac09cbb1fd6' };

export const MODELS: Record<SttVariant, SttModelSpec> = {
  'moonshine-base': {
    variant: 'moonshine-base', kind: 'moonshine',
    archive: { name: 'sherpa-onnx-moonshine-base-en-quantized-2026-02-27.tar.bz2', url: `${RELEASE}/sherpa-onnx-moonshine-base-en-quantized-2026-02-27.tar.bz2`, size: 111266225, sha256: '43232c1d13013d37317163baec3135bd771a186a4356f28c889bab453bb0e891' },
    dir: 'sherpa-onnx-moonshine-base-en-quantized-2026-02-27',
    files: [{ name: 'encoder_model.ort', size: 31326816 }, { name: 'decoder_model_merged.ort', size: 109424400 }, { name: 'tokens.txt', size: 549350 }],
    diskBytes: 141313910,
  },
  'moonshine-tiny': {
    variant: 'moonshine-tiny', kind: 'moonshine',
    archive: { name: 'sherpa-onnx-moonshine-tiny-en-quantized-2026-02-27.tar.bz2', url: `${RELEASE}/sherpa-onnx-moonshine-tiny-en-quantized-2026-02-27.tar.bz2`, size: 29858559, sha256: '9ec31b342d8fa3240c3b81b8f82e1cf7e3ac467c93ca5a999b741d5887164f8d' },
    dir: 'sherpa-onnx-moonshine-tiny-en-quantized-2026-02-27',
    files: [{ name: 'encoder_model.ort', size: 13281600 }, { name: 'decoder_model_merged.ort', size: 30412256 }, { name: 'tokens.txt', size: 549350 }],
    diskBytes: 44256550,
  },
  'parakeet-v3': {
    variant: 'parakeet-v3', kind: 'nemo_transducer',
    archive: { name: 'sherpa-onnx-nemo-parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v3-int8.tar.bz2', url: `${RELEASE}/sherpa-onnx-nemo-parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v3-int8.tar.bz2`, size: 487170055, sha256: '5793d0fd397c5778d2cf2126994d58e9d56b1be7c04d13c7a15bb1b4eafb16bf' },
    dir: 'sherpa-onnx-nemo-parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v3-int8',
    files: [{ name: 'encoder.int8.onnx', size: 652184281 }, { name: 'decoder.int8.onnx', size: 11845275 }, { name: 'joiner.int8.onnx', size: 6355277 }, { name: 'tokens.txt', size: 93939 }],
    diskBytes: 670478772,
  },
};

export const DEFAULT_VARIANT: SttVariant = 'moonshine-base';

/** Bumped whenever the pinned model files change. */
export const MODEL_VERSION = 'sherpa-onnx-1.13.8/asr-models-2026-10-19';

export function isVariant(v: unknown): v is SttVariant { return typeof v === 'string' && v in MODELS; }

export interface DownloadProgress {
  phase: 'download' | 'extract' | 'done';
  file: string;
  received: number;
  total: number;
  /** all downloads together (archive + VAD), bytes */
  overallReceived: number;
  overallTotal: number;
}

export function vadPresent(dir: string): boolean { return sizeIs(path.join(dir, VAD_FILE.name), VAD_FILE.size); }

export function modelPresent(dir: string, variant: SttVariant): boolean {
  const spec = MODELS[variant];
  return spec.files.every((f) => sizeIs(path.join(dir, spec.dir, f.name), f.size));
}

/** Both the recogniser files of `variant` and the VAD model are on disk. */
export function isPresent(dir: string, variant: SttVariant): boolean { return vadPresent(dir) && modelPresent(dir, variant); }

/** The preferred variant when complete, else any complete one, else null. */
export function presentVariant(dir: string, preferred: SttVariant): SttVariant | null {
  if (!vadPresent(dir)) return null;
  for (const v of [preferred, ...(Object.keys(MODELS) as SttVariant[])]) if (modelPresent(dir, v)) return v;
  return null;
}

export function downloadBytes(dir: string, variant: SttVariant): number {
  return (vadPresent(dir) ? 0 : VAD_FILE.size) + (modelPresent(dir, variant) ? 0 : MODELS[variant].archive.size);
}

function sizeIs(file: string, size: number): boolean { try { return fs.statSync(file).size === size; } catch { return false; } }

/**
 * Downloads what is missing for `variant` (the VAD model and the recogniser archive), resuming partial
 * `.part` files with Range requests, verifying sha256, then extracts the archive (only the runtime files and
 * the LICENSE) and deletes it. `signal` aborts; progress is reported after every chunk.
 */
export async function downloadModel(dir: string, variant: SttVariant, onProgress?: (p: DownloadProgress) => void, signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<void> {
  fs.mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
  const spec = MODELS[variant];
  const needVad = !vadPresent(dir);
  const needModel = !modelPresent(dir, variant);
  const overallTotal = (needVad ? VAD_FILE.size : 0) + (needModel ? spec.archive.size : 0);
  let done = 0;
  if (needVad) {
    await downloadFile(VAD_FILE, path.join(dir, VAD_FILE.name), (received) => onProgress?.({ phase: 'download', file: VAD_FILE.name, received, total: VAD_FILE.size, overallReceived: done + received, overallTotal }), signal);
    done += VAD_FILE.size;
  }
  if (needModel) {
    const archive = path.join(dir, spec.archive.name);
    if (!sizeIs(archive, spec.archive.size)) {
      await downloadFile(spec.archive, archive, (received) => onProgress?.({ phase: 'download', file: spec.archive.name, received, total: spec.archive.size, overallReceived: done + received, overallTotal }), signal);
    }
    done += spec.archive.size;
    const wanted = new Set(spec.files.map((f) => `${spec.dir}/${f.name}`));
    wanted.add(`${spec.dir}/LICENSE`);
    const input = fs.createReadStream(archive, { signal });
    await extractTar(input.pipe(unbzip2()), dir, {
      filter: (e) => wanted.has(e.name),
      onProgress: (written) => onProgress?.({ phase: 'extract', file: spec.dir, received: written, total: spec.diskBytes, overallReceived: done, overallTotal }),
    });
    if (!modelPresent(dir, variant)) throw new Error(`${spec.archive.name}: extracted files are incomplete`);
    fs.rmSync(archive, { force: true });
  }
  onProgress?.({ phase: 'done', file: '', received: 0, total: 0, overallReceived: overallTotal, overallTotal });
}

async function downloadFile(f: ModelFile, target: string, onProgress: (received: number) => void, signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<void> {
  const part = `${target}.part`;
  let have = 0;
  try { have = fs.statSync(part).size; } catch { /* no partial file */ }
  if (have >= f.size) { have = 0; fs.rmSync(part, { force: true }); }
  const headers: Record<string, string> = { 'user-agent': 'DreamRead (Electron; speech model download)' };
  if (have > 0) headers.range = `bytes=${have}-`;
  const res = await fetch(f.url, { headers, signal, redirect: 'follow' });
  if (have > 0 && res.status !== 206) { have = 0; fs.rmSync(part, { force: true }); }
  if (!res.ok || !res.body) throw new Error(`download of ${f.name} failed: HTTP ${res.status}`);
  const total = have + Number(res.headers.get('content-length') ?? 0);
  if (total && total !== f.size) throw new Error(`download of ${f.name}: unexpected size ${total} (expected ${f.size})`);
  let received = have;
  const counter = new Transform({ transform(chunk: Buffer, _enc, cb) { received += chunk.length; onProgress(received); cb(null, chunk); } });
  await pipeline(Readable.fromWeb(res.body as never), counter, fs.createWriteStream(part, { flags: have > 0 ? 'a' : 'w' }), { signal });
  if (fs.statSync(part).size !== f.size) throw new Error(`download of ${f.name} incomplete (${fs.statSync(part).size} of ${f.size} bytes)`);
  const hash = await sha256File(part);
  if (hash !== f.sha256) { fs.rmSync(part, { force: true }); throw new Error(`${f.name}: checksum mismatch (got ${hash})`); }
  fs.renameSync(part, target);
}

export function sha256File(file: string): Promise<string> {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const h = crypto.createHash('sha256');
    fs.createReadStream(file).on('data', (c) => h.update(c)).on('end', () => resolve(h.digest('hex'))).on('error', reject);
  });
}
```

```ts
import fs from 'node:fs';
import os from 'node:os';
import path from 'node:path';
import type { OfflineRecognizer, OfflineRecognizerConfig, OfflineRecognizerResult } from 'sherpa-onnx-node';
import { Emitter } from '@core/voice/turns';
import { SpeechSegmenter, type SegmenterOptions } from '@core/voice/vad';
import { RingBuffer, Resampler, int16ToFloat32 } from '@core/voice/audio';
import type { SttEngineEvent } from '@core/voice/session';
import { SileroModel, SileroState, VAD_SAMPLE_RATE, VAD_WINDOW } from './silero';
import { downloadModel, presentVariant, downloadBytes, isVariant, MODELS, VAD_FILE, DEFAULT_VARIANT, MODEL_VERSION, type SttVariant, type DownloadProgress } from './download';

export type { SttEngineEvent } from '@core/voice/session';
export type { SttVariant, DownloadProgress } from './download';

export type EngineState = 'missing' | 'downloading' | 'loading' | 'ready' | 'error';

export interface EngineStatus {
  state: EngineState;
  variant: SttVariant;
  modelDir: string;
  /** bytes still to download for the configured variant (archive + VAD; 0 when installed) */
  downloadBytes: number;
  progress: DownloadProgress | null;
  error: string | null;
  /** open mic sessions */
  sessions: number;
  version: string;
  /** whether the recogniser reports per-utterance confidence (Parakeet yes, Moonshine no) */
  confidence: boolean;
}

export interface SttEngineOptions {
  modelDir: string;
  variant?: SttVariant;
  /** sherpa-onnx intra-op threads for the recogniser; default: cores - 1, between 2 and 4 */
  threads?: number;
  /** VAD segmentation (see SpeechSegmenter); defaults: 600 ms silence, 15 s max, 300 ms pad */
  vad?: SegmenterOptions;
  /** how often (ms of audio) a partial transcript of the segment in progress is decoded; 0 disables (default 900) */
  partialEveryMs?: number;
  /** a segment must be at least this long before partials start (default 1200) */
  partialMinMs?: number;
  /** seconds of audio kept per session for slicing segments (default 25) */
  bufferSeconds?: number;
  /** download the model when start() finds it missing (default true) */
  autoDownload?: boolean;
  log?: (msg: string) => void;
}

export interface StartOptions { sampleRate?: number }

export interface RecognizeResult { text: string; confidence?: number; durationSec: number; decodeMs: number }

export interface SttEngineEvents {
  /** transcripts, speech start/end and errors, per session */
  event: (e: SttEngineEvent) => void;
  /** every status change (download progress, state changes) */
  status: (s: EngineStatus) => void;
}

interface Session {
  id: string;
  sampleRate: number;
  resampler: Resampler | null;
  /** samples waiting for a full VAD window */
  carry: Float32Array;
  ring: RingBuffer;
  segmenter: SpeechSegmenter;
  vadState: SileroState;
  /** serialises the async VAD runs so windows are processed in order */
  chain: Promise<void>;
  /** sample position of the last partial decode */
  lastPartialAt: number;
  lastPartialText: string;
  /** a partial decode queued or running for the current segment */
  partialQueued: boolean;
  stopped: boolean;
}

interface DecodeJob { session: Session; segmentId: number; kind: 'partial' | 'final'; samples: Float32Array }

/**
 * Free, local, offline speech-to-text for the voice tutor: Silero VAD (onnxruntime-node) cuts the 16 kHz
 * mic stream into utterances, sherpa-onnx (Moonshine v2 base int8 by default, or Parakeet TDT 0.6B v3)
 * recognises each one. Moonshine is an offline model, so "partials" are decodes of the segment so far,
 * every `partialEveryMs` of audio once it is `partialMinMs` long; the final comes ~600 ms (the end-of-speech
 * silence) + decode time after the learner stops talking. Only one decode runs at a time (sherpa's worker
 * thread); a final always takes precedence over partials and a newer partial replaces an older queued one.
 */
export class SttEngine extends Emitter<SttEngineEvents> {
  readonly modelDir: string;
  readonly variant: SttVariant;
  private readonly threads: number;
  private readonly vadOptions: SegmenterOptions;
  private readonly partialEvery: number;
  private readonly partialMin: number;
  private readonly bufferSeconds: number;
  private readonly autoDownload: boolean;
  private readonly log: (msg: string) => void;
  private sherpa: typeof import('sherpa-onnx-node') | null = null;
  private recognizer: OfflineRecognizer | null = null;
  private vad: SileroModel | null = null;
  private loadedVariant: SttVariant | null = null;
  private readyPromise: Promise<void> | null = null;
  private downloadPromise: Promise<void> | null = null;
  private downloadAbort: AbortController | null = null;
  private progress: DownloadProgress | null = null;
  private lastError: string | null = null;
  private sessions = new Map<string, Session>();
  private queue: DecodeJob[] = [];
  private decoding = false;
  private decodeIdle: Promise<void> = Promise.resolve();
  private decodeDone: (() => void) | null = null;

  constructor(opts: SttEngineOptions) {
    super();
    this.modelDir = opts.modelDir;
    const env = process.env.STT_VARIANT;
    this.variant = opts.variant ?? (isVariant(env) ? env : DEFAULT_VARIANT);
    this.threads = opts.threads ?? Math.max(2, Math.min(4, os.cpus().length - 1));
    this.vadOptions = { sampleRate: VAD_SAMPLE_RATE, windowSamples: VAD_WINDOW, minSilenceMs: 600, maxSpeechMs: 15000, padMs: 300, ...opts.vad };
    this.partialEvery = Math.round(((opts.partialEveryMs ?? 900) / 1000) * VAD_SAMPLE_RATE);
    this.partialMin = Math.round(((opts.partialMinMs ?? 1200) / 1000) * VAD_SAMPLE_RATE);
    this.bufferSeconds = opts.bufferSeconds ?? 25;
    this.autoDownload = opts.autoDownload ?? true;
    this.log = opts.log ?? (() => undefined);
  }

  /** The variant on disk (the configured one, or any complete one), else null. */
  get installedVariant(): SttVariant | null { return presentVariant(this.modelDir, this.variant); }

  status(): EngineStatus {
    const installed = this.installedVariant;
    const state: EngineState = this.downloadPromise ? 'downloading' : this.lastError ? 'error' : this.recognizer ? 'ready' : this.readyPromise ? 'loading' : installed ? 'ready' : 'missing';
    const variant = this.loadedVariant ?? installed ?? this.variant;
    return {
      state, variant, modelDir: this.modelDir, downloadBytes: downloadBytes(this.modelDir, this.variant),
      progress: this.progress, error: this.lastError, sessions: this.sessions.size, version: MODEL_VERSION,
      confidence: MODELS[variant].kind === 'nemo_transducer',
    };
  }

  private emitStatus(): void { this.emit('status', this.status()); }

  /** Downloads the VAD and recogniser files if missing. Safe to call repeatedly; resumes partial files. */
  download(): Promise<void> {
    if (this.installedVariant === this.variant) return Promise.resolve();
    if (this.downloadPromise) return this.downloadPromise;
    this.downloadAbort = new AbortController();
    this.lastError = null;
    this.downloadPromise = downloadModel(this.modelDir, this.variant, (p) => { this.progress = p; this.emitStatus(); }, this.downloadAbort.signal)
      .catch((e) => { this.lastError = (e as Error).message; throw e; })
      .finally(() => { this.downloadPromise = null; this.downloadAbort = null; this.progress = null; this.emitStatus(); });
    this.emitStatus();
    return this.downloadPromise;
  }

  cancelDownload(): void { this.downloadAbort?.abort(); }

  /** Loads the recogniser and the VAD (downloading first when `autoDownload`). */
  ensureReady(autoDownload = this.autoDownload): Promise<void> {
    if (this.recognizer && this.vad) return Promise.resolve();
    if (this.readyPromise) return this.readyPromise;
    this.readyPromise = (async () => {
      if (!this.installedVariant) {
        if (!autoDownload) throw new Error('The speech recognition model has not been downloaded yet.');
        await this.download();
      }
      const variant = this.installedVariant;
      if (!variant) throw new Error('Speech model files are missing.');
      this.emitStatus();
      const t0 = Date.now();
      const sherpa = await loadSherpa();
      this.sherpa = sherpa;
      const [recognizer, vad] = await Promise.all([
        sherpa.OfflineRecognizer.createAsync(this.recognizerConfig(variant)),
        SileroModel.load(path.join(this.modelDir, VAD_FILE.name)),
      ]);
      this.recognizer = recognizer; this.vad = vad; this.loadedVariant = variant;
      this.lastError = null;
      this.log(`stt: ${variant} loaded in ${Date.now() - t0} ms (sherpa-onnx ${sherpa.version}, ${this.threads} threads)`);
      this.emitStatus();
    })().catch((e) => { this.lastError = (e as Error).message; this.readyPromise = null; this.emitStatus(); throw e; });
    return this.readyPromise;
  }

  private recognizerConfig(variant: SttVariant): OfflineRecognizerConfig {
    const spec = MODELS[variant];
    const dir = path.join(this.modelDir, spec.dir);
    const base = { tokens: path.join(dir, 'tokens.txt'), numThreads: this.threads, provider: 'cpu', debug: 0 };
    if (spec.kind === 'moonshine') {
      return { featConfig: { sampleRate: VAD_SAMPLE_RATE, featureDim: 80 }, modelConfig: { ...base, moonshine: { encoder: path.join(dir, 'encoder_model.ort'), mergedDecoder: path.join(dir, 'decoder_model_merged.ort') } }, decodingMethod: 'greedy_search' };
    }
    return {
      featConfig: { sampleRate: VAD_SAMPLE_RATE, featureDim: 80 },
      modelConfig: { ...base, modelType: 'nemo_transducer', transducer: { encoder: path.join(dir, 'encoder.int8.onnx'), decoder: path.join(dir, 'decoder.int8.onnx'), joiner: path.join(dir, 'joiner.int8.onnx') } },
      decodingMethod: 'greedy_search',
    };
  }

  async release(): Promise<void> {
    for (const id of [...this.sessions.keys()]) await this.stop(id);
    await this.vad?.release();
    this.vad = null; this.recognizer = null; this.loadedVariant = null; this.readyPromise = null;
  }

  // ---- sessions -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  /** Opens a mic session. Audio pushed later is mono PCM at `sampleRate` (default 16000; others are resampled). */
  async start(sessionId: string, opts: StartOptions = {}): Promise<void> {
    if (this.sessions.has(sessionId)) throw new Error(`stt: session "${sessionId}" is already open`);
    await this.ensureReady();
    const sampleRate = opts.sampleRate ?? VAD_SAMPLE_RATE;
    if (!(sampleRate >= 8000 && sampleRate <= 192000)) throw new Error(`stt: unsupported sample rate ${sampleRate}`);
    const s: Session = {
      id: sessionId, sampleRate,
      resampler: sampleRate === VAD_SAMPLE_RATE ? null : new Resampler(sampleRate, VAD_SAMPLE_RATE),
      carry: new Float32Array(0),
      ring: new RingBuffer(this.bufferSeconds * VAD_SAMPLE_RATE),
      segmenter: new SpeechSegmenter(this.vadOptions),
      vadState: new SileroState(),
      chain: Promise.resolve(),
      lastPartialAt: 0, lastPartialText: '', partialQueued: false, stopped: false,
    };
    this.sessions.set(sessionId, s);
    this.emitStatus();
  }

  /** Feeds audio (Float32 -1..1 or Int16) to an open session. Returns once the VAD has consumed it. */
  pushAudio(sessionId: string, data: Float32Array | Int16Array): Promise<void> {
    const s = this.sessions.get(sessionId);
    if (!s || s.stopped) return Promise.reject(new Error(`stt: session "${sessionId}" is not open`));
    let pcm = data instanceof Int16Array ? int16ToFloat32(data) : data;
    if (s.resampler) pcm = s.resampler.process(pcm);
    const buf = s.carry.length ? concat(s.carry, pcm) : pcm;
    const whole = buf.length - (buf.length % VAD_WINDOW);
    s.carry = buf.subarray(whole).slice();
    const windows = buf.subarray(0, whole);
    if (!windows.length) return s.chain;
    s.ring.write(windows);
    s.chain = s.chain.then(() => this.runVad(s, windows)).catch((e) => this.fail(s, e as Error));
    return s.chain;
  }

  /** Closes a session: an utterance still open is finalised; resolves after its final transcript was emitted. */
  async stop(sessionId: string): Promise<void> {
    const s = this.sessions.get(sessionId);
    if (!s) return;
    s.stopped = true;
    await s.chain.catch(() => undefined);
    if (s.resampler) { const tail = s.resampler.flush(); if (tail.length) s.ring.write(tail); }
    for (const ev of s.segmenter.flush()) this.onSegmentEvent(s, ev);
    this.sessions.delete(sessionId);
    await this.decodeIdle;
    this.emitStatus();
  }

  private async runVad(s: Session, windows: Float32Array): Promise<void> {
    const vad = this.vad;
    if (!vad) return;
    for (let i = 0; i + VAD_WINDOW <= windows.length; i += VAD_WINDOW) {
      if (s.stopped) return;
      const prob = await vad.process(windows.subarray(i, i + VAD_WINDOW), s.vadState);
      for (const ev of s.segmenter.push(prob)) this.onSegmentEvent(s, ev);
      const active = s.segmenter.active;
      if (active && this.partialEvery > 0) {
        const pos = s.segmenter.position;
        if (pos - active.start >= this.partialMin && pos - s.lastPartialAt >= this.partialEvery && !s.partialQueued) {
          s.lastPartialAt = pos;
          s.partialQueued = true;
          this.enqueue({ session: s, segmentId: active.segmentId, kind: 'partial', samples: s.ring.slice(active.start, pos) });
        }
      }
    }
  }

  private onSegmentEvent(s: Session, ev: ReturnType<SpeechSegmenter['push']>[number]): void {
    const segmentId = `${s.id}:${ev.segmentId}`;
    if (ev.type === 'speechStart') {
      s.lastPartialAt = ev.start; s.lastPartialText = '';
      this.emit('event', { type: 'speechStart', sessionId: s.id, segmentId });
      return;
    }
    this.emit('event', { type: 'speechEnd', sessionId: s.id, segmentId });
    // a final supersedes any partial still queued for this segment
    this.queue = this.queue.filter((j) => !(j.session === s && j.segmentId === ev.segmentId && j.kind === 'partial'));
    s.partialQueued = false;
    this.enqueue({ session: s, segmentId: ev.segmentId, kind: 'final', samples: s.ring.slice(ev.start, ev.end) });
  }

  private enqueue(job: DecodeJob): void {
    this.queue.push(job);
    if (!this.decoding) {
      this.decoding = true;
      this.decodeIdle = new Promise<void>((r) => { this.decodeDone = r; });
      void this.pump();
    }
  }

  private async pump(): Promise<void> {
    try {
      while (this.queue.length) {
        // finals first, then the newest partial
        const fi = this.queue.findIndex((j) => j.kind === 'final');
        const job = fi >= 0 ? this.queue.splice(fi, 1)[0] : this.queue.shift()!;
        const s = job.session;
        const segmentId = `${s.id}:${job.segmentId}`;
        try {
          const t0 = Date.now();
          const r = await this.decodeSamples(job.samples);
          const text = r.text.trim();
          if (job.kind === 'final') {
            this.log(`stt: final [${segmentId}] ${(job.samples.length / VAD_SAMPLE_RATE).toFixed(2)} s in ${Date.now() - t0} ms: ${JSON.stringify(text)}`);
            this.emit('event', { type: 'final', text, confidence: r.confidence, segmentId, sessionId: s.id });
          } else {
            s.partialQueued = false;
            if (text && text !== s.lastPartialText && s.segmenter.active?.segmentId === job.segmentId) {
              s.lastPartialText = text;
              this.emit('event', { type: 'partial', text, confidence: r.confidence, segmentId, sessionId: s.id });
            }
          }
        } catch (e) {
          if (job.kind === 'partial') s.partialQueued = false;
          this.fail(s, e as Error);
        }
      }
    } finally {
      this.decoding = false;
      this.decodeDone?.();
      this.decodeDone = null;
    }
  }

  private async decodeSamples(samples: Float32Array, sampleRate = VAD_SAMPLE_RATE): Promise<{ text: string; confidence?: number }> {
    const rec = this.recognizer;
    if (!rec) throw new Error('stt: recogniser not loaded');
    const stream = rec.createStream();
    stream.acceptWaveform({ samples, sampleRate });
    const r = await rec.decodeAsync(stream);
    return { text: r.text, confidence: confidenceOf(r) };
  }

  private fail(s: Session, e: Error): void {
    this.log(`stt: session ${s.id}: ${e.message}`);
    this.emit('event', { type: 'error', sessionId: s.id, message: e.message });
  }

  // ---- one-shot recognition (tests, bench) -------------------------------------------------------------------

  /** Recognises a whole WAV file (any sample rate; sherpa resamples) in one go, without VAD. */
  async recognizeFile(file: string): Promise<RecognizeResult> {
    await this.ensureReady();
    if (!fs.existsSync(file)) throw new Error(`stt: no such file ${file}`);
    const wave = this.sherpa!.readWave(file);
    return this.recognizeSamples(wave.samples, wave.sampleRate);
  }

  /** Recognises a buffer of mono PCM in one go, without VAD. */
  async recognizeSamples(samples: Float32Array, sampleRate = VAD_SAMPLE_RATE): Promise<RecognizeResult> {
    await this.ensureReady();
    const t0 = Date.now();
    const r = await this.decodeSamples(samples, sampleRate);
    return { text: r.text.trim(), confidence: r.confidence, durationSec: samples.length / sampleRate, decodeMs: Date.now() - t0 };
  }
}

type Sherpa = typeof import('sherpa-onnx-node');

/**
 * sherpa-onnx-node is CommonJS (`module.exports = { OfflineRecognizer : ... }`); Node's named-export detection
 * misses that shape, so a dynamic import yields only `default`. Accept both.
 */
async function loadSherpa(): Promise<Sherpa> {
  const mod = (await import('sherpa-onnx-node')) as unknown as Sherpa & { default?: Sherpa };
  return typeof mod.OfflineRecognizer === 'function' ? mod : mod.default!;
}

/** Mean token probability (exp of the mean log-prob) for transducer models; undefined when the model gives none. */
export function confidenceOf(r: Pick<OfflineRecognizerResult, 'ys_log_probs'>): number | undefined {
  const lp = r.ys_log_probs;
  if (!lp || !lp.length) return undefined;
  let s = 0;
  for (const v of lp) s += v;
  return Math.max(0, Math.min(1, Math.exp(s / lp.length)));
}

function concat(a: Float32Array, b: Float32Array): Float32Array {
  const out = new Float32Array(a.length + b.length);
  out.set(a); out.set(b, a.length);
  return out;
}
```

### `src/main/stt/ipc.ts` (78 lines)

```ts
import { app, ipcMain, BrowserWindow } from 'electron';
import path from 'node:path';
import { SttEngine, type EngineStatus, type SttEngineEvent, type RecognizeResult } from './engine';
import { isVariant } from './download';
import { getSettings } from '../settings';

/**
 * IPC for local speech-to-text. Channels (renderer -> main, all `invoke`):
 *  - stt:status                                   -> EngineStatus (model present? downloading? progress?)
 *  - stt:download                                 -> resolves when the model files are on disk (progress via stt:progress)
 *  - stt:cancelDownload
 *  - stt:start(sessionId, { sampleRate? })        -> opens a mic session (loads/downloads the model first)
 *  - stt:push(sessionId, ArrayBuffer)             -> Int16 mono PCM at the session's sample rate (16 kHz, 20–40 ms frames)
 *  - stt:stop(sessionId)                          -> closes it; resolves after the last final was sent
 *  - stt:recognizeFile(path)                      -> RecognizeResult (tests / debugging)
 * Main -> renderer (sent to every window):
 *  - 'stt:event'    SttEngineEvent: { type:'partial'|'final', text, confidence?, segmentId, sessionId }
 *                   | { type:'speechStart'|'speechEnd', sessionId, segmentId } | { type:'error', sessionId, message }
 *  - 'stt:progress' EngineStatus on every change (download progress, state)
 * Preload bridge: sttStatus / sttDownload / sttCancelDownload / sttStart / sttPush / sttStop / onSttEvent /
 * onSttProgress in src/preload/index.ts (types in src/shared/api.ts).
 */
let engine: SttEngine | null = null;

/** The model chosen in Settings (voiceChat.model); STT_VARIANT (env) wins when set, as before. */
function configuredVariant(): ReturnType<typeof getSettings>['voiceChat']['model'] | undefined {
  if (process.env.STT_VARIANT) return undefined;
  try { const v = getSettings().voiceChat?.model; return isVariant(v) ? v : undefined; } catch { return undefined; }
}

export function sttEngine(): SttEngine {
  // the learner picked another model: a fresh engine, once no mic session or download is running
  const want = configuredVariant();
  if (engine && want && engine.variant !== want) {
    const st = engine.status();
    if (st.sessions === 0 && st.state !== 'downloading' && st.state !== 'loading') { void engine.release(); engine = null; }
  }
  if (!engine) {
    const userData = app.getPath('userData');
    engine = new SttEngine({ modelDir: process.env.STT_MODEL_DIR || path.join(userData, 'models', 'stt'), variant: want, log: (m) => console.log(m) });
    engine.on('status', (s) => broadcast('stt:progress', s));
    engine.on('event', (e) => broadcast('stt:event', e));
  }
  return engine;
}

function broadcast(channel: 'stt:progress' | 'stt:event', payload: EngineStatus | SttEngineEvent): void {
  for (const w of BrowserWindow.getAllWindows()) if (!w.isDestroyed()) w.webContents.send(channel, payload);
}

function sessionIdOf(v: unknown): string {
  if (typeof v !== 'string' || !v || v.length > 64) throw new Error('stt: invalid session id');
  return v;
}

export function registerSttIpc(): void {
  ipcMain.handle('stt:status', (): EngineStatus => sttEngine().status());
  ipcMain.handle('stt:download', async (): Promise<EngineStatus> => { await sttEngine().download(); return sttEngine().status(); });
  ipcMain.handle('stt:cancelDownload', (): void => sttEngine().cancelDownload());
  ipcMain.handle('stt:start', async (_e, sessionId: unknown, opts?: { sampleRate?: number }): Promise<EngineStatus> => {
    await sttEngine().start(sessionIdOf(sessionId), { sampleRate: typeof opts?.sampleRate === 'number' ? opts.sampleRate : undefined });
    return sttEngine().status();
  });
  ipcMain.handle('stt:push', (_e, sessionId: unknown, pcm: unknown): Promise<void> => {
    const id = sessionIdOf(sessionId);
    const buf = pcm instanceof ArrayBuffer ? new Int16Array(pcm, 0, pcm.byteLength >> 1)
      : ArrayBuffer.isView(pcm) ? new Int16Array(pcm.buffer, pcm.byteOffset, pcm.byteLength >> 1)
        : null;
    if (!buf) return Promise.reject(new Error('stt:push expects an ArrayBuffer of Int16 PCM'));
    return sttEngine().pushAudio(id, buf);
  });
  ipcMain.handle('stt:stop', (_e, sessionId: unknown): Promise<void> => sttEngine().stop(sessionIdOf(sessionId)));
  ipcMain.handle('stt:recognizeFile', (_e, file: unknown): Promise<RecognizeResult> => {
    if (typeof file !== 'string') return Promise.reject(new Error('stt:recognizeFile expects a path'));
    return sttEngine().recognizeFile(file);
  });
  app.on('will-quit', () => { void engine?.release(); });
}
```

### `src/main/stt/silero.ts` (46 lines)

```ts
import type { InferenceSession as OrtSession, Tensor as OrtTensor } from 'onnxruntime-node';

/**
 * Silero VAD (the `silero_vad.onnx` sherpa-onnx redistributes: inputs x[1,512], h[2,1,64], c[2,1,64];
 * outputs prob, new_h, new_c; 16 kHz only) run through onnxruntime-node, the runtime the app already ships
 * for Kokoro. One SileroModel (ORT session) is shared; each audio stream owns a SileroState (the LSTM
 * state), so several mic sessions can run on the same model. ~0.5 ms per 32 ms window on a 4-core x86.
 */
export const VAD_SAMPLE_RATE = 16000;
export const VAD_WINDOW = 512;

type Ort = typeof import('onnxruntime-node');

export class SileroState {
  h = new Float32Array(2 * 64);
  c = new Float32Array(2 * 64);
  reset(): void { this.h.fill(0); this.c.fill(0); }
}

export class SileroModel {
  private constructor(private readonly ort: Ort, private readonly session: OrtSession) {}

  static async load(modelPath: string, ort?: Ort): Promise<SileroModel> {
    const rt = ort ?? (await import('onnxruntime-node'));
    const session = await rt.InferenceSession.create(modelPath, { executionProviders: ['cpu'], graphOptimizationLevel: 'all', intraOpNumThreads: 1, interOpNumThreads: 1, logSeverityLevel: 3 });
    for (const n of ['x', 'h', 'c']) if (!session.inputNames.includes(n)) throw new Error(`silero_vad.onnx: unexpected inputs ${session.inputNames.join(',')}`);
    return new SileroModel(rt, session);
  }

  /** Speech probability (0..1) of one 512-sample window at 16 kHz; updates `state`. */
  async process(window: Float32Array, state: SileroState): Promise<number> {
    if (window.length !== VAD_WINDOW) throw new Error(`silero: window must be ${VAD_WINDOW} samples, got ${window.length}`);
    const { Tensor } = this.ort;
    const feeds: Record<string, OrtTensor> = {
      x: new Tensor('float32', window, [1, VAD_WINDOW]),
      h: new Tensor('float32', state.h, [2, 1, 64]),
      c: new Tensor('float32', state.c, [2, 1, 64]),
    };
    const out = await this.session.run(feeds);
    state.h = new Float32Array(out.new_h.data as Float32Array);
    state.c = new Float32Array(out.new_c.data as Float32Array);
    return (out.prob.data as Float32Array)[0];
  }

  async release(): Promise<void> { await this.session.release(); }
}
```

### `src/main/stt/tar.ts` (137 lines)

```ts
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { Writable } from 'node:stream';

/**
 * Minimal streaming tar extractor (ustar / GNU, as produced by `tar` on macOS and Linux): enough for the
 * sherpa-onnx model archives, which are plain files inside one top-level directory. Handles regular files,
 * directories, GNU long names ('L') and pax 'path' records ('x'); everything else is skipped. Entry names
 * are sanitised: absolute paths and '..' components are rejected.
 */
export interface TarEntryInfo { name: string; size: number }

export interface ExtractOptions {
  /** return false to skip an entry (its bytes are discarded) */
  filter?: (entry: TarEntryInfo) => boolean;
  /** called with the running total of bytes written to disk */
  onProgress?: (written: number) => void;
}

const BLOCK = 512;

function parseOctal(buf: Buffer, off: number, len: number): number {
  const s = buf.toString('latin1', off, off + len).replace(/\0.*$/s, '').trim();
  if (!s) return 0;
  // GNU base-256 encoding for large sizes
  if (buf[off] & 0x80) { let v = 0; for (let i = 1; i < len; i++) v = v * 256 + buf[off + i]; return v; }
  return parseInt(s, 8) || 0;
}

function cstr(buf: Buffer, off: number, len: number): string {
  const end = buf.indexOf(0, off);
  return buf.toString('utf8', off, end === -1 || end > off + len ? off + len : end);
}

export function safeRelative(name: string): string | null {
  const parts = name.replace(/\\/g, '/').split('/').filter((p) => p.length > 0 && p !== '.');
  if (!parts.length || name.startsWith('/') || parts.some((p) => p === '..')) return null;
  return parts.join('/');
}

/** Extracts a tar stream into `dest`; resolves with the relative paths of the files written. */
export function extractTar(input: NodeJS.ReadableStream, dest: string, opts: ExtractOptions = {}): Promise<string[]> {
  return new Promise<string[]>((resolve, reject) => {
    const written: string[] = [];
    let pending: Buffer = Buffer.alloc(0);
    let remaining = 0; // data bytes left in the current entry
    let padding = 0; // bytes to the next 512 boundary after the entry data
    let out: fs.WriteStream | null = null;
    let outPath = '';
    let longName: string | null = null;
    let paxPath: string | null = null;
    let total = 0;
    let finished = false;

    const fail = (e: Error): void => { if (finished) return; finished = true; out?.destroy(); reject(e); };

    const sink = new Writable({
      write(chunk: Buffer, _enc, cb) {
        pending = pending.length ? Buffer.concat([pending, chunk]) : chunk;
        void consume().then(() => cb(), (e: Error) => { fail(e); cb(e); });
      },
      final(cb) {
        if (out) { fail(new Error('tar: archive ended inside a file')); cb(); return; }
        if (!finished) { finished = true; resolve(written); }
        cb();
      },
    });
    sink.on('error', fail);
    input.on('error', fail);

    async function consume(): Promise<void> {
      for (;;) {
        if (remaining > 0) {
          if (!pending.length) return;
          const take = Math.min(remaining, pending.length);
          const data = pending.subarray(0, take);
          pending = pending.subarray(take);
          remaining -= take;
          if (out) {
            if (!out.write(data)) await new Promise<void>((r) => out!.once('drain', r));
            total += take;
            opts.onProgress?.(total);
          } else if (longName !== null) longName += data.toString('utf8');
          else if (paxPath !== null) paxPath += data.toString('utf8');
          if (remaining === 0 && out) {
            const ws = out; out = null;
            await new Promise<void>((r, j) => ws.end((e?: Error | null) => (e ? j(e) : r())));
            written.push(outPath);
          }
          continue;
        }
        if (padding > 0) {
          const take = Math.min(padding, pending.length);
          pending = pending.subarray(take); padding -= take;
          if (padding > 0) return;
        }
        if (pending.length < BLOCK) return;
        const header = pending.subarray(0, BLOCK);
        pending = pending.subarray(BLOCK);
        if (header.every((b) => b === 0)) continue; // end-of-archive blocks
        const type = String.fromCharCode(header[156]);
        const size = parseOctal(header, 124, 12);
        remaining = size;
        padding = (BLOCK - (size % BLOCK)) % BLOCK;
        if (type === 'L') { longName = ''; continue; }
        if (type === 'x') { paxPath = ''; continue; }
        if (type === 'g') { continue; }
        let name = cstr(header, 0, 100);
        const prefix = header.toString('latin1', 257, 263) === 'ustar\0' || header.toString('latin1', 257, 262) === 'ustar' ? cstr(header, 345, 155) : '';
        if (prefix) name = `${prefix}/${name}`;
        if (longName !== null) { name = longName.replace(/\0+$/, ''); longName = null; }
        if (paxPath !== null) {
          const m = /(?:^|\n)\d+ path=([^\n]*)\n/.exec(paxPath);
          if (m) name = m[1];
          paxPath = null;
        }
        const rel = safeRelative(name);
        if (rel === null) throw new Error(`tar: refusing entry "${name}"`);
        const isFile = type === '0' || type === '\0' || type === '7';
        if (type === '5') { await fs.promises.mkdir(path.join(dest, rel), { recursive: true }); continue; }
        if (!isFile || (opts.filter && !opts.filter({ name: rel, size }))) continue;
        outPath = rel;
        const full = path.join(dest, rel);
        await fs.promises.mkdir(path.dirname(full), { recursive: true });
        out = fs.createWriteStream(full);
        out.on('error', fail);
        if (size === 0) {
          const ws = out; out = null;
          await new Promise<void>((r, j) => ws.end((e?: Error | null) => (e ? j(e) : r())));
          written.push(outPath);
        }
      }
    }

    input.pipe(sink);
  });
}
```

```ts
/**
 * Single place that wires the pure text modules (written as separate modules) into the main process.
 * Kept separate so the main process compiles while modules are being developed.
 */
import type { Book } from '@core/model';
import type { Segmenter } from '@core/segment';
import type { Importer, ImportContext } from '@core/import/types';
import type { Dictionary } from '@core/dict/types';
import type { DictData } from '@shared/api';

export interface TextModules {
  createSegmenter(): Segmenter;
  importers: { epub: Importer; pdf: Importer; text: Importer };
  textToBook(title: string, text: string, ctx: ImportContext): Promise<Book>;
  createDictionary(data: DictData): Dictionary;
  detectNames(book: Pick<Book, 'chapters'>, dict: Dictionary): string[];
}

let modules: TextModules | null = null;

export async function loadTextModules(): Promise<TextModules> {
  if (modules) return modules;
  const [segment, epub, text, pdf, dict, names] = await Promise.all([
    import('@core/segment'),
    import('@core/import/epub'),
    import('@core/import/text'),
    import('@core/import/pdf'),
    import('@core/dict/dictionary'),
    import('@core/dict/names'),
  ]);
  modules = {
    createSegmenter: segment.createSegmenter,
    importers: { epub: epub.epubImporter, pdf: pdf.pdfImporter, text: text.textImporter },
    textToBook: text.textToBook,
    createDictionary: dict.createDictionary,
    detectNames: names.detectNames,
  };
  return modules;
}
```
