### `src/main/tts.ts` (359 lines)

```ts
import { ipcMain } from 'electron';
import OpenAI from 'openai';
import type { TtsEngineId } from '@shared/settings';
import type { CloudTtsResult, TtsVoiceInfo, WordTiming } from '@shared/api';
import { getSecret, getAzureCredentials } from './secrets';
import { kokoroSynthesize, kokoroVoices, registerKokoroIpc, warmUpKokoro } from './kokoro/ipc';

/**
 * Voices synthesized in the main process (the renderer has no network access):
 *  - edge: Microsoft Edge "Read Aloud" neural voices through the unofficial msedge-tts client. Free, no key,
 *          returns word boundaries. May break when Microsoft changes its token scheme; the app then falls back.
 *  - openai: OpenAI /v1/audio/speech (gpt-4o-mini-tts). Paid. No word timing; the renderer estimates it.
 *  - elevenlabs: ElevenLabs with-timestamps endpoint. Paid. Character alignment -> word timings.
 *  - kokoro: Kokoro-82M running locally through onnxruntime-node (src/main/kokoro). Free. Word timings from the model.
 *  - azure: Azure Speech REST (SSML). Paid, 500k chars/month free. The REST endpoint has no word boundaries,
 *           so no timings are returned and the renderer estimates them proportionally to word length.
 *  - google: Google Cloud Text-to-Speech v1beta1 REST with an API key. Paid, 1M chars/month free per voice
 *            family. Neural2 voices: SSML with <mark name="w{i}"/> before each word + SSML_MARK time pointing
 *            give word start times. Chirp 3 HD voices take plain text (no marks), so their timing is estimated.
 */
export function registerTtsHandlers(): void {
  registerKokoroIpc();
  // the Dream voice is the default: load it right after start-up (off the main thread) when it is chosen and on disk
  setTimeout(() => {
    import('./settings').then(({ getSettings }) => {
      const v = getSettings().voice;
      if (v.engine === 'kokoro' || v.explainEngine === 'kokoro') warmUpKokoro();
    }).catch(() => undefined);
  }, 1500).unref?.();
  ipcMain.handle('tts:voices', async (_e, engine: TtsEngineId): Promise<TtsVoiceInfo[]> => listVoices(engine));
  ipcMain.handle('tts:synthesize', async (_e, engine: TtsEngineId, text: string, voiceId: string, rate: number): Promise<CloudTtsResult> => {
    const t = text.trim();
    if (!t) return { audio: new ArrayBuffer(0), mime: 'audio/mpeg', timings: [], durationSec: 0 };
    if (engine === 'edge') return synthEdge(t, voiceId || 'en-GB-SoniaNeural', rate);
    if (engine === 'openai') return synthOpenAI(t, voiceId || 'ballad', rate);
    if (engine === 'elevenlabs') return synthElevenLabs(t, voiceId || 'JBFqnCBsd6RMkjVDRZzb');
    if (engine === 'kokoro') return kokoroSynthesize(t, voiceId || 'bf_emma', 1); // rate is applied on playback
    if (engine === 'azure') return synthAzure(t, voiceId || 'en-GB-SoniaNeural', rate);
    if (engine === 'google') return synthGoogle(t, voiceId || 'en-GB-Neural2-A', rate);
    throw new Error(`Voice engine "${engine}" is not available in this version.`);
  });
}

async function listVoices(engine: TtsEngineId): Promise<TtsVoiceInfo[]> {
  if (engine === 'kokoro') return kokoroVoices();
  if (engine === 'edge') {
    const { MsEdgeTTS } = await import('msedge-tts');
    const tts = new MsEdgeTTS();
    const voices = await withTimeout(tts.getVoices(), 15_000, 'Microsoft voices');
    return voices
      .filter((v) => /^(en|zh)-/.test(v.Locale))
      .map((v) => ({ id: v.ShortName, name: friendly(v.FriendlyName, v.ShortName), lang: v.Locale, gender: v.Gender }))
      .sort((a, b) => rank(b.lang) - rank(a.lang) || a.name.localeCompare(b.name));
  }
  if (engine === 'azure') return getAzureCredentials() ? AZURE_VOICES.map((v) => ({ ...v })) : [];
  if (engine === 'google') return getSecret('google') ? GOOGLE_VOICES.map((v) => ({ ...v })) : [];
  if (engine === 'openai') {
    if (!getSecret('openai')) return [];
    return ['ballad', 'fable', 'alloy', 'ash', 'coral', 'echo', 'nova', 'onyx', 'sage', 'shimmer', 'verse', 'marin', 'cedar'].map((id) => ({ id, name: id[0].toUpperCase() + id.slice(1), lang: 'en', note: id === 'ballad' || id === 'fable' ? 'sounds most British' : undefined }));
  }
  if (engine === 'elevenlabs') {
    const key = getSecret('elevenlabs');
    if (!key) return [];
    const res = await fetch('https://api.elevenlabs.io/v1/voices', { headers: { 'xi-api-key': key } });
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`ElevenLabs voices: HTTP ${res.status}`);
    const data = (await res.json()) as { voices: { voice_id: string; name: string; labels?: Record<string, string> }[] };
    return data.voices.map((v) => ({ id: v.voice_id, name: v.name, lang: /brit|english \(uk\)|gb/i.test(JSON.stringify(v.labels ?? {})) ? 'en-GB' : 'en', gender: v.labels?.gender, note: v.labels?.accent }))
      .sort((a, b) => rank(b.lang) - rank(a.lang) || a.name.localeCompare(b.name));
  }
  return [];
}

function rank(lang: string): number { return lang.toLowerCase() === 'en-gb' ? 3 : lang.toLowerCase().startsWith('en') ? 2 : lang.toLowerCase().startsWith('zh') ? 1 : 0; }
function friendly(full: string, short: string): string {
  const m = /Microsoft (\w+) Online \(Natural\) - (\w+) \(([^)]+)\)/.exec(full);
  return m ? `${m[1]} (${m[3]})` : short;
}

function withTimeout<T>(p: Promise<T>, ms: number, what: string): Promise<T> {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const t = setTimeout(() => reject(new Error(`${what} timed out`)), ms);
    p.then((v) => { clearTimeout(t); resolve(v); }, (e) => { clearTimeout(t); reject(e); });
  });
}

// ---- Microsoft Edge ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
async function synthEdge(text: string, voice: string, rate: number): Promise<CloudTtsResult> {
  const { MsEdgeTTS, OUTPUT_FORMAT } = await import('msedge-tts');
  const tts = new MsEdgeTTS({ connectionTimeoutMs: 15_000, synthesisTimeoutMs: 60_000 });
  await tts.setMetadata(voice, OUTPUT_FORMAT.AUDIO_24KHZ_48KBITRATE_MONO_MP3, { wordBoundaryEnabled: true });
  const prosody = rate && Math.abs(rate - 1) > 0.05 ? { rate: `${rate >= 1 ? '+' : ''}${Math.round((rate - 1) * 100)}%` } : undefined;
  const { audioStream, metadataStream } = tts.toStream(text, prosody);
  const chunks: Buffer[] = [];
  const metaChunks: string[] = [];
  const audioDone = new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
    audioStream.on('data', (c: Buffer) => chunks.push(c));
    audioStream.on('end', resolve);
    audioStream.on('error', reject);
  });
  const metaDone = metadataStream ? new Promise<void>((resolve) => {
    metadataStream.on('data', (c: Buffer | string) => metaChunks.push(c.toString()));
    metadataStream.on('end', resolve);
    metadataStream.on('error', () => resolve());
  }) : Promise.resolve();
  try {
    await withTimeout(Promise.all([audioDone, metaDone]), 70_000, 'Microsoft voice synthesis');
  } finally {
    try { tts.close(); } catch { /* ignore */ }
  }
  const audio = Buffer.concat(chunks);
  if (audio.length === 0) throw new Error('Microsoft voice returned no audio (the free service may be temporarily unavailable).');
  const timings = parseEdgeMetadata(metaChunks, text);
  return { audio: audio.buffer.slice(audio.byteOffset, audio.byteOffset + audio.byteLength), mime: 'audio/mpeg', timings, durationSec: null };
}

/** Edge metadata chunks are JSON objects {Metadata:[{Type:'WordBoundary',Data:{Offset,Duration,text:{Text}}}]} with 100-ns ticks. */
export function parseEdgeMetadata(chunks: string[], text: string): WordTiming[] | null {
  const words: { start: number; end: number; word: string }[] = [];
  for (const chunk of chunks) {
    for (const piece of chunk.split(/\n(?=\{)/)) {
      try {
        const obj = JSON.parse(piece) as { Metadata?: { Type: string; Data: { Offset: number; Duration: number; text: { Text: string } } }[] };
        for (const m of obj.Metadata ?? []) {
          if (m.Type !== 'WordBoundary' || typeof m.Data?.text?.Text !== 'string') continue;
          words.push({ start: m.Data.Offset / 1e7, end: (m.Data.Offset + m.Data.Duration) / 1e7, word: m.Data.text.Text });
        }
      } catch { /* partial chunk */ }
    }
  }
  if (!words.length) return null;
  return alignWords(words, text);
}

/** Matches spoken word tokens to character positions in the original text, sequentially. */
export function alignWords(words: { start: number; end: number; word: string }[], text: string): WordTiming[] {
  const out: WordTiming[] = [];
  let cursor = 0;
  const lower = text.toLowerCase();
  const tokenAt = (i: number) => /^[\p{L}\p{N}'’\-]+/u.exec(lower.slice(i))?.[0] ?? '';
  for (const w of words) {
    const needle = w.word.toLowerCase().replace(/[^\p{L}\p{N}'’\-]/gu, '');
    if (!needle) continue;
    let idx = lower.indexOf(needle, cursor);
    // a word must start at a word boundary ("at" is not the tail of "cat"); apostrophe-led pieces ("'s") may follow a letter
    if (/^[\p{L}\p{N}]/u.test(needle)) while (idx > 0 && /[\p{L}\p{N}]/u.test(lower[idx - 1])) idx = lower.indexOf(needle, idx + 1);
    let len = needle.length;
    if (idx < 0 || idx - cursor > 40) {
      // the engine normalised the token (e.g. "2000" spoken as "two thousand"): take the next original token instead
      const m = /[\p{L}\p{N}]/u.exec(lower.slice(cursor));
      if (!m) break;
      idx = cursor + m.index;
      len = tokenAt(idx).length || 1;
    }
    out.push({ start: w.start, end: w.end, charIndex: idx, charLength: len });
    cursor = idx + len;
  }
  return out;
}

// ---- OpenAI --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
async function synthOpenAI(text: string, voice: string, rate: number): Promise<CloudTtsResult> {
  const key = getSecret('openai');
  if (!key) throw new Error('Add your OpenAI API key in Settings to use the OpenAI voice.');
  const client = new OpenAI({ apiKey: key, maxRetries: 1, timeout: 60_000 });
  const res = await client.audio.speech.create({
    model: 'gpt-4o-mini-tts',
    voice: voice as never,
    input: text,
    instructions: 'Read this aloud in a clear, warm British English accent (Received Pronunciation), at a natural storytelling pace, for an English learner.',
    response_format: 'mp3',
    speed: Math.min(4, Math.max(0.25, rate || 1)),
  });
  const audio = await res.arrayBuffer();
  return { audio, mime: 'audio/mpeg', timings: null, durationSec: null };
}

// ---- ElevenLabs ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
async function synthElevenLabs(text: string, voice: string): Promise<CloudTtsResult> {
  const key = getSecret('elevenlabs');
  if (!key) throw new Error('Add your ElevenLabs API key in Settings to use this voice.');
  const res = await fetch(`https://api.elevenlabs.io/v1/text-to-speech/${encodeURIComponent(voice)}/with-timestamps?output_format=mp3_44100_64`, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'xi-api-key': key, 'content-type': 'application/json' },
    body: JSON.stringify({ text, model_id: 'eleven_flash_v2_5' }),
  });
  if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`ElevenLabs: HTTP ${res.status} ${(await res.text()).slice(0, 200)}`);
  const data = (await res.json()) as { audio_base64: string; alignment?: { characters: string[]; character_start_times_seconds: number[]; character_end_times_seconds: number[] } | null };
  const audio = Buffer.from(data.audio_base64, 'base64');
  const timings = data.alignment ? charAlignmentToWords(data.alignment) : null;
  return { audio: audio.buffer.slice(audio.byteOffset, audio.byteOffset + audio.byteLength), mime: 'audio/mpeg', timings, durationSec: null };
}

export function charAlignmentToWords(a: { characters: string[]; character_start_times_seconds: number[]; character_end_times_seconds: number[] }): WordTiming[] {
  const out: WordTiming[] = [];
  let i = 0;
  while (i < a.characters.length) {
    if (/\s/.test(a.characters[i])) { i++; continue; }
    const start = i;
    while (i < a.characters.length && !/\s/.test(a.characters[i])) i++;
    out.push({ start: a.character_start_times_seconds[start], end: a.character_end_times_seconds[i - 1], charIndex: start, charLength: i - start });
  }
  return out;
}

// ---- shared SSML helpers -------------------------------------------------------------------------
export function escapeXml(s: string): string {
  return s.replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;').replace(/"/g, '&quot;').replace(/'/g, '&apos;');
}

/** "en-GB-SoniaNeural" -> "en-GB" */
export function voiceLocale(voice: string): string {
  const m = /^([a-z]{2,3}-[A-Z]{2})/.exec(voice);
  return m ? m[1] : 'en-GB';
}

/** SSML prosody rate ("+20%") for a playback rate, or null at normal speed. */
function prosodyRate(rate: number): string | null {
  if (!rate || Math.abs(rate - 1) <= 0.05) return null;
  const pct = Math.round((Math.min(3, Math.max(0.5, rate)) - 1) * 100);
  return `${pct >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${pct}%`;
}

function toArrayBuffer(b: Buffer): ArrayBuffer { return b.buffer.slice(b.byteOffset, b.byteOffset + b.byteLength) as ArrayBuffer; }

// ---- Azure Speech --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
const AZURE_VOICES: TtsVoiceInfo[] = [
  { id: 'en-GB-SoniaNeural', name: 'Sonia (UK)', lang: 'en-GB', gender: 'Female' },

export const AZURE_OUTPUT_FORMAT = 'audio-24khz-48kbitrate-mono-mp3';

export function buildAzureSsml(text: string, voice: string, rate = 1): string {
  const body = escapeXml(text);
  const r = prosodyRate(rate);
  const inner = r ? `<prosody rate="${r}">${body}</prosody>` : body;
  return `<speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="${voiceLocale(voice)}"><voice name="${escapeXml(voice)}">${inner}</voice></speak>`;
}

export async function synthAzure(text: string, voice: string, rate: number): Promise<CloudTtsResult> {
  const creds = getAzureCredentials();
  if (!creds) throw new Error('Add your Azure Speech key and region in Settings to use the Azure voices.');
  const res = await fetch(`https://${creds.region}.tts.speech.microsoft.com/cognitiveservices/v1`, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: {
      'Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key': creds.key,
      'Content-Type': 'application/ssml+xml',
      'X-Microsoft-OutputFormat': AZURE_OUTPUT_FORMAT,
      'User-Agent': 'DreamRead',
    },
    body: buildAzureSsml(text, voice, rate),
    signal: AbortSignal.timeout(60_000),
  });
  if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`Azure Speech: HTTP ${res.status}${res.status === 401 ? ' (check the key and that the region matches your Speech resource)' : ''} ${(await res.text().catch(() => '')).slice(0, 200)}`.trim());
  const audio = await res.arrayBuffer();
  if (audio.byteLength === 0) throw new Error('Azure Speech returned no audio.');
  // the REST endpoint has no word boundary events: the renderer estimates word times from word lengths
  return { audio, mime: 'audio/mpeg', timings: null, durationSec: null };
}

const GOOGLE_VOICES: TtsVoiceInfo[] = [
  ...(['A', 'C', 'F'] as const).map((l) => ({ id: `en-GB-Neural2-${l}`, name: `Neural2 ${l} (UK)`, lang: 'en-GB', gender: 'Female', quality: 'Neural2', note: 'exact word highlight' })),
  ...(['B', 'D'] as const).map((l) => ({ id: `en-GB-Neural2-${l}`, name: `Neural2 ${l} (UK)`, lang: 'en-GB', gender: 'Male', quality: 'Neural2', note: 'exact word highlight' })),
  ...(['Aoede', 'Kore', 'Leda', 'Zephyr', 'Achernar'] as const).map((n) => ({ id: `en-GB-Chirp3-HD-${n}`, name: `${n} (UK)`, lang: 'en-GB', gender: 'Female', quality: 'Chirp 3 HD', note: 'most natural, estimated highlight' })),
  ...(['Charon', 'Fenrir', 'Orus', 'Puck'] as const).map((n) => ({ id: `en-GB-Chirp3-HD-${n}`, name: `${n} (UK)`, lang: 'en-GB', gender: 'Male', quality: 'Chirp 3 HD', note: 'most natural, estimated highlight' })),
  ...(['F', 'J'] as const).map((l) => ({ id: `en-US-Neural2-${l}`, name: `Neural2 ${l} (US)`, lang: 'en-US', quality: 'Neural2' })),
];

/** Chirp 3 HD voices do not take SSML marks (no time pointing): they get plain text and estimated timing. */
export function isChirpVoice(voice: string): boolean { return /chirp/i.test(voice); }

const WORD_RE = /[\p{L}\p{N}][\p{L}\p{N}'’\-]*/gu;

/** SSML with <mark name="w{i}"/> before word i, plus each word's position in `text`. */
export function buildGoogleMarkedSsml(text: string): { ssml: string; words: { charIndex: number; charLength: number }[] } {
  const words: { charIndex: number; charLength: number }[] = [];
  let out = '';
  let last = 0;
  for (const m of text.matchAll(WORD_RE)) {
    const i = m.index!;
    out += escapeXml(text.slice(last, i)) + `<mark name="w${words.length}"/>` + escapeXml(m[0]);
    words.push({ charIndex: i, charLength: m[0].length });
    last = i + m[0].length;
  }
  out += escapeXml(text.slice(last));
  return { ssml: `<speak>${out}</speak>`, words };
}

/** Google timepoints ({markName: "w3", timeSeconds}) -> word timings; a word's end is the next word's start. */
export function googleTimepointsToWords(timepoints: { markName?: string; timeSeconds?: number }[] | undefined, words: { charIndex: number; charLength: number }[]): WordTiming[] | null {
  const starts = new Map<number, number>();
  for (const tp of timepoints ?? []) {
    const m = /^w(\d+)$/.exec(tp.markName ?? '');
    if (m && typeof tp.timeSeconds === 'number' && Number.isFinite(tp.timeSeconds)) starts.set(Number(m[1]), tp.timeSeconds);
  }
  const out: WordTiming[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < words.length; i++) {
    const start = starts.get(i);
    if (start === undefined) continue;
    out.push({ start, end: start, charIndex: words[i].charIndex, charLength: words[i].charLength });
  }
  if (!out.length) return null;
  for (let i = 0; i < out.length; i++) out[i].end = i + 1 < out.length ? out[i + 1].start : out[i].start + 0.08 * out[i].charLength + 0.15;
  return out;
}

export function buildGoogleRequest(text: string, voice: string, rate: number): { body: Record<string, unknown>; words: { charIndex: number; charLength: number }[] | null } {
  const chirp = isChirpVoice(voice);
  const marked = chirp ? null : buildGoogleMarkedSsml(text);
  const audioConfig: Record<string, unknown> = { audioEncoding: 'MP3' };
  if (rate && Math.abs(rate - 1) > 0.05) audioConfig.speakingRate = Math.min(2, Math.max(0.25, rate));
  const body: Record<string, unknown> = {
    input: marked ? { ssml: marked.ssml } : { text },
    voice: { languageCode: voiceLocale(voice), name: voice },
    audioConfig,
  };
  if (marked) body.enableTimePointing = ['SSML_MARK'];
  return { body, words: marked?.words ?? null };
}

export async function synthGoogle(text: string, voice: string, rate: number): Promise<CloudTtsResult> {
  const key = getSecret('google');
  if (!key) throw new Error('Add your Google Cloud API key in Settings to use the Google voices.');
  const { body, words } = buildGoogleRequest(text, voice, rate);
  const res = await fetch(`https://texttospeech.googleapis.com/v1beta1/text:synthesize?key=${encodeURIComponent(key)}`, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' },
    body: JSON.stringify(body),
    signal: AbortSignal.timeout(60_000),
  });
  if (!res.ok) {
    const raw = await res.text().catch(() => '');
    let msg = raw;
    try { msg = (JSON.parse(raw) as { error?: { message?: string } }).error?.message ?? raw; } catch { /* not JSON */ }
    throw new Error(`Google Text-to-Speech: HTTP ${res.status} ${msg.slice(0, 200)}`.trim());
  }
  const data = (await res.json()) as { audioContent?: string; timepoints?: { markName?: string; timeSeconds?: number }[] };
  if (!data.audioContent) throw new Error('Google Text-to-Speech returned no audio.');
  const audio = Buffer.from(data.audioContent, 'base64');
  const timings = words ? googleTimepointsToWords(data.timepoints, words) : null;
  return { audio: toArrayBuffer(audio), mime: 'audio/mpeg', timings, durationSec: null };
}
```

```ts
/**
 * My Vocabulary: every word the learner had explained, with the sentence it was met in, the explanation and
 * where in which book. Stored in <userData>/data/vocabulary.json (JsonStore, atomic writes) and mirrored to
 * ~/Documents/Dream Read/my-vocabulary.csv, which is rewritten (debounced) after every change so the file is
 * always current. The status map used by highlighting (VocabState.words, settings.ts) is kept in sync.
 *
 * Also computes the Progress page numbers from the dictionary data: per CEFR level how many of the
 * CEFR-tagged words are known / learning / unknown.
 */
import path from 'node:path';
import type { CefrLevel } from '@core/model';
import { CEFR_LEVELS } from '@core/model';
import type { DictData, VocabEntry, VocabEntryInput, VocabEntryStatus, VocabProgress, LevelProgress, UnknownWord } from '@shared/api';
import type { VocabState } from '@shared/settings';
import { JsonStore, writeAtomic } from './storage';
import { exportDir } from './paths';
import * as settings from './settings';

export interface VocabularyFile { version: 1; entries: Record<string, VocabEntry> }

const store = new JsonStore<VocabularyFile>('vocabulary', () => ({ version: 1, entries: {} }));

export const CSV_FILE_NAME = 'my-vocabulary.csv';
export const CSV_DEBOUNCE_MS = 2000;

/** The dictionary is loaded lazily by library.ts; the IPC layer hands it over so this module stays testable. */
let dictProvider: (() => Promise<DictData>) | null = null;
export function setDictionaryProvider(p: (() => Promise<DictData>) | null): void { dictProvider = p; }

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * Entries
 * ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

export function listEntries(): VocabEntry[] {
  return Object.values(store.get().entries).sort((a, b) => (b.lastSeenAt > a.lastSeenAt ? 1 : b.lastSeenAt < a.lastSeenAt ? -1 : a.lemma.localeCompare(b.lemma)));
}

export function getEntry(lemma: string): VocabEntry | null { return store.get().entries[lemma] ?? null; }

/**
 * Merges a new explanation into an existing entry: one more explanation, lastSeenAt bumped, the first sentence
 * (and where it was met) kept, the latest non-empty explanation and Chinese kept. A known word stays known.
 */
export function mergeEntry(existing: VocabEntry | null, input: VocabEntryInput, nowIso: string): VocabEntry {
  if (!existing) {
    return {
      lemma: input.lemma, word: input.word || input.lemma, sentence: input.sentence ?? '', explanation: input.explanation ?? '',
      chinese: input.chinese ?? '', bookId: input.bookId ?? '', bookTitle: input.bookTitle ?? '', chapter: input.chapter ?? '',
      position: input.position ?? null, createdAt: nowIso, lastSeenAt: nowIso, timesExplained: 1, status: 'learning',
      level: input.level, again: input.again ? 1 : 0,
    };
  }
  return {
    ...existing,
    word: existing.word || input.word || input.lemma,
    sentence: existing.sentence || input.sentence || '',
    explanation: input.explanation || existing.explanation,
    chinese: input.chinese || existing.chinese,
    bookId: existing.bookId || input.bookId, bookTitle: existing.bookTitle || input.bookTitle, chapter: existing.chapter || input.chapter,
    position: existing.position ?? input.position ?? null,
    lastSeenAt: nowIso,
    timesExplained: existing.timesExplained + 1,
    level: existing.level ?? input.level,
    again: existing.again + (input.again ? 1 : 0),
  };
}

export async function upsertEntry(input: VocabEntryInput, now: Date = new Date()): Promise<VocabEntry> {
  const lemma = String(input.lemma ?? '').trim();
  if (!lemma) throw new Error('vocabulary: a lemma is required');
  if (!input.level && dictProvider) {
    try { input = { ...input, level: levelOf(await dictProvider(), lemma) ?? undefined }; } catch { /* dictionary missing */ }
  }
  const nowIso = now.toISOString();
  let entry!: VocabEntry;
  store.update((f) => {
    entry = mergeEntry(f.entries[lemma] ?? null, { ...input, lemma }, nowIso);
    return { ...f, entries: { ...f.entries, [lemma]: entry } };
  });
  // the highlighting map: learning unless the learner already knows the word
  if (settings.getVocab().words[lemma] !== 'known') settings.setWordStatus(lemma, 'learning');
  scheduleCsv();
  return entry;
}

export function setEntryStatus(lemma: string, status: VocabEntryStatus): void {
  store.update((f) => {
    const e = f.entries[lemma];
    if (!e) return f;
    return { ...f, entries: { ...f.entries, [lemma]: { ...e, status } } };
  });
  settings.setWordStatus(lemma, status);
  scheduleCsv();
}

export function deleteEntry(lemma: string): void {
  store.update((f) => {
    if (!(lemma in f.entries)) return f;
    const entries = { ...f.entries };
    delete entries[lemma];
    return { ...f, entries };
  });
  settings.setWordStatus(lemma, null);
  scheduleCsv();
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * CSV mirror
 * ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

export function csvPath(): string { return path.join(exportDir(), CSV_FILE_NAME); }

function csvField(v: string): string {
  const s = (v ?? '').replace(/\r?\n/g, ' ').trim();
  return /[",;\t]/.test(s) ? `"${s.replace(/"/g, '""')}"` : s;
}

/** UTF-8 with a BOM so Excel and Numbers show the Chinese; CRLF line ends; oldest entry first. */
export function toCsv(entries: VocabEntry[]): string {
  const rows = [...entries].sort((a, b) => a.createdAt.localeCompare(b.createdAt) || a.lemma.localeCompare(b.lemma));
  const lines = ['word,chinese,explanation,sentence,book,chapter,date,status'];
  for (const e of rows) {
    lines.push([e.word || e.lemma, e.chinese, e.explanation, e.sentence, e.bookTitle, e.chapter, e.createdAt.slice(0, 10), e.status].map(csvField).join(','));
  }
  return `﻿${lines.join('\r\n')}\r\n`;
}

let csvTimer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null;

/** Writes the CSV now (used by the Export button) and cancels a pending debounced write. */
export function writeCsv(): string {
  if (csvTimer) { clearTimeout(csvTimer); csvTimer = null; }
  const file = csvPath();
  writeAtomic(file, toCsv(listEntries()));
  return file;
}

function scheduleCsv(): void {
  if (csvTimer) clearTimeout(csvTimer);
  csvTimer = setTimeout(() => {
    csvTimer = null;
    try { writeCsv(); } catch (e) { console.error('vocabulary: could not write the CSV', e); }
  }, CSV_DEBOUNCE_MS);
  // never keep the app alive for the mirror file
  (csvTimer as { unref?: () => void }).unref?.();
}

/** true while a debounced CSV write is pending (tests) */
export function csvWritePending(): boolean { return csvTimer !== null; }

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * Progress (dictionary + status map)
 * ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

const TAGGED: ReadonlySet<string> = new Set(['cefrj', 'oct']);

function levelOf(dict: DictData, word: string): CefrLevel | null {
  const raw = dict.w[word];
  if (!raw) return null;
  return (CEFR_LEVELS as string[]).includes(raw.l) ? (raw.l as CefrLevel) : null;
}

/** Single-word headwords with a level from a real CEFR list (not estimated), per level. */
function taggedWords(dict: DictData): Map<CefrLevel, string[]> {
  const out = new Map<CefrLevel, string[]>(CEFR_LEVELS.map((l) => [l, []]));
  for (const [word, raw] of Object.entries(dict.w)) {
    if (!TAGGED.has(raw.s) || word.includes(' ')) continue;
    const level = levelOf(dict, word);
    if (level) out.get(level)!.push(word);
  }
  return out;
}

/** YYYY-MM-DD in local time. */
export function dayKey(d: Date): string {
  const p = (n: number) => String(n).padStart(2, '0');
  return `${d.getFullYear()}-${p(d.getMonth() + 1)}-${p(d.getDate())}`;
}

/** Days in a row with activity, counted back from today (or from yesterday when today has none yet). */
export function streakFrom(days: Iterable<string>, now: Date): number {
  const set = new Set(days);
  if (set.size === 0) return 0;
  const cursor = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), now.getDate());
  if (!set.has(dayKey(cursor))) cursor.setDate(cursor.getDate() - 1);
  let n = 0;
  while (set.has(dayKey(cursor))) { n++; cursor.setDate(cursor.getDate() - 1); }
  return n;
}

export function computeProgress(dict: DictData, words: VocabState['words'], entries: VocabEntry[], now: Date = new Date()): VocabProgress {
  const levels: LevelProgress[] = [];
  let unknownTotal = 0;
  for (const [level, list] of taggedWords(dict)) {
    const p: LevelProgress = { level, known: 0, learning: 0, unknown: 0, total: list.length };
    for (const w of list) {
      const st = words[w];
      if (st === 'known') p.known++;
      else if (st === 'learning') p.learning++;
      else if (st !== 'ignored') p.unknown++;
    }
    unknownTotal += p.unknown;
    levels.push(p);
  }
  let known = 0, learning = 0;
  for (const st of Object.values(words)) { if (st === 'known') known++; else if (st === 'learning') learning++; }
  const weekAgo = new Date(now.getTime() - 7 * 86400_000).toISOString();
  const learnedThisWeek = entries.filter((e) => e.createdAt >= weekAgo).length;
  const days = new Set<string>();
  for (const e of entries) { days.add(dayKey(new Date(e.createdAt))); days.add(dayKey(new Date(e.lastSeenAt))); }
  const lastActiveDay = days.size ? [...days].sort().at(-1)! : null;
  return { levels, totals: { known, learning, unknown: unknownTotal, entries: entries.length }, learnedThisWeek, streakDays: streakFrom(days, now), lastActiveDay };
}

/** Tagged words of a level the learner has not marked, by corpus rank (COCA `frq`: 1 = most frequent, 0 = unranked, last). */
export function unknownAtLevel(dict: DictData, words: VocabState['words'], level: CefrLevel): UnknownWord[] {
  const list = taggedWords(dict).get(level) ?? [];
  const out: UnknownWord[] = [];
  for (const w of list) {
    if (words[w]) continue;
    const raw = dict.w[w];
    out.push({ word: w, zh: (raw.t ?? '').split(/\r?\n/)[0].trim(), ipa: raw.i ? `/${raw.i.replace(/^\/+|\/+$/g, '')}/` : '', level, frq: raw.f | 0 });
  }
  const rank = (f: number) => (f > 0 ? f : Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER);
  return out.sort((a, b) => rank(a.frq) - rank(b.frq) || a.word.localeCompare(b.word));
}

export async function getProgress(now: Date = new Date()): Promise<VocabProgress> {
  const dict = dictProvider ? await dictProvider().catch(() => ({ w: {}, f: {} })) : { w: {}, f: {} };
  return computeProgress(dict, settings.getVocab().words, listEntries(), now);
}

export async function getUnknownAtLevel(level: CefrLevel): Promise<UnknownWord[]> {
  if (!dictProvider) return [];
  const dict = await dictProvider();
  return unknownAtLevel(dict, settings.getVocab().words, level);
}
```

```ts
import { contextBridge, ipcRenderer, webUtils } from 'electron';
import type { ReadAlongApi } from '@shared/api';

const invoke = (channel: string, ...args: unknown[]) => ipcRenderer.invoke(channel, ...args);

const api: ReadAlongApi = {
  importBookDialog: () => invoke('library:importDialog'),
  importFile: (p) => invoke('library:importFile', p),
  pathForFile: (file) => webUtils.getPathForFile(file),
  importText: (title, text) => invoke('library:importText', title, text),
  listLibrary: () => invoke('library:list'),
  loadBook: (id) => invoke('library:load', id),
  removeBook: (id) => invoke('library:remove', id),
  saveProgress: (id, position, percent) => invoke('library:progress', id, position, percent),
  loadDictionary: () => invoke('dict:load'),
  getVocab: () => invoke('vocab:get'),
  setWordStatus: (lemma, status) => invoke('vocab:setStatus', lemma, status),
  setMarkedRanges: (bookId, ranges) => invoke('vocab:setMarked', bookId, ranges),
  vocabEntries: () => invoke('vocab:entries'),
  vocabUpsertEntry: (entry) => invoke('vocab:upsertEntry', entry),
  vocabSetEntryStatus: (lemma, status) => invoke('vocab:setEntryStatus', lemma, status),
  vocabDeleteEntry: (lemma) => invoke('vocab:deleteEntry', lemma),
  vocabExportCsv: () => invoke('vocab:exportCsv'),
  vocabCsvPath: () => invoke('vocab:csvPath'),
  vocabProgress: () => invoke('vocab:progress'),
  vocabUnknownAtLevel: (level) => invoke('vocab:unknownAtLevel', level),
  getSettings: () => invoke('settings:get'),
  setSettings: (patch) => invoke('settings:set', patch),
  setSecret: (name, value) => invoke('secrets:set', name, value),
  hasSecret: (name) => invoke('secrets:has', name),
  secretStatus: () => invoke('secrets:status'),
  dismissLostKeys: () => invoke('secrets:dismissLost'),
  aiExplain: (req) => invoke('ai:explain', req),
  aiCancel: (id) => invoke('ai:cancel', id),
  aiTest: (provider) => invoke('ai:test', provider),
  onAiEvent: (cb) => {
    const handler = (_e: Electron.IpcRendererEvent, ev: Parameters<typeof cb>[0]) => cb(ev);
    ipcRenderer.on('ai:event', handler);
    return () => ipcRenderer.removeListener('ai:event', handler);
  },
  getUsage: () => invoke('ai:usage'),
  hintsGet: (bookId, chapter) => invoke('hints:get', bookId, chapter),
  hintsPhrases: (bookId, chapter) => invoke('hints:phrases', bookId, chapter),
  hintsRequest: (bookId, chapter) => invoke('hints:request', bookId, chapter),
  hintsClear: (bookId) => invoke('hints:clear', bookId),
  onHintsProgress: (cb) => {
    const handler = (_e: Electron.IpcRendererEvent, ev: Parameters<typeof cb>[0]) => cb(ev);
    ipcRenderer.on('hints:progress', handler);
    return () => ipcRenderer.removeListener('hints:progress', handler);
  },
  ttsListVoices: (engine) => invoke('tts:voices', engine),
  ttsSynthesize: (engine, text, voiceId, rate) => invoke('tts:synthesize', engine, text, voiceId, rate),
  kokoroStatus: () => invoke('kokoro:status'),
  kokoroDownload: () => invoke('kokoro:download'),
  kokoroCancelDownload: () => invoke('kokoro:cancelDownload'),
  kokoroPrepare: (items) => invoke('kokoro:prepare', items),
  onKokoroProgress: (cb) => {
    const handler = (_e: Electron.IpcRendererEvent, s: Parameters<typeof cb>[0]) => cb(s);
    ipcRenderer.on('kokoro:progress', handler);
    return () => ipcRenderer.removeListener('kokoro:progress', handler);
  },
  sttStatus: () => invoke('stt:status'),
  sttDownload: () => invoke('stt:download'),
  sttCancelDownload: () => invoke('stt:cancelDownload'),
  sttStart: (sessionId, opts) => invoke('stt:start', sessionId, opts ?? {}),
  sttPush: (sessionId, pcm) => invoke('stt:push', sessionId, pcm),
  sttStop: (sessionId) => invoke('stt:stop', sessionId),
  onSttEvent: (cb) => {
    const handler = (_e: Electron.IpcRendererEvent, ev: Parameters<typeof cb>[0]) => cb(ev);
    ipcRenderer.on('stt:event', handler);
    return () => ipcRenderer.removeListener('stt:event', handler);
  },
  onSttProgress: (cb) => {
    const handler = (_e: Electron.IpcRendererEvent, s: Parameters<typeof cb>[0]) => cb(s);
    ipcRenderer.on('stt:progress', handler);
    return () => ipcRenderer.removeListener('stt:progress', handler);
  },
  getDiagnostics: () => invoke('app:diagnostics'),
  openExternal: (url) => invoke('app:openExternal', url),
  exportText: (fileName, contents) => invoke('app:exportText', fileName, contents),
  onMenu: (cb) => {
    const handler = (_e: Electron.IpcRendererEvent, action: string) => cb(action);
    ipcRenderer.on('menu:action', handler);
    return () => ipcRenderer.removeListener('menu:action', handler);
  },
};

contextBridge.exposeInMainWorld('readalong', api);
```

### `src/renderer/app.tsx` (87 lines)

```tsx
import React, { useEffect } from 'react';
import { useApp, applyAppearance } from './state/store';
import { Library } from './views/Library';
import { SettingsView } from './views/Settings';
import { DiagnosticsView } from './views/Diagnostics';
import { ReaderView } from './reader/ReaderView';
import { Vocabulary } from './views/Vocabulary';
import { Progress } from './views/Progress';
import { LevelTest } from './views/LevelTest';
import { Tip } from './ui/Tip';

export function App(): JSX.Element {
  const view = useApp((s) => s.view);
  const settings = useApp((s) => s.settings);
  const toast = useApp((s) => s.toast);
  const book = useApp((s) => s.book);

  useEffect(() => {
    (async () => {
      const [settings, vocab] = await Promise.all([window.readalong.getSettings(), window.readalong.getVocab()]);
      useApp.getState().setSettings(settings);
      useApp.getState().setVocab(vocab);
      await useApp.getState().refreshLibrary();
      // first start: find the learner's level, then the settings tour
      if (!settings.onboarded) useApp.getState().setView(settings.level.testedAt ? 'settings' : 'leveltest');
    })();
    const off = window.readalong.onMenu((action) => {
      const st = useApp.getState();
      if (action === 'settings') st.setView('settings');
      else if (action === 'library') st.setView('library');
      else if (action === 'diagnostics') st.setView('diagnostics');
      else if (action === 'vocabulary') st.setView('vocabulary');
      else if (action === 'progress') st.setView('progress');
      else if (action === 'open') void Library.openDialog();
      else if (action === 'paste') Library.openPaste();
      else if (action === 'fontUp' || action === 'fontDown') {
        const size = Math.min(34, Math.max(12, st.settings.appearance.fontSizePx + (action === 'fontUp' ? 2 : -2)));
        void st.patchSettings({ appearance: { ...st.settings.appearance, fontSizePx: size } });
      } else if (action === 'theme') {
        const order = ['night', 'sepia', 'light', 'grey'] as const;
        const next = order[(order.indexOf(st.settings.appearance.theme as never) + 1) % order.length];
        void st.patchSettings({ appearance: { ...st.settings.appearance, theme: next } });
      } else if (action === 'band') {
        // the old subtitle band is now the Listening screen
        if (st.view === 'reader' && st.book) st.setMode(st.mode === 'reading' ? 'listening' : 'reading');
      } else window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('readalong:menu', { detail: action }));
    });
    return off;
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => { applyAppearance(settings); }, [settings]);

  // The reader fills the whole window and draws its own slim bars (the traffic-light drag region included).
  const reader = view === 'reader' && book;

  return (
    <div className="app">
      {!reader && (
        <div className="titlebar drag">
          <span className="title app-name">Dream Read</span>
          <div className="row no-drag">
            {view !== 'library' && <Tip text="Your books (Cmd+L)" below align="end"><button className="quiet" onClick={() => useApp.getState().setView('library')}>Library</button></Tip>}
            {book && <Tip text="Back to where you stopped" below align="end"><button className="quiet" onClick={() => useApp.getState().setView('reader')}>Continue reading</button></Tip>}
            {view !== 'vocabulary' && <Tip text="Every word you asked about, with its sentence and meaning" below align="end"><button className="quiet" onClick={() => useApp.getState().setView('vocabulary')} data-testid="nav-vocabulary">My Vocabulary</button></Tip>}
            {view !== 'progress' && <Tip text="Known and unknown words for each level" below align="end"><button className="quiet" onClick={() => useApp.getState().setView('progress')} data-testid="nav-progress">Progress</button></Tip>}
            {view !== 'settings' && <Tip text="Look, voice, AI and level (Cmd+,)" below align="end"><button className="quiet" onClick={() => useApp.getState().setView('settings')}>Settings</button></Tip>}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
      <div className="content">
        {view === 'library' && <Library />}
        {reader && <ReaderView key={book.id} book={book} />}
        {view === 'settings' && <SettingsView />}
        {view === 'diagnostics' && <DiagnosticsView />}
        {view === 'vocabulary' && <Vocabulary />}
        {view === 'progress' && <Progress />}
        {view === 'leveltest' && <LevelTest onDone={() => useApp.getState().setView(useApp.getState().book ? 'reader' : 'settings')} />}
        {toast && (
          <div className="toast" role="status">
            <span>{toast.text}</span>
            {toast.action && <button onClick={() => { toast.action!.run(); useApp.setState({ toast: null }); }}>{toast.action.label}</button>}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```css
html, body, #root { height: 100%; margin: 0; }
body { background: var(--bg); color: var(--fg); font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.45; -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased; overflow: hidden; }

button:hover { background: var(--bg-hover); border-color: var(--border-strong); }

button:focus-visible, input:focus-visible, select:focus-visible, textarea:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 1px; }
input[type="text"], input[type="password"], input[type="number"], select, textarea { background: var(--bg-sunken); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--radius-sm); padding: 7px 10px; }
input[type="text"]:focus, input[type="password"]:focus, input[type="number"]:focus, select:focus, textarea:focus { border-color: var(--border-strong); outline: none; }
textarea { font-family: var(--font-sans); line-height: 1.5; }
input[type="range"] { accent-color: var(--accent); width: 100%; margin: 6px 0; }
input[type="checkbox"], input[type="radio"] { accent-color: var(--accent); }
a { color: var(--accent); text-decoration: none; }
a:hover { text-decoration: underline; }

.drag { -webkit-app-region: drag; }
.no-drag { -webkit-app-region: no-drag; }

/* App shell */
.app { display: flex; flex-direction: column; height: 100%; }
.titlebar { height: 40px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 0 12px 0 84px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg-elevated) 82%, transparent); backdrop-filter: blur(18px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(18px); flex: none; zoom: var(--ui-scale); }

.library.drag-over::after { content: 'Drop to add to your library'; position: absolute; inset: 12px; border: 2px dashed var(--accent); border-radius: 16px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; color: var(--accent); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg) 70%, transparent); font-size: 16px; pointer-events: none; }

.book-card { background: var(--bg-elevated); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--radius); padding: 12px; cursor: pointer; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; transition: transform 160ms ease, box-shadow 160ms ease, border-color 160ms; box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm); }
.book-card:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: var(--shadow); border-color: var(--border-strong); }
.book-cover { aspect-ratio: 2 / 3; border-radius: 8px; background: linear-gradient(160deg, var(--cover-a), var(--cover-b)); position: relative; overflow: hidden; display: flex; align-items: flex-end; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06); }
.book-cover::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 10px; top: 0; bottom: 0; width: 1px; background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.22); }
.book-cover::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 11px; top: 0; bottom: 0; width: 1px; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1); }
.book-cover .initials { position: absolute; top: 14px; left: 18px; right: 12px; font-family: var(--font-serif); font-size: 34px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.02em; color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.82); line-height: 1; text-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25); }
.book-cover .cover-title { padding: 10px 12px 12px 18px; font-family: var(--font-serif); font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.25; color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.88); display: -webkit-box; -webkit-line-clamp: 3; -webkit-box-orient: vertical; overflow: hidden; }
.book-cover .cover-kind { position: absolute; top: 12px; right: 12px; font-size: 9px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.55); font-weight: 600; }
.book-card .t { font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.3; display: -webkit-box; -webkit-line-clamp: 2; -webkit-box-orient: vertical; overflow: hidden; }
.book-card .m { color: var(--fg-muted); font-size: 12px; }
.book-card .progress { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-size: 12px; color: var(--fg-muted); }
.book-card .ring { width: 18px; height: 18px; flex: none; }
.book-card .ring circle { fill: none; stroke-width: 3; }
.book-card .ring .track { stroke: var(--border-strong); }
.book-card .ring .fill { stroke: var(--accent); stroke-linecap: round; transform: rotate(-90deg); transform-origin: 50% 50%; }
.book-card .bar { height: 3px; background: var(--border); border-radius: 2px; overflow: hidden; }
.book-card .bar > i { display: block; height: 100%; background: var(--accent); border-radius: 2px; }
.book-card .foot { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 6px; margin-top: auto; }
.book-card .foot button { padding: 5px 12px; font-size: 13px; }
.book-card .foot .remove { opacity: 0; }
.book-card:hover .foot .remove, .book-card:focus-within .foot .remove { opacity: 1; }
.empty { color: var(--fg-muted); padding: 56px 24px; text-align: center; border: 1px dashed var(--border-strong); border-radius: 16px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 10px; }
.empty .glyph { width: 56px; height: 56px; color: var(--fg-faint); }
.empty p { margin: 0; font-size: 15px; max-width: 46ch; }

/* Panels / dialogs */
.modal-backdrop { position: absolute; inset: 0; background: rgba(8, 9, 12, 0.45); backdrop-filter: blur(6px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(6px); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; z-index: 50; zoom: var(--ui-scale); }
.modal { background: var(--bg-elevated); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 16px; padding: 22px; width: min(720px, 90vw); max-height: 85vh; overflow: auto; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; box-shadow: var(--shadow); }
.modal h2 { margin: 0; font-size: 18px; }
.row { display: flex; gap: 10px; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.row.end { justify-content: flex-end; }
.muted { color: var(--fg-muted); }
.small { font-size: 12px; }

/* Settings */
.settings { display: flex; height: 100%; zoom: var(--ui-scale); }
.settings nav { width: 200px; border-right: 1px solid var(--border); padding: 20px 12px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; flex: none; background: var(--bg-sunken); }
.settings nav .nav-title { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--fg-faint); padding: 0 10px 10px; }
.settings nav button { text-align: left; border: none; background: transparent; color: var(--fg-muted); padding: 7px 10px; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; font-size: 13.5px; }
.settings nav button:hover { background: var(--bg-hover); color: var(--fg); }
.settings nav button.active { background: var(--accent-soft); color: var(--fg); font-weight: 500; }
.settings nav button .nav-ico { width: 16px; height: 16px; flex: none; opacity: 0.8; }
.settings nav button.primary { background: var(--accent); color: var(--accent-fg); justify-content: center; font-weight: 600; margin-top: 8px; }
.settings section { flex: 1; overflow: auto; padding: 32px 40px 56px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 22px; }
.settings section > * { max-width: 760px; }
.settings h2 { margin: 0; font-size: 22px; }
.settings .section-lead { color: var(--fg-muted); margin: -12px 0 0; font-size: 14px; }
.settings h3 { margin: 10px 0 0; font-size: 14px; color: var(--fg-muted); font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.02em; }
.card { background: var(--bg-elevated); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--radius); padding: 18px 20px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 16px; }
.field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; }
.field label { font-weight: 500; font-size: 13px; }
.field .hint { color: var(--fg-muted); font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.5; }
.field textarea { min-height: 110px; }
.field .value { color: var(--fg-muted); font-weight: 400; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.choice-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(200px, 1fr)); gap: 10px; }
.choice { border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 10px; padding: 11px 13px; cursor: pointer; background: var(--bg); display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; transition: border-color 120ms, background-color 120ms; }
.choice:hover { border-color: var(--border-strong); }
.choice.active { border-color: var(--accent); background: var(--accent-soft); }
.choice .name { font-weight: 600; }
.choice .cost { font-size: 12px; color: var(--fg-muted); }
.badge { display: inline-block; font-size: 11px; padding: 1px 7px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--bg-hover); color: var(--fg-muted); }
.badge.free { color: var(--ok); }
.badge.paid { color: var(--accent); }
.kv { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 220px 1fr; gap: 8px 12px; font-size: 13px; }
.kv .key { font-family: ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 12px; background: var(--bg-sunken); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 6px; padding: 1px 7px; justify-self: start; }

/* Theme cards */
.theme-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(140px, 1fr)); gap: 12px; }
.theme-card { border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 12px; padding: 6px; cursor: pointer; background: var(--bg); display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; transition: border-color 120ms, box-shadow 120ms; }
.theme-card:hover { border-color: var(--border-strong); }
.theme-card.active { border-color: var(--accent); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--accent-soft); }
.theme-card .preview { border-radius: 8px; padding: 12px 12px 10px; height: 78px; font-family: var(--font-serif); font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.4; overflow: hidden; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; }
.theme-card .preview .aa { font-size: 22px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1; }
.theme-card .preview .line { height: 4px; border-radius: 2px; opacity: 0.35; width: 85%; }
.theme-card .preview .line.short { width: 55%; }
.theme-card .name { font-size: 13px; text-align: center; padding: 2px 0 4px; }

/* Live samples next to size sliders */
.sample { background: var(--bg-sunken); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 10px; padding: 14px 18px; overflow: hidden; transition: font-size 120ms; }
.sample.book { font-family: var(--reader-font); }
.sample.subtitle { font-family: var(--reader-font); text-align: center; }
.sample.explain { line-height: 1.5; }
.sample.explain .zh { font-family: var(--font-zh); color: var(--fg-muted); }
.sample.ui { display: flex; gap: 10px; align-items: center; }
.size-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(180px, 240px) 1fr; gap: 18px; align-items: start; }
@media (max-width: 760px) { .size-row { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }
.swatches { display: flex; gap: 14px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.swatch { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font-size: 12px; color: var(--fg-muted); }
.swatch input[type="color"] { width: 26px; height: 26px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 6px; padding: 1px; background: transparent; }

/* Toast */
.toast { position: absolute; left: 50%; bottom: 28px; transform: translateX(-50%); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg-elevated) 92%, transparent); backdrop-filter: blur(14px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(14px); color: var(--fg); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 999px; padding: 9px 18px; z-index: 60; box-shadow: var(--shadow); display: flex; gap: 14px; align-items: center; font-size: 13px; max-width: min(560px, 90vw); animation: toast-in 220ms ease-out; zoom: var(--ui-scale); }
.toast button { padding: 4px 12px; border-radius: 999px; font-size: 12.5px; }
@keyframes toast-in { from { opacity: 0; transform: translate(-50%, 8px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: translate(-50%, 0); } }

/* Tips: "tap anything to see how it works". Hidden when appearance.showTips is off (html[data-tips="0"]). */
.tip-wrap { position: relative; display: inline-flex; }
.tip-wrap > .tip { position: absolute; left: 50%; bottom: calc(100% + 8px); transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(2px); visibility: hidden; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--fg) 92%, var(--bg)); color: var(--bg); font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.35; padding: 6px 10px; border-radius: 8px; white-space: nowrap; pointer-events: none; opacity: 0; transition: opacity 120ms ease 350ms, transform 120ms ease 350ms, visibility 0s linear 350ms; z-index: 70; box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm); font-family: var(--font-sans); font-weight: 400; }
.tip-wrap > .tip.wrap { white-space: normal; width: max-content; max-width: 280px; }
.tip-wrap > .tip.below { bottom: auto; top: calc(100% + 8px); transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(-2px); }
.tip-wrap > .tip.start { left: 0; transform: translateY(2px); }
.tip-wrap > .tip.end { left: auto; right: 0; transform: translateY(2px); }
.tip-wrap > .tip.below.start, .tip-wrap > .tip.below.end { transform: translateY(-2px); }
.tip-wrap:hover > .tip, .tip-wrap:focus-within > .tip { opacity: 1; visibility: visible; transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(0); }
.tip-wrap:hover > .tip.start, .tip-wrap:focus-within > .tip.start, .tip-wrap:hover > .tip.end, .tip-wrap:focus-within > .tip.end { transform: translateY(0); }
:root[data-tips="0"] .tip-wrap > .tip { display: none; }

/* Explanation styles editor (Settings → AI) */
.styles-editor { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 22px; }
.styles-editor h3 { margin: 0; }
.style-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(220px, 1fr)); gap: 10px; }
.style-card { border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 10px; padding: 11px 13px; cursor: pointer; background: var(--bg); display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; transition: border-color 120ms, background-color 120ms, box-shadow 120ms; min-width: 0; }
.style-card:hover { border-color: var(--border-strong); }
.style-card.in-use { border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 55%, var(--border)); }
.style-card.selected { border-color: var(--accent); background: var(--accent-soft); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--accent-soft); }
.style-card .name { font-weight: 600; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; min-width: 0; }
.style-card .name > span:first-child { overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
.style-card .desc { font-size: 12.5px; line-height: 1.4; }
.style-card .basis { font-size: 11.5px; line-height: 1.4; color: var(--fg-faint); }
.badge.on { color: var(--accent); background: var(--accent-soft); font-weight: 600; flex: none; }
.hidden-styles summary, details.advanced summary { cursor: pointer; color: var(--fg-muted); font-size: 13px; user-select: none; }
.hidden-styles summary:hover, details.advanced summary:hover { color: var(--fg); }
.style-actions { gap: 8px; }
.style-fields { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 16px; }
.seg { display: inline-flex; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--radius-sm); overflow: hidden; background: var(--bg-sunken); }
.seg .tip-wrap + .tip-wrap > button { border-left: 1px solid var(--border); }
.seg button { border: none; border-radius: 0; background: transparent; padding: 6px 12px; font-size: 13px; color: var(--fg-muted); white-space: nowrap; }
.seg button:hover { background: var(--bg-hover); color: var(--fg); }
.seg button.on { background: var(--accent-soft); color: var(--fg); font-weight: 500; }
.styles-editor textarea.prompt { min-height: 170px; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.5; resize: vertical; }
.styles-editor textarea.prompt.rules { min-height: 220px; }
.placeholder-legend { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 5px 16px; font-size: 12px; color: var(--fg-muted); line-height: 1.5; }
.placeholder-legend .lead { flex-basis: 100%; }
.placeholder-legend code { font-family: ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 11.5px; background: var(--bg-sunken); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 5px; padding: 0 5px; color: var(--fg); }
.shape-row { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 12px 14px; }
.shape-row .field { width: 128px; gap: 4px; }
.shape-row .field label { font-size: 12px; color: var(--fg-muted); font-weight: 400; line-height: 1.3; }
.shape-row .tip-wrap, .shape-row input[type="number"] { width: 100%; }
.styles-editor details.advanced { align-self: flex-start; padding-top: 22px; }
.styles-editor .tip-wrap > select, .styles-editor .tip-wrap > input[type="text"] { min-width: 0; }
.prompt-preview .preview-box { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; }
.prompt-preview .preview-label { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--fg-faint); margin-top: 6px; }
.prompt-preview pre { margin: 0; white-space: pre-wrap; word-break: break-word; font-family: ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.5; background: var(--bg-sunken); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--radius-sm); padding: 10px 12px; max-height: 320px; overflow: auto; color: var(--fg); }

/* My vocabulary + Progress (src/renderer/views/Vocabulary.tsx, Progress.tsx) */
.vocab, .progress-view { padding: 36px 40px 48px; overflow: auto; height: 100%; position: relative; zoom: var(--ui-scale); }
.vocab h1, .progress-view h1 { font-size: 26px; margin: 0 0 4px; }
.vocab .lead, .progress-view .lead { color: var(--fg-muted); margin: 0 0 20px; }
.vocab .toolbar { display: flex; gap: 10px; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-bottom: 10px; }
.vocab .toolbar .search, .progress-view .search { min-width: 240px; flex: 1 1 240px; max-width: 420px; }
.vocab .spacer, .progress-view .spacer { flex: 1; }
.chips { display: flex; gap: 4px; background: var(--bg-sunken); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 999px; padding: 3px; }
.chip { border: none; background: transparent; color: var(--fg-muted); padding: 5px 12px; border-radius: 999px; font-size: 13px; }
.chip:hover { background: var(--bg-hover); color: var(--fg); border-color: transparent; }
.chip.active { background: var(--accent-soft); color: var(--fg); font-weight: 500; }
.vocab .csv-path { font-size: 12px; margin: 0 0 18px; }
.vocab .csv-path .path { font-family: ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 11.5px; background: var(--bg-sunken); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 6px; padding: 1px 6px; user-select: all; }
.level-pill { display: inline-block; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.04em; padding: 1px 7px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--bg-hover); color: var(--fg-muted); flex: none; }
.level-pill.l-a1, .level-pill.l-a2 { color: var(--ok); }
.level-pill.l-b1, .level-pill.l-b2 { color: var(--accent); }
.level-pill.l-c1, .level-pill.l-c2 { color: var(--hl-marked); }
.vocab-list { display: flex; flex-direction: column; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--radius); background: var(--bg-elevated); overflow: hidden; }
.vocab-row { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); }
.vocab-row:last-child { border-bottom: none; }
.vocab-row .head { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(120px, 1.2fr) minmax(140px, 2fr) auto minmax(100px, 1.2fr) 64px 10px; gap: 14px; align-items: center; padding: 11px 16px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 120ms; }
.vocab-row .head:hover, .vocab-row.open .head { background: var(--bg-hover); }
.vocab-row .head:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: -2px; }
.vocab-row .word { font-family: var(--reader-font); font-size: 17px; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
.vocab-row .zh { font-family: var(--font-zh); color: var(--fg-muted); font-size: 13.5px; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
.vocab-row .book { color: var(--fg-muted); font-size: 12.5px; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
.vocab-row .date { color: var(--fg-faint); font-size: 12px; text-align: right; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; white-space: nowrap; }
.status-dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--hl-learning); display: inline-block; }
.status-dot.known { background: var(--ok); }
.vocab-row .body { padding: 2px 16px 16px 16px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; }
.vocab-row .sentence { margin: 0; font-family: var(--reader-font); font-size: 15.5px; line-height: 1.55; color: var(--fg); }
.vocab-row .explanation { margin: 0; font-size: var(--explain-size); line-height: 1.55; max-width: 72ch; white-space: pre-wrap; }
.vocab-row .meta { font-size: 12px; }
.vocab-row .actions { margin-top: 4px; }
.vocab-row .actions button { font-size: 13px; padding: 5px 12px; }
button.danger { color: var(--danger); }
button.danger:hover { color: var(--danger); }
@media (max-width: 820px) {
  .vocab-row .head { grid-template-columns: minmax(100px, 1fr) minmax(100px, 1.4fr) auto 10px; }
  .vocab-row .book, .vocab-row .date { display: none; }
}

.progress-view .stats { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(150px, 1fr)); gap: 12px; margin-bottom: 22px; max-width: 760px; }
.progress-view .stat { background: var(--bg-elevated); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--radius); padding: 14px 16px; }
.progress-view .stat .n { font-size: 28px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.02em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; line-height: 1.1; }
.progress-view .stat .l { color: var(--fg-muted); font-size: 12.5px; margin-top: 4px; }
.level-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(150px, 1fr)); gap: 12px; }
.level-card { text-align: left; background: var(--bg-elevated); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--radius); padding: 14px 16px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 120ms, box-shadow 120ms, transform 160ms; box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm); }
.level-card:hover { border-color: var(--border-strong); transform: translateY(-1px); }
.level-card.active { border-color: var(--accent); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--accent-soft); }
.level-card .top { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 8px; }
.level-card .lvl { font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.01em; }
.level-card .name { color: var(--fg-muted); font-size: 12px; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
.level-card .pct { font-size: 22px; font-weight: 600; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.level-card .pct .of { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 400; color: var(--fg-muted); }
.level-card .stack { display: flex; height: 6px; border-radius: 3px; overflow: hidden; background: var(--border); }
.level-card .stack i, .progress-view .legend i { display: inline-block; height: 100%; }
.level-card .stack .known, .progress-view .legend .known { background: var(--ok); }
.level-card .stack .learning, .progress-view .legend .learning { background: var(--accent); }
.level-card .stack .unknown, .progress-view .legend .unknown { background: var(--border-strong); }
.level-card .nums { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 4px 10px; color: var(--fg-muted); font-size: 11.5px; }
.level-card .nums b { color: var(--fg); font-weight: 500; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.progress-view .legend { font-size: 12px; margin: 12px 0 24px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.progress-view .legend i { width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 3px; margin-left: 6px; }
.unknown-panel { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; }
.unknown-panel h2 { margin: 0; font-size: 18px; }
.unknown-list { border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--radius); background: var(--bg-elevated); overflow: hidden; }
.unknown-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(120px, 1fr) minmax(90px, 0.8fr) minmax(160px, 2.4fr) auto; gap: 14px; align-items: center; padding: 8px 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); }
.unknown-row:last-child { border-bottom: none; }
.unknown-row:hover { background: var(--bg-hover); }
.unknown-row .word { font-family: var(--reader-font); font-size: 16px; }
.unknown-row .ipa { font-size: 12.5px; }
.unknown-row .zh { font-family: var(--font-zh); color: var(--fg-muted); font-size: 13.5px; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
.unknown-row .acts { display: flex; gap: 4px; }
.unknown-row .acts button { font-size: 12.5px; padding: 4px 10px; }
.progress-view .row.center { justify-content: center; margin: 8px 0; }

/* ---- vocabulary level test (views/LevelTest.tsx) ---- */
.level-test { height: 100%; overflow: auto; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 32px 24px 48px; zoom: var(--ui-scale); }
.level-card { width: 100%; max-width: 560px; gap: 12px; }
.level-card h2 { margin: 0; font-size: 22px; }
.level-intro-line { margin: 0; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.55; }
.level-actions { margin-top: 10px; gap: 10px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.level-preparing { align-items: center; text-align: center; }
.level-stage { width: 100%; max-width: 560px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 14px; }
.level-meta { width: 100%; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; font-size: 13px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.level-progress-bar { width: 100%; height: 3px; border-radius: 2px; background: var(--border); overflow: hidden; }
.level-progress-fill { height: 100%; background: var(--accent); transition: width 160ms ease; }
.level-question { margin: 28px 0 0; font-size: 14px; }
.level-word { font-family: var(--reader-font); font-size: 56px; line-height: 1.15; letter-spacing: -0.01em; text-align: center; min-height: 1.2em; padding: 12px 0 28px; overflow-wrap: anywhere; animation: level-word-in 140ms ease; }
@keyframes level-word-in { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(4px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: none; } }
.level-answers { display: flex; gap: 14px; width: 100%; }
.level-answers .tip-wrap { flex: 1; }
.level-answers .tip-wrap > .tip { white-space: normal; width: max-content; max-width: 240px; }
.level-answer { width: 100%; padding: 16px 20px; font-size: 17px; border-radius: var(--radius); }
.level-answer.no { background: var(--bg-elevated); }
.level-keys { margin: 6px 0 0; font-size: 12px; }
.level-result { align-items: center; text-align: center; }
.level-result-level { font-family: var(--reader-font); font-size: 72px; line-height: 1; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.02em; color: var(--accent); margin: 6px 0 2px; }
.level-result-sub { margin: -6px 0 0; font-size: 14px; }
.level-result .level-actions { justify-content: center; }
```

```tsx
import React from 'react';
import type { ReadMode } from '@shared/settings';
import { SHORTCUT_HELP, LISTEN_KEYS, WINDOW_KEY_OF, shortcutLabel } from './shortcuts';

/** The "?" sheet: every shortcut with a one-line explanation. Keys come from settings.shortcuts. */
export function HelpSheet({ shortcuts, mode, onClose }: { shortcuts: Record<string, string>; mode: ReadMode; onClose: () => void }): JSX.Element {
  return (
    <div className="modal-backdrop" onClick={onClose} data-testid="help">
      <div className="modal help-sheet" onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
        <div className="row"><h2>Keyboard shortcuts</h2><span className="grow" /><span className="muted small">You are in {mode === 'reading' ? 'Reading' : 'Listening'} mode</span><button className="icon quiet" onClick={onClose} aria-label="Close">✕</button></div>
        <div className="help-groups">
          {SHORTCUT_HELP.map((g) => (
            <section key={g.group}>
              <h3>{g.group}</h3>
              <div className="kv">
                {g.items.map((it) => {
                  const key = LISTEN_KEYS[it.id] ?? shortcuts[WINDOW_KEY_OF[it.id] ?? it.id];
                  if (!key) return null;
                  const off = it.modes && !it.modes.includes(mode);
                  return <React.Fragment key={it.id}><span className="key">{shortcutLabel(key)}</span><span className={off ? 'muted' : ''}>{it.text}{off ? ` (${it.modes!.join('/')} mode)` : ''}</span></React.Fragment>;
                })}
              </div>
            </section>
          ))}
        </div>
        <div className="muted small">Mouse: in Reading mode tap the left or right fifth of the page to turn it, the middle to show or hide the bars; swipe sideways for the previous or next sentence. Tap any word for its meaning and a spoken explanation; double-tap to mark it known; select text to explain a phrase.</div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```
