### `src/renderer/reader/ListeningScreen.tsx` (152 lines)

```tsx
import React, { useEffect, useLayoutEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import type { Position } from '@core/model';
import type { Settings, TtsEngineId } from '@shared/settings';
import type { TtsVoice } from '@core/tts/engine';
import { ENGINE_LABELS, AVAILABLE_ENGINES } from '@core/tts/engine';
import { useApp } from '../state/store';
import { Tip } from '../ui/Tip';
import type { ScreenShared } from './ReaderView';
import { keyOf } from './ReaderView';
import { BookIcon } from './ReadingScreen';
import { Timeline } from './Timeline';
import { clampRate, wordsPerMinute } from './progress';

/** The current line sits this far down the text area (the rest of the screen shows what comes next). */
const ANCHOR = 0.4;

interface Props {
  shared: ScreenShared;
  settings: Settings;
  voices: TtsVoice[];
  autoStop: boolean;
  onAutoStop: () => void;
  transcriptOpen: boolean;
  onTranscript: () => void;
  transcript: React.ReactNode;
  waiting: boolean;
  onContinue: () => void;
  onVoice: (engine: TtsEngineId, voiceId: string) => void;
  onWindow: (s: Settings['listen']['lastSecondsWindow']) => void;
}

/**
 * Listening mode: the chapter as lines (karaoke / lyrics). The current sentence is large and bright and the
 * text flows upward as the voice reads; past lines dim. A whole-book timeline and calm, always-visible controls.
 */
export function ListeningScreen(p: Props): JSX.Element {
  const { shared, settings } = p;
  const { book, index, chapter, position, playState, html, docRef, ensureRef, onRendered } = shared;
  const scrollRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const linesRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const [scrubbing, setScrubbing] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const playing = playState === 'playing' || playState === 'explaining';
  const wpm = wordsPerMinute('listening', settings.voice.rate, true);

  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    const lines = linesRef.current; if (!lines) return;
    lines.innerHTML = html;
    docRef.current = lines;
    onRendered();
    return () => { if (docRef.current === lines) docRef.current = null; };
  }, [html, onRendered, docRef]);

  function ensureVisible(pos: Position, force = false): void {
    const scroll = scrollRef.current, lines = linesRef.current; if (!scroll || !lines) return;
    const el = lines.querySelector<HTMLElement>(`.s[data-key="${keyOf(pos)}"]`); if (!el) return;
    const place = () => {
      const r = el.getBoundingClientRect(), s = scroll.getBoundingClientRect();
      const top = scroll.scrollTop + (r.top - s.top) + r.height / 2 - scroll.clientHeight * ANCHOR;
      scroll.scrollTo({ top: Math.max(0, top), behavior: force ? 'auto' : 'smooth' });
    };
    place();
    // the line grows when it becomes the current one: settle once the size transition has ended
    if (!force) setTimeout(place, 260);
  }
  useEffect(() => { ensureRef.current = ensureVisible; return () => { ensureRef.current = () => undefined; }; });
  useEffect(() => {
    const scroll = scrollRef.current; if (!scroll) return;
    const ro = new ResizeObserver(() => ensureVisible(position, true));
    ro.observe(scroll);
    return () => ro.disconnect();
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [settings.appearance.subtitleSizePx, settings.appearance.fontSizePx, settings.appearance.listenMaxLineChars]);

  const onLinesClick = (e: React.MouseEvent) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    const target = e.target as HTMLElement;
    const w = target.closest<HTMLElement>('.w');
    if (w?.dataset.lemma) { if (e.detail === 2) { e.preventDefault(); return; } shared.tapWord(w); return; }
    if (shared.closeOverlays()) return;
    const s = target.closest('.s');
    if (s) shared.tapSentence(s);
  };

  const rate = settings.voice.rate;
  const setRate = (r: number) => shared.setRate(clampRate(r));
  const engines = AVAILABLE_ENGINES;

  return (
    <div className={`screen listening ${playing ? 'playing' : ''}`} data-testid="listening">
      <div className="traffic-drag drag" aria-hidden="true" />
      <div className="listen-main">
        <div className="listen-scroll" ref={scrollRef}>
          <div className="listen-head drag">
            <span className="book-title">{book.title}</span>
            {book.chapters[chapter] && book.chapters.length > 1 && <span className="chapter-name">{book.chapters[chapter].title}</span>}
            <span className="grow" />
            <div className="row no-drag">
              <Tip text="Reading mode: pages, like a Kindle (L)" below align="end"><button className="primary switch" onClick={shared.switchMode} data-testid="switch-mode"><BookIcon /> Read</button></Tip>
              <Tip text="Your books" below align="end"><button className="quiet" onClick={() => useApp.getState().setView('library')}>Library</button></Tip>
              <Tip text="Look, voice, AI and level" below align="end"><button className="quiet" onClick={() => useApp.getState().setView('settings')}>Settings</button></Tip>
              <Tip text="All keyboard shortcuts (?)" below align="end"><button className="quiet icon" onClick={shared.openHelp} aria-label="Shortcuts">?</button></Tip>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="listen-lines" ref={linesRef} onClick={onLinesClick} onDoubleClick={shared.onDoubleClick} onMouseUp={shared.onMouseUp} data-testid="doc" />
        </div>
        {p.transcript}
      </div>
      {p.waiting && <div className="waiting-chip" onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}><span>Your turn: say or type the answer…</span><button onClick={p.onContinue}>Continue</button></div>}
      <div className="listen-bottom" onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
        <Timeline index={index} wpm={wpm} position={position} scrubbing={scrubbing} onScrub={setScrubbing} onSeek={(pos) => shared.seek(pos)} />
        <div className="controls" data-testid="controls">
          <div className="group transport">
            <Tip text="Previous sentence (←)" align="start"><button className="icon" onClick={shared.prev} aria-label="Previous sentence">⏮</button></Tip>
            <Tip text="Play or pause (Space)"><button className="primary icon play" onClick={shared.playPause} data-testid="play" aria-label={playing ? 'Pause' : 'Play'}>{playing ? '❚❚' : '▶'}</button></Tip>
            <Tip text="Next sentence (→)"><button className="icon" onClick={shared.next} aria-label="Next sentence">⏭</button></Tip>
          </div>
          <div className="group speed" data-testid="speed">
            <Tip text="Slower (−)"><button className="icon" onClick={() => setRate(rate - 0.1)} aria-label="Slower">−</button></Tip>
            <input type="range" min={0.5} max={2} step={0.1} value={rate} onChange={(e) => setRate(Number(e.target.value))} aria-label="Speed" />
            <Tip text="Faster (+)"><button className="icon" onClick={() => setRate(rate + 0.1)} aria-label="Faster">+</button></Tip>
            <span className="val">{rate.toFixed(1)}×</span>
          </div>
          <div className="group explain">
            <Tip text="Hear the last explanation again, deeper; or explain the hard word of this sentence (D)"><button onClick={shared.dontKnow} data-testid="dontknow">I don't know</button></Tip>
            <Tip text="Speak the Chinese meaning at the end of each explanation, with a Chinese voice"><button className={settings.ai.speakChinese ? 'listen-toggle on' : 'listen-toggle'} aria-pressed={settings.ai.speakChinese} onClick={() => void useApp.getState().patchSettings({ ai: { ...useApp.getState().settings.ai, speakChinese: !useApp.getState().settings.ai.speakChinese } })} data-testid="chinese-toggle">中文</button></Tip>
            <Tip text="Explain what was just read (Shift+E)"><button onClick={shared.explainLast} data-testid="explain-last">Explain last</button></Tip>
            <select value={settings.listen.lastSecondsWindow} onChange={(e) => p.onWindow(Number(e.target.value) as never)} aria-label="How far back" data-testid="window">
              {[20, 30, 40, 60].map((s) => <option key={s} value={s}>{s} s</option>)}
            </select>
            <Tip text={p.autoStop ? 'Pause at hard words is on (Q)' : 'Pause at hard words is off (Q)'}><button className={`icon ${p.autoStop ? 'active' : ''}`} onClick={p.onAutoStop} aria-label="Pause at hard words" data-testid="autostop">{p.autoStop ? '◉' : '○'}</button></Tip>
          </div>
          <span className="grow" />
          <div className="group right">
            <select className="voice" value={`${settings.voice.engine}|${settings.voice.voiceId}`} onChange={(e) => { const [eng, id] = e.target.value.split('|'); p.onVoice(eng as TtsEngineId, id); }} aria-label="Voice" data-testid="voice">
              {engines.map((eng) => {
                const vs = p.voices.filter((v) => v.engine === eng);
                const meta = ENGINE_LABELS[eng];
                return (
                  <optgroup key={eng} label={`${meta.label} · ${meta.cost}`}>
                    {vs.length === 0 && <option value={`${eng}|`}>{eng === settings.voice.engine ? 'Default voice' : `Default voice (${meta.kind === 'cloud' ? 'needs setup' : 'auto'})`}</option>}
                    {vs.map((v) => <option key={v.id} value={`${eng}|${v.id}`}>{v.name} ({v.lang}){v.note ? ` – ${v.note}` : ''}</option>)}
                  </optgroup>
                );
              })}
            </select>
            <Tip text="Show or hide the written explanations" align="end"><button className={`icon ${p.transcriptOpen ? 'active' : ''}`} onClick={p.onTranscript} aria-label="Explanations" data-testid="transcript-toggle">≡</button></Tip>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### `src/renderer/reader/ReaderView.tsx` (767 lines)

```tsx
import React, { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import type { Book, Position, CefrLevel } from '@core/model';
import type { WordStatus, MarkedRange, TtsEngineId, ReadMode } from '@shared/settings';
import type { TtsVoice } from '@core/tts/engine';
import type { HintMap, ExplainRequest, PhraseHit } from '@shared/api';
import { Playback, type PlaybackState } from '@core/listen/playback';
import { ListenController, type TranscriptEntry, type CommandWindow } from '@core/listen/controller';
import { getEngine, useFakeEngine, cancelAllEngines, defaultVoiceFor, chineseVoiceId } from '@core/tts/registry';
import { explain as aiExplain } from '@core/ai/client';
import { firstPosition, getSentence, percentAt, nextPosition, prevPosition } from '@core/nav';
import { skippedSentences, stripInline } from '@core/import/skip';
import { sentenceKey } from '@core/model';
import { useApp } from '../state/store';
import { useDictionary } from './useDictionary';
import { renderChapter, renderSentence, restyleLemma, type TokenMeta } from './render';
import { hintText } from './hints';
import { indexBook, positionAtTime, timeAt, wordsPerMinute, clampRate, type BookIndex } from './progress';
import { WordCard, type CardData } from './WordCard';
import { HelpSheet } from './HelpSheet';
import { ReadingScreen, type ReadingPopover } from './ReadingScreen';
import { ListeningScreen } from './ListeningScreen';
import { Transcript } from './Transcript';
import { matchesShortcut, isTypingTarget, LISTEN_KEYS, shortcutLabel } from './shortcuts';
import { VoiceChat, type VoiceSnapshot } from '../voice/VoiceChat';
import { VoiceChatUI, type VoiceExchange } from '../voice/VoiceChatUI';
import { MicCapture, SilentMic } from '../voice/mic';
import { sttBridge, e2eSttBridge, installE2eHooks } from '../voice/bridge';
import { Tip } from '../ui/Tip';
import { toChapterPhraseMap, type ChapterPhraseMap } from './phrases';

const E2E = typeof location !== 'undefined' && new URLSearchParams(location.search).has('e2e');
if (E2E) useFakeEngine(2);
/** e2e: every AI request the reader sent (the spec checks kinds, questions and "again") */
const e2eRequests: ExplainRequest[] = [];

export const keyOf = (p: Position) => `${p.chapter}.${p.paragraph}.${p.sentence}`;

/** How long the word card stays after its explanation ended. */
const CARD_LINGER_MS = 1500;

export type Card = CardData & { pos: Position; tokenIndex: number; entryId: number | null };
export interface SelBar { x: number; y: number; text: string; kind: 'word' | 'phrase' | 'sentence' | 'passage'; ranges: MarkedRange[]; pos: Position }

/** What both screens get from the reader: the rendered chapter, the shared position and the shared actions. */
export interface ScreenShared {
  book: Book;
  index: BookIndex;
  chapter: number;
  position: Position;
  playState: PlaybackState;
  /** the chapter's HTML (word spans, hints); the screen injects it and calls onRendered */
  html: string;
  docRef: React.MutableRefObject<HTMLDivElement | null>;
  /** the screen registers how it brings a sentence into view */
  ensureRef: React.MutableRefObject<(pos: Position, force?: boolean) => void>;
  onRendered: () => void;
  /** a tap on a word: opens the card and starts the spoken explanation */
  tapWord: (el: HTMLElement) => void;
  /** a tap on a sentence (not a word): the reading moves there */
  tapSentence: (el: Element) => boolean;
  /** closes the card / selection bar if one is open; true when something was closed (the tap is used up) */
  closeOverlays: () => boolean;
  onDoubleClick: (e: React.MouseEvent) => void;
  onMouseUp: () => void;
  posOf: (el: Element) => Position | null;
  playPause: () => void;
  prev: () => void;
  next: () => void;
  seek: (pos: Position) => void;
  goToChapter: (i: number) => void;
  setRate: (r: number) => void;
  switchMode: () => void;
  explainLast: () => void;
  dontKnow: () => void;
  explainSentenceAt: (pos: Position) => void;
  seekSeconds: (delta: number) => void;
  openHelp: () => void;
  wpm: number;
  busy: boolean;
}

export function ReaderView({ book }: { book: Book }): JSX.Element {
  const dict = useDictionary();
  const settings = useApp((s) => s.settings);
  const vocab = useApp((s) => s.vocab);
  const library = useApp((s) => s.library);
  const mode = useApp((s) => s.mode);
  const showToast = useApp((s) => s.showToast);

  const rootRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const docRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);
  const ensureRef = useRef<(pos: Position, force?: boolean) => void>(() => undefined);
  const settingsRef = useRef(settings); settingsRef.current = settings;
  const vocabRef = useRef(vocab); vocabRef.current = vocab;
  const modeRef = useRef<ReadMode>(mode); modeRef.current = mode;
  const metaRef = useRef(new Map<string, (TokenMeta | null)[]>());
  const playbackRef = useRef<Playback | null>(null);
  const controllerRef = useRef<ListenController | null>(null);
  const voiceIdRef = useRef<string>('');
  const explainVoiceIdRef = useRef<string>('');
  const zhVoiceRef = useRef<string | null>(null);
  const markedRef = useRef<MarkedRange[]>(vocab.marked[book.id] ?? []);
  const warnedRef = useRef<string>('');
  const posRef = useRef<Position>(firstPosition(book) ?? { chapter: 0, paragraph: 0, sentence: 0 });
  const currentWordRef = useRef<HTMLElement[]>([]);
  const cardRef = useRef<Card | null>(null);
  const cardCloseTimer = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);
  /** the Dream voice (Kokoro) is downloaded and loaded; until then a Mac voice reads */
  const kokoroReadyRef = useRef(false);
  const macVoiceIdRef = useRef<string>('');
  /** The engine that actually reads: Kokoro only once its model is ready (tests always use the fake Mac voice). */
  const readEngineId = (): TtsEngineId => { const id = settingsRef.current.voice.engine; return id === 'kokoro' && (E2E || !kokoroReadyRef.current) ? 'webspeech' : id; };
  const readVoiceId = (): string => (readEngineId() === settingsRef.current.voice.engine ? voiceIdRef.current : macVoiceIdRef.current);

  const [chapter, setChapter] = useState<number>(() => (library.find((b) => b.id === book.id)?.position ?? firstPosition(book))?.chapter ?? 0);
  const [position, setPosition] = useState<Position>(posRef.current);
  const [playState, setPlayState] = useState<PlaybackState>('idle');
  const [card, _setCard] = useState<Card | null>(null);
  const setCard = (c: Card | null) => { cardRef.current = c; _setCard(c); };
  const [transcript, setTranscript] = useState<TranscriptEntry[]>([]);
  const [transcriptOpen, setTranscriptOpen] = useState(false);
  const [voices, setVoices] = useState<TtsVoice[]>([]);
  const [selBar, setSelBar] = useState<SelBar | null>(null);
  const [ready, setReady] = useState(false);
  const [help, setHelp] = useState(false);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [waiting, setWaiting] = useState(false);
  const [autoStop, setAutoStop] = useState(true);
  const [popover, setPopover] = useState<ReadingPopover>(null);
  // ---- voice chat ----
  const voiceRef = useRef<VoiceChat | null>(null);
  const [voiceSnap, setVoiceSnap] = useState<VoiceSnapshot | null>(null);
  const [voicePop, setVoicePop] = useState(false);
  const savedEntriesRef = useRef(new Set<number>());
  const [heard, setHeard] = useState<{ text: string; command: 'know' | 'dont_know' | 'bye' } | null>(null);
  /** the AI's chapter hints (lemma -> [meaning as used here, other meaning]); null until the job has run */
  const [hints, setHints] = useState<HintMap | null>(null);
  const hintsRef = useRef<HintMap | null>(null); hintsRef.current = hints;
  /** the commands window of a stop (or after an explanation) is open: the bottom bar with I know / I don't know / Go on */
  const [cmdWin, setCmdWin] = useState<(CommandWindow & { id: number }) | null>(null);
  const cmdWinRef = useRef<CommandWindow | null>(null);
  const cmdSeq = useRef(0);
  /** chapter -> the chapter phrase job's hits per sentence (window.readalong.hintsPhrases, when that bridge exists) */
  const phrasesRef = useRef(new Map<number, ChapterPhraseMap>());
  /** bumps when chapter phrases arrive, so the chapter is rendered again with them highlighted */
  const [phrasesVersion, setPhrasesVersion] = useState(0);
  const hintOverrides = useMemo(() => { const out: Record<string, string> = {}; for (const [lemma, pair] of Object.entries(hints ?? {})) if (pair?.[0]) out[lemma] = pair[0]; return out; }, [hints]);

  const names = useMemo(() => new Set(book.names), [book]);
  /** sentences the voice leaves out (Skip settings: footnotes, captions, ...) */
  const skippedRef = useRef(new Set<string>());
  useEffect(() => { skippedRef.current = skippedSentences(book, settings.skip); }, [book, settings.skip]);
  const index = useMemo(() => indexBook(book), [book]);
  const playing = playState === 'playing' || playState === 'explaining';
  const wpm = wordsPerMinute(mode, settings.voice.rate, playing);

  // ---- voices ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  useEffect(() => {
    let on = true;
    (async () => {
      const s = settingsRef.current;
      voiceIdRef.current = s.voice.voiceId || (await defaultVoiceFor(s.voice.engine));
      macVoiceIdRef.current = await defaultVoiceFor('webspeech');
      const ee = s.voice.explainEngine ?? s.voice.engine;
      explainVoiceIdRef.current = s.voice.explainVoiceId || (ee === s.voice.engine ? voiceIdRef.current : await defaultVoiceFor(ee));
      zhVoiceRef.current = await chineseVoiceId();
      const list: TtsVoice[] = [];
      for (const id of ['webspeech', s.voice.engine, s.voice.explainEngine].filter(Boolean) as TtsEngineId[]) {
        if (list.some((v) => v.engine === id)) continue;
        try { list.push(...(await getEngine(id).listVoices())); } catch { /* engine not configured */ }
      }
      if (on) setVoices(list);
    })();
    return () => { on = false; };
  }, [settings.voice.engine, settings.voice.voiceId, settings.voice.explainEngine, settings.voice.explainVoiceId]);

  // ---- playback + listening controller (shared by both screens) ---------------------------------
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!dict) return;
    const start = library.find((b) => b.id === book.id)?.position ?? firstPosition(book) ?? { chapter: 0, paragraph: 0, sentence: 0 };
    posRef.current = start; setPosition(start); setChapter(start.chapter);
    const playback = new Playback(book, {
      engine: () => getEngine(readEngineId()),
      voice: () => ({ voiceId: readVoiceId(), rate: settingsRef.current.voice.rate }),
      pauseMs: () => settingsRef.current.voice.pauseBetweenSentencesMs,
      shouldSkip: (p) => skippedRef.current.has(sentenceKey(p)),
      strip: (t) => stripInline(t, settingsRef.current.skip),
    }, start);
    const controller = new ListenController(playback, {
      book, dict, names,
      settings: () => settingsRef.current,
      vocab: () => vocabRef.current,
      marked: () => markedRef.current,
      engine: () => getEngine(readEngineId()),
      explainEngine: () => { const ee = settingsRef.current.voice.explainEngine ?? settingsRef.current.voice.engine; return getEngine(ee === 'kokoro' && (E2E || !kokoroReadyRef.current) ? 'webspeech' : ee); },
      zhEngine: () => getEngine('webspeech'),
      voice: () => ({ voiceId: readVoiceId(), rate: settingsRef.current.voice.rate }),
      explainVoice: () => { const ee = settingsRef.current.voice.explainEngine ?? settingsRef.current.voice.engine; const fallback = ee === 'kokoro' && (E2E || !kokoroReadyRef.current); return { voiceId: fallback ? macVoiceIdRef.current : explainVoiceIdRef.current, rate: Math.min(settingsRef.current.voice.rate, 1.2) }; },
      zhVoiceId: () => (settingsRef.current.ai.speakChinese ? zhVoiceRef.current : null),
      contextZh: (lemma) => hintsRef.current?.[lemma],
      explain: (req, onDelta) => { if (E2E) e2eRequests.push(structuredClone(req)); const h = aiExplain(req, (_d, full) => onDelta(full)); return { done: h.done, cancel: h.cancel }; },
      mode: () => modeRef.current,
      onWaiting: (w) => setWaiting(w),
      onPauseWindow: (open) => voiceRef.current?.pauseWindow(open),
      onCommandWindow: (w) => { cmdWinRef.current = w; setCmdWin(w ? { ...w, id: ++cmdSeq.current } : null); },
      chapterPhrases: (pos) => phrasesRef.current.get(pos.chapter)?.[sentenceKey(pos)],
      // the dictionary card shows under the word while it is said 3 times and explained; it goes away afterwards
      onStopTarget: (t) => {
        if (!t) { closeCard(); return; }
        cancelCardClose();
        const c = anchorCard(t.kind, t.target);
        if (c) setCard(t.kind === 'phrase' ? { ...c, word: t.target } : c);
      },
      onTranscript: (entry) => {
        setTranscript((prev) => (prev.some((e) => e.id === entry.id) ? prev.map((e) => (e.id === entry.id ? entry : e)) : [...prev.slice(-40), entry]));
        setBusy(controller.busy);
        voiceRef.current?.setTutorState(!controller.busy ? 'idle' : entry.status === 'thinking' ? 'thinking' : 'speaking');
        if (entry.kind === 'question' && entry.status === 'thinking') setHeard(null);
        // every explained word or phrase goes into My Vocabulary (and the CSV), with its sentence and explanation
        if (entry.lemma && (entry.kind === 'word' || entry.kind === 'phrase') && entry.status === 'done' && entry.text && !savedEntriesRef.current.has(entry.id)) {
          savedEntriesRef.current.add(entry.id);
          const ch = book.chapters[entry.position?.chapter ?? 0];
          void window.readalong.vocabUpsertEntry({
            lemma: entry.lemma, word: entry.target, sentence: entry.sentence, explanation: entry.text, chinese: entry.chinese ?? '',
            bookId: book.id, bookTitle: book.title, chapter: ch?.title ?? '', position: entry.position, level: entry.level as never, again: entry.again,
          }).catch(() => undefined);
        }
        followEntry(entry);
      },
      onMarkLearning: (lemma) => { if (!vocabRef.current.words[lemma]) void changeStatus(lemma, 'learning', false); },
      onBudget: (daily, monthly) => {
        const s = settingsRef.current; const today = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
        if (s.ai.dailyWarnUsd > 0 && daily >= s.ai.dailyWarnUsd && warnedRef.current !== today) { warnedRef.current = today; showToast(`AI spending today: $${daily.toFixed(2)} (monthly $${monthly.toFixed(2)})`); }
      },
    });
    controller.enabled = modeRef.current === 'listening';
    playbackRef.current = playback; controllerRef.current = controller;
    const offs = [
      playback.on('sentence', (pos) => { posRef.current = pos; setPosition(pos); setChapter((c) => (c === pos.chapter ? c : pos.chapter)); highlightSentence(pos); scheduleSave(pos); prepareAhead(pos); }),
      playback.on('word', (pos, ti) => highlightWord(pos, ti)),
      playback.on('state', (st) => { setPlayState(st); setBusy(controller.busy); if (!controller.busy) voiceRef.current?.setTutorState('idle'); }),
      playback.on('finished', () => showToast('End of the book.')),
      playback.on('error', (e) => {
        const eng = readEngineId();
        if (eng === 'kokoro') {
          // the Dream voice failed: read on with a Mac voice; the choice in Settings stays, it is tried again when it reports ready
          kokoroReadyRef.current = false;
          showToast(`The Dream voice failed (${e.message}). Using a Mac voice for now.`);
          playback.play();
        } else if (eng !== 'webspeech') {
          const names: Partial<Record<TtsEngineId, string>> = { edge: 'Microsoft', openai: 'OpenAI', elevenlabs: 'ElevenLabs', azure: 'Azure', google: 'Google' };
          showToast(`${names[eng] ?? 'The'} voice failed (${e.message}). Switching to the Mac voice.`);
          void useApp.getState().patchSettings({ voice: { ...settingsRef.current.voice, engine: 'webspeech', voiceId: '' } }).then(async () => { voiceIdRef.current = await defaultVoiceFor('webspeech'); playback.play(); });
        } else showToast(`Voice error: ${e.message}`);
      }),
    ];
    setReady(true);
    return () => { offs.forEach((f) => f()); controller.dispose(); playback.stop(); cancelAllEngines(); playbackRef.current = null; controllerRef.current = null; };
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [dict, book]);

  // ---- voice chat: the learner talks with the tutor (mic -> local speech-to-text -> questions / commands) ----------
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!ready) return;
    const chat = new VoiceChat({
      stt: E2E ? e2eSttBridge() : sttBridge(),
      mic: E2E ? new SilentMic() : new MicCapture(),
      alwaysOn: settingsRef.current.voiceChat?.alwaysOn ?? false,
      tutor: {
        know: () => answerKnow(),
        dontKnow: () => answerDontKnow(),
        ask: (text, spoken) => {
          // in the window right after the word was said, anything the learner says goes with its explanation
          if (ctl()?.answerWindow({ text })) return;
          const cur = getSentence(book, posRef.current); void ctl()?.explainNow('question', cur?.text ?? '', posRef.current, null, undefined, text, undefined, undefined, spoken);
        },
        hold: () => { ctl()?.hold(); },
        release: () => ctl()?.release(modeRef.current === 'listening'),
        keepWaiting: () => ctl()?.keepWaiting(),
        continueBook: () => { const c = ctl(); if (c && !c.answerWindow('bye') && modeRef.current === 'listening') c.continueNow(); },
      },
    });
    voiceRef.current = chat;
    setVoiceSnap(chat.snapshot);
    const offs = [
      chat.on('change', (snap) => setVoiceSnap(snap)),
      chat.on('heard', (h) => setHeard(h.command ? { text: h.text, command: h.command } : null)),
    ];
    const uninstall = E2E ? installE2eHooks(chat, e2eRequests) : () => undefined;
    return () => { offs.forEach((f) => f()); uninstall(); chat.dispose(); if (voiceRef.current === chat) voiceRef.current = null; };
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [ready, book]);
  // the consent card and errors live in the popover: show it
  useEffect(() => { if (voiceSnap?.consent || voiceSnap?.error) setVoicePop(true); }, [voiceSnap?.consent, voiceSnap?.error]);
  // entering Listening mode without the speech model: offer the download once, so the windows at hard words can hear
  const hasVoice = voiceSnap !== null;
  useEffect(() => {
    const chat = voiceRef.current;
    if (mode !== 'listening' || !chat || settingsRef.current.voiceChat?.modelOffered) return;
    void chat.offerModel().then((shown) => {
      if (shown) void useApp.getState().patchSettings({ voiceChat: { ...settingsRef.current.voiceChat, modelOffered: true } });
    });
  }, [mode, hasVoice]);
  const setAlwaysOn = (on: boolean) => {
    voiceRef.current?.setAlwaysOn(on);
    void useApp.getState().patchSettings({ voiceChat: { ...settingsRef.current.voiceChat, alwaysOn: on } });
  };
  /** what the popover shows: the last question and its answer, or the last command heard */
  const voiceLast: VoiceExchange | null = useMemo(() => {
    if (heard) return { you: heard.text, tutor: heard.command === 'know' ? 'Good, marked as known.' : heard.command === 'dont_know' ? 'Once more, from another angle.' : 'Bye bye! Talk to me any time.', status: 'done' };
    const q = [...transcript].reverse().find((e) => e.kind === 'question');
    return q ? { you: q.question ?? '', tutor: q.parts?.free ?? q.text, status: q.status, error: q.error } : null;
  }, [heard, transcript]);

  // ---- the Dream voice (Kokoro): download on first use, read with a Mac voice meanwhile --------------
  useEffect(() => {
    if (E2E || (settings.voice.engine !== 'kokoro' && settings.voice.explainEngine !== 'kokoro') || typeof window.readalong.kokoroStatus !== 'function') return;
    let on = true;
    let announced = false;
    const apply = (st: { state: string; error: string | null }) => {
      if (!on) return;
      const ready = st.state === 'ready';
      if (ready !== kokoroReadyRef.current) {
        kokoroReadyRef.current = ready; // the next sentence is read with the new engine
        if (ready && announced) showToast('The Dream voice is ready.');
      }
      if (st.state === 'error' && st.error && !announced) { announced = true; showToast(`The Dream voice could not be downloaded (${st.error}). Using a Mac voice.`); }
    };
    const off = window.readalong.onKokoroProgress(apply);
    void window.readalong.kokoroStatus().then((st) => {
      if (!on) return;
      apply(st);
      if (st.state === 'missing' || st.state === 'error') {
        announced = true;
        showToast('Downloading the Dream voice (192 MB)… using a Mac voice meanwhile');
        void window.readalong.kokoroDownload().then(apply).catch((e: Error) => showToast(`The Dream voice could not be downloaded (${e.message}). Using a Mac voice.`));
      }
    }).catch(() => undefined);
    return () => { on = false; off(); };
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [settings.voice.engine, settings.voice.explainEngine]);

  /** While Kokoro reads, the next five sentences are synthesized ahead so each one starts without a wait. */
  function prepareAhead(pos: Position): void {
    if (readEngineId() !== 'kokoro' || typeof window.readalong.kokoroPrepare !== 'function') return;
    // exactly what Playback will ask for: Skip-panel sentences left out, the stripped text, speed 1 (the main
    // process always synthesizes Kokoro at speed 1; the rate is applied on playback), so the cache key matches
    const items: { text: string; voice?: string; speed?: number }[] = [];
    let p: Position | null = pos;
    for (let i = 0; i < 5 && p; ) {
      p = nextPosition(book, p);
      if (!p) break;
      if (skippedRef.current.has(sentenceKey(p))) continue;
      i++;
      const s = getSentence(book, p);
      const text = s ? (stripInline(s.text, settingsRef.current.skip)?.text ?? s.text) : '';
      if (text.trim()) items.push({ text, voice: readVoiceId() || undefined, speed: 1 });
    }
    if (items.length) void window.readalong.kokoroPrepare(items).catch(() => undefined);
  }

  // ---- chapter hints: cached by the main process; this chapter and the next are requested when missing ------
  useEffect(() => {
    const api = window.readalong;
    if (E2E || typeof api.hintsGet !== 'function') return;
    let on = true;
    setHints(null);
    const fetch = () => api.hintsGet(book.id, chapter).then((m) => { if (on) setHints(m); return m; }).catch(() => null);
    void fetch().then((m) => {
      if (!on) return;
      if (!m) void api.hintsRequest(book.id, chapter).catch(() => undefined);
      if (book.chapters[chapter + 1]) void api.hintsRequest(book.id, chapter + 1).catch(() => undefined);
    });
    const off = api.onHintsProgress((ev) => { if (ev.bookId === book.id && ev.chapter === chapter && ev.state === 'done') void fetch(); });
    return () => { on = false; off(); };
  }, [book, chapter]);

  // ---- chapter phrases (idioms, phrasal verbs, slang) found by the chapter job: Listening stops at them like words ----
  useEffect(() => {
    const api = window.readalong as unknown as { hintsPhrases?: (bookId: string, chapter: number) => Promise<unknown>; onHintsProgress?: typeof window.readalong.onHintsProgress };
    if (typeof api.hintsPhrases !== 'function') return;
    let on = true;
    const load = (ch: number) => { void api.hintsPhrases!(book.id, ch).then((d) => { if (!on) return; phrasesRef.current.set(ch, toChapterPhraseMap(d, ch)); if (ch === chapter) setPhrasesVersion((v) => v + 1); }, () => undefined); };
    load(chapter);
    if (book.chapters[chapter + 1]) load(chapter + 1);
    const off = typeof api.onHintsProgress === 'function' ? api.onHintsProgress((ev) => { if (ev.bookId === book.id && ev.state === 'done' && (ev.chapter === chapter || ev.chapter === chapter + 1)) load(ev.chapter); }) : () => undefined;
    return () => { on = false; off(); };
  }, [book, chapter]);
  useEffect(() => { phrasesRef.current = new Map(); }, [book]);

  // the controller stops at hard words only on the Listening screen (and only while auto-stop is on)
  useEffect(() => { const c = controllerRef.current; if (c) c.enabled = mode === 'listening' && autoStop; }, [mode, autoStop, ready]);

  // ---- rendering the chapter ------------------------------------------------------------------
  /** the chapter phrase job's hits of a sentence, in the shape annotateSentence takes */
  function phraseHitsOf(key: string): PhraseHit[] {
    const ch = Number(key.split('.')[0]);
    return (phrasesRef.current.get(ch)?.[key] ?? []).map((h) => ({ sentenceKey: key, start: h.start, end: h.end, text: h.text, lemma: h.lemma, level: h.level as CefrLevel, zh: h.zh ?? '' }));
  }
  const renderOpts = useCallback(() => ({ dict: dict!, names, learner: settingsRef.current.learnerLevel as CefrLevel, vocab: vocabRef.current.words, marked: markedRef.current, hints: settingsRef.current.appearance.showHints !== false, hintOverrides, phrases: phraseHitsOf }), [dict, names, hintOverrides]);

  const html = useMemo(() => {
    if (!dict) return '';
    const ch = book.chapters[chapter];
    if (!ch) return '';
    const { html, meta } = renderChapter(ch, renderOpts());
    metaRef.current = meta;
    // the small chapter label is for chapters whose text does not start with its own heading
    const label = ch.paragraphs[0]?.kind.startsWith('h') ? '' : `<div class="chapter-title">${ch.title.replace(/</g, '&lt;')}</div>`;
    return `<div class="doc-inner">${label}${html}</div>`;
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [dict, chapter, book, renderOpts, settings.learnerLevel, settings.appearance.showHints, vocab.marked, phrasesVersion]);
  useEffect(() => { markedRef.current = vocab.marked[book.id] ?? []; }, [vocab.marked, book.id]);

  /** the screen injected the chapter: put the highlight back and bring the sentence into view */
  const onRendered = useCallback(() => {
    highlightSentence(posRef.current);
    requestAnimationFrame(() => ensureRef.current(posRef.current, true));
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, []);

  // ---- highlighting -------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  function highlightSentence(pos: Position): void {
    const root = docRef.current; if (!root) return;
    root.querySelectorAll('.s.cur').forEach((e) => e.classList.remove('cur'));
    root.querySelectorAll('.s.past').forEach((e) => e.classList.remove('past'));
    const el = root.querySelector(`.s[data-key="${keyOf(pos)}"]`);
    el?.classList.add('cur');
    if (modeRef.current === 'listening' && el) {
      // lines before the current one are dimmed more than the ones to come
      for (const s of root.querySelectorAll('.s')) { if (s === el) break; s.classList.add('past'); }
    }
    clearWord();
    ensureRef.current(pos);
  }
  function clearWord(): void { for (const el of currentWordRef.current) el.classList.remove('cur-w'); currentWordRef.current = []; }
  function highlightWord(pos: Position, tokenIndex: number): void {
    clearWord();
    const el = docRef.current?.querySelector<HTMLElement>(`.s[data-key="${keyOf(pos)}"] .w[data-t="${tokenIndex}"]`);
    if (el) { el.classList.add('cur-w'); currentWordRef.current.push(el); }
  }

  // ---- progress -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  const saveTimer = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);
  function scheduleSave(pos: Position): void {
    if (saveTimer.current) clearTimeout(saveTimer.current);
    saveTimer.current = setTimeout(() => { void window.readalong.saveProgress(book.id, pos, percentAt(book, pos)); }, 1500);
  }
  useEffect(() => () => { if (saveTimer.current) { clearTimeout(saveTimer.current); void window.readalong.saveProgress(book.id, posRef.current, percentAt(book, posRef.current)); } }, [book]);

  // ---- vocabulary changes -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  async function changeStatus(lemma: string, status: WordStatus | null, toast = true): Promise<void> {
    const prev = vocabRef.current.words[lemma];
    const words = { ...vocabRef.current.words };
    if (status) words[lemma] = status; else delete words[lemma];
    useApp.getState().setVocab({ ...vocabRef.current, words });
    await window.readalong.setWordStatus(lemma, status);
    // keep the My Vocabulary entry (if the word has one) in step: known words are saved as known
    if (status === 'known' || status === 'learning') void window.readalong.vocabSetEntryStatus(lemma, status).catch(() => undefined);
    const hint = !status && dict && settingsRef.current.appearance.showHints !== false ? (hintsRef.current?.[lemma]?.[0] || hintText(dict.lookup(lemma)?.entry.zh ?? '')) : undefined;
    if (docRef.current) restyleLemma(docRef.current, lemma, status, settingsRef.current.learnerLevel, hint);
    if (toast && status === 'known') showToast(`“${lemma}” marked known`, { label: 'Undo', run: () => void changeStatus(lemma, prev ?? null, false) });
  }

  async function setMarked(ranges: MarkedRange[]): Promise<void> {
    markedRef.current = ranges;
    useApp.getState().setVocab({ ...vocabRef.current, marked: { ...vocabRef.current.marked, [book.id]: ranges } });
    await window.readalong.setMarkedRanges(book.id, ranges);
  }

  // ---- the word card ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  function metaFor(pos: Position, tokenIndex: number): TokenMeta | null {
    const list = metaRef.current.get(keyOf(pos));
    if (list) return list[tokenIndex] ?? null;
    const cur = getSentence(book, pos);
    if (!cur || !dict) return null;
    renderSentence(cur.para, cur.sentence, pos.chapter, renderOpts(), metaRef.current);
    return metaRef.current.get(keyOf(pos))?.[tokenIndex] ?? null;
  }
  function posOf(el: Element): Position | null {
    const s = el.closest<HTMLElement>('.s'); if (!s?.dataset.key) return null;
    const [c, p, sIdx] = s.dataset.key.split('.').map(Number);
    return { chapter: c, paragraph: p, sentence: sIdx };
  }
  function cancelCardClose(): void { if (cardCloseTimer.current) { clearTimeout(cardCloseTimer.current); cardCloseTimer.current = null; } }
  function closeCard(): void { cancelCardClose(); setCard(null); }
  /** Builds the card for a word span (anchored under it) without starting anything. */
  function cardFor(wordEl: HTMLElement): Card | null {
    const pos = posOf(wordEl); if (!pos) return null;
    const ti = Number(wordEl.dataset.t);
    const meta = metaFor(pos, ti); if (!meta) return null;
    const container = rootRef.current!.getBoundingClientRect();
    const r = wordEl.getBoundingClientRect();
    const above = container.bottom - r.bottom < (modeRef.current === 'listening' ? 300 : 230);
    const pair = hintsRef.current?.[meta.lemma];
    return { word: wordEl.firstChild?.textContent ?? wordEl.textContent ?? '', lemma: meta.lemma, ipa: meta.ipa, zh: meta.zh, here: pair?.[0] || undefined, other: pair?.[1] || undefined, level: meta.level, isName: meta.isName, status: vocabRef.current.words[meta.lemma], x: r.left - container.left + r.width / 2, y: (above ? r.top : r.bottom) - container.top, above, explain: { status: 'idle', text: '' }, pos, tokenIndex: ti, entryId: null };
  }
  /** A tap on a word: the card opens and the explanation starts at once (Reading mode: the audio stays paused after). */
  function tapWord(wordEl: HTMLElement, explain = true): void {
    const c = cardFor(wordEl); if (!c) return;
    cancelCardClose();
    setCard(c); setSelBar(null);
    if (!explain) return;
    const d = c.zh || c.ipa ? { ipa: c.ipa, zh: c.zh.split('\n')[0], level: c.level ?? undefined } : null;
    void ctl()?.explainNow('word', c.word, c.pos, d, c.isName ? undefined : c.lemma);
  }
  /** Keeps the card in step with the explanation it belongs to; opens one when listening stopped on a hard word. */
  /** Opens the dictionary card under a word or phrase of the current sentence (Listening stops). */
  function anchorCard(kind: string, target: string): Card | null {
    if (!docRef.current) return null;
    const cur = docRef.current.querySelector(`.s[data-key="${keyOf(posRef.current)}"]`) ?? docRef.current.querySelector('.s.cur');
    const spans = Array.from(cur?.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>(kind === 'word' ? '.w[data-lemma]' : '.ph, [data-phrase]') ?? []);
    const el = spans.find((w) => (w.firstChild?.textContent ?? w.textContent ?? '').trim() === target) ?? spans.find((w) => (w.textContent ?? '').trim().toLowerCase() === target.toLowerCase());
    const wordEl = el?.classList.contains('w') ? el : el?.querySelector<HTMLElement>('.w') ?? null;
    if (!wordEl) return null;
    return cardFor(wordEl);
  }

  function followEntry(entry: TranscriptEntry): void {
    let c = cardRef.current;
    const isWordish = entry.kind === 'word' || entry.kind === 'phrase';
    if (!c && isWordish && entry.status === 'thinking') {
      // an automatic stop (or an explanation started from elsewhere): anchor a card to the word in the current sentence
      c = anchorCard(entry.kind, entry.target); if (!c) return;
      cancelCardClose();
    }
    if (!c) return;
    if (c.entryId === null) {
      if (!(isWordish && entry.status === 'thinking' && entry.target.toLowerCase() === c.word.toLowerCase())) return;
      cancelCardClose();
    } else if (c.entryId !== entry.id) {
      // a newer explanation of the same word ("I don't know") takes over the card
      if (!(isWordish && entry.status === 'thinking' && entry.target.toLowerCase() === c.word.toLowerCase())) return;
      cancelCardClose();
    }
    const next: Card = { ...c, entryId: entry.id, explain: { status: entry.status, text: entry.parts?.free ?? entry.text, error: entry.error } };
    setCard(next);
    if (entry.status === 'done' || entry.status === 'skipped' || entry.status === 'error') {
      cancelCardClose();
      cardCloseTimer.current = setTimeout(() => { if (cardRef.current?.entryId === entry.id) setCard(null); cardCloseTimer.current = null; }, CARD_LINGER_MS);
    }
  }
  useEffect(() => () => cancelCardClose(), []);

  /** A tap on a sentence (not on a word): the reading moves there. */
  function tapSentence(el: Element): boolean {
    const pos = posOf(el); if (!pos) return false;
    closeCard(); setSelBar(null);
    seek(pos);
    return true;
  }
  const onDoubleClick = (e: React.MouseEvent) => {
    const w = (e.target as HTMLElement).closest<HTMLElement>('.w');
    if (w?.dataset.lemma && !w.classList.contains('name')) { e.preventDefault(); window.getSelection()?.removeAllRanges(); closeCard(); setSelBar(null); ctl()?.markKnown(w.dataset.lemma); void changeStatus(w.dataset.lemma, 'known'); }
  };
  const onMouseUp = () => {
    setTimeout(() => {
      const sel = window.getSelection();
      const root = docRef.current;
      if (!sel || sel.isCollapsed || !root || !sel.anchorNode || !root.contains(sel.anchorNode)) { setSelBar(null); return; }
      const text = sel.toString().replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
      if (!text || text.length > 2000) { setSelBar(null); return; }
      const a = (sel.anchorNode.parentElement)?.closest('.s'), f = (sel.focusNode?.parentElement)?.closest('.s');
      const posA = a ? posOf(a) : null, posF = f ? posOf(f) : null;
      const rect = sel.getRangeAt(0).getBoundingClientRect(); const c = rootRef.current!.getBoundingClientRect();
      const words = text.split(/\s+/).length;
      let kind: SelBar['kind'] = 'phrase';
      const ranges: MarkedRange[] = [];
      if (posA && posF && keyOf(posA) === keyOf(posF)) {
        const cur = getSentence(book, posA)!;
        const whole = text.length >= cur.text.trim().length - 2;
        kind = words === 1 ? 'word' : whole ? 'sentence' : 'phrase';
        const startIdx = cur.text.indexOf(text);
        ranges.push({ ...posA, start: whole || startIdx < 0 ? cur.sentence.start : cur.sentence.start + startIdx, end: whole || startIdx < 0 ? cur.sentence.end : cur.sentence.start + startIdx + text.length, text });
      } else if (posA && posF) {
        kind = 'passage';
        const [from, to] = [posA, posF].sort((x, y) => x.chapter - y.chapter || x.paragraph - y.paragraph || x.sentence - y.sentence);
        let p: Position | null = from;
        while (p && (p.chapter < to.chapter || p.paragraph < to.paragraph || (p.paragraph === to.paragraph && p.sentence <= to.sentence))) {

            <button className="cmd dont-know" data-testid="cmd-dont-know" onClick={answerDontKnow}>I don’t know <kbd>{shortcutLabel(settings.shortcuts.dontKnow || 'KeyD')}</kbd></button>

          </div>

        </div>
      )}

      {!ready && <div className="reader-preparing">Preparing…</div>}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import React, { useCallback, useEffect, useLayoutEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import type { Position } from '@core/model';
import type { Settings, ThemeId } from '@shared/settings';
import { useApp } from '../state/store';
import { Tip } from '../ui/Tip';
import type { ScreenShared } from './ReaderView';
import { keyOf } from './ReaderView';
import { bookPages, chapterMarks, fractionAt, nextProgressKind, positionAtWords, progressText, wordsLeft, type ProgressKind } from './progress';

export type ReadingPopover = 'aa' | 'goto' | null;

/** Chrome (the two bars) hides this long after the mouse last moved. */
const CHROME_HIDE_MS = 3000;

const THEMES: { id: ThemeId; name: string; bg: string; fg: string }[] = [
  { id: 'night', name: 'Night', bg: '#15171c', fg: '#d7d2c8' },
  { id: 'sepia', name: 'Sepia', bg: '#f4ecd8', fg: '#3b3328' },
  { id: 'light', name: 'Light', bg: '#faf9f6', fg: '#2a2a2e' },
  { id: 'grey', name: 'Grey', bg: '#2b2d31', fg: '#e0e0e0' },
];

interface Props { shared: ScreenShared; settings: Settings; popover: ReadingPopover; setPopover: (p: ReadingPopover) => void }

/**
 * Reading mode: Kindle-like pages. Tap zones (left fifth = back, right fifth = forward, middle = bars on/off),
 * bars that hide after 3 s without mouse movement, Aa and Go to popovers, a progress line with chapter ticks.
 */
export function ReadingScreen({ shared, settings, popover, setPopover }: Props): JSX.Element {
  const { book, index, chapter, position, playState, html, docRef, ensureRef, onRendered } = shared;
  const screenRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const viewRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const pagesRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const [page, setPage] = useState({ index: 0, count: 1 });

  const chromeTimer = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);
  const overBars = useRef(false);
  const popoverRef = useRef(popover); popoverRef.current = popover;
  const [progressKind, setProgressKind] = useState<ProgressKind>('page');
  const [gotoPage, setGotoPage] = useState('');
  const pending = useRef<Position | null>(null);
  const pageStep = useRef({ w: 0, gap: 48 });
  const playing = playState === 'playing' || playState === 'explaining';

  // ---- layout: CSS columns, one column per page ------------------------------------------------------
  const layoutPages = useCallback(() => {
    const view = viewRef.current, pages = pagesRef.current;
    if (!view || !pages) return;
    const w = view.clientWidth, h = view.clientHeight, gap = Math.max(32, settings.appearance.marginPx);
    pageStep.current = { w, gap };
    pages.style.cssText = `width:${w}px;height:${h}px;column-width:${w}px;column-gap:${gap}px;`;
    const count = Math.max(1, Math.round((pages.scrollWidth + gap) / (w + gap)));
    setPage((p) => ({ index: Math.min(p.index, count - 1), count }));
  }, [settings.appearance.marginPx]);

  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    const pages = pagesRef.current; if (!pages) return;
    pages.innerHTML = html;
    docRef.current = pages;
    layoutPages();
    onRendered();
    return () => { if (docRef.current === pages) docRef.current = null; };
  }, [html, layoutPages, onRendered, docRef]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const view = viewRef.current; if (!view) return;
    const ro = new ResizeObserver(() => { layoutPages(); requestAnimationFrame(() => ensureVisible(pendingPosition(), true)); });
    ro.observe(view);
    return () => ro.disconnect();
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [layoutPages, settings.appearance.fontSizePx, settings.appearance.lineHeight, settings.appearance.maxLineChars, settings.appearance.showHints]);
  useEffect(() => {
    const pages = pagesRef.current; if (!pages) return;
    pages.style.transform = `translateX(${-page.index * (pageStep.current.w + pageStep.current.gap)}px)`;
  }, [page]);

  const positionRef = useRef(position); positionRef.current = position;
  const pendingPosition = () => pending.current ?? positionRef.current;

  function pageOfSentence(pos: Position): number | null {
    const el = pagesRef.current?.querySelector(`.s[data-key="${keyOf(pos)}"]`);
    if (!el || !viewRef.current) return null;
    const rect = el.getClientRects()[0] ?? el.getBoundingClientRect();
    const viewRect = viewRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
    const step = pageStep.current.w + pageStep.current.gap;

  const turn = useCallback((dir: 1 | -1) => {

      const next = Math.min(p.count - 1, Math.max(0, p.index + dir));

    for (const el of pagesRef.current?.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('.s[data-key]') ?? []) {

      const abs = r.left - viewRect.left + page.index * step;

    }

  }, [page.index]);

  const onViewClick = (e: React.MouseEvent) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    if (popover) { setPopover(null); return; }
    const target = e.target as HTMLElement;
    const w = target.closest<HTMLElement>('.w');
    if (w?.dataset.lemma) { if (e.detail === 2) { e.preventDefault(); return; } shared.tapWord(w); return; }
    if (shared.closeOverlays()) return;
    const rect = viewRef.current!.getBoundingClientRect();
    const x = (e.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width;
    if (x < 0.2) { turn(-1); return; }
    if (x > 0.8) { turn(1); return; }
    const s = target.closest('.s');
    if (s && shared.tapSentence(s)) return;
    toggleChrome();
  };

  const swipe = useRef({ dx: 0, lock: 0 });
  const onWheel = (e: React.WheelEvent) => {
    if (Math.abs(e.deltaX) <= Math.abs(e.deltaY)) return;
    const now = Date.now();
    if (now < swipe.current.lock) return;
    swipe.current.dx += e.deltaX;
    if (Math.abs(swipe.current.dx) > 60) { swipe.current.lock = now + 450; swipe.current.dx = 0; if (e.deltaX > 0) shared.next(); else shared.prev(); }
  };
  const touch = useRef<{ x: number; y: number } | null>(null);
  const onTouchStart = (e: React.TouchEvent) => { const t = e.touches[0]; touch.current = { x: t.clientX, y: t.clientY }; };
  const onTouchEnd = (e: React.TouchEvent) => { const s = touch.current; touch.current = null; if (!s) return; const t = e.changedTouches[0]; const dx = t.clientX - s.x, dy = t.clientY - s.y; if (Math.abs(dx) > 50 && Math.abs(dx) > Math.abs(dy) * 1.5) { if (dx < 0) shared.next(); else shared.prev(); } };

  // ---- chrome: bars that hide after 3 s of stillness --------------------------------------------------
  const armHide = useCallback(() => {
    if (chromeTimer.current) clearTimeout(chromeTimer.current);
    chromeTimer.current = setTimeout(() => { if (!overBars.current && !popoverRef.current) setChrome(false); }, CHROME_HIDE_MS);
  }, []);
  const onMouseMove = useCallback(() => { setChrome(true); armHide(); }, [armHide]);
  const toggleChrome = () => { setChrome((v) => { if (!v) armHide(); else if (chromeTimer.current) clearTimeout(chromeTimer.current); return !v; }); };
  useEffect(() => { armHide(); return () => { if (chromeTimer.current) clearTimeout(chromeTimer.current); }; }, [armHide]);
  useEffect(() => { if (popover) { setChrome(true); if (chromeTimer.current) clearTimeout(chromeTimer.current); } else armHide(); }, [popover, armHide]);

  // ---- progress -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  const pages = bookPages(index, chapter, page.index, page.count);
  const left = wordsLeft(index, position);
  const fraction = fractionAt(index, position);
  const status = progressText(progressKind, { page: pages.page, pageCount: pages.total, wordsLeftChapter: left.chapter, wordsLeftBook: left.book, wpm: shared.wpm, fraction });
  const marks = chapterMarks(index);
  const ch = book.chapters[chapter];

  const goToWords = (words: number) => { const pos = positionAtWords(index, words); if (!pos) return; pending.current = pos; shared.seek(pos); setPopover(null); };
  const setA = (patch: Partial<Settings['appearance']>) => void useApp.getState().patchSettings({ appearance: { ...settings.appearance, ...patch } });
  const bars = { onMouseEnter: () => { overBars.current = true; }, onMouseLeave: () => { overBars.current = false; armHide(); } };

  return (
    <div className={`screen reading ${chrome ? 'chrome-on' : 'chrome-off'} ${playing ? 'playing' : ''}`} ref={screenRef} onMouseMove={onMouseMove} data-testid="reading">
      <div className="traffic-drag drag" aria-hidden="true" />
      <header className="bar top drag" {...bars} onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()} data-testid="topbar">
        <div className="titles">
          <span className="book-title" title={book.title}>{book.title}</span>
          {ch && book.chapters.length > 1 && <span className="chapter-name" title={ch.title}>{ch.title}</span>}
        </div>
        <div className="row no-drag">
          <Tip text="Text size, spacing, theme and margins" below><button className={`quiet ${popover === 'aa' ? 'active' : ''}`} onClick={() => setPopover(popover === 'aa' ? null : 'aa')} data-testid="aa"><span className="aa">Aa</span></button></Tip>
          <Tip text="Chapter, page or percent (G)" below><button className={`quiet ${popover === 'goto' ? 'active' : ''}`} onClick={() => setPopover(popover === 'goto' ? null : 'goto')} data-testid="goto">Go to</button></Tip>
          <Tip text="Listening mode: large lines, the voice pauses at hard words and explains them (L)" below align="end"><button className="primary switch" onClick={shared.switchMode} data-testid="switch-mode"><HeadphonesIcon /> Listen</button></Tip>
          <Tip text="Your books" below align="end"><button className="quiet" onClick={() => useApp.getState().setView('library')}>Library</button></Tip>
          <Tip text="Look, voice, AI and level" below align="end"><button className="quiet" onClick={() => useApp.getState().setView('settings')}>Settings</button></Tip>
          <Tip text="All keyboard shortcuts (?)" below align="end"><button className="quiet icon" onClick={shared.openHelp} aria-label="Shortcuts">?</button></Tip>
        </div>
        {popover === 'aa' && (
          <div className="popover aa-pop no-drag" onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()} data-testid="aa-pop">
            <div className="pop-row"><span>Text size</span><div className="steps"><button onClick={() => setA({ fontSizePx: Math.max(12, settings.appearance.fontSizePx - 2) })} aria-label="Smaller">A−</button><span className="val">{settings.appearance.fontSizePx}</span><button onClick={() => setA({ fontSizePx: Math.min(34, settings.appearance.fontSizePx + 2) })} aria-label="Larger">A+</button></div></div>
            <div className="pop-row"><span>Line spacing</span><div className="steps">{[1.4, 1.6, 1.8, 2.0].map((lh) => <button key={lh} className={Math.abs(settings.appearance.lineHeight - lh) < 0.05 ? 'active' : ''} onClick={() => setA({ lineHeight: lh })}>{lh.toFixed(1)}</button>)}</div></div>
            <div className="pop-row"><span>Margins</span><div className="steps">{[{ n: 'Narrow', m: 24, c: 90 }, { n: 'Medium', m: 48, c: 70 }, { n: 'Wide', m: 96, c: 56 }].map((o) => <button key={o.n} className={settings.appearance.maxLineChars === o.c ? 'active' : ''} onClick={() => setA({ marginPx: o.m, maxLineChars: o.c })}>{o.n}</button>)}</div></div>
            <div className="pop-row"><span>Font</span><div className="steps">{([['serif', 'Serif'], ['sans', 'Sans'], ['dyslexic', 'Dyslexic']] as const).map(([id, n]) => <button key={id} className={settings.appearance.fontFamily === id ? 'active' : ''} onClick={() => setA({ fontFamily: id })}>{n}</button>)}</div></div>
            <div className="pop-row themes">{THEMES.map((t) => <button key={t.id} className={`theme ${settings.appearance.theme === t.id ? 'active' : ''}`} style={{ background: t.bg, color: t.fg }} onClick={() => setA({ theme: t.id })} data-testid={`aa-theme-${t.id}`}><span className="aa">Aa</span><span>{t.name}</span></button>)}</div>
            <div className="pop-row"><label className="check"><input type="checkbox" checked={settings.appearance.showHints !== false} onChange={(e) => setA({ showHints: e.target.checked })} /> Chinese hints under hard words</label></div>
            <div className="pop-row"><label className="check"><input type="checkbox" checked={settings.appearance.pageTurnAnimation !== false} onChange={(e) => setA({ pageTurnAnimation: e.target.checked })} /> Page-turn animation</label></div>
          </div>
        )}
        {popover === 'goto' && (
          <div className="popover goto-pop no-drag" onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()} data-testid="goto-pop">
            <div className="pop-row"><button onClick={() => goToWords(0)}>Cover</button><button onClick={() => { const first = index.sentences[0]; if (first) goToWords(first.before); }}>Beginning</button>
              <form className="page-form" onSubmit={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); const n = Number(gotoPage); if (n >= 1) goToWords((n - 1) * pages.wordsPerPage); }}>
                <input type="number" min={1} max={pages.total} placeholder={`Page 1–${pages.total}`} value={gotoPage} onChange={(e) => setGotoPage(e.target.value)} data-testid="goto-page" /><button type="submit">Go</button>
              </form>
            </div>
            <div className="pop-row"><span className="muted small">{Math.floor(fraction * 100)}%</span><input type="range" min={0} max={100} step={1} defaultValue={Math.floor(fraction * 100)} onChange={(e) => goToWords((Number(e.target.value) / 100) * index.totalWords)} data-testid="goto-percent" /></div>
            <div className="chapter-list">
              {book.chapters.map((c) => <button key={c.index} className={`quiet ${c.index === chapter ? 'active' : ''}`} onClick={() => { shared.goToChapter(c.index); setPopover(null); }}><span className="n">{c.index + 1}</span><span className="t">{c.title}</span></button>)}
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </header>

      <div className="page-view" ref={viewRef} onClick={onViewClick} onDoubleClick={shared.onDoubleClick} onMouseUp={shared.onMouseUp} onWheel={onWheel} onTouchStart={onTouchStart} onTouchEnd={onTouchEnd} data-testid="doc">
        <div className={`pages ${settings.appearance.pageTurnAnimation === false ? 'no-anim' : ''}`} ref={pagesRef} />
        <div className="zone left" aria-hidden="true" /><div className="zone right" aria-hidden="true" />
      </div>

      <footer className="bar bottom" {...bars} onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()} data-testid="bottombar">
        <Tip text="Click to cycle: page, time left in chapter, time left in book, percent" align="start"><button className="quiet status" onClick={() => setProgressKind(nextProgressKind(progressKind))} data-testid="progress-text">{status}</button></Tip>
        <span className="grow" />
        <Tip text="Play or pause the voice (Space)"><button className={`quiet play ${playing ? 'on' : ''}`} onClick={shared.playPause} data-testid="play" aria-label={playing ? 'Pause' : 'Play'}>{playing ? '❚❚' : '▶'}</button></Tip>
        <span className="muted small page-count">{page.index + 1} / {page.count} in chapter</span>
      </footer>
      <div className="progress-line" aria-hidden="true">
        <div className="fill" style={{ width: `${fraction * 100}%` }} />
        {marks.map((m) => m.at > 0 && <i key={m.index} className="tick" style={{ left: `${m.at * 100}%` }} title={m.title} />)}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

export function HeadphonesIcon(): JSX.Element {
  return <svg className="ico" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M4 14v-2a8 8 0 0 1 16 0v2" /><rect x="3" y="13" width="4" height="7" rx="1.5" /><rect x="17" y="13" width="4" height="7" rx="1.5" /></svg>;
}
export function BookIcon(): JSX.Element {
  return <svg className="ico" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M12 7c-2-2-5-2.5-8-2v13c3-.5 6 0 8 2 2-2 5-2.5 8-2V5c-3-.5-6 0-8 2Z" /><path d="M12 7v13" /></svg>;
}
```

### `src/renderer/reader/Timeline.tsx` (61 lines)

```tsx
import React, { useRef, useState } from 'react';
import type { Position } from '@core/model';
import { chapterMarks, formatClock, positionAtTime, timeAt, totalTime, type BookIndex } from './progress';

interface Props {
  index: BookIndex;
  wpm: number;
  position: Position;
  /** seconds under the pointer while dragging (null = not dragging); reported through onScrub */
  scrubbing: number | null;
  onScrub: (seconds: number | null) => void;
  onSeek: (pos: Position) => void;
}

/** The whole-book timeline: estimated listening time, chapter marks with titles, drag to seek. */
export function Timeline({ index, wpm, position, scrubbing, onScrub, onSeek }: Props): JSX.Element {
  const trackRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const [hover, setHover] = useState<{ x: number; title: string } | null>(null);
  const total = totalTime(index, wpm);
  const now = timeAt(index, position, wpm);
  const marks = chapterMarks(index);
  const frac = total > 0 ? Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (scrubbing ?? now) / total)) : 0;

  const secondsAt = (clientX: number): number => {
    const r = trackRef.current!.getBoundingClientRect();
    return Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (clientX - r.left) / r.width)) * total;
  };
  const onPointerDown = (e: React.PointerEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    (e.currentTarget as HTMLElement).setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);
    onScrub(secondsAt(e.clientX));
  };
  const onPointerMove = (e: React.PointerEvent) => {
    if (scrubbing !== null && (e.buttons & 1)) onScrub(secondsAt(e.clientX));
    const r = trackRef.current!.getBoundingClientRect();
    const f = (e.clientX - r.left) / r.width;
    const m = [...marks].reverse().find((k) => k.at <= f);
    setHover({ x: e.clientX - r.left, title: `${formatClock(f * total)}${m ? ` · ${m.title}` : ''}` });
  };
  const onPointerUp = (e: React.PointerEvent) => {
    if (scrubbing === null) return;
    const sec = secondsAt(e.clientX);
    onScrub(null);
    const pos = positionAtTime(index, sec, wpm);
    if (pos) onSeek(pos);
  };

  return (
    <div className="timeline" data-testid="timeline">
      <span className="t cur" data-testid="clock">{formatClock(scrubbing ?? now)}</span>
      <div className="track" ref={trackRef} role="slider" aria-label="Position in the book" aria-valuemin={0} aria-valuemax={Math.round(total)} aria-valuenow={Math.round(now)} aria-valuetext={formatClock(now)}
        onPointerDown={onPointerDown} onPointerMove={onPointerMove} onPointerUp={onPointerUp} onPointerCancel={() => onScrub(null)} onPointerLeave={() => setHover(null)}>
        <div className="fill" style={{ width: `${frac * 100}%` }} />
        {marks.map((m) => m.at > 0 && <i key={m.index} className="mark" style={{ left: `${m.at * 100}%` }} data-testid="chapter-mark" title={m.title} />)}
        <div className="thumb" style={{ left: `${frac * 100}%` }} />
        {hover && <div className="hover-label" style={{ left: hover.x }}>{hover.title}</div>}
      </div>
      <span className="t total" data-testid="clock-total">{formatClock(total)}</span>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import React, { useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import type { TranscriptEntry } from '@core/listen/controller';

export function Transcript({ entries, onSkip, onClose, onAsk }: { entries: TranscriptEntry[]; onSkip: () => void; onClose: () => void; onAsk: (q: string) => void }): JSX.Element {
  const ref = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const [q, setQ] = React.useState('');
  useEffect(() => { ref.current?.scrollTo({ top: ref.current.scrollHeight }); }, [entries]);
  const active = entries.some((e) => e.status === 'thinking' || e.status === 'speaking');
  return (
    <aside className="transcript" data-testid="transcript">
      <header>
        <span>Explanations and chat</span>
        <span className="grow" />
        {active && <button onClick={onSkip} data-testid="skip">Skip ▶▶</button>}
        <button className="icon" onClick={onClose}>✕</button>
      </header>
      <div className="entries" ref={ref}>
        {entries.length === 0 && <div className="muted small">Tap a word and press Ask AI, press E, or turn on listening mode. Explanations appear here and are spoken aloud. Talk with the tutor with the mic button on the right (M), or type below.</div>}
        {entries.map((e) => e.kind === 'question' ? (
          // a conversation turn: what the learner said or typed, then the tutor's answer
          <div className={`entry chat ${e.status === 'error' ? 'error' : ''}`} key={e.id} data-testid="entry">
            <div className="you"><span className="who">You{e.spoken ? ' (spoken)' : ''}</span> {e.question || '…'}</div>
            <div className="tutor"><span className="who">Tutor</span> {e.status === 'thinking' && !e.text ? <span className="st">thinking…</span> : e.status === 'error' ? <span className="st">{e.error}</span> : <span className="body">{e.parts?.free ?? e.text}</span>}</div>
            {e.status === 'speaking' && <div className="st">speaking</div>}
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className={`entry ${e.status === 'error' ? 'error' : ''}`} key={e.id} data-testid="entry">
            <div className="target">{e.kind === 'passage' ? 'Last part' : e.target}</div>
            {e.kind !== 'passage' && <div className="st">{e.sentence}</div>}
            <div className="st">{e.status === 'thinking' ? 'thinking…' : e.status === 'speaking' ? 'speaking' : e.status === 'skipped' ? 'skipped' : e.status === 'error' ? e.error : e.usd !== undefined ? `done · $${e.usd.toFixed(4)}` : 'done'}</div>
            {e.parts ? (
              <div className="body">
                {e.parts.definition && <div>{e.parts.definition}</div>}
                {e.parts.inSentence && <div><b>Here:</b> {e.parts.inSentence}</div>}
                {e.parts.example && <div><i>{e.parts.example}</i></div>}
                {e.parts.meaning && <div>{e.parts.meaning}</div>}
                {e.parts.summary && <div>{e.parts.summary}</div>}
                {e.parts.chinese && <div className="zh">{e.parts.chinese}</div>}
                {e.parts.hardWords?.map((h, i) => <div key={i}><b>{h.word}</b> — {h.meaning} <span className="zh">{h.zh}</span></div>)}
                {e.parts.free && <div>{e.parts.free}</div>}
              </div>
            ) : e.text ? <div className="body">{e.text}</div> : null}
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
      <form className="row" style={{ padding: 10, borderTop: '1px solid var(--border)' }} onSubmit={(ev) => { ev.preventDefault(); if (q.trim()) { onAsk(q.trim()); setQ(''); } }}>
        <input type="text" style={{ flex: 1 }} placeholder="Ask about this sentence…" value={q} onChange={(e) => setQ(e.target.value)} />
        <button type="submit">Ask</button>
      </form>
    </aside>
  );
}
```

### `src/renderer/reader/WordCard.tsx` (85 lines)

```tsx
import React from 'react';
import type { CefrLevel } from '@core/model';
import type { WordStatus } from '@shared/settings';
import { parseGloss } from '@core/dict/dictionary';
import { Tip } from '../ui/Tip';

/** The small card under a tapped word (Trancy-style): word, IPA, level, meanings, and the three status buttons. */
export interface CardData {
  word: string;
  lemma: string;
  ipa: string;
  zh: string;
  /** the AI's meaning of the word as used in this chapter, and another common meaning (chapter hints job) */
  here?: string;
  other?: string;
  level: CefrLevel | null;
  isName: boolean;
  status: WordStatus | undefined;
  /** anchor: centre x and the bottom of the word, relative to the reader screen */
  x: number;
  y: number;
  /** the card goes above the word when there is no room below */
  above: boolean;
  /** the voice explanation that the tap started: its streamed text and state */
  explain: { status: 'thinking' | 'speaking' | 'done' | 'error' | 'skipped' | 'idle'; text: string; error?: string };
}

interface Props {
  data: CardData;
  onClose: () => void;
  onSay: () => void;
  onKnown: () => void;
  onDontKnow: () => void;
  onIgnore: () => void;
  /** speak the Chinese meaning at the end of explanations */
  chineseOn?: boolean;
  onToggleChinese?: () => void;
}

export function WordCard({ data, onClose, onSay, onKnown, onDontKnow, onIgnore, chineseOn, onToggleChinese }: Props): JSX.Element {
  const glosses = data.zh ? parseGloss(data.zh).slice(0, 2) : [];
  const style: React.CSSProperties = { left: Math.max(8, data.x - 150), top: data.above ? undefined : data.y + 8, bottom: data.above ? `calc(100% - ${data.y}px + 8px)` : undefined };
  const ex = data.explain;
  const english = ex.text ? firstSentences(ex.text, 160) : '';
  return (
    <div className={`card-word ${data.above ? 'above' : 'below'}`} style={style} data-testid="card" data-status={ex.status} onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()} onMouseDown={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
      <div className="hw">
        <span className="word">{data.word}</span>
        {data.ipa && <span className="ipa">{data.ipa}</span>}
        <Tip text="Say the word (S)"><button className="icon say" onClick={onSay} aria-label="Say the word">▶</button></Tip>
        <span className="grow" />
        {data.level && <span className="lvl">{data.level}</span>}
        {data.isName && <span className="lvl">name</span>}
        {data.lemma !== data.word.toLowerCase() && !data.isName && <span className="lemma">{data.lemma}</span>}
      </div>
      {data.here && <div className="zh here" data-testid="card-here"><span className="pos">here</span>{data.here}{data.other && <span className="muted"> · {data.other}</span>}</div>}
      {glosses.length > 0 ? (
        <div className="zh">{glosses.slice(0, data.here ? 1 : 2).map((g, i) => <span key={i}>{g.pos && <span className="pos">{g.pos}</span>}{g.zh}</span>)}</div>
      ) : data.isName ? <div className="muted small">A name.</div> : <div className="muted small">Not in the offline dictionary.</div>}
      <div className={`en ${ex.status}`} data-testid="card-explain">
        {ex.status === 'thinking' && !english && <span className="muted">Explaining…</span>}
        {english && <span>{english}</span>}
        {ex.status === 'error' && !english && <span className="muted">{ex.error ?? 'The explanation failed.'}</span>}
        {(ex.status === 'speaking' || ex.status === 'thinking') && <span className="live-dot" aria-hidden="true" />}
      </div>
      <div className="row status-btns">
        <Tip text="Known: no highlight, no hint, never explained (K)" align="start"><button className={data.status === 'known' ? 'active' : ''} onClick={onKnown} data-testid="card-known">I know</button></Tip>
        <Tip text="Hear it explained again, deeper; stays highlighted (D)"><button className={data.status === 'learning' ? 'active' : ''} onClick={onDontKnow} data-testid="card-dontknow">I don't know</button></Tip>
        <Tip text="Ignore this word for good (X)" align="end"><button className={data.status === 'ignored' ? 'active' : ''} onClick={onIgnore} data-testid="card-ignore">Ignore</button></Tip>
        {onToggleChinese && <Tip text={chineseOn ? 'Chinese meaning is spoken at the end of explanations. Tap to turn it off.' : 'Chinese meaning is not spoken. Tap to turn it on.'} align="end"><button className={chineseOn ? 'active' : ''} onClick={onToggleChinese} data-testid="card-chinese" aria-pressed={!!chineseOn}>中文 {chineseOn ? 'on' : 'off'}</button></Tip>}
        <span className="grow" />
        <button className="icon quiet close" onClick={onClose} aria-label="Close (Esc)">✕</button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

/** The first sentence or two of a streamed explanation, cut at a sentence end within `max` characters. */
export function firstSentences(text: string, max: number): string {
  const t = text.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
  if (t.length <= max) return t;
  const cut = t.slice(0, max);
  const end = Math.max(cut.lastIndexOf('. '), cut.lastIndexOf('! '), cut.lastIndexOf('? '));
  return end > max / 3 ? cut.slice(0, end + 1) : `${cut.trimEnd()}…`;
}
```

### `src/renderer/reader/hints.ts` (45 lines)

```ts
import type { CefrLevel } from '@core/model';
import type { VocabState } from '@shared/settings';
import type { WordInfo } from '@core/vocab/analysis';
import { isAboveLevel } from '@core/vocab/analysis';
import { parseGloss } from '@core/dict/dictionary';

/**
 * Word Wise-style hints: a short Chinese meaning under the words above the learner's level. Pure helpers so
 * the rule ("which words, which text") is testable without a DOM.
 */

/** Longest hint shown under a word; longer glosses are cut at a sense boundary. */
export const HINT_MAX_CHARS = 6;

/** A word gets a hint when it is above the learner's level, not a name, not known/ignored/learning, and the dictionary has a gloss. */
export function wantsHint(info: WordInfo | null, learner: CefrLevel, vocab: VocabState['words']): boolean {
  if (!info || info.isName || !info.entry) return false;
  if (vocab[info.lemma]) return false;
  return isAboveLevel(info, learner);
}

/**
 * The hint text for a dictionary gloss: the first sense of the first line, without the part-of-speech tag,
 * cut at a separator so it stays within `max` characters ("n. 房子, 住宅; 家庭" -> "房子").
 * A later AI job may replace these with context-aware hints (the `hints` map on the book position).
 */
export function hintText(zh: string, max = HINT_MAX_CHARS): string {
  if (!zh) return '';
  const g = parseGloss(zh).find((x) => x.zh.trim().length > 0);
  if (!g) return '';
  let s = g.zh.replace(/\[[^\]]*\]|<[^>]*>|\([^)]*\)|（[^）]*）/g, '').trim();
  // first sense: cut at the first separator
  const sep = s.search(/[,，;；、/|]/);
  if (sep > 0) s = s.slice(0, sep).trim();
  if (!s) return '';
  if (s.length > max) s = `${s.slice(0, max - 1)}…`;
  return s;
}

/** The hint for a word, or '' when it should not have one. */
export function hintFor(info: WordInfo | null, learner: CefrLevel, vocab: VocabState['words'], override?: string): string {
  if (!wantsHint(info, learner, vocab)) return '';
  if (override) return override.length > HINT_MAX_CHARS ? `${override.slice(0, HINT_MAX_CHARS - 1)}…` : override;
  return hintText(info!.entry!.zh);
}
```

```ts
import type { ChapterPhrase } from '@core/listen/controller';

/** sentenceKey ("c.p.s") -> the chapter phrase job's hits in that sentence */
export type ChapterPhraseMap = Record<string, ChapterPhrase[]>;

/**
 * Turns whatever the chapter phrase bridge (window.readalong.hintsPhrases) returned into sentenceKey -> hits,
 * tolerantly: a map keyed by "c.p.s" (or "p.s" within the chapter), the same map nested under the chapter
 * number, or a flat list of hits that carry their sentenceKey. Malformed entries are dropped; null gives {}.
 */
export function toChapterPhraseMap(data: unknown, chapter: number): ChapterPhraseMap {
  const out: ChapterPhraseMap = {};
  const add = (key: string, raw: unknown) => {
    const hit = toHit(raw);
    if (!hit) return;
    const parts = key.split('.');
    const full = parts.length === 2 ? `${chapter}.${key}` : key;
    if (!/^\d+\.\d+\.\d+$/.test(full)) return;
    (out[full] ??= []).push(hit);
  };
  if (!data || typeof data !== 'object') return out;
  if (Array.isArray(data)) {
    for (const h of data) { const k = (h as { sentenceKey?: unknown })?.sentenceKey; if (typeof k === 'string') add(k, h); }
    return out;
  }
  let map = data as Record<string, unknown>;
  const nested = map[String(chapter)];
  if (nested && typeof nested === 'object' && !Array.isArray(nested)) map = nested as Record<string, unknown>;
  for (const [key, list] of Object.entries(map)) {
    if (!Array.isArray(list)) continue;
    for (const h of list) add(typeof (h as { sentenceKey?: unknown })?.sentenceKey === 'string' ? (h as { sentenceKey: string }).sentenceKey : key, h);
  }
  return out;
}

function toHit(raw: unknown): ChapterPhrase | null {
  if (!raw || typeof raw !== 'object') return null;
  const r = raw as Record<string, unknown>;
  const start = Number(r.start), end = Number(r.end);
  const text = typeof r.text === 'string' ? r.text : '';
  if (!Number.isInteger(start) || !Number.isInteger(end) || start < 0 || end < start || !text.trim()) return null;
  const level = typeof r.level === 'string' ? r.level : '';
  if (!level) return null;
  const lemma = typeof r.lemma === 'string' && r.lemma.trim() ? r.lemma : text.toLowerCase();
  const zh = typeof r.zh === 'string' ? r.zh : undefined;
  return { start, end, text, lemma, level, ...(zh ? { zh } : {}) };
}
```
