### `src/renderer/reader/progress.ts` (156 lines)

```ts
import type { Book, Position } from '@core/model';
import type { ReadMode } from '@shared/settings';
import { comparePositions } from '@core/nav';

/**
 * Pure helpers behind the progress text (Reading mode) and the whole-book timeline (Listening mode):
 * word counts, reading-speed estimates, time formatting and the sentence <-> time mapping.
 */

/** Silent reading speed assumed when nothing is measured. */
export const READING_WPM = 200;
/** Words per minute of a natural voice at 1.0x (cloud and local voices alike). */
export const SPEECH_WPM = 160;

/** Words per minute the time estimates use: the voice's pace when audio plays, else silent reading. */
export function wordsPerMinute(mode: ReadMode, rate: number, playing: boolean): number {
  if (mode === 'listening' || playing) return Math.max(1, SPEECH_WPM * (Number.isFinite(rate) && rate > 0 ? rate : 1));
  return READING_WPM;
}

export interface SentenceSlot { pos: Position; words: number; /** words before this sentence in the book */ before: number }
export interface ChapterSlot { index: number; title: string; /** words before the chapter */ before: number; words: number }
export interface BookIndex { sentences: SentenceSlot[]; chapters: ChapterSlot[]; totalWords: number }

const countWords = (tokens: { kind: string }[]): number => tokens.reduce((n, t) => n + (t.kind === 'word' ? 1 : 0), 0);

/** Flat index of every sentence with its word offset; built once per book. */
export function indexBook(book: Book): BookIndex {
  const sentences: SentenceSlot[] = [];
  const chapters: ChapterSlot[] = [];
  let n = 0;
  for (const ch of book.chapters) {
    const before = n;
    for (const para of ch.paragraphs) for (const s of para.sentences) {
      const words = countWords(s.tokens);
      sentences.push({ pos: { chapter: ch.index, paragraph: para.index, sentence: s.index }, words, before: n });
      n += words;
    }
    chapters.push({ index: ch.index, title: ch.title, before, words: n - before });
  }
  return { sentences, chapters, totalWords: n };
}

/** Index of the sentence at `pos` in the flat list, or the nearest one before it (0 when the book is empty). */
export function sentenceIndexAt(idx: BookIndex, pos: Position): number {
  const list = idx.sentences;
  let lo = 0, hi = list.length - 1, ans = 0;
  while (lo <= hi) {
    const mid = (lo + hi) >> 1;
    if (comparePositions(list[mid].pos, pos) <= 0) { ans = mid; lo = mid + 1; } else hi = mid - 1;
  }
  return ans;
}

/** Words before `pos` in the whole book. */
export function wordsBefore(idx: BookIndex, pos: Position): number {
  if (!idx.sentences.length) return 0;
  return idx.sentences[sentenceIndexAt(idx, pos)].before;
}

/** Seconds of speech/reading before `pos` at `wpm`. */
export function timeAt(idx: BookIndex, pos: Position, wpm: number): number { return (wordsBefore(idx, pos) / wpm) * 60; }

/** Total seconds for the whole book at `wpm`. */
export function totalTime(idx: BookIndex, wpm: number): number { return (idx.totalWords / wpm) * 60; }

/** The sentence being read `seconds` into the book at `wpm` (clamped to the book). */
export function positionAtTime(idx: BookIndex, seconds: number, wpm: number): Position | null {
  const list = idx.sentences;
  if (!list.length) return null;
  const words = Math.max(0, (seconds / 60) * wpm);
  let lo = 0, hi = list.length - 1, ans = 0;
  while (lo <= hi) {
    const mid = (lo + hi) >> 1;
    if (list[mid].before <= words) { ans = mid; lo = mid + 1; } else hi = mid - 1;
  }
  return list[ans].pos;
}

/** Chapter tick marks for a timeline: fraction 0..1 of the book where each chapter starts, with its title. */
export function chapterMarks(idx: BookIndex): { index: number; title: string; at: number }[] {
  if (!idx.totalWords) return idx.chapters.map((c) => ({ index: c.index, title: c.title, at: 0 }));
  return idx.chapters.map((c) => ({ index: c.index, title: c.title, at: c.before / idx.totalWords }));
}

/** Fraction 0..1 of the book before `pos`. */
export function fractionAt(idx: BookIndex, pos: Position): number { return idx.totalWords ? wordsBefore(idx, pos) / idx.totalWords : 0; }

/** Words left in the chapter of `pos` (from the start of its sentence) and in the whole book. */
export function wordsLeft(idx: BookIndex, pos: Position): { chapter: number; book: number } {
  const before = wordsBefore(idx, pos);
  const ch = idx.chapters[pos.chapter];
  const chapterEnd = ch ? ch.before + ch.words : before;
  return { chapter: Math.max(0, chapterEnd - before), book: Math.max(0, idx.totalWords - before) };
}

/** "3 min", "12 min", "1 h 05 min", "2 h 10 min"; under a minute: "less than a minute". */
export function formatMinutes(minutes: number): string {
  const m = Math.max(0, Math.round(minutes));
  if (m < 1) return 'less than a minute';
  if (m < 60) return `${m} min`;
  const h = Math.floor(m / 60), r = m % 60;
  return r === 0 ? `${h} h` : `${h} h ${String(r).padStart(2, '0')} min`;
}

/** "1:23:40" or "9:05" for a number of seconds. */
export function formatClock(seconds: number): string {
  const s = Math.max(0, Math.floor(seconds));
  const h = Math.floor(s / 3600), m = Math.floor((s % 3600) / 60), r = s % 60;
  const mm = h > 0 ? String(m).padStart(2, '0') : String(m);
  return `${h > 0 ? `${h}:` : ''}${mm}:${String(r).padStart(2, '0')}`;
}

export type ProgressKind = 'page' | 'chapter' | 'book' | 'percent';
export const PROGRESS_KINDS: ProgressKind[] = ['page', 'chapter', 'book', 'percent'];

/** The bottom-left status text of Reading mode; it cycles through the kinds on click. */
export function progressText(kind: ProgressKind, p: { page: number; pageCount: number; wordsLeftChapter: number; wordsLeftBook: number; wpm: number; fraction: number }): string {
  switch (kind) {
    case 'page': return `Page ${p.page} of ${p.pageCount}`;
    case 'chapter': return `${formatMinutes(p.wordsLeftChapter / p.wpm)} left in chapter`;
    case 'book': return `${formatMinutes(p.wordsLeftBook / p.wpm)} left in book`;
    case 'percent': return `${Math.floor(Math.min(1, Math.max(0, p.fraction)) * 100)}%`;
  }
}

export function nextProgressKind(k: ProgressKind): ProgressKind { return PROGRESS_KINDS[(PROGRESS_KINDS.indexOf(k) + 1) % PROGRESS_KINDS.length]; }

/** Speed slider steps: 0.5 .. 2.0 in 0.1 steps, rounded so 0.1 + 0.2 does not become 0.30000000000000004. */
export function clampRate(r: number, min = 0.5, max = 2): number { return Math.round(Math.min(max, Math.max(min, Number.isFinite(r) ? r : 1)) * 10) / 10; }

/** The sentence that starts at or just before the `words`-th word of the book. */
export function positionAtWords(idx: BookIndex, words: number): Position | null {
  const list = idx.sentences;
  if (!list.length) return null;
  const w = Math.max(0, words);
  let lo = 0, hi = list.length - 1, ans = 0;
  while (lo <= hi) {
    const mid = (lo + hi) >> 1;
    if (list[mid].before <= w) { ans = mid; lo = mid + 1; } else hi = mid - 1;
  }
  return list[ans].pos;
}

/**
 * "Page 12 of 240" for the whole book from the one chapter that is laid out: the words per page measured in
 * the current chapter are applied to the rest of the book (Kindle counts pages the same way, by text amount).
 */
export function bookPages(idx: BookIndex, chapter: number, pageIndex: number, pageCount: number): { page: number; total: number; wordsPerPage: number } {
  const ch = idx.chapters[chapter];
  const count = Math.max(1, pageCount);
  const wordsPerPage = ch && ch.words > 0 ? ch.words / count : 250;
  const total = Math.max(1, Math.round(idx.totalWords / wordsPerPage));
  const page = Math.min(total, Math.floor((ch?.before ?? 0) / wordsPerPage) + Math.min(pageIndex, count - 1) + 1);
  return { page, total, wordsPerPage };
}
```

### `src/renderer/reader/render.ts` (129 lines)

```ts
import type { Book, Chapter, Paragraph, Sentence, CefrLevel } from '@core/model';
import type { Dictionary } from '@core/dict/types';
import type { VocabState, MarkedRange } from '@shared/settings';
import type { PhraseHit } from '@shared/api';
import { annotateSentence, type WordInfo } from '@core/vocab/analysis';
import { hintFor } from './hints';

export interface RenderOptions {
  dict: Dictionary;
  names: Set<string>;
  learner: CefrLevel;
  vocab: VocabState['words'];
  marked: MarkedRange[];
  /** Word Wise-style hints (a short Chinese meaning under hard words) as data-hint; default off */
  hints?: boolean;
  /** lemma -> hint text that replaces the dictionary one (a later AI job fills this) */
  hintOverrides?: Record<string, string>;
  /** the chapter phrase job's hits of a sentence (sentenceKey "c.p.s"), when loaded */
  phrases?: (key: string) => readonly PhraseHit[] | undefined;
}

export interface TokenMeta { lemma: string; level: CefrLevel | null; isName: boolean; inDict: boolean; ipa: string; zh: string }

const esc = (s: string) => s.replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;').replace(/"/g, '&quot;');

export function stateClass(info: WordInfo, learner: CefrLevel, vocab: VocabState['words']): string {
  if (info.isName || !info.lemma) return '';
  const st = vocab[info.lemma];
  if (st === 'known' || st === 'ignored') return '';
  if (st === 'learning') return 'hl-learning';
  if (info.level && above(info.level, learner)) return 'hl-unknown';
  return '';
}

export function above(level: CefrLevel, learner: CefrLevel): boolean {
  const order = ['A1', 'A2', 'B1', 'B2', 'C1', 'C2'];
  return order.indexOf(level) > order.indexOf(learner);
}

/**
 * Builds the HTML of one chapter: one element per paragraph, one span per sentence, one span per word
 * token (data-t = token index) so the highlighter can address them without re-rendering.
 * Returns a per-sentence annotation cache used by the popup.
 */
export function renderChapter(chapter: Chapter, opts: RenderOptions): { html: string; meta: Map<string, (TokenMeta | null)[]> } {
  const meta = new Map<string, (TokenMeta | null)[]>();
  const parts: string[] = [];
  for (const para of chapter.paragraphs) {
    const tag = para.kind === 'h1' || para.kind === 'h2' || para.kind === 'h3' ? para.kind : para.kind === 'li' ? 'li' : para.kind === 'blockquote' ? 'blockquote' : para.kind === 'pre' ? 'pre' : 'p';
    parts.push(`<${tag} class="para k-${para.kind}" data-p="${para.index}">`);
    let cursor = 0;
    for (const s of para.sentences) {
      if (s.start > cursor) parts.push(esc(para.text.slice(cursor, s.start)));
      parts.push(renderSentence(para, s, chapter.index, opts, meta));
      cursor = s.end;
    }
    if (cursor < para.text.length) parts.push(esc(para.text.slice(cursor)));
    parts.push(`</${tag}>`);
  }
  return { html: parts.join(''), meta };
}

export function renderSentence(para: Paragraph, s: Sentence, chapter: number, opts: RenderOptions, meta?: Map<string, (TokenMeta | null)[]>): string {
  const key = `${chapter}.${para.index}.${s.index}`;
  const hits = (opts.phrases?.(key) ?? []).filter((h) => Number.isInteger(h.start) && Number.isInteger(h.end) && h.start >= 0 && h.start <= h.end && h.end < s.tokens.length);
  const ann = annotateSentence(para, s, opts.dict, opts.names, opts.learner, hits);
  const marks = opts.marked.filter((m) => m.chapter === chapter && m.paragraph === para.index && m.sentence === s.index);
  // phrase spans (end exclusive): dictionary phrases at their (job-confirmed) level, then the job's own phrases
  // where they do not overlap one already placed
  const phraseAt = new Map<number, { end: number; lemma: string; level: CefrLevel; above: boolean }>();
  const free = (a: number, b: number) => [...phraseAt.entries()].every(([st, p]) => b <= st || a >= p.end);
  for (const ph of ann.phrases) if (free(ph.start, ph.end)) phraseAt.set(ph.start, { end: ph.end, lemma: ph.result.lemma, level: ph.level, above: ph.above });
  for (const h of ann.aiPhrases) if (free(h.start, h.end + 1)) phraseAt.set(h.start, { end: h.end + 1, lemma: h.lemma, level: h.level, above: h.above });
  const metas: (TokenMeta | null)[] = [];
  const out: string[] = [`<span class="s" data-s="${s.index}" data-key="${key}">`];
  let cursor = s.start;
  let phraseEnd = -1;
  for (let i = 0; i < s.tokens.length; i++) {
    const t = s.tokens[i];
    if (t.start > cursor) out.push(esc(para.text.slice(cursor, t.start)));
    const ph = phraseAt.get(i);
    if (ph) {
      const st = opts.vocab[ph.lemma];
      const cls = st === 'known' || st === 'ignored' ? '' : st === 'learning' ? 'hl-learning' : ph.above ? 'hl-unknown' : '';
      out.push(`<span class="ph ${cls}" data-lemma="${esc(ph.lemma)}" data-level="${ph.level}" data-start="${i}" data-end="${ph.end}">`);
      phraseEnd = ph.end - 1; // PhraseSpan.end is exclusive: the span closes after its last word
    }
    const info = ann.infos[i];
    if (t.kind === 'word' && info) {
      const cls = stateClass(info, opts.learner, opts.vocab);
      const inMark = marks.some((m) => t.start >= m.start && t.end <= m.end);
      const hint = opts.hints && phraseEnd < 0 ? hintFor(info, opts.learner, opts.vocab, opts.hintOverrides?.[info.lemma]) : '';
      out.push(`<span class="w${cls ? ' ' + cls : ''}${inMark ? ' hl-marked' : ''}${info.isName ? ' name' : ''}" data-t="${i}" data-lemma="${esc(info.lemma)}"${info.level ? ` data-level="${info.level}"` : ''}${hint ? ` data-hint="${esc(hint)}"` : ''}>${esc(t.text)}</span>`);
      metas.push({ lemma: info.lemma, level: info.level, isName: info.isName, inDict: info.inDict, ipa: info.entry?.ipa ?? '', zh: info.entry?.zh ?? '' });
    } else {
      out.push(`<span class="w ${t.kind}" data-t="${i}">${esc(t.text)}</span>`);
      metas.push(null);
    }
    cursor = t.end;
    if (i === phraseEnd) { out.push('</span>'); phraseEnd = -1; }
  }
  if (cursor < s.end) out.push(esc(para.text.slice(cursor, s.end)));
  out.push('</span>');
  meta?.set(key, metas);
  return out.join('');
}

/**
 * Updates the state class of every span for a lemma after the learner changed its status. A word that is
 * known, learning or ignored loses its hint; a word back to "new" gets it again from `hint`.
 */
export function restyleLemma(root: HTMLElement, lemma: string, status: 'known' | 'learning' | 'ignored' | null, learner: CefrLevel, hint?: string): void {
  const els = root.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>(`[data-lemma="${CSS.escape(lemma)}"]`);
  for (const el of els) {
    el.classList.remove('hl-unknown', 'hl-learning');
    if (status) delete el.dataset.hint;
    if (status === 'learning') el.classList.add('hl-learning');
    else if (!status) {
      const level = el.dataset.level as CefrLevel | undefined;
      if (level && above(level, learner) && !el.classList.contains('name')) { el.classList.add('hl-unknown'); if (hint && el.classList.contains('w')) el.dataset.hint = hint; }
    }
  }
}

export function sentenceTextOf(book: Book, c: number, p: number, s: number): string {
  const para = book.chapters[c]?.paragraphs[p];
  const sent = para?.sentences[s];
  return para && sent ? para.text.slice(sent.start, sent.end) : '';
}
```

```ts
/** Matches a KeyboardEvent against a shortcut string like "Shift+KeyE", "Space", "Equal". */
export function matchesShortcut(e: KeyboardEvent, shortcut: string): boolean {
  if (!shortcut) return false;
  const parts = shortcut.split('+');
  const code = parts.pop()!;
  const need = { shift: parts.includes('Shift'), alt: parts.includes('Alt'), ctrl: parts.includes('Ctrl'), meta: parts.includes('Cmd') || parts.includes('Meta') };
  if (e.code !== code) return false;
  return e.shiftKey === need.shift && e.altKey === need.alt && e.ctrlKey === need.ctrl && e.metaKey === need.meta;
}

export function isTypingTarget(t: EventTarget | null): boolean {
  const el = t as HTMLElement | null;
  if (!el) return false;
  const tag = el.tagName;
  return tag === 'INPUT' || tag === 'TEXTAREA' || tag === 'SELECT' || el.isContentEditable;
}

const KEY_NAMES: Record<string, string> = { Equal: '+', Minus: '−', Slash: '?', Cmd: '⌘', Meta: '⌘', Shift: '⇧', Alt: '⌥', Ctrl: '⌃', Escape: 'Esc' };
export function shortcutLabel(s: string): string {
  return s.split('+').map((part) => KEY_NAMES[part] ?? part.replace(/^(Key|Digit|Arrow)/, '')).join(' ');
}
```

### `src/renderer/reader/useDictionary.ts` (16 lines)

```ts
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import type { Dictionary } from '@core/dict/types';
import { createDictionary } from '@core/dict/dictionary';

let promise: Promise<Dictionary> | null = null;

export function loadDictionary(): Promise<Dictionary> {
  if (!promise) promise = window.readalong.loadDictionary().then((data) => createDictionary(data));
  return promise;
}

export function useDictionary(): Dictionary | null {
  const [dict, setDict] = useState<Dictionary | null>(null);
  useEffect(() => { let on = true; loadDictionary().then((d) => { if (on) setDict(d); }); return () => { on = false; }; }, []);
  return dict;
}
```

```ts
import { create } from 'zustand';
import type { Book } from '@core/model';
import type { Settings, LibraryItem, VocabState, ReadMode } from '@shared/settings';
import { DEFAULT_SETTINGS, isDarkTheme } from '@shared/settings';

export type View = 'library' | 'reader' | 'settings' | 'diagnostics' | 'vocabulary' | 'progress' | 'leveltest';

interface AppState {
  view: View;
  settings: Settings;
  library: LibraryItem[];
  book: Book | null;
  /** the screen the open book is shown on; persisted per book (settings.bookModes) and as settings.lastMode */
  mode: ReadMode;
  vocab: VocabState;
  toast: { text: string; action?: { label: string; run: () => void } } | null;
  setView(v: View): void;
  setSettings(s: Settings): void;
  patchSettings(patch: Partial<Settings>): Promise<void>;
  refreshLibrary(): Promise<void>;
  openBook(id: string): Promise<void>;
  setBook(b: Book | null): void;
  /** switches the screen of the open book and remembers it for the book and as the default for new books */
  setMode(m: ReadMode): void;
  setVocab(v: VocabState): void;
  showToast(text: string, action?: { label: string; run: () => void }): void;
}

/** The screen a book opens on: the one used last for it, else the one used last at all. */
export function modeForBook(settings: Settings, bookId: string): ReadMode {
  return settings.bookModes?.[bookId] ?? settings.lastMode ?? 'reading';
}

/** Library items with the per-book screen filled in from settings, so the library can show it. */
function withModes(items: LibraryItem[], settings: Settings): LibraryItem[] {
  return items.map((it) => (settings.bookModes?.[it.id] ? { ...it, mode: settings.bookModes[it.id] } : it));
}

export const useApp = create<AppState>((set, get) => ({
  view: 'library',
  settings: DEFAULT_SETTINGS,
  library: [],
  book: null,
  mode: 'reading',
  vocab: { words: {}, marked: {} },
  toast: null,
  setView: (view) => set({ view }),
  setSettings: (settings) => set({ settings, library: withModes(get().library, settings) }),
  patchSettings: async (patch) => {
    const settings = await window.readalong.setSettings(patch);
    set({ settings, library: withModes(get().library, settings) });
  },
  refreshLibrary: async () => set({ library: withModes(await window.readalong.listLibrary(), get().settings) }),
  openBook: async (id) => {
    const book = await window.readalong.loadBook(id);
    if (book) set({ book, view: 'reader', mode: modeForBook(get().settings, book.id) });
  },
  setBook: (book) => set({ book, mode: book ? modeForBook(get().settings, book.id) : get().mode }),
  setMode: (mode) => {
    const { book, settings } = get();
    if (get().mode === mode) return;
    set({ mode });
    const patch: Partial<Settings> = { lastMode: mode };
    if (book) patch.bookModes = { ...(settings.bookModes ?? {}), [book.id]: mode };
    void get().patchSettings(patch);
  },
  setVocab: (vocab) => set({ vocab }),
  showToast: (text, action) => {
    set({ toast: { text, action } });
    setTimeout(() => { if (get().toast?.text === text) set({ toast: null }); }, 4000);
  },
}));

/** Applies theme + reader typography to the document root as CSS variables. */
export function applyAppearance(s: Settings): void {
  const root = document.documentElement;
  const a = s.appearance;
  const stored = (a.theme as string) === 'dark' ? 'night' : a.theme;
  const theme = stored === 'system' ? (window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: light)').matches ? 'light' : 'night') : stored;
  root.dataset.theme = theme;
  const hl = isDarkTheme(theme) ? a.highlightsDark : a.highlightsLight;
  root.style.setProperty('--hl-unknown', hl.unknown);
  root.style.setProperty('--hl-learning', hl.learning);
  root.style.setProperty('--hl-sentence', hl.sentence);
  root.style.setProperty('--hl-word', hl.word);
  root.style.setProperty('--hl-marked', hl.marked);
  root.style.setProperty('--reader-font', `var(--font-${a.fontFamily})`);
  root.style.setProperty('--reader-size', `${a.fontSizePx}px`);
  root.style.setProperty('--reader-lh', String(a.lineHeight));
  root.style.setProperty('--reader-margin', `${a.marginPx}px`);
  root.style.setProperty('--subtitle-size', `${a.subtitleSizePx ?? DEFAULT_SETTINGS.appearance.subtitleSizePx}px`);
  root.style.setProperty('--explain-size', `${a.explainSizePx ?? DEFAULT_SETTINGS.appearance.explainSizePx}px`);
  root.style.setProperty('--ui-scale', String(clamp(a.uiScale ?? 1, 0.9, 1.3)));
  root.style.setProperty('--max-line', String(a.maxLineChars ?? DEFAULT_SETTINGS.appearance.maxLineChars));
  root.style.setProperty('--max-line-listen', String(a.listenMaxLineChars ?? DEFAULT_SETTINGS.appearance.listenMaxLineChars));
  root.dataset.tips = a.showTips === false ? '0' : '1';
  root.dataset.underlineOnly = a.underlineOnly ? '1' : '0';
  root.dataset.hints = a.showHints === false ? '0' : '1';
  root.dataset.pageTurn = a.pageTurnAnimation === false ? '0' : '1';
}

function clamp(n: number, lo: number, hi: number): number { return Number.isFinite(n) ? Math.min(hi, Math.max(lo, n)) : 1; }
```

```ts
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import type { DictData } from '@shared/api';
import type { LevelMaterials } from '@core/level/test';
import { prepareMaterials } from '@core/level/test';

/**
 * The raw dictionary data (DictData) for code that needs more than lookups, such as the level test's item
 * pools. Loaded once per renderer and cached in module scope, like reader/useDictionary.ts caches the
 * Dictionary built from the same data.
 */
let dataPromise: Promise<DictData> | null = null;
let materialsPromise: Promise<LevelMaterials> | null = null;

export function loadDictData(): Promise<DictData> {
  if (!dataPromise) dataPromise = window.readalong.loadDictionary();
  return dataPromise;
}

/** Item pools and pseudowords for the level test (prepareMaterials takes about half a second); built once. */
export function loadLevelMaterials(): Promise<LevelMaterials> {
  if (!materialsPromise) {
    materialsPromise = loadDictData().then((data) => prepareMaterials(data));
    materialsPromise.catch(() => { materialsPromise = null; });
  }
  return materialsPromise;
}

export function useDictData(): DictData | null {
  const [data, setData] = useState<DictData | null>(null);
  useEffect(() => { let on = true; loadDictData().then((d) => { if (on) setData(d); }); return () => { on = false; }; }, []);
  return data;
}

/** null while the dictionary loads or the materials are being prepared; the Error when loading failed. */
export function useLevelMaterials(): { materials: LevelMaterials | null; error: Error | null } {
  const [materials, setMaterials] = useState<LevelMaterials | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState<Error | null>(null);
  useEffect(() => {
    let on = true;
    loadLevelMaterials().then((m) => { if (on) setMaterials(m); }, (e: unknown) => { if (on) setError(e instanceof Error ? e : new Error(String(e))); });
    return () => { on = false; };
  }, []);
  return { materials, error };
}
```

```tsx
import React from 'react';

/**
 * A quiet tooltip for the main buttons: "tap anything to see how it works". Wraps its child and shows `text`
 * on hover or keyboard focus. Hidden app-wide when Settings → Reading look → Tips is off (html[data-tips="0"],
 * set by applyAppearance from appearance.showTips).
 */
export function Tip({ text, children, below, wrap, align }: { text: string; children: React.ReactNode; below?: boolean; wrap?: boolean; /** keep the tip inside the window near an edge: 'start' hangs right from the button, 'end' hangs left */ align?: 'start' | 'end' }): JSX.Element {
  return (
    <span className="tip-wrap">
      {children}
      <span className={`tip${below ? ' below' : ''}${wrap ? ' wrap' : ''}${align ? ` ${align}` : ''}`} role="tooltip">{text}</span>
    </span>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { SECRET_NAMES, SECRET_LABELS, type Diagnostics, type SecretName, type SecretStatusMap } from '@shared/api';
import { KeyStatusDot, LostKeyNotice, STORAGE_NOTE, NO_KEYS } from './Settings';

/** Shows environment facts the user can paste back when something does not work on their Mac. */
export function DiagnosticsView(): JSX.Element {
  const [d, setD] = useState<Diagnostics | null>(null);
  const [voices, setVoices] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [probe, setProbe] = useState<string>('not run');
  const [keys, setKeys] = useState<SecretStatusMap>(NO_KEYS);
  const [testResult, setTestResult] = useState<Partial<Record<SecretName, string>>>({});
  const refreshKeys = () => window.readalong.secretStatus().then(setKeys).catch(() => { /* main not ready */ });
  const testKey = async (name: SecretName) => {
    setTestResult((t) => ({ ...t, [name]: 'Testing…' }));
    try { const r = await window.readalong.aiTest(name); setTestResult((t) => ({ ...t, [name]: `${r.ok ? '✅' : '❌'} ${r.message}${r.detail ? ` [${r.detail}]` : ''}` })); }
    catch (e) { setTestResult((t) => ({ ...t, [name]: `❌ ${(e as Error).message}` })); }
  };
  useEffect(() => {
    void window.readalong.getDiagnostics().then(setD);
    void refreshKeys();
    const load = () => setVoices(speechSynthesis.getVoices().map((v) => `${v.name} [${v.lang}]${v.default ? ' (default)' : ''}${v.localService ? '' : ' remote'}`));
    load();
    speechSynthesis.addEventListener('voiceschanged', load);
    return () => speechSynthesis.removeEventListener('voiceschanged', load);
  }, []);
  const runProbe = () => {
    const u = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance('Testing word boundary events for Dream Read.');
    const gb = speechSynthesis.getVoices().find((v) => v.lang.replace('_', '-').toLowerCase() === 'en-gb');
    if (gb) u.voice = gb;
    let words = 0; const t0 = performance.now();
    u.onboundary = (e) => { if (e.name === 'word') words++; };
    u.onend = () => setProbe(`voice=${u.voice?.name ?? 'default'} wordEvents=${words} durationMs=${Math.round(performance.now() - t0)}`);
    u.onerror = (e) => setProbe(`error: ${e.error}`);
    setProbe('speaking…');
    speechSynthesis.cancel(); speechSynthesis.speak(u);
  };
  const keyLines = SECRET_NAMES.map((n) => `key ${n}: ${keys[n].verified ? 'saved, verified' : keys[n].saved ? 'saved, UNREADABLE' : keys[n].lostAtStartup ? 'lost at startup' : 'none'}${testResult[n] ? ` · test: ${testResult[n]}` : ''}`);
  const text = [d ? Object.entries(d).map(([k, v]) => `${k}: ${typeof v === 'object' ? JSON.stringify(v) : String(v)}`).join('\n') : '', ...keyLines, `voices (${voices.length}):`, ...voices, `probe: ${probe}`].join('\n');
  return (
    <div className="library">
      <h1>Diagnostics</h1>
      <div className="row"><button onClick={runProbe}>Test speech voice</button><button onClick={() => navigator.clipboard.writeText(text)}>Copy all</button></div>
      <div className="field" style={{ marginTop: 16 }}>
        <label>API keys</label>
        {SECRET_NAMES.map((name) => (
          <React.Fragment key={name}>
            <LostKeyNotice name={name} status={keys[name]} onDismiss={() => { void window.readalong.dismissLostKeys().then(refreshKeys); }} />
            <div className="row" data-testid={`diag-key-${name}`}>
              <span style={{ width: 150 }}><KeyStatusDot status={keys[name]} /> {SECRET_LABELS[name]}</span>
              <span className="muted" style={{ width: 130 }}>{keys[name].verified ? 'saved, verified' : keys[name].saved ? 'saved, unreadable' : 'no key'}</span>
              <button onClick={() => testKey(name)} disabled={!keys[name].saved}>Test</button>
              {testResult[name] && <span className="hint">{testResult[name]}</span>}
            </div>
          </React.Fragment>
        ))}
        <div className="hint">{STORAGE_NOTE}{d ? ` File: ${d.secretsFile}` : ''}</div>
      </div>
      <pre style={{ whiteSpace: 'pre-wrap', fontSize: 12, marginTop: 16 }} data-testid="diagnostics-text">{text}</pre>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### `src/renderer/views/LevelTest.tsx` (203 lines)

```tsx
import React, { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { useApp } from '../state/store';
import { useLevelMaterials } from '../state/useDictData';
import { Tip } from '../ui/Tip';
import type { CefrLevel } from '@core/model';
import type { LevelResult } from '@core/level/score';
import type { LevelTestSession, TestItem } from '@core/level/test';
import { createSession } from '@core/level/test';
import { LevelModel } from '@core/level/adapt';
import type { LevelSettings } from '@shared/settings';
import {
  INTRO_LINES, INTRO_TITLE, LEVEL_TEST_VIEW_ID, answerForKey, changeText, levelMessage, progressText, stageText,
} from './levelText';

export { LEVEL_TEST_VIEW_ID };
export * from './levelText';

/**
 * The vocabulary level test screen: intro card, one word at a time (two stages of 50), result card.
 * Shown at first start and from Settings → Level. Routing: the app shows it for view === LEVEL_TEST_VIEW_ID.
 *
 * `onDone` is called when the learner leaves the screen: 'used' after "Use this level" (settings saved),
 * 'kept' after "Keep my old level", 'skipped' after "Skip for now" on the intro card.
 */
export type LevelTestOutcome = 'used' | 'kept' | 'skipped';

export interface LevelTestProps {
  onDone?: (outcome: LevelTestOutcome) => void;
}

type Phase = 'intro' | 'test' | 'between' | 'result';

export function LevelTest({ onDone }: LevelTestProps): JSX.Element {
  const settings = useApp((s) => s.settings);
  const patch = useApp((s) => s.patchSettings);
  const { materials, error } = useLevelMaterials();
  const [phase, setPhase] = useState<Phase>('intro');
  const [session, setSession] = useState<LevelTestSession | null>(null);
  const [items, setItems] = useState<TestItem[]>([]);
  const [index, setIndex] = useState(0);
  const [result, setResult] = useState<LevelResult | null>(null);
  /** words of this run's sessions (a "Test again" avoids them too) */
  const usedRef = useRef<{ words: string[]; pseudowords: string[] }>({ words: [], pseudowords: [] });
  const previousLevel: CefrLevel | null = settings.onboarded ? settings.learnerLevel : null;

  // Start a session as soon as the learner pressed Start and the materials are ready.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (phase !== 'test' || session || !materials) return;
    const prev = settings.level?.used ?? { words: [], pseudowords: [] };
    const s = createSession(materials, {
      seed: `${Date.now()}-${Math.floor(Math.random() * 1e9)}`,
      previous: { words: [...prev.words, ...usedRef.current.words], pseudowords: [...prev.pseudowords, ...usedRef.current.pseudowords] },
    });
    setSession(s);
    setItems(s.items());
    setIndex(0);
  }, [phase, session, materials, settings.level]);

  const start = useCallback(() => { setSession(null); setResult(null); setPhase('test'); }, []);

  const finish = useCallback((s: LevelTestSession) => {
    usedRef.current = {
      words: [...usedRef.current.words, ...s.usedWords()],
      pseudowords: [...usedRef.current.pseudowords, ...s.usedPseudowords()],
    };
    setResult(s.result());
    setPhase('result');
  }, []);

  const answer = useCallback((yes: boolean) => {
    if (!session || phase !== 'test') return;
    const item = items[index];
    if (!item) return;
    session.answer(item.id, yes);
    if (index + 1 < items.length) { setIndex(index + 1); return; }
    if (!session.stageComplete()) return;
    if (session.stage === 1) setPhase('between'); else finish(session);
  }, [session, phase, items, index, finish]);

  const continueStage = useCallback(() => {
    if (!session || session.stage !== 1) return;
    setItems(session.nextStage());
    setIndex(0);
    setPhase('test');
  }, [session]);

  // Keyboard: Y / J / → = Yes, N / K / ← = No, Enter = continue between stages. Space is not used on purpose.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (phase !== 'test' && phase !== 'between') return;
    const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent): void => {
      if (e.repeat || e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey || e.altKey) return;
      const t = e.target as HTMLElement | null;
      if (t && (t.tagName === 'INPUT' || t.tagName === 'TEXTAREA' || t.tagName === 'SELECT' || t.isContentEditable)) return;
      if (phase === 'between') { if (e.code === 'Enter') { e.preventDefault(); continueStage(); } return; }
      const a = answerForKey(e.code);
      if (a === null) return;
      e.preventDefault();
      answer(a);
    };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', onKey);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey);
  }, [phase, answer, continueStage]);

  const useLevel = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!result) return;
    const testedAt = new Date().toISOString();
    const prev = settings.level?.used ?? { words: [], pseudowords: [] };
    const level: LevelSettings = {
      model: LevelModel.fromTest(result, testedAt).toJSON(),
      lastResult: result,
      testedAt,
      used: {
        words: [...new Set([...prev.words, ...usedRef.current.words])],
        pseudowords: [...new Set([...prev.pseudowords, ...usedRef.current.pseudowords])],
      },
    };
    await patch({ learnerLevel: result.cefr, onboarded: true, level });
    onDone?.('used');
  }, [result, settings.level, patch, onDone]);

  const message = useMemo(() => (result ? levelMessage(result) : null), [result]);
  const change = useMemo(() => (result ? changeText(result, previousLevel) : null), [result, previousLevel]);

  return (
    <div className="level-test" data-testid="level-test">
      {phase === 'intro' && (
        <div className="card level-card" data-testid="level-intro">
          <h2>{INTRO_TITLE}</h2>
          {INTRO_LINES.map((line, i) => <p key={i} className="level-intro-line">{line}</p>)}
          <div className="row level-actions">
            <Tip text="Begin the test (about 5 minutes)"><button className="primary" onClick={start} data-testid="level-start" autoFocus>Start</button></Tip>
            <Tip text={`Keep your level at ${settings.learnerLevel} for now. You can take the test later in Settings → Level.`} wrap>
              <button onClick={() => onDone?.('skipped')} data-testid="level-skip">Skip for now</button>
            </Tip>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {phase === 'test' && (!session || !items[index]) && (
        <div className="card level-card level-preparing" data-testid="level-preparing">
          {error
            ? <p className="level-intro-line">Sorry, the dictionary could not be loaded, so the test cannot start. Please restart the app and try again.</p>
            : <p className="level-intro-line muted">Preparing the test…</p>}
          {error && <div className="row level-actions"><button onClick={() => onDone?.('skipped')}>Back</button></div>}
        </div>
      )}

      {phase === 'test' && session && items[index] && (
        <div className="level-stage" data-testid="level-stage" data-stage={session.stage}>
          <div className="level-meta">
            <span className="muted" data-testid="level-stage-text">{stageText(session.stage)}</span>
            <span className="muted" data-testid="level-progress">{progressText(index, items.length)}</span>
          </div>
          <div className="level-progress-bar" aria-hidden="true"><div className="level-progress-fill" style={{ width: `${(index / items.length) * 100}%` }} /></div>
          <p className="level-question muted">Do you know this word?</p>
          <div className="level-word" data-testid="level-word" key={items[index].id}>{items[index].word}</div>
          <div className="level-answers">
            <Tip text="I do not know it, or I am not sure (N, K or ←)"><button className="level-answer no" onClick={() => answer(false)} data-testid="level-no">No</button></Tip>
            <Tip text="I know what it means (Y, J or →)"><button className="level-answer yes primary" onClick={() => answer(true)} data-testid="level-yes">Yes, I know it</button></Tip>
          </div>
          <p className="level-keys muted">Keys: Y or → for Yes, N or ← for No</p>
        </div>
      )}

      {phase === 'between' && (
        <div className="card level-card" data-testid="level-between">
          <h2>Well done, halfway there</h2>
          <p className="level-intro-line">{stageText(2)}: 50 more words, chosen for you from the first half.</p>
          <div className="row level-actions">
            <Tip text="Show the next words (Enter)"><button className="primary" onClick={continueStage} data-testid="level-continue" autoFocus>Continue</button></Tip>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {phase === 'result' && result && message && (
        <div className="card level-card level-result" data-testid="level-result" data-reliable={message.reliable ? '1' : '0'} data-level={result.cefr}>
          {message.reliable
            ? <>
                <div className="level-result-level" data-testid="level-result-level">{result.cefr}</div>
                <h2>{message.title}</h2>
                <p className="level-result-sub muted">{message.subtitle}</p>
                <p className="level-intro-line">{message.body}</p>
                {change && <p className="level-intro-line muted">{change}</p>}
              </>
            : <>
                <h2>{message.title}</h2>
                <p className="level-result-sub muted">{message.subtitle}</p>
                <p className="level-intro-line">{message.body}</p>
              </>}
          <div className="row level-actions">
            {message.reliable && (
              <Tip text={`Set my level to ${result.cefr} and highlight words above it`} wrap>
                <button className="primary" onClick={() => { void useLevel(); }} data-testid="level-use" autoFocus>Use this level</button>
              </Tip>
            )}
            <Tip text="Take the test again with new words"><button className={message.reliable ? '' : 'primary'} onClick={start} data-testid="level-again" autoFocus={!message.reliable}>Test again</button></Tip>
            <Tip text={`Keep my level at ${settings.learnerLevel}`}><button onClick={() => onDone?.('kept')} data-testid="level-keep">Keep my old level</button></Tip>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

### `src/renderer/views/Library.tsx` (146 lines)

```tsx
import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useApp } from '../state/store';
import type { LibraryItem } from '@shared/settings';
import { Tip } from '../ui/Tip';

let setPasteOpen: ((v: boolean) => void) | null = null;

/** Up to two initials from the title, skipping leading articles: "The Great Gatsby" → "GG". */
export function coverInitials(title: string): string {
  const words = title.replace(/[^\p{L}\p{N}\s]/gu, ' ').split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
  const meaningful = words.filter((w) => !/^(the|a|an|of|and|le|la|les|der|die|das)$/i.test(w));
  const pick = (meaningful.length ? meaningful : words).slice(0, 2);
  return pick.map((w) => w[0]!.toUpperCase()).join('') || '·';
}

/** A stable soft tint per title so each cover looks different but stays calm: hue from a string hash. */
export function coverHue(title: string): number {
  let h = 0;
  for (const ch of title) h = (h * 31 + ch.charCodeAt(0)) >>> 0;
  return h % 360;
}

function Cover({ item }: { item: LibraryItem }): JSX.Element {
  const hue = coverHue(item.title);
  const style = { background: `linear-gradient(160deg, hsl(${hue} 22% 42%), hsl(${(hue + 30) % 360} 26% 26%))` } as React.CSSProperties;
  return (
    <div className="book-cover" style={style} aria-hidden="true">
      <span className="initials">{coverInitials(item.title)}</span>
      <span className="cover-kind">{item.kind.toUpperCase()}</span>
      <span className="cover-title">{item.title}</span>
    </div>
  );
}

function Ring({ percent }: { percent: number }): JSX.Element {
  const r = 7, c = 2 * Math.PI * r;
  return (
    <svg className="ring" viewBox="0 0 18 18" aria-hidden="true">
      <circle className="track" cx="9" cy="9" r={r} />
      <circle className="fill" cx="9" cy="9" r={r} strokeDasharray={`${c * Math.min(1, Math.max(0, percent / 100))} ${c}`} />
    </svg>
  );
}

export function Library(): JSX.Element {
  const library = useApp((s) => s.library);
  const [pasteOpen, _setPasteOpen] = useState(false);
  const [title, setTitle] = useState('');
  const [text, setText] = useState('');
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  setPasteOpen = _setPasteOpen;
  useEffect(() => { void useApp.getState().refreshLibrary(); }, []);

  const importPaste = async () => {
    if (!text.trim()) return;
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      const book = await window.readalong.importText(title.trim(), text);
      await useApp.getState().refreshLibrary();
      useApp.getState().setBook(book);
      useApp.getState().setView('reader');
      _setPasteOpen(false); setText(''); setTitle('');
    } catch (e) {
      useApp.getState().showToast(`Could not import: ${(e as Error).message}`);
    } finally { setBusy(false); }
  };

  const [dragOver, setDragOver] = useState(false);
  const onDrop = async (e: React.DragEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault(); setDragOver(false);
    const files = Array.from(e.dataTransfer.files).filter((f) => /\.(epub|pdf|txt|md)$/i.test(f.name));
    if (!files.length) return;
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      let last = null;
      for (const f of files) last = await window.readalong.importFile(window.readalong.pathForFile(f));
      await useApp.getState().refreshLibrary();
      if (last && files.length === 1) { useApp.getState().setBook(last); useApp.getState().setView('reader'); }
    } catch (err) { useApp.getState().showToast(`Could not import: ${(err as Error).message}`); }
    finally { setBusy(false); }
  };
  const sorted = [...library].sort((a, b) => (b.lastOpenedAt || b.addedAt).localeCompare(a.lastOpenedAt || a.addedAt));
  return (
    <div className={`library ${dragOver ? 'drag-over' : ''}`} data-testid="library" onDragOver={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); setDragOver(true); }} onDragLeave={() => setDragOver(false)} onDrop={onDrop}>
      <h1>Your books</h1>
      <p className="lead">{library.length === 0 ? 'A quiet place for the books you are reading.' : `${library.length} ${library.length === 1 ? 'book' : 'books'} · drop a file anywhere to add one`}</p>
      <div className="actions">
        <Tip text="Choose an EPUB, PDF or text file from your Mac" below align="start"><button className="primary" onClick={() => Library.openDialog()} data-testid="open-book">Open a book…</button></Tip>
        <Tip text="Paste an article or a chapter and read it like a book" below align="start"><button onClick={() => _setPasteOpen(true)} data-testid="paste-text">Paste text…</button></Tip>
        {busy && <span className="muted">Importing…</span>}
      </div>
      {library.length === 0 && !busy && (
        <div className="empty">
          <svg className="glyph" viewBox="0 0 56 56" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.6" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" aria-hidden="true">
            <path d="M28 16c-4-4-10-5-18-4v30c8-1 14 0 18 4 4-4 10-5 18-4V12c-8-1-14 0-18 4Z" /><path d="M28 16v30" />
          </svg>
          <p>Drop an EPUB, PDF or text file here, or open one above, and Dream Read will read it to you.</p>
        </div>
      )}
      <div className="grid">
        {sorted.map((it) => {
          const pct = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, it.percent));
          return (
            <div className="book-card" key={it.id} onClick={() => useApp.getState().openBook(it.id)} data-testid="book-card" role="button" tabIndex={0} onKeyDown={(e) => { if (e.key === 'Enter') void useApp.getState().openBook(it.id); }}>
              <Cover item={it} />
              <div className="t">{it.title}</div>
              <div className="m">{it.author ? `${it.author} · ` : ''}{it.words.toLocaleString()} words</div>
              <div className="progress"><Ring percent={pct} /><span>{pct > 0 ? `${Math.round(pct)}% read` : 'Not started'}</span></div>
              <div className="bar"><i style={{ width: `${pct}%` }} /></div>
              <div className="foot">
                <button className="primary" onClick={(e) => { e.stopPropagation(); void useApp.getState().openBook(it.id); }} data-testid="continue-book">{pct > 0 ? 'Continue' : 'Start'}</button>
                <button className="quiet remove" onClick={async (e) => { e.stopPropagation(); if (confirm(`Remove “${it.title}” from the library?`)) { await window.readalong.removeBook(it.id); await useApp.getState().refreshLibrary(); } }}>Remove</button>
              </div>
            </div>
          );
        })}
      </div>
      {pasteOpen && (
        <div className="modal-backdrop" onClick={() => _setPasteOpen(false)}>
          <div className="modal" onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
            <h2>Paste text</h2>
            <input type="text" placeholder="Title (optional)" value={title} onChange={(e) => setTitle(e.target.value)} data-testid="paste-title" />
            <textarea style={{ minHeight: 260 }} placeholder="Paste an article, a chapter, anything in English…" value={text} onChange={(e) => setText(e.target.value)} data-testid="paste-body" />
            <div className="row end">
              <button onClick={() => _setPasteOpen(false)}>Cancel</button>
              <button className="primary" disabled={busy || !text.trim()} onClick={importPaste} data-testid="paste-import">Add to library</button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

Library.openDialog = async function openDialog(): Promise<void> {
  try {
    const book = await window.readalong.importBookDialog();
    if (!book) return;
    await useApp.getState().refreshLibrary();
    useApp.getState().setBook(book);
    useApp.getState().setView('reader');
  } catch (e) {
    useApp.getState().showToast(`Could not open: ${(e as Error).message}`);
  }
};
Library.openPaste = function openPaste(): void { useApp.getState().setView('library'); setPasteOpen?.(true); };
```

```tsx
import React, { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import type { CefrLevel } from '@core/model';
import type { VocabProgress, LevelProgress, UnknownWord } from '@shared/api';
import { useApp } from '../state/store';
import { Tip } from '../ui/Tip';
import { sayWord } from './Vocabulary';

const PAGE = 100;

/** Widths (in %) of the three segments of a level bar; an empty level shows nothing. */
export function barSegments(p: Pick<LevelProgress, 'known' | 'learning' | 'unknown'>): { known: number; learning: number; unknown: number } {
  const sum = p.known + p.learning + p.unknown;
  if (sum === 0) return { known: 0, learning: 0, unknown: 0 };
  return { known: (p.known / sum) * 100, learning: (p.learning / sum) * 100, unknown: (p.unknown / sum) * 100 };
}

const LEVEL_NAMES: Record<CefrLevel, string> = { A1: 'Beginner', A2: 'Elementary', B1: 'Intermediate', B2: 'Upper intermediate', C1: 'Advanced', C2: 'Mastery' };

function LevelCard({ p, active, onClick }: { p: LevelProgress; active: boolean; onClick: () => void }): JSX.Element {
  const seg = barSegments(p);
  const pct = p.total ? Math.round((p.known / p.total) * 100) : 0;
  return (
    <button className={`level-card ${active ? 'active' : ''}`} onClick={onClick} aria-pressed={active} data-testid={`level-card-${p.level}`}>
      <div className="top"><span className="lvl">{p.level}</span><span className="name">{LEVEL_NAMES[p.level]}</span></div>
      <div className="pct">{pct}%<span className="of"> known</span></div>
      <div className="stack" aria-hidden="true">
        <i className="known" style={{ width: `${seg.known}%` }} /><i className="learning" style={{ width: `${seg.learning}%` }} /><i className="unknown" style={{ width: `${seg.unknown}%` }} />
      </div>
      <div className="nums"><span><b>{p.known}</b> known</span><span><b>{p.learning}</b> learning</span><span><b>{p.unknown}</b> to learn</span></div>
    </button>
  );
}

export function Progress(): JSX.Element {
  const [progress, setProgress] = useState<VocabProgress | null>(null);
  const [level, setLevel] = useState<CefrLevel | null>(null);
  const [words, setWords] = useState<UnknownWord[] | null>(null);
  const [q, setQ] = useState('');
  const [limit, setLimit] = useState(PAGE);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const reloadProgress = async () => { try { setProgress(await window.readalong.vocabProgress()); } catch (e) { useApp.getState().showToast(`Could not load progress: ${(e as Error).message}`); } };
  useEffect(() => { void reloadProgress(); }, []);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!level) { setWords(null); return; }
    let alive = true;
    setWords(null); setLimit(PAGE); setQ('');
    window.readalong.vocabUnknownAtLevel(level).then((w) => { if (alive) setWords(w); }).catch(() => { if (alive) setWords([]); });
    return () => { alive = false; };
  }, [level]);

  const shown = useMemo(() => {
    const needle = q.trim().toLowerCase();
    const list = needle ? (words ?? []).filter((w) => w.word.includes(needle) || w.zh.includes(needle)) : (words ?? []);
    return list;
  }, [words, q]);

  const markKnown = async (w: UnknownWord) => {
    setBusy(w.word);
    try {
      await window.readalong.setWordStatus(w.word, 'known');
      setWords((ws) => (ws ?? []).filter((x) => x.word !== w.word));
      setProgress((p) => p ? { ...p, levels: p.levels.map((l) => (l.level === w.level ? { ...l, known: l.known + 1, unknown: Math.max(0, l.unknown - 1) } : l)), totals: { ...p.totals, known: p.totals.known + 1, unknown: Math.max(0, p.totals.unknown - 1) } } : p);
      try { useApp.getState().setVocab(await window.readalong.getVocab()); } catch { /* main not ready */ }
    } catch (e) { useApp.getState().showToast(`Could not save: ${(e as Error).message}`); }
    finally { setBusy(null); }
  };

  const t = progress?.totals;
  return (
    <div className="progress-view" data-testid="progress">
      <h1>Progress</h1>
      <p className="lead">How far your English vocabulary has come, level by level.</p>
      <div className="stats" data-testid="progress-stats">
        <div className="stat"><div className="n">{t ? t.known.toLocaleString() : '–'}</div><div className="l">words known</div></div>
        <div className="stat"><div className="n">{progress ? progress.learnedThisWeek : '–'}</div><div className="l">new this week</div></div>
        <div className="stat"><div className="n">{progress ? progress.streakDays : '–'}</div><div className="l">{progress?.streakDays === 1 ? 'day in a row' : 'days in a row'}</div></div>
        <div className="stat"><div className="n">{t ? t.learning.toLocaleString() : '–'}</div><div className="l">learning</div></div>
      </div>
      {progress === null && <p className="muted">Counting…</p>}
      {progress && (
        <div className="level-row">
          {progress.levels.map((p) => <LevelCard key={p.level} p={p} active={level === p.level} onClick={() => setLevel(level === p.level ? null : p.level)} />)}
        </div>
      )}
      {progress && <p className="legend muted"><i className="known" /> known <i className="learning" /> learning <i className="unknown" /> to learn · tap a level to see the words you have not met yet</p>}

      {level && (
        <div className="unknown-panel" data-testid="unknown-panel">
          <div className="row">
            <h2>{level} words to learn</h2>
            <span className="muted">{words ? `${shown.length.toLocaleString()} ${shown.length === 1 ? 'word' : 'words'}, most common first` : 'Loading…'}</span>
            <span className="spacer" />
            <input type="text" className="search" placeholder="Find a word…" value={q} onChange={(e) => setQ(e.target.value)} aria-label="Find a word" />
            <button className="quiet" onClick={() => setLevel(null)}>Close</button>
          </div>
          {words && shown.length === 0 && <div className="empty"><p>{q ? 'No words match.' : `You know every ${level} word in the dictionary. Well done.`}</p></div>}
          {shown.length > 0 && (
            <div className="unknown-list" role="list">
              {shown.slice(0, limit).map((w) => (
                <div className="unknown-row" key={w.word} role="listitem" data-testid="unknown-row">
                  <span className="word">{w.word}</span>
                  <span className="ipa muted">{w.ipa}</span>
                  <span className="zh">{w.zh}</span>
                  <span className="acts">
                    <Tip text="Hear it" align="end"><button className="quiet" onClick={() => void sayWord(w.word)}>Say it</button></Tip>
                    <button disabled={busy === w.word} onClick={() => void markKnown(w)} data-testid="mark-known">I know it</button>
                  </span>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          )}
          {shown.length > limit && <div className="row center"><button onClick={() => setLimit(limit + PAGE)}>Show {Math.min(PAGE, shown.length - limit)} more</button></div>}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useApp } from '../state/store';
import type { Settings, TtsEngineId, AiProviderId, ThemeId } from '@shared/settings';
import { DEFAULT_SETTINGS } from '@shared/settings';
import { CEFR_LEVELS } from '@core/model';

import { shortcutLabel, SHORTCUT_HELP } from '../reader/shortcuts';
const HELP_NAMES: Record<string, string> = Object.fromEntries(SHORTCUT_HELP.flatMap((g) => g.items.map((i) => [i.id, i.text])));
import { SECRET_LABELS, type SecretName, type SecretStatus, type SecretStatusMap, type KokoroStatus } from '@shared/api';
import { Tip } from '../ui/Tip';

export const STORAGE_NOTE = 'Keys are stored encrypted in the app\'s own data folder; they survive updates and re-signing.';

export const NO_KEYS: SecretStatusMap = { anthropic: EMPTY_STATUS, openai: EMPTY_STATUS, elevenlabs: EMPTY_STATUS, azure: EMPTY_STATUS, google: EMPTY_STATUS };
const KEY_PLACEHOLDER: Record<SecretName, string> = { anthropic: 'sk-ant-…', openai: 'sk-…', elevenlabs: 'sk_… or 32 hex characters', azure: 'Speech resource key', google: 'AIza…' };

type Section = 'start' | 'look' | 'voice' | 'skip' | 'ai' | 'level' | 'shortcuts' | 'data';

export const AI_MODELS: { provider: AiProviderId; id: string; name: string; cost: string; note: string }[] = [
  { provider: 'anthropic', id: 'claude-haiku-5-5', name: 'Claude Haiku 5.5', cost: 'about 1–2 cents a day', note: 'Fast and cheap. Fine for word meanings.' },
  { provider: 'anthropic', id: 'claude-sonnet-5-5', name: 'Claude Sonnet 5.5', cost: 'about 30 cents a day', note: 'Smarter, more natural explanations.' },

  { provider: 'openai', id: 'gpt-5.6-terra', name: 'ChatGPT: GPT-5.6', cost: 'about 30 cents a day', note: 'Higher quality.' },
];

/** Theme cards: the colours mirror the tokens in main.css so the preview is honest. */
const THEMES: { id: ThemeId; name: string; bg: string; fg: string; accent: string; muted: string }[] = [
  { id: 'night', name: 'Night', bg: '#15171c', fg: '#d7d2c8', accent: '#d9a066', muted: '#8e8a82' },
  { id: 'sepia', name: 'Sepia', bg: '#f4ecd8', fg: '#3b3328', accent: '#b5651d', muted: '#7a6e5c' },
  { id: 'light', name: 'Light', bg: '#faf9f6', fg: '#2a2a2e', accent: '#b5651d', muted: '#6f6e6a' },
  { id: 'grey', name: 'Grey', bg: '#2b2d31', fg: '#e0e0e0', accent: '#d9a066', muted: '#9a9ea6' },
  { id: 'system', name: 'Match system', bg: 'linear-gradient(135deg, #15171c 50%, #faf9f6 50%)', fg: '#9a968e', accent: '#c58a4a', muted: '#9a968e' },
];

const NAV_ICONS: Record<Section, JSX.Element> = {
  start: <path d="M3 11.5 12 4l9 7.5M5 10v10h14V10" />,
  look: <path d="M12 5C7 5 3.5 8.5 2 12c1.5 3.5 5 7 10 7s8.5-3.5 10-7c-1.5-3.5-5-7-10-7Zm0 10a3 3 0 1 0 0-6 3 3 0 0 0 0 6Z" />,
  voice: <path d="M12 3a3 3 0 0 0-3 3v6a3 3 0 0 0 6 0V6a3 3 0 0 0-3-3ZM6 11a6 6 0 0 0 12 0M12 17v4M9 21h6" />,
```
