```tsx
  level: <path d="M4 20V10M10 20V4M16 20v-7M22 20H2" />,
  shortcuts: <path d="M3 7h18v10H3zM7 11h1M11 11h1M15 11h1M8 14h8" />,
  data: <path d="M12 3c-4.4 0-8 1.3-8 3v12c0 1.7 3.6 3 8 3s8-1.3 8-3V6c0-1.7-3.6-3-8-3ZM4 12c0 1.7 3.6 3 8 3s8-1.3 8-3M4 6c0 1.7 3.6 3 8 3s8-1.3 8-3" />,
};
function NavIcon({ id }: { id: Section }): JSX.Element {
  return <svg className="nav-ico" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.7" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" aria-hidden="true">{NAV_ICONS[id]}</svg>;
}

export function SettingsView(): JSX.Element {
  const settings = useApp((s) => s.settings);
  const patch = useApp((s) => s.patchSettings);
  const [section, setSection] = useState<Section>(settings.onboarded ? 'look' : 'start');
  const [keys, setKeys] = useState<SecretStatusMap>(NO_KEYS);
  const [keyInput, setKeyInput] = useState<Partial<Record<SecretName, string>>>({});
  const [azureRegion, setAzureRegion] = useState<string>('uksouth');
  /** per key: the warning or error from the last Save */
  const [keyNotes, setKeyNotes] = useState<Partial<Record<SecretName, string>>>({});
  const [testResult, setTestResult] = useState<Partial<Record<SecretName, string>>>({});
  const [voices, setVoices] = useState<TtsVoice[]>([]);
  /** per engine: the outcome of the last "Test voice" */
  const [voiceTest, setVoiceTest] = useState<Partial<Record<TtsEngineId, string>>>({});
  const [usage, setUsage] = useState<{ today: number; month: number }>({ today: 0, month: 0 });

  const refreshKeys = async () => { try { setKeys(await window.readalong.secretStatus()); } catch { /* main not ready */ } };
  useEffect(() => { void refreshKeys(); }, []);
  useEffect(() => {
    (async () => {
      const list: TtsVoice[] = [];
      for (const id of Object.keys(ENGINE_LABELS) as TtsEngineId[]) {
        try { list.push(...(await getEngine(id).listVoices())); } catch { /* not configured */ }
      }
      setVoices(list);
    })();
  }, [keys]);
  useEffect(() => {
    void window.readalong.getUsage().then((records) => {
      const today = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10); const month = today.slice(0, 7);
      setUsage({ today: records.filter((r) => r.date.startsWith(today)).reduce((s, r) => s + r.usd, 0), month: records.filter((r) => r.date.startsWith(month)).reduce((s, r) => s + r.usd, 0) });
    });
  }, [section]);

  const saveKey = async (name: SecretName) => {
    let value = keyInput[name]?.trim() ?? '';
    if (name === 'azure' && value) value = JSON.stringify({ key: value, region: azureRegion.trim().toLowerCase() || 'uksouth' });
    setTestResult((t) => ({ ...t, [name]: '' }));
    try {
      const r = await window.readalong.setSecret(name, value);
      setKeyNotes((n) => ({ ...n, [name]: r.warning ?? 'Saved and verified.' }));
      setKeyInput((k) => ({ ...k, [name]: '' }));
    } catch (e) {
      setKeyNotes((n) => ({ ...n, [name]: `Could not save: ${(e as Error).message}` }));
    }
    await refreshKeys();
  };
  const removeKey = async (name: SecretName) => { await window.readalong.setSecret(name, ''); setKeyNotes((n) => ({ ...n, [name]: '' })); setTestResult((t) => ({ ...t, [name]: '' })); await refreshKeys(); };
  const testKey = async (name: SecretName) => {
    setTestResult((t) => ({ ...t, [name]: 'Testing…' }));
    try { const r = await window.readalong.aiTest(name); setTestResult((t) => ({ ...t, [name]: `${r.ok ? '✅' : '❌'} ${r.message}` })); }
    catch (e) { setTestResult((t) => ({ ...t, [name]: `❌ ${(e as Error).message}` })); }
  };
  const dismissLost = async () => { await window.readalong.dismissLostKeys(); await refreshKeys(); };
  const previewVoice = async (engine: TtsEngineId, voiceId: string) => {
    const e = getEngine(engine);
    e.cancelAll();
    const id = voiceId || (await defaultVoiceFor(engine));
    return e.speak('Hello! This is how I will read your books. The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.', { voiceId: id, rate: settings.voice.rate });
  };
  /** "Test voice" on an engine card: plays the sample and reports a failure (missing key, no internet) in words. */
  const testVoice = async (engine: TtsEngineId) => {
    setVoiceTest((t) => ({ ...t, [engine]: 'Playing a sample…' }));
    try {
      const h = await previewVoice(engine, engine === S.voice.engine ? S.voice.voiceId : '');
      const outcome = await h.done;
      setVoiceTest((t) => ({ ...t, [engine]: outcome === 'error' ? `❌ ${h.error?.message ?? 'The voice could not play.'}` : outcome === 'ended' ? '✅ Sample played.' : '' }));
    } catch (e) { setVoiceTest((t) => ({ ...t, [engine]: `❌ ${(e as Error).message}` })); }
  };
  const S = settings;
  const set = (p: Partial<Settings>) => void patch(p);
  const setA = (p: Partial<Settings['appearance']>) => set({ appearance: { ...S.appearance, ...p } });
  const skip: SkipSettings = { ...DEFAULT_SKIP, ...(S.skip ?? {}) };
  const setSkip = (p: Partial<SkipSettings>) => set({ skip: { ...skip, ...p } });

  const nav: { id: Section; label: string }[] = [
    { id: 'start', label: 'Start' }, { id: 'look', label: 'Reading look' }, { id: 'voice', label: 'Voice' }, { id: 'skip', label: 'Skip' }, { id: 'ai', label: 'AI' },
    { id: 'level', label: 'Level & stops' }, { id: 'shortcuts', label: 'Shortcuts' }, { id: 'data', label: 'Data' },
  ];

  return (
    <div className="settings" data-testid="settings">
      <nav aria-label="Settings sections">
        <div className="nav-title">Settings</div>
        {nav.map((n) => <button key={n.id} className={section === n.id ? 'active' : ''} onClick={() => setSection(n.id)} data-testid={`nav-${n.id}`}><NavIcon id={n.id} />{n.label}</button>)}
        <span style={{ flex: 1 }} />
        {!S.onboarded && <button className="primary" data-testid="finish-onboarding" onClick={() => { set({ onboarded: true }); useApp.getState().setView('library'); }}>Done, open my library</button>}
      </nav>

      {section === 'start' && (
        <section>
          <h2>{S.onboarded ? 'Dream Read' : 'Welcome to Dream Read'}</h2>
          <p className="section-lead">Dream Read reads English books aloud with a British voice, shows the meaning of any word you tap, and explains hard words and sentences with Claude or ChatGPT, spoken aloud, like a tutor sitting next to you.</p>
          <div className="card">
            <div><b>Three things to set up</b>, each takes a minute:</div>
            <ol style={{ margin: 0, paddingLeft: 20, display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 8 }}>
              <li><b>AI</b>: choose Claude or ChatGPT and paste an API key. Without a key, tapping words still shows the dictionary meaning; only the spoken explanations need the key.</li>
              <li><b>Voice</b>: the Mac voices work right away. For a much better British voice, download “Daniel (Enhanced)” or “Serena (Premium)” once in System Settings → Accessibility → Spoken Content → System Voice → Manage Voices, then pick it here.</li>
              <li><b>Your level</b>: words above your level are highlighted and explained automatically in listening mode.</li>
            </ol>
            <div className="row"><button className="primary" onClick={() => setSection('ai')}>Start with AI →</button><button onClick={() => setSection('look')}>Choose how it looks</button></div>
          </div>
          <div className="hint muted">Tip: Cmd+, opens Settings at any time. Space plays or pauses. Q turns listening mode on and off.</div>
        </section>
      )}

      {section === 'look' && (
        <section data-testid="section-look">
          <h2>Reading look</h2>
          <p className="section-lead">Calm colours and sizes you can live in for hours. Every change applies at once.</p>

          <h3>Theme</h3>
          <div className="theme-grid" role="radiogroup" aria-label="Theme">
            {THEMES.map((t) => (
              <div key={t.id} className={`theme-card ${S.appearance.theme === t.id ? 'active' : ''}`} role="radio" aria-checked={S.appearance.theme === t.id} tabIndex={0} onClick={() => setA({ theme: t.id })} onKeyDown={(e) => { if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') { e.preventDefault(); setA({ theme: t.id }); } }} data-testid={`theme-${t.id}`}>
                <div className="preview" style={{ background: t.bg, color: t.fg }}>
                  <span className="aa">Aa</span>
                  <span className="line" style={{ background: t.fg }} />
                  <span className="line short" style={{ background: t.accent, opacity: 0.9 }} />
                </div>
                <div className="name">{t.name}</div>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>

          <h3>Text sizes</h3>
          <div className="card">
            <div className="size-row">
              <div className="field">
                <label>Book text <span className="value">{S.appearance.fontSizePx}px</span></label>
                <input type="range" min={14} max={34} value={S.appearance.fontSizePx} onChange={(e) => setA({ fontSizePx: Number(e.target.value) })} data-testid="size-book" />
                <div className="hint">What you read on the page. Cmd+= and Cmd+− change it while reading.</div>
              </div>
              <div className="sample book" style={{ fontSize: S.appearance.fontSizePx, lineHeight: S.appearance.lineHeight, fontFamily: `var(--font-${S.appearance.fontFamily})` }}>The letter arrived the next morning. Elizabeth read it twice before folding it away.</div>
            </div>
            <div className="size-row">
              <div className="field">
                <label>Listening subtitles <span className="value">{S.appearance.subtitleSizePx}px</span></label>
                <input type="range" min={14} max={40} value={S.appearance.subtitleSizePx} onChange={(e) => setA({ subtitleSizePx: Number(e.target.value) })} data-testid="size-subtitle" />
                <div className="hint">The sentence being read, shown in the band at the bottom while you listen.</div>
              </div>
              <div className="sample subtitle" style={{ fontSize: S.appearance.subtitleSizePx, fontFamily: `var(--font-${S.appearance.fontFamily})` }}>Mr. Darcy remained <u>sanguine</u> about the weather.</div>
            </div>
            <div className="size-row">
              <div className="field">
                <label>Explanations <span className="value">{S.appearance.explainSizePx}px</span></label>
                <input type="range" min={12} max={24} value={S.appearance.explainSizePx} onChange={(e) => setA({ explainSizePx: Number(e.target.value) })} data-testid="size-explain" />
                <div className="hint">The explanation panel and transcript.</div>
              </div>
              <div className="sample explain" style={{ fontSize: S.appearance.explainSizePx }}><b>sanguine</b> — hopeful and confident about the future, even when things look bad. <span className="zh">乐观的</span></div>
            </div>
            <div className="size-row">
              <div className="field">
                <label>Buttons and menus <span className="value">{Math.round(S.appearance.uiScale * 100)}%</span></label>
                <input type="range" min={0.9} max={1.3} step={0.05} value={S.appearance.uiScale} onChange={(e) => setA({ uiScale: Number(e.target.value) })} data-testid="size-ui" />
                <div className="hint">The size of everything that is not book text: this page changes with it.</div>
              </div>
              <div className="sample ui"><button className="primary">Continue</button><button>Settings</button><span className="muted">Library · 3 books</span></div>
            </div>
          </div>

          <h3>Lines</h3>
          <div className="card">
            <div className="size-row">
              <div className="field">
                <label>Line spacing <span className="value">{S.appearance.lineHeight.toFixed(2)}</span></label>
                <input type="range" min={1.2} max={2.2} step={0.05} value={S.appearance.lineHeight} onChange={(e) => setA({ lineHeight: Number(e.target.value) })} data-testid="line-height" />
              </div>
              <div className="sample book" style={{ fontSize: S.appearance.fontSizePx, lineHeight: S.appearance.lineHeight, fontFamily: `var(--font-${S.appearance.fontFamily})` }}>The committee's deliberations were protracted and acrimonious, but a consensus emerged. The children went home before the rain started.</div>
            </div>
            <div className="size-row">
              <div className="field">
                <label>Line length <span className="value">{S.appearance.maxLineChars} characters</span></label>
                <input type="range" min={45} max={110} value={S.appearance.maxLineChars} onChange={(e) => setA({ maxLineChars: Number(e.target.value) })} data-testid="line-length" />
                <div className="hint">Shorter lines are easier on the eyes; 60–75 is typical for a book.</div>
              </div>
              <div className="sample book" style={{ fontSize: Math.min(S.appearance.fontSizePx, 16), lineHeight: S.appearance.lineHeight, fontFamily: `var(--font-${S.appearance.fontFamily})`, maxWidth: `${S.appearance.maxLineChars}ch` }}>It is a truth universally acknowledged, that a single man in possession of a good fortune, must be in want of a wife. However little known the feelings or views of such a man may be on his first entering a neighbourhood, this truth is so well fixed in the minds of the surrounding families.</div>
            </div>
            <div className="size-row">
              <div className="field">
                <label>Listening screen width <span className="value">{S.appearance.listenMaxLineChars} characters</span></label>
                <input type="range" min={60} max={140} value={S.appearance.listenMaxLineChars} onChange={(e) => setA({ listenMaxLineChars: Number(e.target.value) })} data-testid="line-length-listen" />
                <div className="hint">The subtitle band uses the full width with comfortable side margins.</div>
              </div>
              <div className="sample subtitle" style={{ fontSize: Math.min(S.appearance.subtitleSizePx, 18), fontFamily: `var(--font-${S.appearance.fontFamily})`, maxWidth: `${S.appearance.listenMaxLineChars}ch` }}>The letter arrived the next morning. It contained a single, perplexing sentence, and Elizabeth read it twice before folding it away.</div>
            </div>
            <div className="field">
              <label>Page margins <span className="value">{S.appearance.marginPx}px</span></label>
              <input type="range" min={16} max={160} step={4} value={S.appearance.marginPx} onChange={(e) => setA({ marginPx: Number(e.target.value) })} />
            </div>
          </div>

          <h3>Page</h3>
          <div className="card">
            <div className="row" style={{ gap: 18 }}>
              <div className="field"><label>Font</label><select value={S.appearance.fontFamily} onChange={(e) => setA({ fontFamily: e.target.value as never })}><option value="serif">Serif (book)</option><option value="sans">Sans-serif</option><option value="dyslexic">Easy to read</option></select></div>
              <div className="field"><label>Layout</label><select value={S.appearance.layout} onChange={(e) => setA({ layout: e.target.value as never })} data-testid="layout"><option value="page">Pages (like Kindle)</option><option value="scroll">Scroll</option></select></div>
              <div className="field"><label>Subtitle band</label><select value={S.appearance.bandEnabled ? '1' : '0'} onChange={(e) => setA({ bandEnabled: e.target.value === '1' })}><option value="1">Shown</option><option value="0">Hidden</option></select></div>
              <div className="field"><label>Band height <span className="value">{S.appearance.bandHeightPct}%</span></label><input type="range" min={15} max={60} value={S.appearance.bandHeightPct} onChange={(e) => setA({ bandHeightPct: Number(e.target.value) })} style={{ width: 140 }} /></div>
            </div>
            <div className="row" style={{ gap: 18 }}>
              <div className="field"><label>Highlight style</label><select value={S.appearance.underlineOnly ? '1' : '0'} onChange={(e) => setA({ underlineOnly: e.target.value === '1' })}><option value="0">Colour fill</option><option value="1">Underline only</option></select></div>
              <div className="field"><label>Tips</label><select value={S.appearance.showTips ? '1' : '0'} onChange={(e) => setA({ showTips: e.target.value === '1' })} data-testid="show-tips"><option value="1">Show: hover a button to see how it works</option><option value="0">Hide</option></select></div>
            </div>
          </div>

          <h3>Highlight colours</h3>
          <div className="card">
            {(['highlightsDark', 'highlightsLight'] as const).map((k) => (
              <div className="field" key={k}>
                <label>{k === 'highlightsDark' ? 'In the Night and Grey themes' : 'In the Sepia and Light themes'}</label>
                <div className="swatches">
                  {(['unknown', 'learning', 'marked', 'sentence', 'word'] as const).map((c) => (
                    <label key={c} className="swatch">
                      <input type="color" value={S.appearance[k][c]} onChange={(e) => setA({ [k]: { ...S.appearance[k], [c]: e.target.value } } as never)} />
                      {{ unknown: 'hard word', learning: 'learning', marked: 'marked', sentence: 'sentence being read', word: 'word being read' }[c]}
                    </label>
                  ))}
                  <button className="quiet" onClick={() => setA({ [k]: DEFAULT_SETTINGS.appearance[k] } as never)}>Reset</button>
                </div>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </section>
      )}

      {section === 'voice' && (
        <section>
          <h2>Voice</h2>
          <p className="section-lead">Who reads to you, and how fast.</p>
          <div className="field">
            <label>Reading voice</label>
            <div className="choice-grid">
              {AVAILABLE_ENGINES.map((id) => {
                const m = ENGINE_LABELS[id];
                const needsKey = !!m.key && !keys[m.key].saved;
                return (
                  <div key={id} className={`choice ${S.voice.engine === id ? 'active' : ''}`} onClick={() => set({ voice: { ...S.voice, engine: id, voiceId: '' } })} data-testid={`engine-${id}`}>
                    <span className="name">{m.label} <span className={`badge ${m.perHour === 'free' ? 'free' : 'paid'}`} data-testid={`engine-price-${id}`}>{m.perHour === 'free' ? 'free' : m.perHour}</span></span>
                    <span className="cost">{m.cost}</span>
                    <span className="cost">{m.quality}</span>
                    {m.key && <span className="cost" data-testid={`engine-key-${id}`}><KeyStatusDot status={keys[m.key]} /> {SECRET_LABELS[m.key]} key: {keys[m.key].verified ? 'saved' : keys[m.key].saved ? 'saved but unreadable, paste it again' : 'needed (below)'}</span>}
                    <span className="row">
                      <button disabled={needsKey} onClick={(e) => { e.stopPropagation(); void testVoice(id); }} data-testid={`engine-test-${id}`}>▶ Test voice</button>
                    </span>
                    {voiceTest[id] && <span className="cost" data-testid={`engine-test-result-${id}`}>{voiceTest[id]}</span>}
                  </div>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          </div>
          {S.voice.engine === 'kokoro' && <KokoroCard />}
          <VoicePicker label="Voice" engine={S.voice.engine} voiceId={S.voice.voiceId} voices={voices} onChange={(voiceId) => set({ voice: { ...S.voice, voiceId } })} onPreview={() => previewVoice(S.voice.engine, S.voice.voiceId)} />
          {S.voice.engine === 'webspeech' && <div className="hint muted small">Better free British voices: System Settings → Accessibility → Spoken Content → System Voice → Manage Voices… → English (UK) → download Daniel (Enhanced), Serena (Premium) or Jamie (Premium). Restart Dream Read afterwards and pick the new voice here.</div>}
          <div className="field">
            <label>Explanation voice</label>
            <select value={S.voice.explainEngine ?? ''} onChange={(e) => set({ voice: { ...S.voice, explainEngine: (e.target.value || null) as TtsEngineId | null, explainVoiceId: null } })}>
              <option value="">Same as the reading voice</option>
              {AVAILABLE_ENGINES.map((id) => <option key={id} value={id}>{ENGINE_LABELS[id].label} · {ENGINE_LABELS[id].cost}</option>)}
            </select>
          </div>
          {S.voice.explainEngine && <VoicePicker label="Explanation voice" engine={S.voice.explainEngine} voiceId={S.voice.explainVoiceId ?? ''} voices={voices} onChange={(explainVoiceId) => set({ voice: { ...S.voice, explainVoiceId } })} onPreview={() => previewVoice(S.voice.explainEngine!, S.voice.explainVoiceId ?? '')} />}
          <div className="card">
            <div className="size-row">
              <div className="field"><label>Speed <span className="value">{S.voice.rate.toFixed(1)}×</span></label><input type="range" min={0.5} max={2.5} step={0.1} value={S.voice.rate} onChange={(e) => set({ voice: { ...S.voice, rate: Number(e.target.value) } })} /></div>
              <div className="field"><label>Pause between sentences <span className="value">{S.voice.pauseBetweenSentencesMs} ms</span></label><input type="range" min={0} max={3000} step={50} value={S.voice.pauseBetweenSentencesMs} onChange={(e) => set({ voice: { ...S.voice, pauseBetweenSentencesMs: Number(e.target.value) } })} /></div>
            </div>
          </div>
          <h3>Keys for paid voices</h3>
          <div className="card">
            {(['openai', 'elevenlabs', 'azure', 'google'] as const).map((name) => (
              <React.Fragment key={name}>
                <LostKeyNotice name={name} status={keys[name]} onDismiss={dismissLost} />
                <div className="row" data-testid={`voice-key-${name}`}>
                  <span style={{ width: 150 }}><KeyStatusDot status={keys[name]} /> {SECRET_LABELS[name]} <KeyBadge status={keys[name]} /></span>
                  <input type="password" style={{ flex: 1 }} placeholder={KEY_PLACEHOLDER[name]} value={keyInput[name] ?? ''} onChange={(e) => setKeyInput((k) => ({ ...k, [name]: e.target.value }))} />
                  {name === 'azure' && <input type="text" style={{ width: 110 }} placeholder="region" title="Azure region of the Speech resource, e.g. uksouth" value={azureRegion} onChange={(e) => setAzureRegion(e.target.value)} />}
                  <button onClick={() => saveKey(name)} disabled={!keyInput[name]?.trim()}>Save</button>
                  <button onClick={() => testKey(name)} disabled={!keys[name].saved}>Test</button>
                  {keys[name].saved && <button onClick={() => removeKey(name)}>Remove</button>}
                </div>
                {keyNotes[name] && <div className="hint">{keyNotes[name]}</div>}
                {testResult[name] && <div className="hint" data-testid={`test-result-${name}`}>{testResult[name]}</div>}
              </React.Fragment>
            ))}
            <div className="hint">The OpenAI key is shared with ChatGPT explanations. Azure needs the key and the region of your Speech resource (500,000 characters a month free); Google needs a Cloud API key with the Text-to-Speech API enabled (1 million characters a month free per voice type). Prices per hour assume about 54,000 characters of book text per hour of listening. Microsoft Edge voices need no key but use an unofficial free service that may stop working one day. {STORAGE_NOTE}</div>
          </div>
        </section>
      )}

      {section === 'skip' && (
        <section data-testid="skip-section">
          <h2>Skip</h2>
          <p className="section-lead">Parts of a book the voice leaves out. The text on the page does not change.</p>
          <div className="card">
            <label className="row" data-testid="skip-all">
              <input type="checkbox" checked={allSkipped(skip)} onChange={(e) => set({ skip: skipAll(e.target.checked) })} />
              <span><b>Skip all</b> <span className="hint muted small">Turn every option below on or off.</span></span>
            </label>
            {SKIP_OPTIONS.map((o) => (
              <label key={o.id} className="row" data-testid={`skip-${o.id}`}>
                <input type="checkbox" checked={skip[o.id]} onChange={(e) => setSkip({ [o.id]: e.target.checked })} />
                <span>{o.label} <span className="hint muted small">{o.hint}</span></span>
              </label>
            ))}
          </div>
          <div className="hint muted small">Headers, footers, page numbers, footnotes, contents lines and captions are skipped as whole lines; brackets, citations and web addresses are left out of the sentence being read.</div>
        </section>
      )}

      {section === 'ai' && (
        <section>
          <h2>AI</h2>
          <p className="section-lead">Who explains the hard words, and how much it may cost.</p>
          <div className="field">
            <label>Which AI explains things?</label>
            <div className="choice-grid">
              {AI_MODELS.map((m) => {
                const active = S.ai.provider === m.provider && (m.provider === 'anthropic' ? S.ai.anthropicModel : S.ai.openaiModel) === m.id;
                return (
                  <div key={m.id} className={`choice ${active ? 'active' : ''}`} onClick={() => set({ ai: { ...S.ai, provider: m.provider, ...(m.provider === 'anthropic' ? { anthropicModel: m.id } : { openaiModel: m.id }) } })} data-testid={`model-${m.id}`}>
                    <span className="name">{m.name}</span>
                    <span className="cost">{m.cost} at 3 hours of listening</span>
                    <span className="cost">{m.note}</span>
                  </div>
                );
              })}
            </div>
            <div className="hint">Costs are estimates for about 120 explanations a day. You pay the AI company directly through your own API key; this app adds nothing.</div>
          </div>
          <div className="card">
            <div className="field">
              <label><KeyStatusDot status={keys[S.ai.provider]} /> {S.ai.provider === 'anthropic' ? 'Anthropic API key' : 'OpenAI API key'} <KeyBadge status={keys[S.ai.provider]} /></label>
              <LostKeyNotice name={S.ai.provider} status={keys[S.ai.provider]} onDismiss={dismissLost} />
              <div className="row">
                <input type="password" style={{ flex: 1 }} placeholder={KEY_PLACEHOLDER[S.ai.provider]} value={keyInput[S.ai.provider] ?? ''} onChange={(e) => setKeyInput((k) => ({ ...k, [S.ai.provider]: e.target.value }))} data-testid="api-key" />
                <button className="primary" onClick={() => saveKey(S.ai.provider)} disabled={!keyInput[S.ai.provider]?.trim()}>Save key</button>
                <button onClick={() => testKey(S.ai.provider)} disabled={!keys[S.ai.provider].saved}>Test</button>
                {keys[S.ai.provider].saved && <button onClick={() => removeKey(S.ai.provider)}>Remove</button>}
              </div>
              {keyNotes[S.ai.provider] && <div className="hint" data-testid="key-note">{keyNotes[S.ai.provider]}</div>}
              {testResult[S.ai.provider] && <div className="hint" data-testid="test-result">{testResult[S.ai.provider]}</div>}
              <div className="hint">
                {S.ai.provider === 'anthropic'
                  ? <>Get a key: sign in at <a href="#" onClick={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); void window.readalong.openExternal('https://platform.claude.com/'); }}>platform.claude.com</a>, open Billing to add 5 dollars of credit, then API keys → Create key.</>
                  : <>Get a key: sign in at <a href="#" onClick={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); void window.readalong.openExternal('https://platform.openai.com/api-keys'); }}>platform.openai.com</a>, add credit under Billing, then create an API key.</>}
                {' '}{STORAGE_NOTE}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
          <StylesEditor settings={S} patch={set} models={AI_MODELS} />
          <div className="row" style={{ gap: 18 }}>
            <div className="field"><label>Length of passage summaries and answers to questions</label>
              <select value={S.ai.explanationLength} onChange={(e) => set({ ai: { ...S.ai, explanationLength: e.target.value as never } })}><option value="short">Short</option><option value="normal">Normal</option><option value="long">Long</option></select></div>
            <div className="field"><label>Speak the Chinese meaning</label>
              <select value={S.ai.speakChinese ? '1' : '0'} onChange={(e) => set({ ai: { ...S.ai, speakChinese: e.target.value === '1' } })}><option value="1">Yes, with the Mac Chinese voice</option><option value="0">No, show it only</option></select></div>
          </div>
          <h3>Budget</h3>
          <div className="card">
            <div className="row" style={{ gap: 18 }}>
              <div className="field"><label>Warn me when a day costs more than</label><div className="row">$<input type="number" min={0} step={0.5} style={{ width: 90 }} value={S.ai.dailyWarnUsd} onChange={(e) => set({ ai: { ...S.ai, dailyWarnUsd: Number(e.target.value) } })} /></div></div>
              <div className="field"><label>Stop AI for the month after</label><div className="row">$<input type="number" min={0} step={1} style={{ width: 90 }} value={S.ai.monthlyStopUsd} onChange={(e) => set({ ai: { ...S.ai, monthlyStopUsd: Number(e.target.value) } })} /></div></div>
              <div className="field"><label>Spent</label><div className="hint">today ${usage.today.toFixed(2)} · this month ${usage.month.toFixed(2)}</div></div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </section>
      )}

      {section === 'level' && (
        <section>
          <h2>Level & stops</h2>
          <p className="section-lead">Which words count as hard, and how often listening mode pauses to explain one.</p>
          <div className="field">
            <label>My English level</label>
            <div className="row">{CEFR_LEVELS.map((l) => <button key={l} className={S.learnerLevel === l ? 'primary' : ''} onClick={() => set({ learnerLevel: l })} data-testid={`level-${l}`}>{l}</button>)}</div>
            <div className="row">
              <Tip text="A 5-minute yes/no word test that finds your real level"><button onClick={() => useApp.getState().setView('leveltest')} data-testid="level-take">{S.level.testedAt ? 'Test my level again' : 'Test my level'}</button></Tip>
              {S.level.lastResult && <span className="hint muted small">Last test: {S.level.lastResult.cefr}, about {S.level.lastResult.sizeLemmas.toLocaleString()} words, {new Date(S.level.testedAt ?? 0).toLocaleDateString()}</span>}
            </div>
            <div className="hint">Words above this level are highlighted. In listening mode the reading stops at them and the AI explains them. Double-click a highlighted word to mark it known.</div>
          </div>
          <div className="card">
            <div className="field"><label>In listening mode, stop and explain</label>
              <div className="row" style={{ gap: 16 }}>
                <label className="row" style={{ gap: 6 }}><input type="checkbox" checked={S.listen.autoExplainWords} onChange={(e) => set({ listen: { ...S.listen, autoExplainWords: e.target.checked } })} /> highlighted words</label>
                <label className="row" style={{ gap: 6 }}><input type="checkbox" checked={S.listen.autoExplainPhrases} onChange={(e) => set({ listen: { ...S.listen, autoExplainPhrases: e.target.checked } })} /> highlighted phrases</label>
                <label className="row" style={{ gap: 6 }}><input type="checkbox" checked={S.listen.firstOccurrencePerChapterOnly} onChange={(e) => set({ listen: { ...S.listen, firstOccurrencePerChapterOnly: e.target.checked } })} /> only the first time a word appears in a chapter</label>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="row" style={{ gap: 18 }}>
              <div className="field"><label>Say the word (times, before and after)</label><input type="number" min={0} max={5} style={{ width: 80 }} value={S.listen.wordRepeats} onChange={(e) => set({ listen: { ...S.listen, wordRepeats: Number(e.target.value) } })} /></div>
              <div className="field"><label>Repeat the sentence after a word (times)</label><input type="number" min={0} max={4} style={{ width: 80 }} value={S.listen.sentenceRepeatsAfterWord} onChange={(e) => set({ listen: { ...S.listen, sentenceRepeatsAfterWord: Number(e.target.value) } })} /></div>
              <div className="field"><label>Repeat a sentence being explained (total)</label><input type="number" min={1} max={4} style={{ width: 80 }} value={S.listen.sentenceRepeatsForPhrase} onChange={(e) => set({ listen: { ...S.listen, sentenceRepeatsForPhrase: Number(e.target.value) } })} /></div>
            </div>
            <div className="row" style={{ gap: 18 }}>
              <div className="field"><label>Maximum stops per 10 minutes (0 = no limit)</label><input type="number" min={0} max={30} style={{ width: 80 }} value={S.listen.maxStopsPer10Min} onChange={(e) => set({ listen: { ...S.listen, maxStopsPer10Min: Number(e.target.value) } })} /></div>
              <div className="field"><label>“Explain last” window</label><select value={S.listen.lastSecondsWindow} onChange={(e) => set({ listen: { ...S.listen, lastSecondsWindow: Number(e.target.value) as never } })}>{[20, 30, 40, 60].map((s) => <option key={s} value={s}>{s} seconds</option>)}</select></div>
              <div className="field"><label>While listening, one tap on a highlighted word</label><select value={S.listen.tapHighlightCancels ? '1' : '0'} onChange={(e) => set({ listen: { ...S.listen, tapHighlightCancels: e.target.value === '1' } })}><option value="1">marks it known and keeps reading</option><option value="0">opens the word popup</option></select></div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </section>
      )}

      {section === 'shortcuts' && (
        <section>
          <h2>Keyboard shortcuts</h2>
          <p className="section-lead">They work while reading, when no text box has the focus.</p>
          <div className="card">
            <div className="kv">
              {Object.entries(S.shortcuts).map(([k, v]) => <React.Fragment key={k}><span>{SHORTCUT_NAMES[k] ?? HELP_NAMES[k] ?? k}</span><span className="key">{shortcutLabel(v)}</span></React.Fragment>)}
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="hint muted">Cmd+O opens a book, Cmd+Shift+V pastes text, Cmd+= / Cmd+− change the text size, Cmd+T cycles the theme.</div>
        </section>
      )}

      {section === 'data' && <DataSection usage={usage} />}
    </div>
  );
}

/** Green = saved and readable, orange = saved but unreadable, grey = none. */
export function KeyStatusDot({ status }: { status: SecretStatus }): JSX.Element {
  const color = status.verified ? 'var(--ok)' : status.saved ? 'var(--accent)' : status.lostAtStartup ? 'var(--danger)' : 'var(--fg-muted)';
  const title = status.verified ? 'Key saved and verified' : status.saved ? 'Key saved but cannot be read; paste it again' : status.lostAtStartup ? 'Key could not be recovered' : 'No key saved';
  return <span title={title} aria-label={title} style={{ display: 'inline-block', width: 9, height: 9, borderRadius: '50%', background: color, verticalAlign: 'middle', marginRight: 2 }} />;
}

function KeyBadge({ status }: { status: SecretStatus }): JSX.Element {
  if (status.verified) return <span className="badge free">saved</span>;
  if (status.saved) return <span className="badge paid">unreadable</span>;
  return <span className="badge">none</span>;
}

/** Shown once per session for a key that was stored with the old Keychain scheme and could not be read after a re-sign. */
export function LostKeyNotice({ name, status, onDismiss }: { name: SecretName; status: SecretStatus; onDismiss: () => void }): JSX.Element | null {
  if (!status.lostAtStartup || status.saved) return null;
  return (
    <div className="hint" style={{ color: 'var(--danger)' }} data-testid={`lost-key-${name}`}>
      Your {SECRET_LABELS[name]} key could not be recovered after the app was updated or re-signed. Please paste it again. <a href="#" onClick={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); onDismiss(); }}>Dismiss</a>
    </div>
  );
}

const SHORTCUT_NAMES: Record<string, string> = {
  playPause: 'Play / pause', prevSentence: 'Previous sentence', nextSentence: 'Next sentence', prevParagraph: 'Previous paragraph', nextParagraph: 'Next paragraph',
  prevPage: 'Previous page', nextPage: 'Next page', replaySentence: 'Replay sentence', explain: 'Explain word / selection / sentence', explainLast: 'Explain the last part',
  markKnown: 'Mark word known', markLearning: 'Mark word learning', ignore: 'Ignore word', toggleListen: 'Listening mode on/off', toggleBand: 'Subtitle band on/off',
  sayWord: 'Say the word', speedUp: 'Faster', speedDown: 'Slower', speedReset: 'Normal speed', nextHard: 'Next hard word', prevHard: 'Previous hard word', closePopup: 'Close popup / skip explanation', markPhrase: 'Mark selection or sentence for listening',
};

function VoicePicker({ label, engine, voiceId, voices, onChange, onPreview }: { label: string; engine: TtsEngineId; voiceId: string; voices: TtsVoice[]; onChange: (id: string) => void; onPreview: () => void }): JSX.Element {
  const list = voices.filter((v) => v.engine === engine);
  const english = list.filter((v) => v.lang.toLowerCase().startsWith('en'));
  const others = list.filter((v) => !v.lang.toLowerCase().startsWith('en'));
  return (
    <div className="field">
      <label>{label}</label>
      <div className="row">
        <select value={voiceId} onChange={(e) => onChange(e.target.value)} style={{ minWidth: 280 }} data-testid={`voice-${engine}`}>
          <option value="">Automatic (best British voice available)</option>
          {english.map((v) => <option key={v.id} value={v.id}>{v.name} · {v.lang}{v.quality ? ` · ${v.quality}` : ''}{v.note ? ` · ${v.note}` : ''}</option>)}
          {others.length > 0 && <optgroup label="Other languages">{others.map((v) => <option key={v.id} value={v.id}>{v.name} · {v.lang}</option>)}</optgroup>}
        </select>
        <Tip text="Hear a sample sentence in this voice"><button onClick={onPreview}>▶ Preview</button></Tip>
      </div>
      {list.length === 0 && engine !== 'webspeech' && <div className="hint">No voices listed yet: check the key or the internet connection. The automatic voice will be used.</div>}
    </div>
  );
}

function DataSection({ usage }: { usage: { today: number; month: number } }): JSX.Element {
  const [diag, setDiag] = useState<string>('');
  const [exported, setExported] = useState<string>('');
  useEffect(() => { void window.readalong.getDiagnostics().then((d) => setDiag(JSON.stringify(d, null, 1))); }, []);
  const vocab = useApp((s) => s.vocab);
  const known = Object.values(vocab.words).filter((v) => v === 'known').length;
  const learning = Object.values(vocab.words).filter((v) => v === 'learning').length;
  const exportCsv = async () => {
    const rows = [['word', 'status'], ...Object.entries(vocab.words)];
    const csv = rows.map((r) => r.join(',')).join('\n');
    try {
      const file = await window.readalong.exportText('dream-read-vocabulary.csv', csv);
      setExported(`Saved to ${file}`);
    } catch {
      // fall back to a browser download when the main process cannot write (older build)
      const blob = new Blob([csv], { type: 'text/csv' });
      const a = document.createElement('a'); a.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob); a.download = 'dream-read-vocabulary.csv'; a.click();
    }
  };
  return (
    <section>
      <h2>Data</h2>
      <p className="section-lead">What the app has learned about you, and where it keeps it. Everything stays on your Mac.</p>
      <div className="card">
        <div className="field"><label>AI spending</label><div>today ${usage.today.toFixed(3)} · this month ${usage.month.toFixed(2)}</div></div>
        <div className="field"><label>Vocabulary</label><div>{known} known · {learning} learning</div>
          <div className="row"><Tip text="Writes a CSV into Documents → Dream Read"><button onClick={exportCsv}>Export CSV</button></Tip><button onClick={() => useApp.getState().setView('diagnostics')}>Diagnostics</button></div>
          {exported && <div className="hint">{exported}</div>}
        </div>
      </div>
      <div className="field"><label>Where your data lives</label><pre className="small muted" style={{ whiteSpace: 'pre-wrap', margin: 0 }}>{diag}</pre></div>
    </section>
  );
}


/** Download state of the free local voice, with a one-click download and progress. */
export function KokoroCard(): JSX.Element {
  const [st, setSt] = useState<KokoroStatus | null>(null);
  useEffect(() => {
    let on = true;
    window.readalong.kokoroStatus().then((s) => { if (on) setSt(s); }).catch(() => undefined);
    const off = window.readalong.onKokoroProgress((s) => { if (on) setSt(s); });
    return () => { on = false; off(); };
  }, []);
  if (!st) return <div className="hint muted small">Checking the Dream voice…</div>;
  const mb = (n: number) => `${Math.round(n / 1_048_576)} MB`;
  if (st.state === 'ready') return <div className="hint small" data-testid="kokoro-ready">Dream voice is ready on this Mac. {st.queued > 0 ? `Preparing ${st.queued} sentences ahead…` : 'Sentences are prepared ahead and kept on disk, so playback stays smooth.'}</div>;
  if (st.state === 'downloading' && st.progress) {
    return (
      <div className="field" data-testid="kokoro-downloading">
        <div className="hint small">Downloading the Dream voice: {mb(st.progress.received)} of {mb(st.progress.total)} ({Math.round(st.progress.percent)}%). You can keep reading with a Mac voice meanwhile.</div>
        <div className="bar"><i style={{ width: `${st.progress.percent}%` }} /></div>
        <div className="row"><button onClick={() => void window.readalong.kokoroCancelDownload()}>Cancel</button></div>
      </div>
    );
  }
  if (st.state === 'loading') return <div className="hint small">Loading the Dream voice…</div>;
  return (
    <div className="field" data-testid="kokoro-missing">
      <div className="hint small">{st.state === 'error' && st.error ? `The voice could not be set up: ${st.error}. ` : ''}The Dream voice is a free, natural British voice that runs on your Mac. It needs a one-time download of about {mb(st.downloadBytes)}.</div>
      <div className="row"><button className="primary" onClick={() => void window.readalong.kokoroDownload()} data-testid="kokoro-download">Download the Dream voice</button></div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import React, { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import type { Settings, AiProviderId } from '@shared/settings';
import type { ExplainRequest } from '@shared/api';
import { DEFAULT_STYLES, DEFAULT_CONTEXT_RULES, KNOBS, PLACEHOLDERS, resolveStyles, type ExplanationStyle, type StyleId, type StyleOverride, type ScriptShape, type Personality, type Length, type AnswerType } from '@shared/styles';
import { buildStyledPrompt } from '@core/ai/prompts';
import { Tip } from '../ui/Tip';

/**
 * Settings → AI → Explanation styles: the learner picks, edits, copies, hides and creates the styles the AI
 * teaches in, edits the shared context rules, and can preview the exact prompt that will be sent.
 *
 * Every change is persisted through patchSettings → IPC. Patches carry only the fields that changed
 * (the main process deep-merges them), so two quick edits never overwrite each other. Text fields are
 * debounced 300 ms and flushed on blur and on unmount.
 */

export interface ModelChoice { provider: AiProviderId; id: string; name: string }

/** A nested partial of settings.ai; `null` for a style removes the learner's override (or the learner-made style). */
export type AiPatch = { [K in keyof Settings['ai']]?: K extends 'styles' ? Partial<Record<StyleId, StyleOverride | null>> : Settings['ai'][K] };

export const PLACEHOLDER_MEANINGS: Record<(typeof PLACEHOLDERS)[number], string> = {
  word: 'the word or phrase being explained',
  sentence: 'the sentence it is in',
  before: 'the text before the sentence',
  after: 'the text after the sentence',
  title: 'the book title',
  chapter: 'the chapter name',
  level: 'your English level',
  dict: 'the dictionary hint (sound, Chinese meaning, level)',
  native: 'your first language (Chinese)',
};

const SHAPE_FIELDS: { key: keyof ScriptShape; label: string; tip: string }[] = [
  { key: 'wordBefore', label: 'Say the word before', tip: 'How many times the voice says the word before the explanation' },
  { key: 'wordAfter', label: 'Say the word after', tip: 'How many times the voice says the word after the explanation' },
  { key: 'sentenceAfterWord', label: 'Sentence after a word', tip: 'After a word is explained, read its sentence this many times' },
  { key: 'sentenceBefore', label: 'Sentence before', tip: 'When a sentence is explained, read it this many times first' },
  { key: 'sentenceAfter', label: 'Sentence after', tip: 'When a sentence is explained, read it this many times afterwards' },
];

const KNOB_TIPS: Record<Personality | Length | AnswerType, string> = {
  warm: 'Encouraging, uses "you" and "we", praises one thing you already know',
  strict: 'Straight to the point, no small talk, ends with one thing to remember',
  peer: 'A relaxed classmate reading the same book with you',
  short: 'About fifty words: the meaning here and one reason it matters',
  normal: 'About a minute of speaking: meaning, role in the context, one example',
  long: 'Up to two minutes: meaning, context, sound or structure, example, a nearby line',
  explain: 'Only explains; never asks you questions',
  quiz: 'Explains, then asks one short question, waits, then gives the answer',
  example: 'Explains, then gives one new everyday sentence of its own',
};

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Pure helpers (exported for unit tests)

/** "Teacher Style" -> "teacher-style"; empty -> "style". */
export function slugify(name: string): string {
  const s = name.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-').replace(/^-+|-+$/g, '').slice(0, 24).replace(/-+$/g, '');
  return s || 'style';
}

/** The first free learner-made id for a name: my-<slug>-1, my-<slug>-2, ... */
export function nextStyleId(name: string, existing: readonly string[]): string {
  const base = `my-${slugify(name)}`;
  for (let n = 1; ; n++) {
    const id = `${base}-${n}`;
    if (!existing.includes(id)) return id;
  }
}

/** The override that makes a full, independent copy of a style as a learner-made one. */
export function duplicateOverride(style: ExplanationStyle): StyleOverride {
  return {
    userMade: true, hidden: false,
    name: `${style.name} (copy)`, description: style.description, basis: `Your own style, copied from ${style.name}.`,
    wordPrompt: style.wordPrompt, sentencePrompt: style.sentencePrompt, shape: { ...style.shape },
    provider: style.provider, model: style.model, maxTokens: style.maxTokens,
    personality: style.personality, length: style.length, answerType: style.answerType,
  };
}

/** The override for a brand-new learner-made style; its prompts come from the custom style's defaults. */
export function newStyleOverride(): StyleOverride {
  return { userMade: true, hidden: false, name: 'My new style', description: 'Your own style.', basis: 'Your own style. Edit anything below.' };
}

export function isBuiltin(id: StyleId): boolean { return DEFAULT_STYLES.some((d) => d.id === id); }

/** A sample explanation request for the prompt preview. */
export function sampleRequest(kind: 'word' | 'sentence'): ExplainRequest {
  const sentence = 'Mr. Darcy remained sanguine about the weather.';
  return {
    kind, target: kind === 'word' ? 'sanguine' : sentence, sentence,
    before: 'The letter arrived the next morning. It contained a single, perplexing sentence. Elizabeth read it twice before folding it away.',
    after: 'The committee\'s deliberations were protracted and acrimonious, but a consensus emerged. The children went home.',
    book: { title: 'Pride and Prejudice', chapter: 'Chapter 3' },
    dict: kind === 'word' ? { ipa: 'ˈsæŋɡwɪn', zh: '乐观的', level: 'C1' } : null,
    position: { chapter: 2, paragraph: 4, sentence: 1 }, history: [],
  };
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Debounced text fields

/** Local draft of a text value, committed `delay` ms after the last keystroke, on blur and on unmount. */
function useDebouncedText(value: string, commit: (v: string) => void, delay = 300): { draft: string; change: (v: string) => void; flush: () => void } {
  const [draft, setDraft] = useState(value);
  const timer = useRef<number | null>(null);
  const pending = useRef<string | null>(null);
  const commitRef = useRef(commit);
  commitRef.current = commit;
  useEffect(() => { if (pending.current === null) setDraft(value); }, [value]);
  const flush = useCallback(() => {
    if (timer.current !== null) { window.clearTimeout(timer.current); timer.current = null; }
    if (pending.current !== null) { const v = pending.current; pending.current = null; commitRef.current(v); }
  }, []);
  useEffect(() => flush, [flush]);
  const change = useCallback((v: string) => {
    setDraft(v);
    pending.current = v;
    if (timer.current !== null) window.clearTimeout(timer.current);
    timer.current = window.setTimeout(flush, delay);
  }, [flush, delay]);
  return { draft, change, flush };
}

function DebouncedTextarea({ value, onCommit, className, testId, title, rows }: { value: string; onCommit: (v: string) => void; className?: string; testId?: string; title?: string; rows?: number }): JSX.Element {
  const { draft, change, flush } = useDebouncedText(value, onCommit);
  return <textarea className={className} value={draft} onChange={(e) => change(e.target.value)} onBlur={flush} data-testid={testId} title={title} rows={rows} spellCheck={false} />;
}

function DebouncedInput({ value, onCommit, testId, title, placeholder }: { value: string; onCommit: (v: string) => void; testId?: string; title?: string; placeholder?: string }): JSX.Element {
  const { draft, change, flush } = useDebouncedText(value, onCommit);
  return <input type="text" value={draft} onChange={(e) => change(e.target.value)} onBlur={flush} data-testid={testId} title={title} placeholder={placeholder} />;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

function Segmented<T extends string>({ options, value, onChange, testPrefix, label }: { options: { id: T; label: string; tip: string }[]; value: T; onChange: (v: T) => void; testPrefix: string; label: string }): JSX.Element {
  return (
    <div className="seg" role="radiogroup" aria-label={label}>
      {options.map((o) => (
        <Tip key={o.id} text={o.tip} wrap below>
          <button type="button" className={o.id === value ? 'on' : ''} role="radio" aria-checked={o.id === value} onClick={() => onChange(o.id)} data-testid={`${testPrefix}-${o.id}`}>{o.label}</button>
        </Tip>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

export function StylesEditor({ settings, patch, models }: { settings: Settings; patch: (p: Partial<Settings>) => void; models: ModelChoice[] }): JSX.Element {
  const ai = settings.ai;
  const styles = useMemo(() => resolveStyles(ai.styles), [ai.styles]);
  const [selectedId, setSelectedId] = useState<StyleId>(ai.activeStyle);
  const selected = styles.find((s) => s.id === selectedId) ?? styles.find((s) => s.id === ai.activeStyle) ?? styles[0];
  const visible = styles.filter((s) => !s.hidden);
  const hidden = styles.filter((s) => s.hidden);
  const builtin = isBuiltin(selected.id);

  const patchAi = useCallback((p: AiPatch) => patch({ ai: p } as unknown as Partial<Settings>), [patch]);
  const patchStyle = useCallback((id: StyleId, o: StyleOverride) => patchAi({ styles: { [id]: o } }), [patchAi]);
  const edit = (o: StyleOverride) => patchStyle(selected.id, o);

  const use = (id: StyleId) => patchAi({ activeStyle: id });
  const duplicate = () => {
    const id = nextStyleId(selected.name, styles.map((s) => s.id));
    patchStyle(id, duplicateOverride(selected));
    setSelectedId(id);
  };
  const create = () => {
    const id = nextStyleId('style', styles.map((s) => s.id));
    patchStyle(id, newStyleOverride());
    setSelectedId(id);
  };
  const hide = () => {
    const other = visible.find((s) => s.id !== selected.id) ?? styles[0];
    patchAi({ styles: { [selected.id]: { hidden: true } }, ...(ai.activeStyle === selected.id ? { activeStyle: other.id } : {}) });
    setSelectedId(other.id);
  };
  const restore = (id: StyleId) => { patchStyle(id, { hidden: false }); setSelectedId(id); };
  const remove = () => {
    const other = ai.activeStyle === selected.id ? (visible.find((s) => s.id !== selected.id) ?? styles[0]).id : ai.activeStyle;
    patchAi({ styles: { [selected.id]: null }, ...(ai.activeStyle === selected.id ? { activeStyle: other } : {}) });
    setSelectedId(other);
  };
  const reset = () => patchAi({ styles: { [selected.id]: selected.hidden ? { hidden: true } : null } });

  const setShape = (key: keyof ScriptShape, raw: string) => {
    const n = Math.max(0, Math.min(9, Math.round(Number(raw))));
    if (Number.isNaN(n)) return;
    edit({ shape: { ...selected.shape, [key]: n } });
  };
  const modelValue = selected.provider && selected.model ? `${selected.provider}:${selected.model}` : '';
  const defaultModelName = models.find((m) => m.provider === ai.provider && m.id === (ai.provider === 'anthropic' ? ai.anthropicModel : ai.openaiModel))?.name ?? (ai.provider === 'anthropic' ? ai.anthropicModel : ai.openaiModel);

  const [previewOpen, setPreviewOpen] = useState(false);
  const [previewKind, setPreviewKind] = useState<'word' | 'sentence'>('word');
  const preview = useMemo(() => previewOpen ? buildStyledPrompt(sampleRequest(previewKind), { style: selected, contextRules: ai.contextRules, level: settings.learnerLevel, native: 'Chinese' }) : null, [previewOpen, previewKind, selected, ai.contextRules, settings.learnerLevel]);

  return (
    <div className="styles-editor" data-testid="styles-editor">
      <h3>Explanation styles</h3>
      <div className="field">
        <label>How the AI teaches a word or a sentence</label>
        <div className="style-grid" role="listbox" aria-label="Explanation styles">
          {visible.map((s) => (
            <div key={s.id} className={`style-card${s.id === selected.id ? ' selected' : ''}${s.id === ai.activeStyle ? ' in-use' : ''}`} role="option" aria-selected={s.id === selected.id} tabIndex={0}
              onClick={() => setSelectedId(s.id)} onKeyDown={(e) => { if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') { e.preventDefault(); setSelectedId(s.id); } }} data-testid={`style-card-${s.id}`}>
              <span className="name"><span>{s.name}</span>{s.id === ai.activeStyle && <span className="badge on" data-testid="style-active-badge">Active</span>}{s.userMade && s.id !== ai.activeStyle && <span className="badge">Yours</span>}</span>
              <span className="desc">{s.description}</span>
              <span className="basis">{s.basis}</span>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
        <div className="hint">Click a style to see and edit it below. The <b>Active</b> style is the one used when a word or sentence is explained. Every style's text can be changed; built-in styles can always be reset.</div>
      </div>
      {hidden.length > 0 && (
        <details className="hidden-styles" data-testid="hidden-styles">
          <summary>Hidden styles ({hidden.length}) — restore</summary>
          <div className="row" style={{ marginTop: 8 }}>
            {hidden.map((s) => (
              <Tip key={s.id} text="Show this style in the list again" below>
                <button onClick={() => restore(s.id)} data-testid={`style-restore-${s.id}`}>{s.name} ↺</button>
              </Tip>
            ))}
          </div>
        </details>
      )}

      <div className="card" data-testid="style-editor">
        <div className="row style-actions">
          <Tip text="Explain words and sentences with this style from now on" below><button className="primary" onClick={() => use(selected.id)} disabled={ai.activeStyle === selected.id} data-testid="style-use">{ai.activeStyle === selected.id ? 'In use' : 'Use this style'}</button></Tip>
          <Tip text="Make your own copy of this style that you can change freely" below><button onClick={duplicate} data-testid="style-duplicate">Duplicate</button></Tip>
          {builtin
            ? <Tip text="Take this style out of the list; you can restore it any time" below><button onClick={hide} disabled={visible.length < 2 || selected.hidden} data-testid="style-hide">Hide</button></Tip>
            : <Tip text="Delete this style of yours for good" below><button onClick={remove} data-testid="style-delete">Delete</button></Tip>}
          <span style={{ flex: 1 }} />
          <Tip text="Start a new style of your own from the custom defaults" below align="end"><button onClick={create} data-testid="style-new">+ New style</button></Tip>
        </div>

        <div key={selected.id} className="style-fields">
          <div className="row" style={{ gap: 18, alignItems: 'flex-start' }}>
            <div className="field" style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 220 }}>
              <label>Name</label>
              <DebouncedInput value={selected.name} onCommit={(name) => edit({ name })} testId="style-name" title="The name shown in the list of styles" />
            </div>
            <div className="field" style={{ flex: 2, minWidth: 260 }}>
              <label>One-line description</label>
              <DebouncedInput value={selected.description} onCommit={(description) => edit({ description })} testId="style-description" title="One line under the name in the list of styles" placeholder="What this style does, in one line" />
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="row knobs" style={{ gap: 18, alignItems: 'flex-start' }}>
            <div className="field"><label>Personality</label>
              <Segmented label="Personality" testPrefix="knob-personality" value={selected.personality} onChange={(personality) => edit({ personality })}
                options={(Object.keys(KNOBS.personality) as Personality[]).map((id) => ({ id, label: KNOBS.personality[id].label, tip: KNOB_TIPS[id] }))} /></div>
            <div className="field"><label>Length</label>
              <Segmented label="Length" testPrefix="knob-length" value={selected.length} onChange={(length) => edit({ length })}
                options={(Object.keys(KNOBS.length) as Length[]).map((id) => ({ id, label: KNOBS.length[id].label, tip: KNOB_TIPS[id] }))} /></div>
            <div className="field"><label>Answer type</label>
              <Segmented label="Answer type" testPrefix="knob-answer" value={selected.answerType} onChange={(answerType) => edit({ answerType })}
                options={(Object.keys(KNOBS.answerType) as AnswerType[]).map((id) => ({ id, label: KNOBS.answerType[id].label, tip: KNOB_TIPS[id] }))} /></div>
          </div>
          <div className="hint">Each choice adds one sentence to the prompt. Open <b>Preview</b> below to read them.</div>

          <div className="field">
            <label><Tip text="Sent when a word or a phrase is explained; the context rules and the book text go with it" wrap below align="start"><span>Word prompt</span></Tip></label>
            <DebouncedTextarea className="prompt" value={selected.wordPrompt} onCommit={(wordPrompt) => edit({ wordPrompt })} testId="style-word-prompt" title="What the AI is asked to do for a word or a phrase" />
          </div>
          <div className="field">
            <label><Tip text="Sent when a whole sentence is explained" wrap below align="start"><span>Sentence prompt</span></Tip></label>

            <div className="field">

                <select value={modelValue} onChange={(e) => { const [provider, ...rest] = e.target.value.split(':'); const id = rest.join(':'); edit(provider && id ? { provider: provider as AiProviderId, model: id } : { provider: null, model: null }); }} data-testid="style-model">
                  <option value="">Use the default model ({defaultModelName})</option>
                  {models.map((m) => <option key={`${m.provider}:${m.id}`} value={`${m.provider}:${m.id}`}>{m.name}</option>)}
                </select>

            </div>
            <details className="advanced">

                <Tip text="A hard stop on the length of the reply; the length knob above already tells the AI how long to talk" wrap below align="start">
                  <input type="number" min={100} max={4000} step={50} value={selected.maxTokens} onChange={(e) => { const n = Number(e.target.value); if (!Number.isNaN(n) && n > 0) edit({ maxTokens: n }); }} data-testid="style-max-tokens" style={{ width: 110 }} />
                </Tip>
              </div>
            </details>

        </div>

        <div className="field prompt-preview">
          <div className="row">
            <Tip text="See the exact text that will be sent to the AI, for a sample sentence" wrap below align="start"><button onClick={(e) => { setPreviewOpen((o) => !o); e.currentTarget.blur(); }} data-testid="style-preview" aria-expanded={previewOpen}>{previewOpen ? 'Hide preview' : 'Preview the prompt'}</button></Tip>
            {previewOpen && (
              <div className="seg" role="radiogroup" aria-label="Preview for">
                <Tip text="Preview the prompt for a word" below><button className={previewKind === 'word' ? 'on' : ''} onClick={() => setPreviewKind('word')} data-testid="preview-word">A word</button></Tip>
                <Tip text="Preview the prompt for a sentence" below><button className={previewKind === 'sentence' ? 'on' : ''} onClick={() => setPreviewKind('sentence')} data-testid="preview-sentence">A sentence</button></Tip>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
          {preview && (
            <div className="preview-box" data-testid="preview-box">
              <div className="hint">Sample: the word <b>sanguine</b> in <i>Pride and Prejudice</i>. The real prompt uses your book, {ai.contextWordsBefore} words before and {ai.contextWordsAfter} words after the sentence. Up to {preview.maxTokens} tokens of reply.</div>
              <div className="preview-label">System (the context rules)</div>
              <pre data-testid="preview-system">{preview.system}</pre>
              <div className="preview-label">User (the book text and this style's prompt)</div>
              <pre data-testid="preview-user">{preview.user}</pre>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      <h3>Context rules</h3>
      <div className="card" data-testid="context-rules-card">
        <div className="field">
          <label><Tip text="Sent with every style as the system prompt: who the AI is, how to read the passage, how to speak" wrap below align="start"><span>Rules shared by every style</span></Tip></label>
          <DebouncedTextarea className="prompt rules" value={ai.contextRules} onCommit={(contextRules) => patchAi({ contextRules })} testId="context-rules" title="The shared rules sent with every explanation" />
          <div className="hint">These rules go with every explanation, before the style's own prompt. <a href="#" onClick={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); patchAi({ contextRules: DEFAULT_CONTEXT_RULES }); }} data-testid="context-reset">Reset to default</a></div>
        </div>
        <div className="row" style={{ gap: 18, alignItems: 'flex-start' }}>
          <div className="field">
            <label>Words of text before the sentence</label>
            <Tip text="How much of the book before the sentence the AI reads; more context costs a little more" wrap below align="start"><input type="number" min={0} max={3000} step={50} value={ai.contextWordsBefore} onChange={(e) => { const n = Number(e.target.value); if (!Number.isNaN(n) && n >= 0) patchAi({ contextWordsBefore: Math.round(n) }); }} data-testid="context-before" style={{ width: 110 }} /></Tip>
          </div>
          <div className="field">
            <label>Words of text after</label>
            <Tip text="How much of the book after the sentence the AI reads" wrap below align="start"><input type="number" min={0} max={3000} step={50} value={ai.contextWordsAfter} onChange={(e) => { const n = Number(e.target.value); if (!Number.isNaN(n) && n >= 0) patchAi({ contextWordsAfter: Math.round(n) }); }} data-testid="context-after" style={{ width: 110 }} /></Tip>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="hint">Defaults: 500 words before, 200 after.</div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import React, { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import type { CefrLevel } from '@core/model';
import { CEFR_LEVELS } from '@core/model';
import type { VocabEntry, VocabEntryStatus } from '@shared/api';
import { getEngine, defaultVoiceFor } from '@core/tts/registry';
import { useApp } from '../state/store';
import { Tip } from '../ui/Tip';

/** The two vocabulary screens; app.tsx adds them to its routing under these ids. */
export const VOCAB_VIEW_IDS = ['vocabulary', 'progress'] as const;
export type VocabViewId = (typeof VOCAB_VIEW_IDS)[number];

type StatusFilter = 'learning' | 'known' | 'all';

/** "Oct 3" this year, "Oct 3, 2025" otherwise. */
export function shortDate(iso: string, now: Date = new Date()): string {
  const d = new Date(iso);
  if (Number.isNaN(d.getTime())) return '';
  const opts: Intl.DateTimeFormatOptions = { month: 'short', day: 'numeric' };
  if (d.getFullYear() !== now.getFullYear()) opts.year = 'numeric';
  return d.toLocaleDateString('en-GB', opts);
}

/** Entries matching the search box (word, Chinese, sentence or explanation) and the chips. */
export function filterEntries(entries: VocabEntry[], q: string, status: StatusFilter, bookId: string | null, level: CefrLevel | null): VocabEntry[] {
  const needle = q.trim().toLowerCase();
  return entries.filter((e) => {
    if (status !== 'all' && e.status !== status) return false;
    if (bookId && e.bookId !== bookId) return false;
    if (level && e.level !== level) return false;
    if (!needle) return true;
    return [e.word, e.lemma, e.chinese, e.sentence, e.explanation].some((s) => (s ?? '').toLowerCase().includes(needle));
  });
}

/** Speaks a word with the reading voice from Settings (falls back to the engine's default voice). */
export async function sayWord(text: string): Promise<void> {
  const { voice } = useApp.getState().settings;
  try {
    const engine = getEngine(voice.engine);
    const voiceId = voice.voiceId || (await defaultVoiceFor(voice.engine));
    engine.cancelAll();
    engine.speak(text, { voiceId, rate: Math.min(voice.rate, 1) });
  } catch (e) {
    useApp.getState().showToast(`Could not speak: ${(e as Error).message}`);
  }
}

async function syncHighlightMap(): Promise<void> {
  try { useApp.getState().setVocab(await window.readalong.getVocab()); } catch { /* main not ready */ }
}

export function LevelPill({ level }: { level?: CefrLevel }): JSX.Element | null {
  if (!level) return null;
  return <span className={`level-pill l-${level.toLowerCase()}`}>{level}</span>;
}

function Row({ e, open, onToggle, onChange }: { e: VocabEntry; open: boolean; onToggle: () => void; onChange: () => void }): JSX.Element {
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const act = async (fn: () => Promise<unknown>) => {
    setBusy(true);
    try { await fn(); await syncHighlightMap(); onChange(); } catch (err) { useApp.getState().showToast((err as Error).message); } finally { setBusy(false); }
  };
  const setStatus = (status: VocabEntryStatus) => act(() => window.readalong.vocabSetEntryStatus(e.lemma, status));
  const remove = () => act(async () => { if (confirm(`Remove “${e.word}” from your vocabulary?`)) await window.readalong.vocabDeleteEntry(e.lemma); });
  return (
    <div className={`vocab-row ${open ? 'open' : ''} ${e.status}`} data-testid="vocab-row" data-lemma={e.lemma}>
      <div className="head" role="button" tabIndex={0} onClick={onToggle} onKeyDown={(ev) => { if (ev.key === 'Enter' || ev.key === ' ') { ev.preventDefault(); onToggle(); } }} aria-expanded={open}>
        <span className="word">{e.word || e.lemma}</span>
        <span className="zh">{e.chinese}</span>
        <LevelPill level={e.level} />
        <span className="book" title={e.chapter ? `${e.bookTitle} · ${e.chapter}` : e.bookTitle}>{e.bookTitle}</span>
        <span className="date">{shortDate(e.createdAt)}</span>
        <span className={`status-dot ${e.status}`} title={e.status === 'known' ? 'Known' : 'Learning'} aria-label={e.status} />
      </div>
      {open && (
        <div className="body">
          {e.sentence && <p className="sentence">“{e.sentence}”</p>}
          {e.explanation ? <p className="explanation">{e.explanation}</p> : <p className="explanation muted">No explanation saved yet.</p>}
          <div className="meta muted">
            {e.chapter ? `${e.bookTitle} · ${e.chapter}` : e.bookTitle}
            {e.timesExplained > 1 ? ` · explained ${e.timesExplained} times` : ''}
            {e.again > 0 ? ` · “I don't know” ${e.again}×` : ''}
            {` · last seen ${shortDate(e.lastSeenAt)}`}
          </div>
          <div className="row actions">
            <Tip text="Hear the word in your reading voice" below align="start"><button onClick={() => void sayWord(e.word || e.lemma)} data-testid="vocab-say">Say it</button></Tip>
            {e.status === 'learning'
              ? <button className="primary" disabled={busy} onClick={() => void setStatus('known')} data-testid="vocab-known">Move to Known</button>
              : <button disabled={busy} onClick={() => void setStatus('learning')} data-testid="vocab-learning">Back to Learning</button>}
            <button className="quiet danger" disabled={busy} onClick={() => void remove()} data-testid="vocab-delete">Delete</button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

export function Vocabulary(): JSX.Element {
  const [entries, setEntries] = useState<VocabEntry[] | null>(null);
  const [q, setQ] = useState('');
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<StatusFilter>('learning');
  const [bookId, setBookId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [level, setLevel] = useState<CefrLevel | null>(null);
  const [open, setOpen] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [csvPath, setCsvPath] = useState('');
  const [exporting, setExporting] = useState(false);

  const reload = async () => { try { setEntries(await window.readalong.vocabEntries()); } catch { setEntries([]); } };
  useEffect(() => { void reload(); window.readalong.vocabCsvPath().then(setCsvPath).catch(() => setCsvPath('')); }, []);

  const books = useMemo(() => {
    const m = new Map<string, string>();
    for (const e of entries ?? []) if (e.bookId && !m.has(e.bookId)) m.set(e.bookId, e.bookTitle || 'Untitled');
    return [...m.entries()].sort((a, b) => a[1].localeCompare(b[1]));
  }, [entries]);
  const levels = useMemo(() => CEFR_LEVELS.filter((l) => (entries ?? []).some((e) => e.level === l)), [entries]);
  const shown = useMemo(() => filterEntries(entries ?? [], q, status, bookId, level), [entries, q, status, bookId, level]);
  const counts = useMemo(() => ({ learning: (entries ?? []).filter((e) => e.status === 'learning').length, known: (entries ?? []).filter((e) => e.status === 'known').length }), [entries]);

  const exportCsv = async () => {
    setExporting(true);
    try {
      const file = await window.readalong.vocabExportCsv();
      setCsvPath(file);
      useApp.getState().showToast(`Saved ${file}`);
    } catch (e) { useApp.getState().showToast(`Could not export: ${(e as Error).message}`); }
    finally { setExporting(false); }
  };

  const total = entries?.length ?? 0;
  return (
    <div className="vocab" data-testid="vocabulary">
      <h1>My vocabulary</h1>
      <p className="lead">{total === 0 ? 'Words you have explained will be collected here.' : `${total} ${total === 1 ? 'word' : 'words'} · ${counts.learning} learning · ${counts.known} known`}</p>
      <div className="toolbar">
        <input type="text" className="search" placeholder="Search a word, a meaning or a sentence…" value={q} onChange={(e) => setQ(e.target.value)} data-testid="vocab-search" aria-label="Search" />
        <div className="chips" role="tablist" aria-label="Status">
          {([['learning', `Learning${counts.learning ? ` ${counts.learning}` : ''}`], ['known', `Known${counts.known ? ` ${counts.known}` : ''}`], ['all', 'All']] as [StatusFilter, string][]).map(([id, label]) => (
            <button key={id} className={`chip ${status === id ? 'active' : ''}`} onClick={() => setStatus(id)} role="tab" aria-selected={status === id} data-testid={`vocab-filter-${id}`}>{label}</button>
          ))}
        </div>
        {books.length > 1 && (
          <select value={bookId ?? ''} onChange={(e) => setBookId(e.target.value || null)} aria-label="Book" data-testid="vocab-book">
            <option value="">All books</option>
            {books.map(([id, title]) => <option key={id} value={id}>{title}</option>)}
          </select>
        )}
        {levels.length > 1 && (
          <div className="chips" role="tablist" aria-label="Level">
            <button className={`chip ${level === null ? 'active' : ''}`} onClick={() => setLevel(null)}>Any level</button>
            {levels.map((l) => <button key={l} className={`chip ${level === l ? 'active' : ''}`} onClick={() => setLevel(level === l ? null : l)}>{l}</button>)}
          </div>
        )}
        <span className="spacer" />
        <Tip text="Writes a spreadsheet file you can open in Excel or Numbers" below align="end">
          <button onClick={() => void exportCsv()} disabled={exporting || total === 0} data-testid="vocab-export">Export CSV</button>
        </Tip>
      </div>
      {csvPath && total > 0 && <p className="csv-path muted" data-testid="vocab-csv-path">Kept up to date in <span className="path">{csvPath}</span></p>}

      {entries === null && <p className="muted">Loading…</p>}
      {entries !== null && total === 0 && (
        <div className="empty">
          <svg className="glyph" viewBox="0 0 56 56" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.6" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" aria-hidden="true">
            <rect x="10" y="12" width="36" height="32" rx="4" /><path d="M18 22h20M18 29h20M18 36h12" />
          </svg>
          <p>This list is empty for now. When you read or listen to a book and a word is explained, it is saved here with its sentence and its meaning.</p>
        </div>
      )}
      {entries !== null && total > 0 && shown.length === 0 && <div className="empty"><p>No words match. Try another word or another filter.</p></div>}
      {shown.length > 0 && (
        <div className="vocab-list" role="list">
          {shown.map((e) => <Row key={e.lemma} e={e} open={open === e.lemma} onToggle={() => setOpen(open === e.lemma ? null : e.lemma)} onChange={reload} />)}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```
