### `src/renderer/views/levelText.ts` (117 lines)

```ts
import type { CefrLevel } from '@core/model';
import { levelIndex } from '@core/model';
import type { LevelResult } from '@core/level/score';

/**
 * Texts of the level test screen (LevelTest.tsx), kept pure so they can be unit-tested. Simple English
 * throughout: the reader is a learner who may be at A2.
 */

export const LEVEL_TEST_VIEW_ID = 'leveltest';

/** Items of a full test: 50 + 50 (STAGE1_PER_BAND x 8 + STAGE1_PSEUDO, STAGE2_REAL + STAGE2_PSEUDO). */
export const TOTAL_STAGES = 2;

export const INTRO_TITLE = 'How many English words do you know?';
export const INTRO_LINES = [
  'You will see one word at a time.',
  'Do you know this word? Tap Yes if you know what it means. Tap No if you are not sure.',
  'Some words are not real words. So please be honest: a "Yes" on a fake word lowers your score.',
  'It takes about 5 minutes. There is no pass or fail.',
];

export const LEVEL_NAMES: Record<CefrLevel, string> = {
  A1: 'Beginner', A2: 'Elementary', B1: 'Intermediate', B2: 'Upper intermediate', C1: 'Advanced', C2: 'Near native',
};

/** What the level means for reading in this app, in one friendly sentence. */
export const READING_NOTES: Record<CefrLevel, string> = {
  A1: 'Start with very short, simple stories. The app will explain many words, so take it slowly and enjoy it.',
  A2: 'Short stories and graded readers are a good fit. The app will stop often to explain words; that is normal.',
  B1: 'You can read simple novels and most news. The app will explain the harder words as you go.',
  B2: 'You can read most novels with some help. The app will explain the less common words.',
  C1: 'You can read almost any book. The app will only stop at rare or special words.',
  C2: 'You read like a native speaker. The app will stay quiet most of the time.',
};

export function formatWords(n: number): string {
  return Math.round(n).toLocaleString('en-US');
}

/** "12 of 50" */
export function progressText(index: number, total: number): string {
  return `${Math.min(index + 1, total)} of ${total}`;
}

/** "Stage 1 of 2" */
export function stageText(stage: number): string {
  return `Stage ${stage} of ${TOTAL_STAGES}`;
}

/** "Your level: B2" */
export function levelHeadline(result: LevelResult): string {
  return `Your level: ${result.cefr}`;
}

/** "probably B1 to C1", or "quite sure" when the interval stays inside one level */
export function rangeText(result: LevelResult): string {
  const [lo, hi] = result.cefrRange;
  if (lo === hi) return `quite sure it is ${lo}`;
  return `probably ${lo} to ${hi}`;
}

/** "about 5,500 words" (the lemma estimate; families are not shown, the number would only confuse) */
export function sizeText(result: LevelResult): string {
  return `about ${formatWords(result.sizeLemmas)} words`;
}

/** "You know about 5,500 of the 20,000 most common English words." */
export function sizeSentence(result: LevelResult): string {
  return `You know ${sizeText(result)} of the 20,000 most common English words.`;
}

/** One friendly sentence on what the level means for reading. */
export function readingNote(result: LevelResult): string {
  return READING_NOTES[result.cefr];
}

export const UNRELIABLE_TITLE = 'We could not measure your level this time';
export const UNRELIABLE_TEXT = 'You said "Yes" to many words that are not real. That makes the result unreliable. Please try again and tap "No" when you are not sure.';

/** The whole result message in one object, for the result screen and for tests. */
export interface LevelMessage {
  reliable: boolean;
  title: string;
  /** small text under the title */
  subtitle: string;
  /** one or two sentences of body text */
  body: string;
}

export function levelMessage(result: LevelResult): LevelMessage {
  if (!result.reliable) return { reliable: false, title: UNRELIABLE_TITLE, subtitle: 'Please try again', body: UNRELIABLE_TEXT };
  return {
    reliable: true,
    title: levelHeadline(result),
    subtitle: `${LEVEL_NAMES[result.cefr]} · ${rangeText(result)}`,
    body: `${sizeSentence(result)} ${readingNote(result)}`,
  };
}

/** Compared with the level the learner had before: "same as before", "one level up from B1", "two levels down from C1". */
export function changeText(result: LevelResult, previous: CefrLevel | null): string | null {
  if (!previous || !result.reliable) return null;
  const d = levelIndex(result.cefr) - levelIndex(previous);
  if (d === 0) return `The same as your level before (${previous}).`;
  const n = Math.abs(d) === 1 ? 'One level' : Math.abs(d) === 2 ? 'Two levels' : `${Math.abs(d)} levels`;
  return `${n} ${d > 0 ? 'up' : 'down'} from your level before (${previous}).`;
}

/** Keyboard: Y, J, ArrowRight = Yes; N, K, ArrowLeft = No; anything else = null. Space is not used on purpose. */
export function answerForKey(code: string): boolean | null {
  switch (code) {
    case 'KeyY': case 'KeyJ': case 'ArrowRight': return true;
    case 'KeyN': case 'KeyK': case 'ArrowLeft': return false;
    default: return null;
  }
}
```

### `src/renderer/voice/VoiceChat.ts` (424 lines)

```ts
/**
 * VoiceChat: the voice line between the learner and the tutor. Joins the microphone (MicCapture), the local
 * speech-to-text engine (stt IPC), the VoiceSession (commands / conversation) and the reader (ListenController
 * through the `tutor` callbacks). No DOM here: the UI (VoiceChatUI.tsx) renders `snapshot` and calls the
 * public methods; tests drive it with fakes.
 *
 * Lines:
 *  - 'closed'  the mic is off.
 *  - 'window'  the pause after an explanation (or a quiz wait): the mic is open in 'commands' mode for
 *              "I know" / "I don't know" / "bye bye" / a question. Opens and closes with the pause.
 *  - 'call'    the learner pressed the mic (or Always on): every sentence they say is a question for the
 *              tutor; speaking interrupts the tutor and pauses the book; "bye bye" ends the call.
 */
import { Emitter } from '@core/voice/turns';
import { VoiceSession, type SttEngineEvent } from '@core/voice/session';
import type { CommandListenerOptions } from '@core/voice/turns';
import type { SttStatus } from '@shared/api';
import type { MicLike } from './mic';
import { MicError } from './mic';

export type VoiceLine = 'closed' | 'window' | 'call';
/** what the round mic button shows */
export type VoiceUiState = 'off' | 'listening' | 'thinking' | 'speaking';
/** what the tutor (ListenController) is doing */
export type TutorState = 'idle' | 'thinking' | 'speaking';

/** The stt IPC as VoiceChat uses it (window.readalong.stt*, or a fake under e2e / in tests). */
export interface SttBridge {
  status(): Promise<SttStatus>;
  download(): Promise<SttStatus>;
  cancelDownload(): Promise<void>;
  start(sessionId: string, opts?: { sampleRate?: number }): Promise<SttStatus>;
  push(sessionId: string, pcm: ArrayBuffer): Promise<void>;
  stop(sessionId: string): Promise<void>;
  onEvent(cb: (ev: SttEngineEvent) => void): () => void;
  onProgress(cb: (s: SttStatus) => void): () => void;
}

/** What the voice line does to the reader; implemented by ReaderView with the ListenController. */
export interface TutorActions {
  /** "I know": the word of the last explanation is known now; the book continues at once (Listening) */
  know(): void;
  /** "I don't know": the last explanation again, deeper */
  dontKnow(): void;
  /** a question about the current sentence, sent with the chapter's history; the reply is spoken as it streams */
  ask(text: string, spoken: boolean): void;
  /** the learner started talking: the tutor goes quiet and the book pauses */
  hold(): void;
  /** the learner said nothing after all: the book goes on if it was going (Listening) */
  release(): void;
  /** the learner started talking during the pause: keep the pause open a little longer */
  keepWaiting(): void;
  /** "bye bye" during the pause: the book goes on (Listening); Reading stays where it is */
  continueBook(): void;
}

export interface VoiceTurn { id: number; who: 'you' | 'tutor'; text: string; spoken: boolean }

export interface VoiceSnapshot {
  line: VoiceLine;
  ui: VoiceUiState;
  /** mic input level 0..1 */
  level: number;
  /** live transcript of what the learner is saying */
  partial: string;
  /** the speech model is missing: the consent card asks before downloading */
  consent: boolean;
  /** download / model status (null until known) */
  model: SttStatus | null;
  /** a message for the learner (mic denied, model failed); null when all is well */
  error: string | null;
  alwaysOn: boolean;
}

export interface VoiceChatEvents {
  change: (s: VoiceSnapshot) => void;
  /** the learner said something that was sent to the tutor, or a command was recognised */
  heard: (e: { text: string; command?: 'know' | 'dont_know' | 'bye' }) => void;
}

export interface VoiceChatOptions {
  stt: SttBridge;
  mic: MicLike;
  tutor: TutorActions;
  /** start with Always on */
  alwaysOn?: boolean;
  /** after the learner stopped speaking without a question arriving, the book goes on after this long (ms) */
  noQuestionMs?: number;
  /** the pause closed while the learner was still talking: their sentence is still taken for this long (ms) */
  windowGraceMs?: number;
  /** passed to the CommandListener (debounce, clock) */
  listener?: CommandListenerOptions;
  setTimeout?: (fn: () => void, ms: number) => unknown;
  clearTimeout?: (t: unknown) => void;
}

let nextSession = 0;

export class VoiceChat extends Emitter<VoiceChatEvents> {
  readonly session: VoiceSession;
  private line: VoiceLine = 'closed';
  private tutorState: TutorState = 'idle';
  private userSpeaking = false;
  private level = 0;
  private partial = '';
  private consent = false;
  private model: SttStatus | null = null;
  private error: string | null = null;
  private alwaysOn: boolean;
  /** the pause after an explanation is open (nested opens are counted) */
  private windows = 0;
  /** the call should start once the model is downloaded */
  private callAfterDownload = false;
  /** the book was paused because the learner started talking (barge-in) and no question has gone out yet */
  private holding = false;
  private sid: string | null = null;
  private opening: Promise<void> | null = null;
  private noQuestionTimer: unknown = null;
  private graceTimer: unknown = null;
  private offs: (() => void)[] = [];
  private disposed = false;
  private readonly st: (fn: () => void, ms: number) => unknown;
  private readonly ct: (t: unknown) => void;

  constructor(private readonly opts: VoiceChatOptions) {
    super();
    this.session = new VoiceSession({ mode: 'off', listener: opts.listener });
    this.alwaysOn = !!opts.alwaysOn;
    this.st = opts.setTimeout ?? ((fn, ms) => setTimeout(fn, ms));
    this.ct = opts.clearTimeout ?? ((t) => clearTimeout(t as ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>));
    // only events of the mic session that is open now
    this.session.attach((listener) => opts.stt.onEvent((ev) => { if (this.sid && ev.sessionId === this.sid) listener(ev); }));
    this.offs.push(
      opts.stt.onProgress((s) => { this.model = s; this.afterModelChange(); this.changed(); }),
      opts.mic.on('frame', (pcm) => { const id = this.sid; if (id) void opts.stt.push(id, pcm).catch(() => undefined); }),
      opts.mic.on('level', (l) => { this.level = l; this.changed(); }),
      opts.mic.on('ended', () => { this.error = 'The microphone was disconnected.'; this.closeLine(); }),
      this.session.on('speechStart', () => this.onSpeechStart()),
      this.session.on('speechEnd', () => this.onSpeechEnd()),
      this.session.on('partial', (p) => { this.partial = p.text; this.changed(); }),
      this.session.on('question', (q) => this.onQuestion(q.text)),
      this.session.on('command', (c) => this.onCommand(c.intent, c.text)),
      this.session.on('error', (e) => { this.error = `Speech recognition failed (${e.message}).`; this.changed(); }),
    );
    void opts.stt.status().then((s) => { this.model = s; this.afterModelChange(); this.changed(); }).catch(() => undefined);
  }

  get snapshot(): VoiceSnapshot {
    return { line: this.line, ui: this.uiState(), level: this.line === 'closed' ? 0 : this.level, partial: this.partial, consent: this.consent, model: this.model, error: this.error, alwaysOn: this.alwaysOn };
  }

  get sessionId(): string | null { return this.sid; }

  // ---- what the learner does -------------------------------------------------------------------

  /** The mic button / M key: opens the call, or hangs up. */
  toggle(): void { if (this.line === 'call') this.hangUp(); else this.call(); }

  /** Opens the call (asks to download the speech model first when it is missing). */
  call(): void {
    this.error = null;
    if (!this.model) { void this.opts.stt.status().then((st) => { this.model = st; this.call(); }, (e: Error) => { this.error = e.message; this.changed(); }); return; }
    if (this.model.state === 'error' && !this.model.downloadBytes) { this.error = this.model.error ?? 'Speech recognition is not available.'; this.changed(); return; }
    if (!this.modelReady()) {
      this.callAfterDownload = true;
      this.consent = true;
      this.changed();
      return;
    }
    this.consent = false;
    this.line = 'call';
    this.applyMode();
    this.changed();
    void this.openMic();
  }

  /** Ends the call without a word to the tutor (the button, M, or "bye bye"). */
  hangUp(): void {
    this.callAfterDownload = false;
    if (this.line === 'closed') return;
    if (this.holding) { this.holding = false; this.opts.tutor.release(); }
    if (this.windows > 0) { this.line = 'window'; this.applyMode(); this.changed(); return; }
    this.closeLine();
  }

  setAlwaysOn(on: boolean): void {
    this.alwaysOn = on;
    if (on && this.line !== 'call') this.call();
    this.changed();
  }

  /** The typed box: the same as saying it (pronunciation does not matter). */
  askTyped(text: string): void {
    const t = text.trim();
    if (!t) return;
    this.emit('heard', { text: t });
    this.clearNoQuestion();
    this.holding = false;
    this.opts.tutor.ask(t, false);
  }

  /**
   * Entering Listening mode: when the speech model is not installed, show the download consent card (without
   * opening a call afterwards), so the commands windows at hard words can hear the learner. Returns whether the
   * card was shown; the caller remembers that it asked once.
   */
  offerModel(): Promise<boolean> {
    const decide = (st: SttStatus | null): boolean => {
      if (this.disposed || !st || this.line === 'call' || this.consent) return false;
      if (st.state !== 'missing' && !(st.state === 'error' && st.downloadBytes > 0)) return false;
      this.consent = true;
      this.changed();
      return true;
    };
    if (this.model) return Promise.resolve(decide(this.model));
    return this.opts.stt.status().then((st) => { this.model = st; return decide(st); }, () => false);
  }

  /** The consent card: download the speech model now. */
  acceptDownload(): void {
    this.consent = true;
    this.error = null;
    this.changed();
    this.opts.stt.download().then((s) => { this.model = s; this.consent = false; this.afterModelChange(); this.changed(); }, (e: Error) => {
      if (/abort|cancel/i.test(e.message)) { this.consent = false; this.callAfterDownload = false; } else this.error = `The speech model could not be downloaded (${e.message}).`;
      this.changed();
    });
  }

  declineDownload(): void {
    if (this.model?.state === 'downloading') void this.opts.stt.cancelDownload().catch(() => undefined);
    this.consent = false; this.callAfterDownload = false; this.changed();
  }

  dismissError(): void { this.error = null; this.changed(); }

  // ---- what the reader tells it ----------------------------------------------------------------

  /** ListenController's onPauseWindow: the pause after an explanation (or a quiz wait) opens / closes. */
  pauseWindow(open: boolean): void {
    if (open) {
      this.windows++;
      if (this.graceTimer !== null) { this.ct(this.graceTimer); this.graceTimer = null; }
      if (this.line === 'closed') {
        if (!this.modelReady() || this.error) return; // never ask for a download or a permission by itself
        this.line = 'window';
        void this.openMic();
      }
      this.applyMode();
      this.changed();
      return;
    }
    this.windows = Math.max(0, this.windows - 1);
    if (this.windows > 0) return;
    if (this.line === 'call') { this.applyMode(); this.changed(); return; }
    if (this.line !== 'window') return;
    if (this.userSpeaking) {
      // the learner is in the middle of a sentence: take it, then close
      this.graceTimer = this.st(() => { this.graceTimer = null; if (this.line === 'window' && this.windows === 0) this.closeLine(); }, this.opts.windowGraceMs ?? 4000);
      return;
    }
    this.closeLine();
  }

  /** The tutor (ListenController) is thinking / speaking / done. */
  setTutorState(s: TutorState): void {
    if (s === this.tutorState) return;
    this.tutorState = s;
    this.changed();
  }

  /** Feeds one STT event as if it came from the engine (e2e: `window.__dreamVoice.inject`). */
  inject(ev: Partial<SttEngineEvent> & { type: SttEngineEvent['type'] }): void {
    const sid = this.sid ?? 'injected';
    const segmentId = (ev as { segmentId?: string }).segmentId ?? `${sid}:${++nextSession}`;
    this.session.handle({ ...ev, sessionId: sid, segmentId } as SttEngineEvent);
  }

  dispose(): void {
    this.disposed = true;
    this.clearNoQuestion();
    if (this.graceTimer !== null) { this.ct(this.graceTimer); this.graceTimer = null; }
    this.closeMic();
    this.session.detach();
    for (const off of this.offs) off();
    this.offs = [];
    this.removeAllListeners();
  }

  // ---- internals -------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  private modelReady(): boolean { const st = this.model?.state; return st === 'ready' || st === 'loading'; }

  private afterModelChange(): void {
    if (this.disposed || !this.modelReady()) return;
    if (this.consent && this.model?.state !== 'downloading') this.consent = false;
    if (this.callAfterDownload || (this.alwaysOn && this.line !== 'call')) { this.callAfterDownload = false; this.call(); }
  }

  private uiState(): VoiceUiState {
    if (this.line === 'closed') return this.tutorState === 'idle' ? 'off' : this.tutorState;
    if (this.userSpeaking) return 'listening';
    if (this.tutorState !== 'idle') return this.tutorState;
    return 'listening';
  }

  /** commands while the pause is open (also during a call: "I know" there means the word), conversation otherwise */
  private applyMode(): void {
    const mode = this.line === 'closed' ? 'off' : this.windows > 0 ? 'commands' : this.line === 'call' ? 'conversation' : 'off';
    this.session.setMode(mode);
  }

  private onSpeechStart(): void {
    this.userSpeaking = true;
    this.partial = '';
    this.clearNoQuestion();
    if (this.session.mode === 'commands') this.opts.tutor.keepWaiting();
    else if (this.line === 'call' && !this.holding) { this.holding = true; this.opts.tutor.hold(); }
    this.changed();
  }

  private onSpeechEnd(): void {
    this.userSpeaking = false;
    this.changed();
    if (!this.holding) return;
    // noise, a cough, or words the recogniser could not make out: the book goes on after a moment
    this.clearNoQuestion();
    this.noQuestionTimer = this.st(() => { this.noQuestionTimer = null; if (this.holding) { this.holding = false; this.opts.tutor.release(); } }, this.opts.noQuestionMs ?? 2500);
  }

  private clearNoQuestion(): void { if (this.noQuestionTimer !== null) { this.ct(this.noQuestionTimer); this.noQuestionTimer = null; } }

  private onQuestion(text: string): void {
    const t = text.trim();
    this.userSpeaking = false;
    this.partial = '';
    this.clearNoQuestion();
    if (!t) { this.changed(); return; }
    this.holding = false;
    this.emit('heard', { text: t });
    this.opts.tutor.ask(t, true);
    this.afterTurnInWindow();
    this.changed();
  }

  private onCommand(intent: 'know' | 'dont_know' | 'bye', text: string): void {
    this.userSpeaking = false;
    this.partial = '';
    this.clearNoQuestion();
    this.emit('heard', { text, command: intent });
    if (intent === 'know') { this.opts.tutor.know(); this.afterTurnInWindow(); }
    else if (intent === 'dont_know') { this.opts.tutor.dontKnow(); this.afterTurnInWindow(); }
    else {
      // "bye bye": the voice line closes; Listening carries on, Reading stays where it is
      const inWindow = this.windows > 0;
      const wasHolding = this.holding;
      this.callAfterDownload = false;
      this.holding = false;
      this.windows = 0;
      this.closeLine();
      if (wasHolding) this.opts.tutor.release();
      if (inWindow) this.opts.tutor.continueBook();
    }
    this.changed();
  }

  /** a window line has done its job once the learner answered: the next pause opens a new one */
  private afterTurnInWindow(): void {
    if (this.line !== 'window') return;
    this.windows = 0;
    if (this.graceTimer !== null) { this.ct(this.graceTimer); this.graceTimer = null; }
    this.closeLine();
  }

  private closeLine(): void {
    this.line = 'closed';
    this.userSpeaking = false;
    this.partial = '';
    this.level = 0;
    this.session.setMode('off');
    this.closeMic();
    this.changed();
  }

  private async openMic(): Promise<void> {
    if (this.opening) {
      // a session is still starting (the model may take seconds to load); if the line was closed and opened
      // again meanwhile, that one gives up when it is ready, so a fresh one is opened after it
      await this.opening;
      if (this.sid || this.disposed || this.line === 'closed') return;
      return this.openMic();
    }
    if (this.sid) return;
    const sid = `voice-${Date.now().toString(36)}-${++nextSession}`;
    this.opening = (async () => {
      try {
        this.sid = sid;
        await this.opts.stt.start(sid, { sampleRate: 16000 });
        if (this.sid !== sid || this.lineNow() === 'closed') { void this.opts.stt.stop(sid).catch(() => undefined); return; }
        await this.opts.mic.start();
        if (this.sid !== sid || this.lineNow() === 'closed') this.opts.mic.stop();
      } catch (e) {
        this.error = e instanceof MicError ? e.message : `The microphone could not be opened (${(e as Error).message}).`;
        if (this.sid === sid) { this.sid = null; void this.opts.stt.stop(sid).catch(() => undefined); }
        this.callAfterDownload = false;
        this.line = 'closed'; this.session.setMode('off');
        this.changed();
      } finally { this.opening = null; }
    })();
    return this.opening;
  }

  /** the line as it is now (read again after an await) */
  private lineNow(): VoiceLine { return this.line; }

  private closeMic(): void {
    this.opts.mic.stop();
    const sid = this.sid;
    this.sid = null;
    if (sid) void this.opts.stt.stop(sid).catch(() => undefined);
  }

  private changed(): void { if (!this.disposed) this.emit('change', this.snapshot); }
}
```

```tsx
import React, { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import type { VoiceSnapshot } from './VoiceChat';
import './voice.css';

export interface VoiceExchange { you: string; tutor: string; status: 'thinking' | 'speaking' | 'done' | 'error' | 'skipped' | 'idle'; error?: string }

interface Props {
  snap: VoiceSnapshot;
  /** the last thing the learner said or typed, and the tutor's answer */
  last: VoiceExchange | null;
  popover: boolean;
  onPopover: (open: boolean) => void;
  onToggle: () => void;
  onAlwaysOn: (on: boolean) => void;
  onAsk: (text: string) => void;
  onAcceptDownload: () => void;
  onDeclineDownload: () => void;
  onDismissError: () => void;
  /** key label for the tooltip (e.g. "M") */
  keyLabel: string;
  /** moves the button left of the explanations panel when it is open */
  shifted?: boolean;
}

const LABEL: Record<VoiceSnapshot['ui'], string> = { off: 'Talk with the tutor', listening: 'Listening… just talk', thinking: 'Thinking…', speaking: 'Speaking… talk any time to interrupt' };

/** The floating round mic button (right edge, mid-height) with its popover: status, Always on, typed box. */
export function VoiceChatUI(p: Props): JSX.Element {
  const { snap } = p;
  const [text, setText] = useState('');
  const boxRef = useRef<HTMLTextAreaElement>(null);
  const on = snap.line !== 'closed';
  const state = on || snap.ui !== 'off' ? snap.ui : 'off';
  // the typed box takes the focus when the popover opens, not each time a commands window closes (that would
  // swallow K / D / Esc / M while the popover stays open)
  const onRef = useRef(on); onRef.current = on;
  useEffect(() => { if (p.popover && !onRef.current) boxRef.current?.focus(); }, [p.popover]);
  const send = () => { const t = text.trim(); if (!t) return; p.onAsk(t); setText(''); };
  const mb = (bytes: number | undefined) => Math.max(1, Math.round((bytes || 111e6) / 1e6));
  const prog = snap.model?.progress;
  const pct = prog && prog.overallTotal > 0 ? Math.round((prog.overallReceived / prog.overallTotal) * 100) : null;
  const downloading = snap.model?.state === 'downloading';
  const statusLine = snap.line === 'window' && snap.ui === 'listening' ? 'Say “I know”, “I don’t know”, or ask a question' : LABEL[state];

  return (
    <div className={`voice-dock ${p.shifted ? 'shifted' : ''}`} onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()} onMouseDown={(e) => e.stopPropagation()} onMouseUp={(e) => e.stopPropagation()} data-testid="voice">
      {p.popover && (
        <div className="voice-pop" role="dialog" aria-label="Voice chat" data-testid="voice-popover">
          <div className="vp-head">
            <span className={`vp-dot ${state}`} aria-hidden="true" />
            <span className="vp-status" data-testid="voice-status">{on ? statusLine : 'Voice line closed'}</span>
            <span className="grow" />
            <button className="icon quiet" onClick={() => p.onPopover(false)} aria-label="Close">✕</button>
          </div>
          {on && <div className="vp-meter" aria-hidden="true"><span style={{ transform: `scaleX(${Math.max(0.02, snap.level)})` }} /></div>}
          {snap.partial && <div className="vp-partial" data-testid="voice-partial">“{snap.partial}”</div>}
          {p.last && (
            <div className="vp-turns">
              <div className="vp-you"><b>You</b> {p.last.you}</div>
              <div className="vp-tutor"><b>Tutor</b> {p.last.status === 'thinking' && !p.last.tutor ? <span className="muted">thinking…</span> : p.last.status === 'error' ? <span className="vp-err">{p.last.error}</span> : p.last.tutor}</div>
            </div>
          )}
          {snap.consent && (
            <div className="vp-consent" data-testid="voice-consent">
              <div><b>Download the speech model ({mb(snap.model?.downloadBytes)} MB) once?</b></div>
              <div className="muted small">It runs on your Mac: what you say never leaves it. Typing works meanwhile.</div>
              {downloading ? (
                <div className="vp-progress"><div className="bar"><span style={{ width: `${pct ?? 0}%` }} /></div><span className="small muted">{prog?.phase === 'extract' ? 'Unpacking…' : `${pct ?? 0}%`}</span><button className="quiet" onClick={p.onDeclineDownload}>Cancel</button></div>
              ) : (
                <div className="row"><button className="primary" onClick={p.onAcceptDownload} data-testid="voice-download">Download</button><button className="quiet" onClick={p.onDeclineDownload}>Not now</button></div>
              )}
            </div>
          )}
          {snap.error && <div className="vp-error" data-testid="voice-error"><span>{snap.error}</span><button className="icon quiet" onClick={p.onDismissError} aria-label="Dismiss">✕</button></div>}
          <form className="vp-ask" onSubmit={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); send(); }}>
            <textarea ref={boxRef} rows={2} value={text} placeholder="Ask the tutor about this sentence…" onChange={(e) => setText(e.target.value)}
              onKeyDown={(e) => { if (e.key === 'Enter' && !e.shiftKey) { e.preventDefault(); send(); } }} data-testid="voice-text" />
            <div className="row">
              <span className="muted small vp-hint">Pronunciation does not matter, you can type.</span>
              <span className="grow" />
              <button type="submit" className="primary" disabled={!text.trim()} data-testid="voice-send">Send</button>
            </div>
          </form>
          <label className="vp-always">
            <input type="checkbox" checked={snap.alwaysOn} onChange={(e) => p.onAlwaysOn(e.target.checked)} data-testid="voice-always" />
            <span>Always on <span className="muted small">(the tutor hears you whenever you talk)</span></span>
          </label>
          <div className="muted small">Say “bye bye” to close the line.</div>
        </div>
      )}
      <button className={`voice-mic ${state} ${on ? 'on' : ''}`} onClick={p.onToggle} data-testid="mic" data-state={state} data-line={snap.line}
        aria-label={on ? 'Close the voice line' : 'Talk with the tutor'} title={`${on ? 'Close the voice line' : 'Talk with the tutor'} (${p.keyLabel})`}>
        <MicIcon />
        {on && <span className="ring" style={{ transform: `scale(${1 + snap.level * 0.6})` }} aria-hidden="true" />}
      </button>
      <button className={`voice-more ${p.popover ? 'active' : ''}`} onClick={() => p.onPopover(!p.popover)} aria-label="Type a question, voice options" title="Type a question, voice options" data-testid="voice-more">
        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="14" height="14" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" aria-hidden="true"><rect x="3" y="6" width="18" height="12" rx="2" /><path d="M7 10h.01M11 10h.01M15 10h.01M7 14h10" /></svg>
      </button>
    </div>
  );
}

export function MicIcon(): JSX.Element {
  return <svg className="ico" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><rect x="9" y="3" width="6" height="11" rx="3" /><path d="M5 11a7 7 0 0 0 14 0M12 18v3" /></svg>;
}
```

### `src/renderer/voice/bridge.ts` (62 lines)

```ts
/**
 * The stt IPC for VoiceChat: the preload bridge (window.readalong.stt*), a stand-in where there is no local
 * speech engine (the web build), and the e2e fake (no real mic: transcripts are injected by the spec).
 */
import type { ExplainRequest, SttStatus } from '@shared/api';
import type { SttEngineEvent } from '@core/voice/session';
import type { SttBridge, VoiceChat, VoiceSnapshot } from './VoiceChat';

const base: SttStatus = { state: 'ready', variant: 'moonshine-base', modelDir: '', downloadBytes: 0, progress: null, error: null, sessions: 0, version: '', confidence: false };

export function sttBridge(): SttBridge {
  const api = window.readalong;
  if (typeof api.sttStatus !== 'function' || !api.sttStart || !api.sttPush || !api.sttStop || !api.onSttEvent || !api.onSttProgress || !api.sttDownload || !api.sttCancelDownload) {
    const none: SttStatus = { ...base, state: 'error', error: 'Talking by voice needs the Mac app. You can type your question.' };
    return {
      status: async () => none, download: async () => none, cancelDownload: async () => undefined,
      start: async () => { throw new Error(none.error!); }, push: async () => undefined, stop: async () => undefined,
      onEvent: () => () => undefined, onProgress: () => () => undefined,
    };
  }
  return {
    status: () => api.sttStatus!(),
    download: () => api.sttDownload!(),
    cancelDownload: () => api.sttCancelDownload!(),
    start: (id, opts) => api.sttStart!(id, opts),
    push: (id, pcm) => api.sttPush!(id, pcm),
    stop: (id) => api.sttStop!(id),
    onEvent: (cb) => api.onSttEvent!((ev) => cb(ev as SttEngineEvent)),
    onProgress: (cb) => api.onSttProgress!(cb),
  };
}

/** e2e: the model is "ready", start/push/stop do nothing; events come from window.__dreamVoice.inject. */
export function e2eSttBridge(): SttBridge {
  const ready: SttStatus = { ...base, version: 'e2e' };
  return {
    status: async () => ready, download: async () => ready, cancelDownload: async () => undefined,
    start: async () => ready, push: async () => undefined, stop: async () => undefined,
    onEvent: () => () => undefined, onProgress: () => () => undefined,
  };
}

export interface DreamVoiceHooks {
  /** feeds a transcript event as if the speech engine had sent it, e.g. { type: 'final', text: 'I know', segmentId: 's1' } */
  inject(ev: { type: SttEngineEvent['type']; text?: string; segmentId?: string; message?: string }): void;
  snapshot(): VoiceSnapshot;
  /** every AI request the reader sent so far */
  requests: ExplainRequest[];
}

declare global { interface Window { __dreamVoice?: DreamVoiceHooks } }

/** Exposes window.__dreamVoice (e2e builds only); returns the uninstall function. */
export function installE2eHooks(chat: VoiceChat, requests: ExplainRequest[]): () => void {
  const hooks: DreamVoiceHooks = {
    inject: (ev) => chat.inject({ text: '', ...ev } as SttEngineEvent),
    snapshot: () => chat.snapshot,
    requests,
  };
  window.__dreamVoice = hooks;
  return () => { if (window.__dreamVoice === hooks) delete window.__dreamVoice; };
}
```

### `src/renderer/voice/mic.ts` (185 lines)

```ts
/**
 * Microphone capture for voice chat: getUserMedia (echo cancellation on, so the tutor's own voice from the
 * speakers stays out) -> AudioWorklet -> 16 kHz mono Int16 frames of 512 samples (32 ms) -> `frame` listeners.
 * The worklet is an inline module loaded from a Blob URL; where that is refused (CSP) a ScriptProcessorNode
 * runs the same resampler on the main thread.
 */
import { Emitter } from '@core/voice/turns';

export const MIC_RATE = 16000;
export const FRAME_SAMPLES = 512; // 32 ms at 16 kHz

export const MIC_DENIED_MESSAGE = 'Dream Read needs the microphone: System Settings → Privacy & Security → Microphone';

export class MicError extends Error {
  constructor(public readonly code: 'denied' | 'unavailable' | 'other', message: string) { super(message); }
}

/**
 * Linear-interpolating downsampler with a two-pole low-pass in front (enough for speech recognition), Float32 at
 * the device rate in, Int16 frames at 16 kHz out. The AudioWorklet source below runs the same algorithm.
 */
export class Pcm16kResampler {
  private readonly ratio: number;
  private readonly a: number;
  private lp1 = 0; private lp2 = 0; private prev = 0; private t = 0;
  private buf: Int16Array; private n = 0; private sumSq = 0;

  constructor(inputRate: number, private readonly frame = FRAME_SAMPLES, private readonly onFrame: (pcm: Int16Array, rms: number) => void) {
    this.ratio = inputRate / MIC_RATE;
    // cut-off a little under 8 kHz (the new Nyquist); none when the input already is 16 kHz
    this.a = this.ratio <= 1 ? 1 : 1 - Math.exp((-2 * Math.PI * 7000) / inputRate);
    this.buf = new Int16Array(frame);
  }

  push(input: Float32Array): void {
    for (let i = 0; i < input.length; i++) {
      this.lp1 += this.a * (input[i] - this.lp1);
      this.lp2 += this.a * (this.lp1 - this.lp2);
      const cur = this.lp2;
      while (this.t <= 1) { this.emit(this.prev + (cur - this.prev) * this.t); this.t += this.ratio; }
      this.t -= 1;
      this.prev = cur;
    }
  }

  private emit(v: number): void {
    const c = v > 1 ? 1 : v < -1 ? -1 : v;
    this.buf[this.n++] = c < 0 ? c * 0x8000 : c * 0x7fff;
    this.sumSq += c * c;
    if (this.n === this.frame) {
      const out = this.buf;
      const rms = Math.sqrt(this.sumSq / this.frame);
      this.buf = new Int16Array(this.frame); this.n = 0; this.sumSq = 0;
      this.onFrame(out, rms);
    }
  }
}

const WORKLET_SOURCE = `
class Pcm16k extends AudioWorkletProcessor {
  constructor(options) {
    super();
    this.ratio = sampleRate / ${MIC_RATE};
    this.a = this.ratio <= 1 ? 1 : 1 - Math.exp((-2 * Math.PI * 7000) / sampleRate);
    this.frame = (options && options.processorOptions && options.processorOptions.frame) || ${FRAME_SAMPLES};
    this.lp1 = 0; this.lp2 = 0; this.prev = 0; this.t = 0;
    this.buf = new Int16Array(this.frame); this.n = 0; this.sumSq = 0;
  }
  process(inputs) {
    const input = inputs[0] && inputs[0][0];
    if (!input) return true;
    for (let i = 0; i < input.length; i++) {
      this.lp1 += this.a * (input[i] - this.lp1);
      this.lp2 += this.a * (this.lp1 - this.lp2);
      const cur = this.lp2;
      while (this.t <= 1) {
        let v = this.prev + (cur - this.prev) * this.t;
        v = v > 1 ? 1 : v < -1 ? -1 : v;
        this.buf[this.n++] = v < 0 ? v * 0x8000 : v * 0x7fff;
        this.sumSq += v * v;
        if (this.n === this.frame) {
          const out = this.buf.buffer;
          this.port.postMessage({ pcm: out, rms: Math.sqrt(this.sumSq / this.frame) }, [out]);
          this.buf = new Int16Array(this.frame); this.n = 0; this.sumSq = 0;
        }
        this.t += this.ratio;
      }
      this.t -= 1;
      this.prev = cur;
    }
    return true;
  }
}
registerProcessor('pcm16k', Pcm16k);
`;

export interface MicEvents {
  /** 32 ms of 16 kHz mono Int16 PCM (the ArrayBuffer is the caller's to transfer) */
  frame: (pcm: ArrayBuffer) => void;
  /** input level 0..1 (about 30 per second), for the meter */
  level: (level: number) => void;
  /** the device went away (unplugged) */
  ended: () => void;
}

/** What VoiceChat needs from a microphone (the e2e build passes a fake). */
export interface MicLike {
  start(): Promise<void>;
  stop(): void;
  readonly active: boolean;
  on<K extends keyof MicEvents>(ev: K, fn: MicEvents[K]): () => void;
}

export class MicCapture extends Emitter<MicEvents> implements MicLike {
  private stream: MediaStream | null = null;
  private ctx: AudioContext | null = null;
  private nodes: AudioNode[] = [];
  private starting: Promise<void> | null = null;

  get active(): boolean { return this.stream !== null; }

  start(): Promise<void> {
    if (this.stream) return Promise.resolve();
    if (this.starting) return this.starting;
    this.starting = this.open().finally(() => { this.starting = null; });
    return this.starting;
  }

  private async open(): Promise<void> {
    if (!navigator.mediaDevices?.getUserMedia) throw new MicError('unavailable', 'No microphone is available.');
    let stream: MediaStream;
    try {
      stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ audio: { echoCancellation: true, noiseSuppression: true, autoGainControl: true, channelCount: 1 } });
    } catch (e) {
      const name = (e as Error).name;
      if (name === 'NotAllowedError' || name === 'SecurityError' || name === 'PermissionDeniedError') throw new MicError('denied', MIC_DENIED_MESSAGE);
      if (name === 'NotFoundError' || name === 'OverconstrainedError' || name === 'DevicesNotFoundError') throw new MicError('unavailable', 'No microphone was found. Plug one in, or type your question.');
      throw new MicError('other', `The microphone could not be opened (${(e as Error).message}).`);
    }
    // the device rate (44.1 / 48 kHz): forcing 16 kHz is unreliable on macOS; the worklet downsamples
    const ctx = new AudioContext();
    const src = ctx.createMediaStreamSource(stream);
    const onFrame = (pcm: ArrayBuffer, rms: number) => { this.emit('frame', pcm); this.emit('level', Math.min(1, rms * 4)); };
    let node: AudioNode;
    try {
      const url = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([WORKLET_SOURCE], { type: 'application/javascript' }));
      try { await ctx.audioWorklet.addModule(url); } finally { URL.revokeObjectURL(url); }
      const w = new AudioWorkletNode(ctx, 'pcm16k', { numberOfInputs: 1, numberOfOutputs: 1, channelCount: 1, channelCountMode: 'explicit', processorOptions: { frame: FRAME_SAMPLES } });
      w.port.onmessage = (e: MessageEvent<{ pcm: ArrayBuffer; rms: number }>) => onFrame(e.data.pcm, e.data.rms);
      node = w;
      // pulled through a silent gain so the graph keeps rendering it
      const mute = ctx.createGain(); mute.gain.value = 0;
      src.connect(w); w.connect(mute); mute.connect(ctx.destination);
      this.nodes.push(mute);
    } catch {
      // the worklet could not load: same resampler on the main thread
      const rs = new Pcm16kResampler(ctx.sampleRate, FRAME_SAMPLES, (pcm, rms) => onFrame(pcm.buffer as ArrayBuffer, rms));
      const sp = ctx.createScriptProcessor(1024, 1, 1);
      sp.onaudioprocess = (e) => rs.push(e.inputBuffer.getChannelData(0));
      const mute = ctx.createGain(); mute.gain.value = 0;
      src.connect(sp); sp.connect(mute); mute.connect(ctx.destination);
      node = sp; this.nodes.push(mute);
    }
    if (ctx.state === 'suspended') await ctx.resume().catch(() => undefined);
    for (const t of stream.getAudioTracks()) t.addEventListener('ended', () => { if (this.stream === stream) { this.stop(); this.emit('ended'); } });
    this.stream = stream; this.ctx = ctx; this.nodes.push(src, node);
  }

  stop(): void {
    for (const n of this.nodes) { try { n.disconnect(); } catch { /* already */ } }
    this.nodes = [];
    for (const t of this.stream?.getTracks() ?? []) t.stop();
    this.stream = null;
    void this.ctx?.close().catch(() => undefined);
    this.ctx = null;
  }
}

/** A microphone that never hears anything (e2e tests; the transcript events are injected instead). */
export class SilentMic extends Emitter<MicEvents> implements MicLike {
  private on_ = false;
  get active(): boolean { return this.on_; }
  async start(): Promise<void> { this.on_ = true; }
  stop(): void { this.on_ = false; }
}
```

### `src/web/ai.ts` (393 lines)

```ts
/**
 * AI explanations, key tests and usage for the web build: the semantics of src/main/ai.ts with the
 * provider SDKs replaced by fetch + a small server-sent-events reader, so nothing Node-only is bundled.
 * Requests go straight from the browser to the provider with the learner's own key (Anthropic requires
 * the `anthropic-dangerous-direct-browser-access` header for that; OpenAI allows CORS by default).
 */
import { SECRET_NAMES, SECRET_LABELS, type ExplainRequest, type AiEvent, type AiErrorCode, type SecretName, type ProviderTestResult } from '@shared/api';
import { buildPrompt, buildStyledPrompt, type PromptBundle } from '@core/ai/prompts';
import { resolveStyle, type StyleId } from '@shared/styles';
import type { AiProviderId } from '@shared/settings';
import { getSettings, addUsage, usdSpent } from './settings';
import { getSecret, hasSecret, formatWarning, getAzureCredentials } from './secrets';

/** Approximate list prices in USD per million tokens (input, output, cache read); copied from src/main/ai.ts. */
const PRICES: Record<string, [number, number, number]> = {
  'claude-haiku-5-5': [0.10, 0.50, 0.01],
  'claude-sonnet-5-5': [2, 10, 0.20],
  'claude-opus-5-5': [4, 20, 0.20],
  'claude-fable-5-1': [10, 50, 0.25],
  'claude-haiku-4-5': [1, 5, 0.10],
  'gpt-5.4-mini': [0.75, 4.50, 0.075],
  'gpt-5.6-luna': [0.20, 1.20, 0.02],
  'gpt-5.6-terra': [2, 12, 0.20],
  'gpt-5-mini': [0.25, 2, 0.025],
  'gpt-4o-mini': [0.15, 0.60, 0.075],
};

export function estimateUsd(model: string, inputTokens: number, outputTokens: number, cachedTokens: number): number {
  const p = PRICES[model] ?? Object.entries(PRICES).find(([k]) => model.startsWith(k))?.[1] ?? [2, 10, 0.2];
  return ((inputTokens - cachedTokens) * p[0] + outputTokens * p[1] + cachedTokens * p[2]) / 1_000_000;
}

export function periodStarts(now = new Date()): { day: string; month: string } {
  return { day: new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), now.getDate()).toISOString(), month: new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), 1).toISOString() };
}

export interface StreamResult { text: string; inputTokens: number; outputTokens: number; cachedTokens: number }

/** An HTTP failure from a provider, shaped like the SDK errors classifyError understands. */
export class HttpError extends Error {
  constructor(readonly status: number, message: string, readonly body = '') { super(message); this.name = 'HttpError'; }
}

const REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS = 60_000;

/** Aborts when the caller aborts or after `ms`; the reason tells a timeout apart from a cancel. */
function withTimeout(signal: AbortSignal | undefined, ms: number): { signal: AbortSignal; done: () => void } {
  const ctrl = new AbortController();
  const timer = setTimeout(() => ctrl.abort(Object.assign(new Error('The request timed out'), { name: 'TimeoutError' })), ms);
  const onAbort = () => ctrl.abort(Object.assign(new Error('aborted'), { name: 'AbortError' }));
  if (signal) { if (signal.aborted) onAbort(); else signal.addEventListener('abort', onAbort, { once: true }); }
  return { signal: ctrl.signal, done: () => { clearTimeout(timer); signal?.removeEventListener('abort', onAbort); } };
}

/** Rethrows fetch/read failures with the abort reason (fetch rejects with a generic AbortError otherwise). */
function rethrow(e: unknown, signal: AbortSignal): never {
  if (signal.aborted && signal.reason instanceof Error) throw signal.reason;
  throw e;
}

async function errorFromResponse(res: Response, label: string): Promise<HttpError> {
  let body = '';
  try { body = (await res.text()).slice(0, 2000); } catch { /* no body */ }
  let message = '';
  try {
    const j = JSON.parse(body) as { error?: { message?: string } | string; message?: string };
    message = typeof j.error === 'string' ? j.error : j.error?.message ?? j.message ?? '';
  } catch { message = body.slice(0, 300); }
  return new HttpError(res.status, `${res.status} ${message || `${label} HTTP error`}`, body);
}

/** Reads a text/event-stream body and calls onEvent(eventName, data) for every event. */
export async function readSse(body: ReadableStream<Uint8Array>, onEvent: (event: string, data: string) => void): Promise<void> {
  const reader = body.getReader();
  const decoder = new TextDecoder();
  let buf = '';
  let event = '';
  let data: string[] = [];
  const dispatch = () => {
    if (data.length) onEvent(event || 'message', data.join('\n'));
    event = ''; data = [];
  };
  const line = (l: string) => {
    if (l === '') { dispatch(); return; }
    if (l.startsWith(':')) return;
    const i = l.indexOf(':');
    const field = i < 0 ? l : l.slice(0, i);
    let value = i < 0 ? '' : l.slice(i + 1);
    if (value.startsWith(' ')) value = value.slice(1);
    if (field === 'event') event = value;
    else if (field === 'data') data.push(value);
  };
  for (;;) {
    const { value, done } = await reader.read();
    if (done) break;
    buf += decoder.decode(value, { stream: true });
    let nl: number;
    while ((nl = buf.search(/\r\n|\r|\n/)) >= 0) {
      const sep = buf[nl] === '\r' && buf[nl + 1] === '\n' ? 2 : 1;
      line(buf.slice(0, nl));
      buf = buf.slice(nl + sep);
    }
  }
  buf += decoder.decode();
  if (buf) line(buf);
  dispatch();
}

export async function streamAnthropic(apiKey: string, model: string, prompt: PromptBundle, signal: AbortSignal, onText: (t: string) => void): Promise<StreamResult> {
  // Opus 5.5 / Sonnet 5.5 / Fable: opt into server-side refusal fallbacks, as the Mac app does
  const wantsFallback = /^claude-(opus-5-5|sonnet-5-5|fable)/.test(model);
  const headers: Record<string, string> = {
    'content-type': 'application/json',
    'x-api-key': apiKey,
    'anthropic-version': '2023-06-01',
    'anthropic-dangerous-direct-browser-access': 'true',
  };
  if (wantsFallback) headers['anthropic-beta'] = 'server-side-fallback-2026-07-01';
  const body: Record<string, unknown> = {
    model,
    max_tokens: prompt.maxTokens,
    system: [{ type: 'text', text: prompt.system, cache_control: { type: 'ephemeral' } }],
    messages: [{ role: 'user', content: prompt.user }],
    output_config: { effort: 'low' },
    stream: true,
  };
  if (wantsFallback) body.fallbacks = 'default';
  const t = withTimeout(signal, REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS);
  try {
    const res = await fetch('https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages', { method: 'POST', headers, body: JSON.stringify(body), signal: t.signal }).catch((e) => rethrow(e, t.signal));
    if (!res.ok || !res.body) throw await errorFromResponse(res, 'Anthropic');
    let text = '';
    let stop: string | null = null;
    const u = { input: 0, cacheRead: 0, cacheWrite: 0, output: 0 };
    let streamError: HttpError | null = null;
    const takeUsage = (x: Record<string, number | undefined> | undefined) => {
      if (!x) return;
      if (typeof x.input_tokens === 'number') u.input = Math.max(u.input, x.input_tokens);
      if (typeof x.cache_read_input_tokens === 'number') u.cacheRead = Math.max(u.cacheRead, x.cache_read_input_tokens);
      if (typeof x.cache_creation_input_tokens === 'number') u.cacheWrite = Math.max(u.cacheWrite, x.cache_creation_input_tokens);
      if (typeof x.output_tokens === 'number') u.output = Math.max(u.output, x.output_tokens);
    };
    await readSse(res.body, (_event, data) => {
      let ev: { type?: string; message?: { usage?: Record<string, number> }; delta?: { type?: string; text?: string; stop_reason?: string }; usage?: Record<string, number>; error?: { type?: string; message?: string } };
      try { ev = JSON.parse(data); } catch { return; }
      if (ev.type === 'message_start') takeUsage(ev.message?.usage);
      else if (ev.type === 'content_block_delta' && ev.delta?.type === 'text_delta' && ev.delta.text) { text += ev.delta.text; onText(ev.delta.text); }
      else if (ev.type === 'message_delta') { if (ev.delta?.stop_reason) stop = ev.delta.stop_reason; takeUsage(ev.usage); }
      else if (ev.type === 'error') {
        const type = ev.error?.type ?? '';
        const status = type === 'overloaded_error' ? 529 : type === 'rate_limit_error' ? 429 : type === 'authentication_error' ? 401 : type === 'not_found_error' ? 404 : 500;
        streamError = new HttpError(status, ev.error?.message ?? type ?? 'stream error');
      }
    }).catch((e) => rethrow(e, t.signal));
    if (streamError) throw streamError;
    if (stop === 'refusal') throw Object.assign(new Error('The AI declined to answer this request.'), { code: 'other' });
    return { text, inputTokens: u.input + u.cacheRead + u.cacheWrite, outputTokens: u.output, cachedTokens: u.cacheRead };
  } finally { t.done(); }
}

export async function streamOpenAI(apiKey: string, model: string, prompt: PromptBundle, signal: AbortSignal, onText: (t: string) => void): Promise<StreamResult> {
  const body = {
    model,
    messages: [{ role: 'system', content: prompt.system }, { role: 'user', content: prompt.user }],
    stream: true,
    stream_options: { include_usage: true },
    max_completion_tokens: prompt.maxTokens + 800,
    ...(/^(gpt-5|o[1-9])/.test(model) ? { reasoning_effort: 'low' } : {}),
  };
  const t = withTimeout(signal, REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS);
  try {
    const res = await fetch('https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions', {
      method: 'POST', headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json', authorization: `Bearer ${apiKey}` }, body: JSON.stringify(body), signal: t.signal,
    }).catch((e) => rethrow(e, t.signal));
    if (!res.ok || !res.body) throw await errorFromResponse(res, 'OpenAI');
    let text = '';
    let usage = { prompt_tokens: 0, completion_tokens: 0, cached: 0 };
    let streamError: HttpError | null = null;
    await readSse(res.body, (_event, data) => {
      if (data === '[DONE]') return;
      let chunk: { choices?: { delta?: { content?: string } }[]; usage?: { prompt_tokens: number; completion_tokens: number; prompt_tokens_details?: { cached_tokens?: number } }; error?: { message?: string } };
      try { chunk = JSON.parse(data); } catch { return; }
      if (chunk.error) { streamError = new HttpError(500, chunk.error.message ?? 'stream error'); return; }
      const delta = chunk.choices?.[0]?.delta?.content;
      if (delta) { text += delta; onText(delta); }
      if (chunk.usage) usage = { prompt_tokens: chunk.usage.prompt_tokens, completion_tokens: chunk.usage.completion_tokens, cached: chunk.usage.prompt_tokens_details?.cached_tokens ?? 0 };
    }).catch((e) => rethrow(e, t.signal));
    if (streamError) throw streamError;
    return { text, inputTokens: usage.prompt_tokens, outputTokens: usage.completion_tokens, cachedTokens: usage.cached };
  } finally { t.done(); }
}

/** Same messages and codes as src/main/ai.ts classifyError, for fetch errors (Safari: "Load failed"). */
export function classifyError(e: unknown, ctx?: { model?: string }): { message: string; code: AiErrorCode } {
  const err = e as { name?: string; status?: number; message?: string; code?: string };
  const msg = err?.message ?? '';
  if (err?.name === 'TimeoutError' || /timed? ?out/i.test(msg)) return { message: 'The service did not answer in time. Check your internet connection and try again.', code: 'timeout' };
  if (err?.name === 'AbortError' || err?.code === 'cancelled' || /abort/i.test(msg)) return { message: 'Cancelled', code: 'cancelled' };
  if (err?.status === 401) return { message: 'The API key was rejected. Check it in Settings.', code: 'auth' };
  if (err?.status === 403) return { message: 'The API key is not allowed to use this service (permission denied). Check the key\'s permissions in your provider account.', code: 'auth' };
  if (err?.status === 429) {
    const spend = /spend|usage limit|billing|quota|insufficient|credit/i.test(msg);
    return { message: spend ? 'Your API account has no credit left or reached its spending limit.' : 'Too many requests right now; try again in a moment.', code: spend ? 'spend_limit' : 'rate_limit' };
  }
  if (err?.status === 400 && /usage limit|spend|credit balance|insufficient/i.test(msg)) return { message: 'Your API account has no credit left or reached its spending limit.', code: 'spend_limit' };
  if (err?.status === 404) {
    if (ctx?.model || /model/i.test(msg)) return { message: `Model ${ctx?.model ?? ''} is not available for your key; pick another model.`.replace('Model  is', 'The chosen model is'), code: 'model' };
    return { message: `The service reported "not found" (HTTP 404): ${msg || 'no details'}`, code: 'other' };
  }
  if (err?.status === 529 || err?.status === 503 || err?.status === 502 || /overloaded/i.test(msg)) return { message: 'The AI service is overloaded right now; try again in a moment.', code: 'rate_limit' };
  if ((e instanceof TypeError && !err?.status) || /load failed|failed to fetch|networkerror|network/i.test(msg)) return { message: 'No internet connection, or the AI service is unreachable.', code: 'network' };
  return { message: msg || 'Unknown AI error', code: 'other' };
}

function noKey(provider: AiProviderId): string { return provider === 'anthropic' ? 'Add your Anthropic API key in Settings.' : 'Add your OpenAI API key in Settings.'; }

/** One non-streamed completion (hints job): same request shape and usage accounting; the caller records usage. */
export async function runCompletion(provider: AiProviderId, model: string, prompt: PromptBundle, signal: AbortSignal = new AbortController().signal): Promise<StreamResult> {
  const key = await getSecret(provider);
  if (!key) throw Object.assign(new Error(noKey(provider)), { code: 'no_key' });
  const noop = (): void => { /* nothing is shown */ };
  return provider === 'anthropic' ? streamAnthropic(key, model, prompt, signal, noop) : streamOpenAI(key, model, prompt, signal, noop);
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * Explanations: aiExplain / aiCancel / onAiEvent
 * ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

const listeners = new Set<(ev: AiEvent) => void>();
const streams = new Map<string, AbortController>();
let counter = 0;

function send(ev: AiEvent): void {
  for (const cb of [...listeners]) { try { cb(ev); } catch (e) { console.error('[web] AI listener failed', e); } }
}

export function onAiEvent(cb: (ev: AiEvent) => void): () => void {
  listeners.add(cb);
  return () => { listeners.delete(cb); };
}

export async function aiExplain(req: ExplainRequest): Promise<{ streamId: string }> {
  const streamId = `s${++counter}`;
  const ctrl = new AbortController();
  streams.set(streamId, ctrl);
  // start after returning the id so the renderer can subscribe first
  setTimeout(() => { void runExplain(streamId, req, ctrl).finally(() => streams.delete(streamId)); }, 0);
  return { streamId };
}

export async function aiCancel(streamId: string): Promise<void> { streams.get(streamId)?.abort(); }

async function runExplain(streamId: string, req: ExplainRequest, ctrl: AbortController): Promise<void> {
  try {
    const s = await getSettings();
    const styled = req.kind === 'word' || req.kind === 'phrase' || req.kind === 'sentence';
    const style = styled ? resolveStyle((req.styleId as StyleId) ?? s.ai.activeStyle, s.ai.styles) : null;
    const provider = style?.provider ?? s.ai.provider;
    const model = style?.model ?? (provider === 'anthropic' ? s.ai.anthropicModel : s.ai.openaiModel);
    const key = await getSecret(provider);
    if (!key) { send({ type: 'error', streamId, message: noKey(provider), code: 'no_key' }); return; }
    const monthly = await usdSpent(periodStarts().month);
    if (s.ai.monthlyStopUsd > 0 && monthly >= s.ai.monthlyStopUsd) {
      send({ type: 'error', streamId, message: `Monthly AI budget of $${s.ai.monthlyStopUsd} reached. Raise it in Settings to continue.`, code: 'budget' });
      return;
    }
    const prompt = style
      ? buildStyledPrompt(req, { style, contextRules: s.ai.contextRules, level: s.learnerLevel, native: 'Chinese' })
      : buildPrompt(req, { level: s.learnerLevel, instructions: s.ai.instructions, length: s.ai.explanationLength });
    const onText = (t: string) => send({ type: 'delta', streamId, text: t });
    const result = provider === 'anthropic'
      ? await streamAnthropic(key, model, prompt, ctrl.signal, onText)
      : await streamOpenAI(key, model, prompt, ctrl.signal, onText);
    const usd = estimateUsd(model, result.inputTokens, result.outputTokens, result.cachedTokens);
    try { await addUsage({ date: new Date().toISOString(), provider, model, inputTokens: result.inputTokens, outputTokens: result.outputTokens, cachedTokens: result.cachedTokens, usd }); } catch (e) { console.error('usage not recorded', e); }
    const { day, month } = periodStarts();
    send({ type: 'done', streamId, text: result.text, usage: { inputTokens: result.inputTokens, outputTokens: result.outputTokens, cachedTokens: result.cachedTokens, usd, dailyUsd: await usdSpent(day), monthlyUsd: await usdSpent(month), model } });
  } catch (e) {
    send({ type: 'error', streamId, ...classifyError(e) });
  }
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * Key tests (the "Test" buttons)
 * ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

const TEST_TIMEOUT_MS = 15_000;
type TestOutcome = ProviderTestResult & { code?: AiErrorCode };

function noKeyMessage(name: SecretName): string { return `No ${SECRET_LABELS[name]} API key is saved yet. Paste it in Settings and click Save.`; }

export async function testProvider(provider: SecretName): Promise<ProviderTestResult> {
  if (!SECRET_NAMES.includes(provider)) return { ok: false, message: `Unknown provider "${provider}".` };
  const key = await getSecret(provider);
  if (!key) return { ok: false, message: (await hasSecret(provider)) ? `The ${SECRET_LABELS[provider]} key is saved but cannot be read; remove it and paste it again.` : noKeyMessage(provider) };
  const looksWrong = formatWarning(provider, key);
  const result = await runTest(provider, key);
  if (!result.ok && looksWrong && result.code === 'auth') {
    return { ok: false, message: `The key looks wrong: ${looksWrong.replace(/ It was saved anyway; use Test to check it\.$/, '')} Check that you pasted the whole key.`, detail: result.detail ?? result.message };
  }
  return { ok: result.ok, message: result.message, ...(result.detail ? { detail: result.detail } : {}) };
}

async function runTest(provider: SecretName, key: string): Promise<TestOutcome> {
  const s = await getSettings();
  try {
    if (provider === 'anthropic' || provider === 'openai') {
      const model = provider === 'anthropic' ? s.ai.anthropicModel : s.ai.openaiModel;
      const t = withTimeout(undefined, 30_000);
      try {
        const res = provider === 'anthropic'
          ? await fetch('https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages', {
            method: 'POST', signal: t.signal,
            headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json', 'x-api-key': key, 'anthropic-version': '2023-06-01', 'anthropic-dangerous-direct-browser-access': 'true' },
            body: JSON.stringify({ model, max_tokens: 20, messages: [{ role: 'user', content: 'Reply with the single word OK.' }] }),
          }).catch((e) => rethrow(e, t.signal))
          : await fetch('https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions', {
            method: 'POST', signal: t.signal,
            headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json', authorization: `Bearer ${key}` },
            body: JSON.stringify({ model, messages: [{ role: 'user', content: 'Reply with the single word OK.' }], max_completion_tokens: 20 }),
          }).catch((e) => rethrow(e, t.signal));
        if (!res.ok) throw await errorFromResponse(res, SECRET_LABELS[provider]);
        const j = await res.json() as { model?: string; content?: { type: string; text?: string }[]; choices?: { message?: { content?: string } }[] };
        const text = provider === 'anthropic' ? (j.content ?? []).filter((b) => b.type === 'text').map((b) => b.text ?? '').join('') : j.choices?.[0]?.message?.content ?? '';
        return { ok: true, message: `Connected. ${j.model ?? model} replied: ${text.trim().slice(0, 40)}` };
      } finally { t.done(); }
    }
    if (provider === 'elevenlabs') return await testElevenLabs(key);
    if (provider === 'azure') return await testAzure();
    return await testGoogle(key);
  } catch (e) {
    const model = provider === 'anthropic' ? s.ai.anthropicModel : provider === 'openai' ? s.ai.openaiModel : undefined;
    const c = classifyError(e, { model });
    const raw = (e as { message?: string })?.message;
    return { ok: false, message: c.code === 'other' ? `Unexpected error from ${SECRET_LABELS[provider]}: ${raw || 'no details'}` : c.message, code: c.code, ...(raw ? { detail: raw } : {}) };
  }
}

async function readBody(res: Response): Promise<string> { try { return (await res.text()).slice(0, 2000); } catch { return ''; } }

function httpFailure(label: string, status: number, body: string): TestOutcome {
  const detail = body ? `HTTP ${status}: ${body}` : `HTTP ${status}`;
  if (status === 401) return { ok: false, message: `${label} rejected the key (HTTP 401). Check it and paste it again.`, code: 'auth', detail };
  if (status === 403) return { ok: false, message: `${label} says this key is not allowed to use the service (HTTP 403). Check the key's permissions or quota in your ${label} account.`, code: 'auth', detail };
  if (status === 429) {
    const spend = /quota|credit|billing|limit|exhausted/i.test(body);
    return { ok: false, message: spend ? `Your ${label} account has no credit left or reached its usage limit.` : `${label} is receiving too many requests right now; try again in a moment.`, code: spend ? 'spend_limit' : 'rate_limit', detail };
  }
  if (status === 402) return { ok: false, message: `Your ${label} account has no credit left or reached its spending limit.`, code: 'spend_limit', detail };
  if (status === 404) return { ok: false, message: `${label} replied "not found" (HTTP 404); the service address may have changed. Update the app or try again later.`, code: 'other', detail };
  if (status === 502 || status === 503 || status === 529) return { ok: false, message: `${label} is overloaded or down for maintenance right now; try again in a moment.`, code: 'rate_limit', detail };
  if (status >= 500) return { ok: false, message: `${label} reported a server error (HTTP ${status}); try again in a moment.`, code: 'rate_limit', detail };
  return { ok: false, message: `Unexpected reply from ${label} (HTTP ${status}): ${body.slice(0, 200) || 'no details'}`, code: 'other', detail };
}

function timeoutSignal(ms: number): AbortSignal {
  const c = new AbortController();
  setTimeout(() => c.abort(Object.assign(new Error('The request timed out'), { name: 'TimeoutError' })), ms);
  return c.signal;
}

async function testElevenLabs(key: string): Promise<TestOutcome> {
  const res = await fetch('https://api.elevenlabs.io/v1/user', { headers: { 'xi-api-key': key }, signal: timeoutSignal(TEST_TIMEOUT_MS) });
  const body = await readBody(res);
  if (!res.ok) return httpFailure('ElevenLabs', res.status, body);
  let sub: { tier?: string; character_count?: number; character_limit?: number } = {};
  try { sub = (JSON.parse(body) as { subscription?: typeof sub }).subscription ?? {}; } catch { /* still connected */ }
  const used = sub.character_count ?? 0, limit = sub.character_limit ?? 0;
  if (limit > 0 && used >= limit) return { ok: false, message: `The ElevenLabs key works, but the monthly character allowance is used up (${used.toLocaleString()} of ${limit.toLocaleString()}). Voices will fail until it resets or you upgrade the plan.`, code: 'spend_limit' };
  const facts = [sub.tier ? `${sub.tier} plan` : '', limit > 0 ? `${used.toLocaleString()} of ${limit.toLocaleString()} characters used this month` : ''].filter(Boolean);
  return { ok: true, message: `Connected to ElevenLabs${facts.length ? ` (${facts.join(', ')})` : ''}.` };
}

async function testAzure(): Promise<TestOutcome> {
  const creds = await getAzureCredentials();
  if (!creds) return { ok: false, message: 'The Azure entry could not be read. Paste the key and region again.', code: 'auth' };
  const res = await fetch(`https://${creds.region}.api.cognitive.microsoft.com/sts/v1.0/issueToken`, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key': creds.key }, signal: timeoutSignal(TEST_TIMEOUT_MS) });
  const body = await readBody(res);
  if (res.ok) return { ok: true, message: `Connected to Azure Speech in region "${creds.region}".` };
  if (res.status === 401) return { ok: false, message: `Azure rejected the key (HTTP 401). Check the key, and that the region "${creds.region}" matches your Speech resource.`, code: 'auth', detail: `HTTP 401: ${body}` };
  return httpFailure('Azure Speech', res.status, body);
}

async function testGoogle(key: string): Promise<TestOutcome> {
  const res = await fetch(`https://texttospeech.googleapis.com/v1/voices?key=${encodeURIComponent(key)}&languageCode=en-GB`, { signal: timeoutSignal(TEST_TIMEOUT_MS) });
  const body = await readBody(res);
  if (res.ok) {
    let n = 0;
    try { n = ((JSON.parse(body) as { voices?: unknown[] }).voices ?? []).length; } catch { /* still connected */ }
    return { ok: true, message: `Connected to Google Cloud Text-to-Speech (${n} British English voices available).` };
  }
  return httpFailure('Google Cloud', res.status, body);
}
```

```ts
/**
 * The browser implementation of window.readalong (ReadAlongApi, src/shared/api.ts) used by the iPad / web
 * build. Everything the Electron main process does over IPC happens here, in the page: IndexedDB storage,
 * book import, the dictionary, AI calls, cloud voices and the hints job.
 *
 * Forward compatibility: the object is wrapped in a Proxy. A method the renderer calls that this file does
 * not implement yet (added to ReadAlongApi later) resolves harmlessly (undefined; `on*` subscriptions return
 * an unsubscribe function) and logs one warning per method name. The optional local speech-recognition
 * methods (stt*) are deliberately left undefined, because the renderer feature-detects them.
 */
import type { ReadAlongApi, KokoroStatus, Diagnostics } from '@shared/api';

import * as settings from './settings';
import * as secrets from './secrets';
import * as library from './library';
import * as vocabulary from './vocabulary';
import * as ai from './ai';
import * as tts from './tts';
import { hintsJob, onHintsProgress } from './hints';
import { tokenForFile, takeFile, pickFile, saveTextFile, FILE_TOKEN_PREFIX } from './files';

export const WEB_VERSION = '0.1.0-web';

const KOKORO_UNAVAILABLE: KokoroStatus = {
  state: 'error', variant: 'none', modelDir: '', downloadBytes: 0, progress: null,
  error: 'The Dream voice runs only in the Mac app; on iPad the built-in voices are used', queued: 0, version: '',
};

const noopUnsubscribe = (): (() => void) => () => undefined;

async function importPickedFile(file: File): Promise<import('@core/model').Book> {
  return library.importBytes(file.name, new Uint8Array(await file.arrayBuffer()));
}

/** Every method of ReadAlongApi known when this file was written. */
export const webApiImpl = {
  // library
  importBookDialog: async () => {
    const file = await pickFile();
    return file ? importPickedFile(file) : null;
  },
  importFile: async (p: string) => {
    if (!p.startsWith(FILE_TOKEN_PREFIX)) throw new Error('Files can only be opened with the Open button or by dropping them here.');
    const file = takeFile(p);
    if (!file) throw new Error('The file is no longer available; open it again.');
    return importPickedFile(file);
  },
  pathForFile: (file: File) => tokenForFile(file),
  importText: (title: string, text: string) => library.importText(title, text),
  listLibrary: () => library.listLibrary(),
  loadBook: (id: string) => library.loadBook(id),
  removeBook: async (id: string) => { await library.removeBook(id); await hintsJob.clear(id); },
  saveProgress: (id, position, percent) => library.saveProgress(id, position, percent),
  // dictionary
  loadDictionary: () => library.getDictData(),
  // vocabulary
  getVocab: () => settings.getVocab(),
  setWordStatus: (lemma, status) => settings.setWordStatus(lemma, status),
  setMarkedRanges: (bookId, ranges) => settings.setMarkedRanges(bookId, ranges),
  vocabEntries: () => vocabulary.listEntries(),
  vocabUpsertEntry: (entry) => vocabulary.upsertEntry(entry),
  vocabSetEntryStatus: (lemma, status) => vocabulary.setEntryStatus(lemma, status),
  vocabDeleteEntry: (lemma) => vocabulary.deleteEntry(lemma),
  vocabExportCsv: async () => saveTextFile(vocabulary.CSV_FILE_NAME, vocabulary.toCsv(await vocabulary.listEntries()), 'text/csv'),
  vocabCsvPath: async () => `${vocabulary.CSV_FILE_NAME} (saved with Export)`,
  vocabProgress: () => vocabulary.getProgress(),
  vocabUnknownAtLevel: (level) => vocabulary.getUnknownAtLevel(level),
  // settings & secrets
  getSettings: () => settings.getSettings(),
  setSettings: (patch) => settings.setSettings(patch),
  setSecret: (name, value) => secrets.setSecret(name, value),
  hasSecret: (name) => secrets.hasSecret(name),
  secretStatus: () => secrets.secretStatus(),
  dismissLostKeys: async () => undefined,
  // AI
  aiExplain: (req) => ai.aiExplain(req),
  aiCancel: (id) => ai.aiCancel(id),
  aiTest: (provider) => ai.testProvider(provider),
  onAiEvent: (cb) => ai.onAiEvent(cb),
  getUsage: () => settings.getUsage(),
  // chapter hints
  hintsGet: (bookId, chapter) => hintsJob.get(String(bookId), Number(chapter)),
  // the web hints job (./hints) does not find phrases yet: the reader falls back to dictionary phrases
  hintsPhrases: async () => null,
  hintsRequest: (bookId, chapter) => hintsJob.request(String(bookId), Number(chapter)),
  hintsClear: (bookId) => hintsJob.clear(String(bookId)),
  onHintsProgress: (cb) => onHintsProgress(cb),
  // cloud TTS
  ttsListVoices: (engine) => tts.listVoices(engine),
  ttsSynthesize: (engine, text, voiceId, rate) => tts.synthesize(engine, text, voiceId, rate),
  // Kokoro: desktop only
  kokoroStatus: async () => ({ ...KOKORO_UNAVAILABLE }),
  kokoroDownload: async () => ({ ...KOKORO_UNAVAILABLE }),
  kokoroCancelDownload: async () => undefined,
  kokoroPrepare: async () => undefined,
  onKokoroProgress: () => noopUnsubscribe(),
  // misc
  getDiagnostics: async (): Promise<Diagnostics> => {
    let dictWords = 0;
    try { dictWords = Object.keys((await library.getDictData()).w).length; } catch { /* dictionary missing */ }
    let storage = '';
    try { const est = await navigator.storage?.estimate?.(); if (est?.usage != null) storage = ` (${Math.round(est.usage / 1_048_576)} MB used)`; } catch { /* unknown */ }
    return {
      platform: `web: ${navigator.userAgent}`, arch: (navigator as Navigator & { platform?: string }).platform ?? '', electron: 'none (web)', chrome: '',
      node: 'none (web)', appVersion: WEB_VERSION, userData: `IndexedDB "dream-read" on ${location.origin}${storage}`,
      secretsFile: 'IndexedDB "dream-read" / kv / secrets (stored unencrypted in this browser)', dictWords, secrets: await secrets.secretStatus(),
    };
  },
  openExternal: async (url: string) => { if (/^https?:\/\//.test(url)) window.open(url, '_blank', 'noopener'); },
  exportText: (fileName, contents) => saveTextFile(fileName, contents, /\.csv$/i.test(fileName) ? 'text/csv' : 'text/plain'),
  onMenu: () => noopUnsubscribe(),
} satisfies Partial<ReadAlongApi>;

const warned = new Set<string>();

/**
 * Optional methods the renderer feature-detects (`typeof api.sttStatus === 'function'`) and that cannot work in
 * a browser: they must stay absent so the renderer takes its own fallback (local speech recognition: "Talking by
 * voice needs the Mac app. You can type your question."). Any later stt* / onStt* method is treated the same.
 */
const ABSENT_OPTIONAL = /^(stt|onStt)[A-Z]/;

/** Wraps an implementation so methods it lacks resolve harmlessly (see the file comment). */
export function withFallback<T extends object>(impl: T): ReadAlongApi {
  return new Proxy(impl, {
    get(target, prop, receiver) {
      if (typeof prop === 'symbol' || prop in target) return Reflect.get(target, prop, receiver);
      // never look like a promise, and leave React/devtools probes alone
      if (prop === 'then' || prop === 'toJSON' || prop.startsWith('$$') || prop.startsWith('@@')) return undefined;
      if (ABSENT_OPTIONAL.test(prop)) return undefined;
      return (..._args: unknown[]) => {
        if (!warned.has(prop)) { warned.add(prop); console.warn(`[web] window.readalong.${prop}() is not available in the web version; ignored.`); }
        return prop.startsWith('on') ? () => undefined : Promise.resolve(undefined);
      };
    },
  }) as unknown as ReadAlongApi;
}

export function createWebApi(): ReadAlongApi { return withFallback(webApiImpl); }
```

```ts
/**
 * Files in the browser. The renderer's contract is path based (pathForFile -> importFile(path)); a web page
 * has no paths, so pathForFile hands out a token ("web-file:<n>/<name>") that importFile resolves back to
 * the File object it stands for. The "Open a book" picker is a hidden <input type="file">: on iPad it
 * offers the Files app, iCloud Drive and other providers.
 */
const files = new Map<string, File>();
let counter = 0;
export const FILE_TOKEN_PREFIX = 'web-file:';

export function tokenForFile(file: File): string {
  const token = `${FILE_TOKEN_PREFIX}${++counter}/${file.name}`;
  files.set(token, file);
  return token;
}

export function takeFile(token: string): File | null {
  const f = files.get(token) ?? null;
  files.delete(token);
  return f;
}

/**
 * Opens the system file picker and resolves with the chosen file, or null when the learner cancels.
 * Must be called synchronously from a tap (Safari blocks pickers opened later).
 */
export function pickFile(accept = '.epub,.pdf,.txt,.md,application/epub+zip,application/pdf,text/plain,text/markdown'): Promise<File | null> {
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    const input = document.createElement('input');
    input.type = 'file';
    input.accept = accept;
    input.style.position = 'fixed';
    input.style.left = '-1000px';
    let settled = false;
    const finish = (f: File | null) => {
      if (settled) return;
      settled = true;
      input.remove();
      resolve(f);
    };
    // 'cancel' fires when the picker is dismissed in recent Safari and Chrome. Without it the promise simply
    // stays pending, which is harmless; a focus-based guess would misfire on slow iCloud downloads.
    input.addEventListener('change', () => finish(input.files?.[0] ?? null));
    input.addEventListener('cancel', () => finish(null));
    document.body.appendChild(input);
    input.click();
  });
}

/**
 * Hands a text file to the learner: the share sheet when the browser can share files (iPad: Save to Files,
 * AirDrop, Mail), else a download. Resolves with a short description of where it went.
 */
export async function saveTextFile(fileName: string, contents: string, mime = 'text/plain'): Promise<string> {
  const safe = String(fileName).replace(/[\\/:*?"<>|]+/g, '-').trim() || 'export.txt';
  const blob = new Blob([contents], { type: `${mime};charset=utf-8` });
  const file = new File([blob], safe, { type: blob.type });
  const nav = navigator as Navigator & { canShare?: (d: { files: File[] }) => boolean };
  if (nav.canShare?.({ files: [file] }) && typeof nav.share === 'function') {
    try {
      await nav.share({ files: [file], title: safe });
      return `${safe} (shared)`;
    } catch (e) {
      if ((e as Error).name === 'AbortError') return `${safe} (not saved)`;
      // NotAllowedError (no user gesture left after an await): fall back to a download
    }
  }
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const a = document.createElement('a');
  a.href = url;
  a.download = safe;
  a.rel = 'noopener';
  document.body.appendChild(a);
  a.click();
  a.remove();
  setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 30_000);
  return `Downloads/${safe}`;
}
```
