```ts
/**
 * SHA-256 hex digest, the id scheme of the Mac app (first 24 hex chars of sha256 of the file bytes or text),
 * so a book imported on the iPad gets the same id as on the Mac. crypto.subtle exists only in secure
 * contexts (HTTPS or localhost); served over plain http from a Mac on the Wi-Fi it is missing, so a small
 * pure-JS SHA-256 is used instead.
 */
const K = new Uint32Array([
  0x428a2f98, 0x71374491, 0xb5c0fbcf, 0xe9b5dba5, 0x3956c25b, 0x59f111f1, 0x923f82a4, 0xab1c5ed5, 0xd807aa98, 0x12835b01, 0x243185be, 0x550c7dc3,
  0x72be5d74, 0x80deb1fe, 0x9bdc06a7, 0xc19bf174, 0xe49b69c1, 0xefbe4786, 0x0fc19dc6, 0x240ca1cc, 0x2de92c6f, 0x4a7484aa, 0x5cb0a9dc, 0x76f988da,
  0x983e5152, 0xa831c66d, 0xb00327c8, 0xbf597fc7, 0xc6e00bf3, 0xd5a79147, 0x06ca6351, 0x14292967, 0x27b70a85, 0x2e1b2138, 0x4d2c6dfc, 0x53380d13,
  0x650a7354, 0x766a0abb, 0x81c2c92e, 0x92722c85, 0xa2bfe8a1, 0xa81a664b, 0xc24b8b70, 0xc76c51a3, 0xd192e819, 0xd6990624, 0xf40e3585, 0x106aa070,
  0x19a4c116, 0x1e376c08, 0x2748774c, 0x34b0bcb5, 0x391c0cb3, 0x4ed8aa4a, 0x5b9cca4f, 0x682e6ff3, 0x748f82ee, 0x78a5636f, 0x84c87814, 0x8cc70208,
  0x90befffa, 0xa4506ceb, 0xbef9a3f7, 0xc67178f2,
]);

export function sha256Js(data: Uint8Array): string {
  const h = new Uint32Array([0x6a09e667, 0xbb67ae85, 0x3c6ef372, 0xa54ff53a, 0x510e527f, 0x9b05688c, 0x1f83d9ab, 0x5be0cd19]);
  const bitLen = data.length * 8;
  const padded = new Uint8Array(((data.length + 9 + 63) >> 6) << 6);
  padded.set(data);
  padded[data.length] = 0x80;
  const view = new DataView(padded.buffer);
  view.setUint32(padded.length - 8, Math.floor(bitLen / 0x100000000));
  view.setUint32(padded.length - 4, bitLen >>> 0);
  const w = new Uint32Array(64);
  for (let off = 0; off < padded.length; off += 64) {
    for (let i = 0; i < 16; i++) w[i] = view.getUint32(off + i * 4);
    for (let i = 16; i < 64; i++) {
      const a = w[i - 15], b = w[i - 2];
      const s0 = ((a >>> 7) | (a << 25)) ^ ((a >>> 18) | (a << 14)) ^ (a >>> 3);
      const s1 = ((b >>> 17) | (b << 15)) ^ ((b >>> 19) | (b << 13)) ^ (b >>> 10);
      w[i] = (w[i - 16] + s0 + w[i - 7] + s1) >>> 0;
    }
    let [a, b, c, d, e, f, g, hh] = h;
    for (let i = 0; i < 64; i++) {
      const S1 = ((e >>> 6) | (e << 26)) ^ ((e >>> 11) | (e << 21)) ^ ((e >>> 25) | (e << 7));
      const t1 = (hh + S1 + ((e & f) ^ (~e & g)) + K[i] + w[i]) >>> 0;
      const S0 = ((a >>> 2) | (a << 30)) ^ ((a >>> 13) | (a << 19)) ^ ((a >>> 22) | (a << 10));
      const t2 = (S0 + ((a & b) ^ (a & c) ^ (b & c))) >>> 0;
      hh = g; g = f; f = e; e = (d + t1) >>> 0; d = c; c = b; b = a; a = (t1 + t2) >>> 0;
    }
    h[0] += a; h[1] += b; h[2] += c; h[3] += d; h[4] += e; h[5] += f; h[6] += g; h[7] += hh;
  }
  return Array.from(h, (x) => x.toString(16).padStart(8, '0')).join('');
}

export async function sha256Hex(data: Uint8Array | string): Promise<string> {
  const bytes = typeof data === 'string' ? new TextEncoder().encode(data) : data;
  const subtle = typeof crypto !== 'undefined' ? crypto.subtle : undefined;
  if (subtle) {
    try {
      const buf = await subtle.digest('SHA-256', bytes as BufferSource);
      return Array.from(new Uint8Array(buf), (b) => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
    } catch { /* fall through */ }
  }
  return sha256Js(bytes);
}
```

### `src/web/hints.ts` (156 lines)

```ts
/**
 * The chapter-hints job ("Word Wise in Chinese") in the browser: the same queue, ordering, retry and
 * caching semantics as src/main/hints.ts (HintsJob), with the per-book cache kept in the IndexedDB
 * "hints" store as { version, chapters: { [index]: HintMap } } and progress delivered to onHintsProgress.
 */
import type { Book } from '@core/model';
import type { HintMap, HintsProgress } from '@shared/api';
import type { Settings, AiProviderId } from '@shared/settings';
import { collectHardWords, batchHardWords, buildHintsPrompt, parseHints } from '@core/ai/hints';
import { runCompletion, estimateUsd, periodStarts, classifyError } from './ai';
import { getSettings, getVocab, addUsage, usdSpent } from './settings';
import { readBook, getDictionary } from './library';
import { idbGet, idbSet, idbDelete } from './idb';

export const HINTS_CACHE_VERSION = 1;
export const DEFAULT_ANTHROPIC_HINTS_MODEL = 'claude-haiku-5-5';
const RETRY_AFTER_MS = 2 * 60_000;

export interface HintsCache { version: number; chapters: Record<string, HintMap> }

export function hintsModelFor(s: Settings): { provider: AiProviderId; model: string } {
  const provider = s.ai.provider;
  const model = s.ai.hintsModel?.trim() || (provider === 'anthropic' ? DEFAULT_ANTHROPIC_HINTS_MODEL : s.ai.openaiModel);
  return { provider, model };
}

interface Pending { bookId: string; chapter: number }
const key = (bookId: string, chapter: number) => `${bookId}:${chapter}`;
const same = (a: Pending, b: Pending) => a.bookId === b.bookId && a.chapter === b.chapter;

const listeners = new Set<(ev: HintsProgress) => void>();
function send(ev: HintsProgress): void { for (const cb of [...listeners]) { try { cb(ev); } catch (e) { console.error(e); } } }
export function onHintsProgress(cb: (ev: HintsProgress) => void): () => void { listeners.add(cb); return () => { listeners.delete(cb); }; }

class WebHintsJob {
  private caches = new Map<string, Promise<HintsCache>>();
  private queue: Pending[] = [];
  private running: Pending | null = null;
  private focus: Pending | null = null;
  private failed = new Map<string, number>();
  private books = new Map<string, Book>();

  async get(bookId: string, chapter: number): Promise<HintMap | null> {
    return (await this.cache(bookId)).chapters[String(chapter)] ?? null;
  }

  async request(bookId: string, chapter: number): Promise<void> {
    if (!bookId || !Number.isInteger(chapter) || chapter < 0) return;
    const p = { bookId, chapter };
    this.focus = p;
    if (await this.get(bookId, chapter)) return;
    if (this.queue.some((q) => same(q, p)) || (this.running && same(this.running, p))) return;
    const failedAt = this.failed.get(key(bookId, chapter));
    if (failedAt !== undefined && Date.now() - failedAt < RETRY_AFTER_MS) return;
    this.queue.push(p);
    send({ bookId, chapter, state: 'queued' });
    void this.pump();
  }

  async clear(bookId: string): Promise<void> {
    this.caches.delete(bookId);
    this.books.delete(bookId);
    this.queue = this.queue.filter((p) => p.bookId !== bookId);
    for (const k of [...this.failed.keys()]) if (k.startsWith(`${bookId}:`)) this.failed.delete(k);
    try { await idbDelete('hints', bookId); } catch { /* nothing cached */ }
  }

  private cache(bookId: string): Promise<HintsCache> {
    let c = this.caches.get(bookId);
    if (!c) {
      c = idbGet<HintsCache>('hints', bookId).catch(() => undefined).then((stored) =>
        stored && stored.version === HINTS_CACHE_VERSION && stored.chapters && typeof stored.chapters === 'object' ? stored : { version: HINTS_CACHE_VERSION, chapters: {} });
      this.caches.set(bookId, c);
    }
    return c;
  }

  private async store(bookId: string, chapter: number, hints: HintMap): Promise<void> {
    const c = await this.cache(bookId);
    c.chapters[String(chapter)] = hints;
    await idbSet('hints', bookId, c);
  }

  private next(): Pending | undefined {
    if (this.queue.length === 0) return undefined;
    const f = this.focus;
    const rank = (p: Pending): number => {
      if (!f || p.bookId !== f.bookId) return 1_000_000;
      return p.chapter >= f.chapter ? p.chapter - f.chapter : 100_000 + (f.chapter - p.chapter);
    };
    let best = 0;
    for (let i = 1; i < this.queue.length; i++) if (rank(this.queue[i]) < rank(this.queue[best])) best = i;
    return this.queue.splice(best, 1)[0];
  }

  private async pump(): Promise<void> {
    if (this.running) return;
    for (let p = this.next(); p; p = this.next()) {
      this.running = p;
      try { await this.run(p); } finally { this.running = null; }
    }
  }

  private async book(id: string): Promise<Book | null> {
    const cached = this.books.get(id);
    if (cached) return cached;
    const b = await readBook(id);
    if (b) { this.books.clear(); this.books.set(id, b); }
    return b;
  }

  private async run(p: Pending): Promise<void> {
    const { bookId, chapter } = p;
    const progress = (ev: Omit<HintsProgress, 'bookId' | 'chapter'>) => send({ bookId, chapter, ...ev });
    progress({ state: 'running' });
    try {
      const s = await getSettings();
      const { provider, model } = hintsModelFor(s);
      const book = await this.book(bookId);
      if (!book) throw Object.assign(new Error('The book is no longer in the library.'), { code: 'other' });
      if (!book.chapters[chapter]) throw Object.assign(new Error(`Chapter ${chapter + 1} does not exist.`), { code: 'other' });
      const dict = await getDictionary();
      const known = new Set(Object.keys((await getVocab()).words));
      const words = collectHardWords(book, chapter, dict, s.learnerLevel, new Set(book.names), known);
      const hints: HintMap = {};
      const title = book.chapters[chapter].title;
      for (const batch of batchHardWords(words)) {
        const monthly = await usdSpent(periodStarts().month);
        if (s.ai.monthlyStopUsd > 0 && monthly >= s.ai.monthlyStopUsd) {
          throw Object.assign(new Error(`Monthly AI budget of $${s.ai.monthlyStopUsd} reached. Raise it in Settings to continue.`), { code: 'budget' });
        }
        const prompt = buildHintsPrompt(batch, { title: book.title, chapter: title, level: s.learnerLevel });
        const result = await runCompletion(provider, model, prompt);
        const usd = estimateUsd(model, result.inputTokens, result.outputTokens, result.cachedTokens);
        try { await addUsage({ date: new Date().toISOString(), provider, model, inputTokens: result.inputTokens, outputTokens: result.outputTokens, cachedTokens: result.cachedTokens, usd }); } catch (e) { console.error('hints usage not recorded', e); }
        const parsed = parseHints(result.text);
        for (const w of batch) {
          const pair = parsed[w.lemma] ?? parsed[w.lemma.toLowerCase()];
          if (pair) hints[w.lemma] = pair;
        }
      }
      await this.store(bookId, chapter, hints);
      this.failed.delete(key(bookId, chapter));
      progress({ state: 'done' });
    } catch (e) {
      this.failed.set(key(bookId, chapter), Date.now());
      const err = e as { code?: string; message?: string };
      const c = err?.code === 'no_key' || err?.code === 'budget' || err?.code === 'other'
        ? { message: err.message ?? 'Unknown AI error', code: err.code }
        : classifyError(e, { model: hintsModelFor(await getSettings()).model });
      progress({ state: 'error', error: c.message, code: c.code as HintsProgress['code'] });
    }
  }
}

export const hintsJob = new WebHintsJob();
```

### `src/web/idb.ts` (126 lines)

```ts
/**
 * A tiny promise wrapper over IndexedDB: one database ("dream-read"), a few object stores keyed by
 * out-of-line string keys. Values are stored with the structured-clone algorithm (plain objects, arrays,
 * ArrayBuffers), so a Book is stored as it is, without JSON round trips.
 *
 * When IndexedDB is unavailable (some private-browsing modes) the stores fall back to memory, so the app
 * still runs for the session; nothing is kept after reload then.
 */
export const DB_NAME = 'dream-read';
export const DB_VERSION = 1;
export const STORES = ['kv', 'books', 'hints'] as const;
export type StoreName = (typeof STORES)[number];

let dbPromise: Promise<IDBDatabase | null> | null = null;
const memory = new Map<StoreName, Map<string, unknown>>(STORES.map((s) => [s, new Map()]));

function open(): Promise<IDBDatabase | null> {
  if (dbPromise) return dbPromise;
  dbPromise = new Promise<IDBDatabase | null>((resolve) => {
    let req: IDBOpenDBRequest;
    try {
      if (typeof indexedDB === 'undefined') { resolve(null); return; }
      req = indexedDB.open(DB_NAME, DB_VERSION);
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('[web] IndexedDB unavailable; data is kept in memory only', e);
      resolve(null);
      return;
    }
    req.onupgradeneeded = () => {
      const db = req.result;
      for (const s of STORES) if (!db.objectStoreNames.contains(s)) db.createObjectStore(s);
    };
    req.onsuccess = () => {
      const db = req.result;
      // another tab upgraded the schema: let it proceed, reopen lazily next time
      db.onversionchange = () => { db.close(); dbPromise = null; };
      resolve(db);
    };
    req.onerror = () => { console.warn('[web] IndexedDB open failed; data is kept in memory only', req.error); resolve(null); };
    req.onblocked = () => console.warn('[web] IndexedDB upgrade blocked by another tab');
  });
  return dbPromise;
}

function wrap<T>(req: IDBRequest<T>): Promise<T> {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    req.onsuccess = () => resolve(req.result);
    req.onerror = () => reject(req.error ?? new Error('IndexedDB request failed'));
  });
}

async function tx<T>(store: StoreName, mode: IDBTransactionMode, fn: (s: IDBObjectStore) => IDBRequest<T>): Promise<T> {
  const db = await open();
  if (!db) throw new Error('no-idb');
  const t = db.transaction(store, mode);
  const result = wrap(fn(t.objectStore(store)));
  if (mode === 'readwrite') {
    await new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
      t.oncomplete = () => resolve();
      t.onerror = () => reject(t.error ?? new Error('IndexedDB transaction failed'));
      t.onabort = () => reject(t.error ?? new Error('IndexedDB transaction aborted (storage full?)'));
    });
  }
  return result;
}

export async function idbGet<T>(store: StoreName, key: string): Promise<T | undefined> {
  try { return (await tx(store, 'readonly', (s) => s.get(key))) as T | undefined; }
  catch (e) { if ((e as Error).message === 'no-idb') return memory.get(store)!.get(key) as T | undefined; throw e; }
}

export async function idbSet(store: StoreName, key: string, value: unknown): Promise<void> {
  try { await tx(store, 'readwrite', (s) => s.put(value, key)); }
  catch (e) { if ((e as Error).message === 'no-idb') { memory.get(store)!.set(key, value); return; } throw e; }
}

export async function idbDelete(store: StoreName, key: string): Promise<void> {
  try { await tx(store, 'readwrite', (s) => s.delete(key)); }
  catch (e) { if ((e as Error).message === 'no-idb') { memory.get(store)!.delete(key); return; } throw e; }
}

export async function idbKeys(store: StoreName): Promise<string[]> {
  try { return ((await tx(store, 'readonly', (s) => s.getAllKeys())) as IDBValidKey[]).map(String); }
  catch (e) { if ((e as Error).message === 'no-idb') return [...memory.get(store)!.keys()]; throw e; }
}

/**
 * A JSON-like document kept in the "kv" store with an in-memory cache, the browser counterpart of
 * src/main/storage.ts JsonStore. load() must be awaited once before get(); writes are serialised.
 */
export class KvDoc<T> {
  private cache: T | null = null;
  private loading: Promise<T> | null = null;
  private writing: Promise<void> = Promise.resolve();
  constructor(private key: string, private defaults: () => T) {}

  load(): Promise<T> {
    if (this.cache) return Promise.resolve(this.cache);
    this.loading ??= idbGet<T>('kv', this.key)
      .catch((e) => { console.warn(`[web] could not read ${this.key}`, e); return undefined; })
      .then((stored) => {
        this.cache = stored && typeof stored === 'object' ? ({ ...this.defaults(), ...stored } as T) : this.defaults();
        return this.cache;
      });
    return this.loading;
  }

  async set(value: T): Promise<void> {
    this.cache = value;
    // structuredClone so later in-place edits of the cached object cannot race the write
    const snapshot = structuredClone(value);
    this.writing = this.writing.catch(() => undefined).then(() => idbSet('kv', this.key, snapshot));
    return this.writing;
  }

  async update(fn: (current: T) => T): Promise<T> {
    const next = fn(await this.load());
    await this.set(next);
    return next;
  }
}

/** Asks the browser not to evict our data (Safari honours it for home-screen apps). Best effort. */
export async function requestPersistence(): Promise<boolean> {
  try { return (await navigator.storage?.persist?.()) ?? false; } catch { return false; }
}
```

### `src/web/install.ts` (45 lines)

```ts
/**
 * Runs before the renderer: installs the browser implementation of window.readalong, registers the service
 * worker (offline app shell + dictionary), asks for persistent storage and, in iPad Safari (not yet on the
 * home screen), shows a one-time hint on how to add the app to the home screen.
 */
import { createWebApi } from './api';
import { requestPersistence } from './idb';

window.readalong = createWebApi();
document.documentElement.dataset.web = '1';

const standalone = (): boolean =>
  window.matchMedia?.('(display-mode: standalone)').matches || (navigator as Navigator & { standalone?: boolean }).standalone === true;
if (standalone()) document.documentElement.dataset.standalone = '1';

/** iPadOS reports itself as a Mac; touch points tell them apart. */
export function isIpad(): boolean {
  return /iPad/.test(navigator.userAgent) || (/Macintosh/.test(navigator.userAgent) && navigator.maxTouchPoints > 1);
}

const E2E = new URLSearchParams(location.search).has('e2e');

if ('serviceWorker' in navigator && window.isSecureContext && !E2E) {
  window.addEventListener('load', () => {
    navigator.serviceWorker.register('sw.js').catch((e) => console.warn('[web] service worker not registered', e));
  });
}

void requestPersistence();

const HINT_KEY = 'dream-read:install-hint-dismissed';
function showInstallHint(): void {
  try { if (localStorage.getItem(HINT_KEY)) return; } catch { return; }
  const box = document.createElement('div');
  box.className = 'web-install-hint';
  box.setAttribute('role', 'note');
  const text = document.createElement('span');
  text.textContent = 'To use Dream Read like an app (full screen, works offline), tap the Share button, then "Add to Home Screen".';
  const ok = document.createElement('button');
  ok.textContent = 'OK';
  ok.addEventListener('click', () => { try { localStorage.setItem(HINT_KEY, '1'); } catch { /* private mode */ } box.remove(); });
  box.append(text, ok);
  document.body.appendChild(box);
}
if (isIpad() && !standalone() && !E2E) window.addEventListener('load', () => setTimeout(showInstallHint, 1500));
```

### `src/web/library.ts` (117 lines)

```ts
/**
 * Library, books and dictionary for the web build: the pipeline of src/main/library.ts + text-modules.ts
 * (importer -> Book with segmentation -> detectNames) with books kept in IndexedDB ("books" store) and the
 * library list in the "kv" store. Ids are the first 24 hex chars of sha256, as on the Mac.
 */
import type { Book, Position } from '@core/model';
import type { LibraryItem } from '@shared/settings';
import type { DictData } from '@shared/api';
import type { Dictionary } from '@core/dict/types';
import type { Importer } from '@core/import/types';
import { createSegmenter } from '@core/segment';
import { textImporter, textToBook } from '@core/import/text';
import { createDictionary } from '@core/dict/dictionary';
import { detectNames } from '@core/dict/names';
import { KvDoc, idbGet, idbSet, idbDelete } from './idb';
import { sha256Hex } from './hash';

const libraryDoc = new KvDoc<{ items: LibraryItem[] }>('library', () => ({ items: [] }));

/** URL of the gzipped dictionary next to index.html (copied by scripts/build-web.mjs). */
export const DICT_URL = 'dict.json.gz';

let dictData: Promise<DictData> | null = null;
let dictionary: Promise<Dictionary> | null = null;

/** Inflates a gzip body with DecompressionStream; a body that is already JSON (server-side decoding) is read as is. */
async function readMaybeGzip(res: Response): Promise<string> {
  const buf = new Uint8Array(await res.arrayBuffer());
  if (buf[0] !== 0x1f || buf[1] !== 0x8b) return new TextDecoder().decode(buf);
  if (typeof DecompressionStream === 'undefined') throw new Error('This browser cannot unpack the dictionary (DecompressionStream is missing; update Safari to 16.4 or later).');
  const stream = new Blob([buf]).stream().pipeThrough(new DecompressionStream('gzip'));
  return new Response(stream).text();
}

export function getDictData(): Promise<DictData> {
  dictData ??= (async () => {
    const res = await fetch(DICT_URL);
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`The dictionary could not be loaded (HTTP ${res.status}).`);
    return JSON.parse(await readMaybeGzip(res)) as DictData;
  })();
  dictData.catch(() => { dictData = null; });
  return dictData;
}

export function getDictionary(): Promise<Dictionary> {
  dictionary ??= getDictData().then((d) => createDictionary(d));
  dictionary.catch(() => { dictionary = null; });
  return dictionary;
}

export async function listLibrary(): Promise<LibraryItem[]> {
  return [...(await libraryDoc.load()).items].sort((a, b) => (b.lastOpenedAt > a.lastOpenedAt ? 1 : -1));
}

/** Reads a stored book without touching lastOpenedAt (hints job). */
export async function readBook(id: string): Promise<Book | null> {
  try { return (await idbGet<Book>('books', id)) ?? null; } catch { return null; }
}

export async function loadBook(id: string): Promise<Book | null> {
  const book = await readBook(id);
  if (!book) return null;
  await libraryDoc.update((lib) => ({ items: lib.items.map((it) => (it.id === id ? { ...it, lastOpenedAt: new Date().toISOString() } : it)) }));
  return book;
}

export async function removeBook(id: string): Promise<void> {
  try { await idbDelete('books', id); } catch { /* ignore */ }
  await libraryDoc.update((lib) => ({ items: lib.items.filter((it) => it.id !== id) }));
}

export async function saveProgress(id: string, position: Position, percent: number): Promise<void> {
  await libraryDoc.update((lib) => ({ items: lib.items.map((it) => (it.id === id ? { ...it, position, percent, lastOpenedAt: new Date().toISOString() } : it)) }));
}

async function finishImport(book: Book): Promise<Book> {
  try { book.names = detectNames(book, await getDictionary()); } catch (e) { console.warn('[web] names not detected (no dictionary)', e); book.names ??= []; }
  try {
    await idbSet('books', book.id, book);
  } catch (e) {
    throw new Error(`The book could not be stored in this browser (${(e as Error).message}). Free some space or remove a book and try again.`);
  }
  const item: LibraryItem = {
    id: book.id, title: book.title, author: book.author, kind: book.source.kind,
    addedAt: book.source.importedAt, lastOpenedAt: new Date().toISOString(), position: null, percent: 0, words: book.stats.words,
  };
  await libraryDoc.update((lib) => ({ items: [...lib.items.filter((it) => it.id !== book.id), item] }));
  return book;
}

function extOf(name: string): string { const m = /\.[^./\\]+$/.exec(name); return m ? m[0].toLowerCase() : ''; }

async function importerFor(ext: string): Promise<Importer> {
  // EPUB and PDF importers are loaded on demand (pdf.js is large): separate chunks in dist/web
  if (ext === '.epub') return (await import('@core/import/epub')).epubImporter;
  if (ext === '.pdf') return (await import('@core/import/pdf')).pdfImporter;
  return textImporter;
}

export async function importBytes(name: string, bytes: Uint8Array): Promise<Book> {
  const id = (await sha256Hex(bytes)).slice(0, 24);
  const existing = await loadBook(id);
  if (existing) return existing;
  const ext = extOf(name);
  const importer = await importerFor(ext);
  const book = await importer.importBytes(bytes, { segmenter: createSegmenter(), id, sourcePath: name });
  if (!book.title) book.title = ext ? name.slice(0, -ext.length) : name;
  return finishImport(book);
}

export async function importText(title: string, text: string): Promise<Book> {
  const id = (await sha256Hex(text)).slice(0, 24);
  const existing = await loadBook(id);
  if (existing) return existing;
  const book = await textToBook(title || 'Pasted text', text, { segmenter: createSegmenter(), id });
  return finishImport(book);
}
```

### `src/web/secrets.ts` (87 lines)

```ts
/**
 * API keys in the web build. Unlike the Mac app (AES-256-GCM in secrets.json under a key file in the app's
 * data folder, src/main/secrets.ts), the keys are kept as plain strings in this site's IndexedDB: a web page
 * has no place to hide an encryption key that its own scripts could not also read, so encrypting would add
 * nothing. They never leave the device except in the requests to the provider they belong to.
 * Anyone who can use this iPad profile (or script on this origin) can read them; see docs/IPAD.md.
 */
import { SECRET_NAMES, SECRET_LABELS, type SecretName, type SecretStatusMap } from '@shared/api';
import { KvDoc } from './idb';

const doc = new KvDoc<Partial<Record<SecretName, string>>>('secrets', () => ({}));
const DEFAULT_AZURE_REGION = 'uksouth';

export async function loadSecrets(): Promise<void> { await doc.load(); }

/** Removes surrounding whitespace; inside a plain key (not JSON) also line breaks (as src/main/secrets.ts). */
export function normalizeSecret(value: string): string {
  const t = (value ?? '').trim();
  if (t.startsWith('{')) return t;
  return t.replace(/\s+/g, '');
}

function parseAzure(value: string): { key: string; region: string } | null {
  const v = value.trim();
  if (!v) return null;
  if (v.startsWith('{')) {
    try {
      const o = JSON.parse(v) as { key?: unknown; region?: unknown };
      const key = typeof o.key === 'string' ? o.key.trim() : '';
      const region = typeof o.region === 'string' && o.region.trim() ? o.region.trim().toLowerCase() : DEFAULT_AZURE_REGION;
      return key ? { key, region } : null;
    } catch { return null; }
  }
  return { key: v, region: DEFAULT_AZURE_REGION };
}

/** Same user-facing warnings as the Mac app. */
export function formatWarning(name: SecretName, value: string): string | null {
  const v = normalizeSecret(value);
  switch (name) {
    case 'anthropic':
      return v.startsWith('sk-ant-') ? null : 'This does not look like an Anthropic key: they start with "sk-ant-". It was saved anyway; use Test to check it.';
    case 'openai':
      if (v.startsWith('sk-ant-')) return 'This looks like an Anthropic key, not an OpenAI key. It was saved anyway; use Test to check it.';
      return v.startsWith('sk-') ? null : 'This does not look like an OpenAI key: they start with "sk-". It was saved anyway; use Test to check it.';
    case 'elevenlabs':
      return /^(sk_)?[0-9a-f]{32,}$/i.test(v) ? null : 'This does not look like an ElevenLabs key: they are 32 or more hexadecimal characters (newer ones start with "sk_"). It was saved anyway; use Test to check it.';
    case 'azure': {
      const creds = parseAzure(v);
      if (!creds) return 'The Azure entry could not be read. Paste the key, or a JSON object {"key": "...", "region": "uksouth"}. It was saved anyway; use Test to check it.';
      if (!/^[A-Za-z0-9]{32,}$/.test(creds.key)) return 'This does not look like an Azure Speech key: they are 32 or more letters and digits. It was saved anyway; use Test to check it.';
      if (!/^[a-z0-9]+$/.test(creds.region)) return `"${creds.region}" does not look like an Azure region (for example "uksouth" or "westeurope"). It was saved anyway; use Test to check it.`;
      return null;
    }
    case 'google':
      return /^AIza[0-9A-Za-z_-]{35}$/.test(v) ? null : 'This does not look like a Google Cloud API key: they start with "AIza" and are 39 characters long. It was saved anyway; use Test to check it.';
  }
  return null;
}

export async function setSecret(name: SecretName, value: string): Promise<{ warning: string | null }> {
  if (!SECRET_NAMES.includes(name)) throw new Error(`Unknown secret "${name}"`);
  const v = normalizeSecret(value);
  await doc.update((d) => {
    const next = { ...d };
    if (v) next[name] = v; else delete next[name];
    return next;
  });
  if (!v) return { warning: null };
  if ((await getSecret(name)) !== v) throw new Error(`The ${SECRET_LABELS[name]} key could not be saved in this browser's storage. Check that the site may store data (not a private window) and try again.`);
  return { warning: formatWarning(name, v) };
}

export async function getSecret(name: SecretName): Promise<string | null> { return (await doc.load())[name] ?? null; }
export async function hasSecret(name: SecretName): Promise<boolean> { return !!(await getSecret(name)); }

export async function getAzureCredentials(): Promise<{ key: string; region: string } | null> {
  const v = await getSecret('azure');
  return v ? parseAzure(v) : null;
}

export async function secretStatus(): Promise<SecretStatusMap> {
  const d = await doc.load();
  const out = {} as SecretStatusMap;
  for (const name of SECRET_NAMES) out[name] = { saved: !!d[name], verified: !!d[name], lostAtStartup: false };
  return out;
}
```

### `src/web/settings.ts` (75 lines)

```ts
/**
 * Settings, word statuses and AI usage for the web build: the same semantics as src/main/settings.ts
 * (stored settings deep-merged over DEFAULT_SETTINGS, theme migration, last 5000 usage records),
 * stored in IndexedDB instead of JSON files.
 *
 * Web-only adjustment: the voice engines that need the Mac app (Kokoro, Microsoft Edge voices) are not
 * available in a browser, so they read as the built-in system voices ("webspeech").
 */
import type { Settings, VocabState, WordStatus, MarkedRange, UsageRecord, TtsEngineId } from '@shared/settings';
import { DEFAULT_SETTINGS, migrateSettings } from '@shared/settings';
import { KvDoc } from './idb';

/** Engines that run only in the desktop app. */
export const UNAVAILABLE_ENGINES: readonly TtsEngineId[] = ['kokoro', 'edge'];

/** DEFAULT_SETTINGS with the voice set to the browser's built-in voices (Safari: the iPad's own voices). */
export function webDefaults(): Settings {
  const d = structuredClone(DEFAULT_SETTINGS);
  d.voice = { ...d.voice, engine: 'webspeech', voiceId: '' };
  return d;
}

const settingsDoc = new KvDoc<Partial<Settings>>('settings', () => ({}));
const vocabDoc = new KvDoc<VocabState>('vocab', () => ({ words: {}, marked: {} }));
const usageDoc = new KvDoc<{ records: UsageRecord[] }>('usage', () => ({ records: [] }));

/** Recursively merges patch over base: nested plain objects merge, arrays and scalars replace (as src/main/settings.ts). */
export function deepMerge<T>(base: T, patch: Partial<T>): T {
  const out: Record<string, unknown> = { ...(base as Record<string, unknown>) };
  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries((patch ?? {}) as Record<string, unknown>)) {
    const cur = out[k];
    if (v && typeof v === 'object' && !Array.isArray(v) && cur && typeof cur === 'object' && !Array.isArray(cur)) out[k] = deepMerge(cur, v as never);
    else out[k] = v;
  }
  return out as T;
}

/** Replaces desktop-only voice engines by the browser voices. */
export function webVoice(s: Settings): Settings {
  const v = s.voice;
  if (UNAVAILABLE_ENGINES.includes(v.engine)) s.voice = { ...v, engine: 'webspeech', voiceId: '' };
  if (s.voice.explainEngine && UNAVAILABLE_ENGINES.includes(s.voice.explainEngine)) s.voice = { ...s.voice, explainEngine: null, explainVoiceId: null };
  return s;
}

export async function getSettings(): Promise<Settings> {
  const stored = structuredClone(await settingsDoc.load()) as Partial<Settings>;
  return webVoice(migrateSettings(deepMerge(webDefaults(), migrateSettings(stored as Settings))));
}

export async function setSettings(patch: Partial<Settings>): Promise<Settings> {
  const next = webVoice(migrateSettings(deepMerge(await getSettings(), migrateSettings(structuredClone(patch) as Settings))));
  await settingsDoc.set(next);
  return next;
}

export async function getVocab(): Promise<VocabState> { return structuredClone(await vocabDoc.load()); }
export async function setWordStatus(lemma: string, status: WordStatus | null): Promise<void> {
  await vocabDoc.update((v) => {
    const words = { ...v.words };
    if (status) words[lemma] = status; else delete words[lemma];
    return { ...v, words };
  });
}
export async function setMarkedRanges(bookId: string, ranges: MarkedRange[]): Promise<void> {
  await vocabDoc.update((v) => ({ ...v, marked: { ...v.marked, [bookId]: ranges } }));
}

export async function addUsage(rec: UsageRecord): Promise<void> {
  await usageDoc.update((u) => ({ records: [...u.records.slice(-5000), rec] }));
}
export async function getUsage(): Promise<UsageRecord[]> { return [...(await usageDoc.load()).records]; }
export async function usdSpent(sinceIso: string): Promise<number> {
  return (await usageDoc.load()).records.filter((r) => r.date >= sinceIso).reduce((s, r) => s + r.usd, 0);
}
```

```ts
/** The two node:path helpers the PDF importer uses, for the browser bundle (file names only, POSIX style). */
export function extname(p: string): string {
  const base = basename(p);
  const i = base.lastIndexOf('.');
  return i > 0 ? base.slice(i) : '';
}
export function basename(p: string, ext?: string): string {
  const base = String(p).replace(/[\\/]+$/, '').split(/[\\/]/).pop() ?? '';
  return ext && base.endsWith(ext) && base !== ext ? base.slice(0, -ext.length) : base;
}
const path = { extname, basename, sep: '/' };
export default path;
```

### `src/web/tts.ts` (93 lines)

```ts
/**
 * Cloud voices for the web build, called straight from the browser with the learner's key and returning
 * the same CloudTtsResult as src/main/tts.ts. Safari's own voices (Web Speech) need nothing here: the
 * renderer's WebSpeechEngine uses them directly.
 *  - openai: /v1/audio/speech (gpt-4o-mini-tts), no word timings (the renderer estimates them).
 *  - elevenlabs: with-timestamps endpoint, character alignment -> word timings.
 *  - edge, kokoro: desktop only (msedge-tts needs a Node WebSocket client; Kokoro runs onnxruntime-node).
 */
import type { TtsEngineId } from '@shared/settings';
import type { CloudTtsResult, TtsVoiceInfo, WordTiming } from '@shared/api';
import { getSecret } from './secrets';

export const DESKTOP_ONLY_VOICE = 'This voice needs the Dream Read app on a Mac. On iPad, choose the iPad voices (built in), OpenAI or ElevenLabs in Settings.';

function rank(lang: string): number { return lang.toLowerCase() === 'en-gb' ? 3 : lang.toLowerCase().startsWith('en') ? 2 : lang.toLowerCase().startsWith('zh') ? 1 : 0; }

export async function listVoices(engine: TtsEngineId): Promise<TtsVoiceInfo[]> {
  if (engine === 'openai') {
    if (!(await getSecret('openai'))) return [];
    return ['ballad', 'fable', 'alloy', 'ash', 'coral', 'echo', 'nova', 'onyx', 'sage', 'shimmer', 'verse', 'marin', 'cedar'].map((id) => ({ id, name: id[0].toUpperCase() + id.slice(1), lang: 'en', note: id === 'ballad' || id === 'fable' ? 'sounds most British' : undefined }));
  }
  if (engine === 'elevenlabs') {
    const key = await getSecret('elevenlabs');
    if (!key) return [];
    const res = await fetch('https://api.elevenlabs.io/v1/voices', { headers: { 'xi-api-key': key } });
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`ElevenLabs voices: HTTP ${res.status}`);
    const data = (await res.json()) as { voices: { voice_id: string; name: string; labels?: Record<string, string> }[] };
    return data.voices.map((v) => ({ id: v.voice_id, name: v.name, lang: /brit|english \(uk\)|gb/i.test(JSON.stringify(v.labels ?? {})) ? 'en-GB' : 'en', gender: v.labels?.gender, note: v.labels?.accent }))
      .sort((a, b) => rank(b.lang) - rank(a.lang) || a.name.localeCompare(b.name));
  }
  // edge / kokoro: nothing to list in a browser
  return [];
}

export async function synthesize(engine: TtsEngineId, text: string, voiceId: string, rate: number): Promise<CloudTtsResult> {
  const t = text.trim();
  if (!t) return { audio: new ArrayBuffer(0), mime: 'audio/mpeg', timings: [], durationSec: 0 };
  if (engine === 'openai') return synthOpenAI(t, voiceId || 'ballad', rate);
  if (engine === 'elevenlabs') return synthElevenLabs(t, voiceId || 'JBFqnCBsd6RMkjVDRZzb');
  if (engine === 'edge' || engine === 'kokoro') throw new Error(DESKTOP_ONLY_VOICE);
  throw new Error(`Voice engine "${engine}" is not available in this version.`);
}

async function synthOpenAI(text: string, voice: string, rate: number): Promise<CloudTtsResult> {
  const key = await getSecret('openai');
  if (!key) throw new Error('Add your OpenAI API key in Settings to use the OpenAI voice.');
  const res = await fetch('https://api.openai.com/v1/audio/speech', {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { authorization: `Bearer ${key}`, 'content-type': 'application/json' },
    body: JSON.stringify({
      model: 'gpt-4o-mini-tts',
      voice,
      input: text,
      instructions: 'Read this aloud in a clear, warm British English accent (Received Pronunciation), at a natural storytelling pace, for an English learner.',
      response_format: 'mp3',
      speed: Math.min(4, Math.max(0.25, rate || 1)),
    }),
  });
  if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`OpenAI voice: HTTP ${res.status} ${(await res.text().catch(() => '')).slice(0, 200)}`);
  return { audio: await res.arrayBuffer(), mime: 'audio/mpeg', timings: null, durationSec: null };
}

function base64ToBuffer(b64: string): ArrayBuffer {
  const bin = atob(b64);
  const out = new Uint8Array(bin.length);
  for (let i = 0; i < bin.length; i++) out[i] = bin.charCodeAt(i);
  return out.buffer;
}

async function synthElevenLabs(text: string, voice: string): Promise<CloudTtsResult> {
  const key = await getSecret('elevenlabs');
  if (!key) throw new Error('Add your ElevenLabs API key in Settings to use this voice.');
  const res = await fetch(`https://api.elevenlabs.io/v1/text-to-speech/${encodeURIComponent(voice)}/with-timestamps?output_format=mp3_44100_64`, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'xi-api-key': key, 'content-type': 'application/json' },
    body: JSON.stringify({ text, model_id: 'eleven_flash_v2_5' }),
  });
  if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`ElevenLabs: HTTP ${res.status} ${(await res.text().catch(() => '')).slice(0, 200)}`);
  const data = (await res.json()) as { audio_base64: string; alignment?: { characters: string[]; character_start_times_seconds: number[]; character_end_times_seconds: number[] } | null };
  return { audio: base64ToBuffer(data.audio_base64), mime: 'audio/mpeg', timings: data.alignment ? charAlignmentToWords(data.alignment) : null, durationSec: null };
}

export function charAlignmentToWords(a: { characters: string[]; character_start_times_seconds: number[]; character_end_times_seconds: number[] }): WordTiming[] {
  const out: WordTiming[] = [];
  let i = 0;
  while (i < a.characters.length) {
    if (/\s/.test(a.characters[i])) { i++; continue; }
    const start = i;
    while (i < a.characters.length && !/\s/.test(a.characters[i])) i++;
    out.push({ start: a.character_start_times_seconds[start], end: a.character_end_times_seconds[i - 1], charIndex: start, charLength: i - start });
  }
  return out;
}
```

### `src/web/vocabulary.ts` (179 lines)

```ts
/**
 * My Vocabulary for the web build: a port of the pure parts of src/main/vocabulary.ts (merge rules, CSV,
 * Progress numbers) over an IndexedDB document. The Mac app mirrors the list to a CSV file in Documents
 * after every change; a browser cannot write files on its own, so here the CSV is produced on demand and
 * handed to the share sheet / downloads (see files.ts).
 */
import type { CefrLevel } from '@core/model';
import { CEFR_LEVELS } from '@core/model';
import type { DictData, VocabEntry, VocabEntryInput, VocabEntryStatus, VocabProgress, LevelProgress, UnknownWord } from '@shared/api';
import type { VocabState } from '@shared/settings';
import { KvDoc } from './idb';
import * as settings from './settings';
import { getDictData } from './library';

export interface VocabularyFile { version: 1; entries: Record<string, VocabEntry> }
const store = new KvDoc<VocabularyFile>('vocabulary', () => ({ version: 1, entries: {} }));

export const CSV_FILE_NAME = 'my-vocabulary.csv';

export async function listEntries(): Promise<VocabEntry[]> {
  return Object.values((await store.load()).entries).sort((a, b) => (b.lastSeenAt > a.lastSeenAt ? 1 : b.lastSeenAt < a.lastSeenAt ? -1 : a.lemma.localeCompare(b.lemma)));
}

/** Same merge as the Mac app: first sentence and place kept, latest explanation and Chinese kept, counters bumped. */
export function mergeEntry(existing: VocabEntry | null, input: VocabEntryInput, nowIso: string): VocabEntry {
  if (!existing) {
    return {
      lemma: input.lemma, word: input.word || input.lemma, sentence: input.sentence ?? '', explanation: input.explanation ?? '',
      chinese: input.chinese ?? '', bookId: input.bookId ?? '', bookTitle: input.bookTitle ?? '', chapter: input.chapter ?? '',
      position: input.position ?? null, createdAt: nowIso, lastSeenAt: nowIso, timesExplained: 1, status: 'learning',
      level: input.level, again: input.again ? 1 : 0,
    };
  }
  return {
    ...existing,
    word: existing.word || input.word || input.lemma,
    sentence: existing.sentence || input.sentence || '',
    explanation: input.explanation || existing.explanation,
    chinese: input.chinese || existing.chinese,
    bookId: existing.bookId || input.bookId, bookTitle: existing.bookTitle || input.bookTitle, chapter: existing.chapter || input.chapter,
    position: existing.position ?? input.position ?? null,
    lastSeenAt: nowIso,
    timesExplained: existing.timesExplained + 1,
    level: existing.level ?? input.level,
    again: existing.again + (input.again ? 1 : 0),
  };
}

export async function upsertEntry(input: VocabEntryInput, now: Date = new Date()): Promise<VocabEntry> {
  const lemma = String(input.lemma ?? '').trim();
  if (!lemma) throw new Error('vocabulary: a lemma is required');
  if (!input.level) {
    try { input = { ...input, level: levelOf(await getDictData(), lemma) ?? undefined }; } catch { /* dictionary missing */ }
  }
  const nowIso = now.toISOString();
  let entry!: VocabEntry;
  await store.update((f) => {
    entry = mergeEntry(f.entries[lemma] ?? null, { ...input, lemma }, nowIso);
    return { ...f, entries: { ...f.entries, [lemma]: entry } };
  });
  if ((await settings.getVocab()).words[lemma] !== 'known') await settings.setWordStatus(lemma, 'learning');
  return entry;
}

export async function setEntryStatus(lemma: string, status: VocabEntryStatus): Promise<void> {
  await store.update((f) => {
    const e = f.entries[lemma];
    if (!e) return f;
    return { ...f, entries: { ...f.entries, [lemma]: { ...e, status } } };
  });
  await settings.setWordStatus(lemma, status);
}

export async function deleteEntry(lemma: string): Promise<void> {
  await store.update((f) => {
    if (!(lemma in f.entries)) return f;
    const entries = { ...f.entries };
    delete entries[lemma];
    return { ...f, entries };
  });
  await settings.setWordStatus(lemma, null);
}

function csvField(v: string): string {
  const s = (v ?? '').replace(/\r?\n/g, ' ').trim();
  return /[",;\t]/.test(s) ? `"${s.replace(/"/g, '""')}"` : s;
}

/** UTF-8 with a BOM so Excel and Numbers show the Chinese; CRLF line ends; oldest entry first. */
export function toCsv(entries: VocabEntry[]): string {
  const rows = [...entries].sort((a, b) => a.createdAt.localeCompare(b.createdAt) || a.lemma.localeCompare(b.lemma));
  const lines = ['word,chinese,explanation,sentence,book,chapter,date,status'];
  for (const e of rows) {
    lines.push([e.word || e.lemma, e.chinese, e.explanation, e.sentence, e.bookTitle, e.chapter, e.createdAt.slice(0, 10), e.status].map(csvField).join(','));
  }
  return `﻿${lines.join('\r\n')}\r\n`;
}

const TAGGED: ReadonlySet<string> = new Set(['cefrj', 'oct']);

function levelOf(dict: DictData, word: string): CefrLevel | null {
  const raw = dict.w[word];
  if (!raw) return null;
  return (CEFR_LEVELS as string[]).includes(raw.l) ? (raw.l as CefrLevel) : null;
}

let taggedCache: { dict: DictData; map: Map<CefrLevel, string[]> } | null = null;
function taggedWords(dict: DictData): Map<CefrLevel, string[]> {
  if (taggedCache?.dict === dict) return taggedCache.map;
  const out = new Map<CefrLevel, string[]>(CEFR_LEVELS.map((l) => [l, []]));
  for (const [word, raw] of Object.entries(dict.w)) {
    if (!TAGGED.has(raw.s) || word.includes(' ')) continue;
    const level = levelOf(dict, word);
    if (level) out.get(level)!.push(word);
  }
  taggedCache = { dict, map: out };
  return out;
}

export function dayKey(d: Date): string {
  const p = (n: number) => String(n).padStart(2, '0');
  return `${d.getFullYear()}-${p(d.getMonth() + 1)}-${p(d.getDate())}`;
}

export function streakFrom(days: Iterable<string>, now: Date): number {
  const set = new Set(days);
  if (set.size === 0) return 0;
  const cursor = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), now.getDate());
  if (!set.has(dayKey(cursor))) cursor.setDate(cursor.getDate() - 1);
  let n = 0;
  while (set.has(dayKey(cursor))) { n++; cursor.setDate(cursor.getDate() - 1); }
  return n;
}

export function computeProgress(dict: DictData, words: VocabState['words'], entries: VocabEntry[], now: Date = new Date()): VocabProgress {
  const levels: LevelProgress[] = [];
  let unknownTotal = 0;
  for (const [level, list] of taggedWords(dict)) {
    const p: LevelProgress = { level, known: 0, learning: 0, unknown: 0, total: list.length };
    for (const w of list) {
      const st = words[w];
      if (st === 'known') p.known++;
      else if (st === 'learning') p.learning++;
      else if (st !== 'ignored') p.unknown++;
    }
    unknownTotal += p.unknown;
    levels.push(p);
  }
  let known = 0, learning = 0;
  for (const st of Object.values(words)) { if (st === 'known') known++; else if (st === 'learning') learning++; }
  const weekAgo = new Date(now.getTime() - 7 * 86400_000).toISOString();
  const learnedThisWeek = entries.filter((e) => e.createdAt >= weekAgo).length;
  const days = new Set<string>();
  for (const e of entries) { days.add(dayKey(new Date(e.createdAt))); days.add(dayKey(new Date(e.lastSeenAt))); }
  const lastActiveDay = days.size ? [...days].sort().at(-1)! : null;
  return { levels, totals: { known, learning, unknown: unknownTotal, entries: entries.length }, learnedThisWeek, streakDays: streakFrom(days, now), lastActiveDay };
}

export function unknownAtLevel(dict: DictData, words: VocabState['words'], level: CefrLevel): UnknownWord[] {
  const list = taggedWords(dict).get(level) ?? [];
  const out: UnknownWord[] = [];
  for (const w of list) {
    if (words[w]) continue;
    const raw = dict.w[w];
    out.push({ word: w, zh: (raw.t ?? '').split(/\r?\n/)[0].trim(), ipa: raw.i ? `/${raw.i.replace(/^\/+|\/+$/g, '')}/` : '', level, frq: raw.f | 0 });
  }
  const rank = (f: number) => (f > 0 ? f : Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER);
  return out.sort((a, b) => rank(a.frq) - rank(b.frq) || a.word.localeCompare(b.word));
}

export async function getProgress(now: Date = new Date()): Promise<VocabProgress> {
  const dict = await getDictData().catch(() => ({ w: {}, f: {} }) as DictData);
  return computeProgress(dict, (await settings.getVocab()).words, await listEntries(), now);
}

export async function getUnknownAtLevel(level: CefrLevel): Promise<UnknownWord[]> {
  const dict = await getDictData();
  return unknownAtLevel(dict, (await settings.getVocab()).words, level);
}
```

```css
/* iPad / web adjustments layered over the renderer's main.css and reader.css (loaded after them).
   - safe areas: the app is drawn under the status bar (black-translucent) and inside the rounded corners
   - touch: every control at least 44 px high/wide, no hover-only controls, no double-tap zoom
   - no macOS traffic-light gutters (navigator.platform is "MacIntel" on iPad, so the renderer would add them) */

html { -webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%; text-size-adjust: 100%; touch-action: manipulation; -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; background: var(--bg); }
body { overscroll-behavior: none; }
#root {
  padding: env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px) env(safe-area-inset-right, 0px) env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px) env(safe-area-inset-left, 0px);
  box-sizing: border-box;
}
/* keep the content the same height as the visible viewport when the on-screen keyboard is up */
html, body { height: 100%; height: 100dvh; }

/* no traffic lights in a browser */
:root[data-web] .titlebar { padding-left: 16px; }
:root[data-web] .screen.reading .bar.top,
:root[data-web] .listen-head { padding-left: 16px; }
:root[data-web] .traffic-drag { display: none; }
:root[data-web] .drag { -webkit-app-region: no-drag; }


@media (pointer: coarse), (hover: none) {
  /* touch targets: 44 x 44 pt minimum (Apple HIG) */
  button, select, .chip, .seg button, input[type="checkbox"] + label, summary { min-height: 44px; }
  button { min-width: 44px; }
  input[type="text"], input[type="password"], input[type="number"], input[type="search"], select, textarea { min-height: 44px; font-size: 16px; /* 16 px stops Safari zooming into fields */ }
  input[type="range"] { min-height: 44px; }
  input[type="checkbox"], input[type="radio"] { width: 22px; height: 22px; }

  .titlebar { height: 52px; }
  .titlebar button, .bar button, .listen-head button, .controls button, .book-card .foot button { min-height: 44px; padding-top: 8px; padding-bottom: 8px; }
  .screen.reading .bar { height: 56px; }
  .screen.reading .bar.bottom { height: 52px; }
  .listen-head { height: 56px; }
  .controls { gap: 10px; }
  .controls .speed input[type="range"] { width: 140px; }

  /* controls that only appeared on hover are always visible */
  .book-card .foot .remove { opacity: 1; }
  .book-card:hover { transform: none; box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm); border-color: var(--border); }
  .w:hover:not(.punct) { outline: none; }
  .listen-lines .s:hover:not(.cur) { opacity: 0.62; }
  .listen-lines .s.past:hover:not(.cur) { opacity: 0.32; }

  /* tips follow focus (a tap), not a lingering hover */
  .tip-wrap:hover > .tip { opacity: 0; visibility: hidden; }
  .tip-wrap:focus-within > .tip { opacity: 1; visibility: visible; }

  /* thin Mac scrollbars are hard to grab; iOS shows its own */
  ::-webkit-scrollbar { width: 0; height: 0; }
}

/* the install hint shown by src/web/install.ts on iPad Safari (not in the home-screen app) */
.web-install-hint { position: fixed; left: 50%; bottom: calc(16px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px)); transform: translateX(-50%); z-index: 90; max-width: min(560px, calc(100vw - 32px)); background: var(--bg-elevated); color: var(--fg); border: 1px solid var(--border-strong); border-radius: var(--radius); box-shadow: var(--shadow); padding: 12px 12px 12px 16px; display: flex; gap: 12px; align-items: center; font-size: 14px; font-family: var(--font-sans); }
.web-install-hint button { flex: none; }
```

### `web/sw.js` (47 lines)

```js
// Dream Read service worker: cache-first for the app shell and the dictionary, versioned per build.
// scripts/build-web.mjs replaces __VERSION__ and __ASSETS__ when it copies this file to dist/web/sw.js.
// Requests to other origins (AI and voice providers) are never touched.
const VERSION = '__VERSION__';
const CACHE = `dream-read-${VERSION}`;
const ASSETS = __ASSETS__;

self.addEventListener('install', (event) => {
  event.waitUntil(
    caches.open(CACHE)
      .then((cache) => cache.addAll(ASSETS.map((a) => new Request(a, { cache: 'reload' }))))
      .then(() => self.skipWaiting()),
  );
});

self.addEventListener('activate', (event) => {
  event.waitUntil(
    caches.keys()
      .then((keys) => Promise.all(keys.filter((k) => k.startsWith('dream-read-') && k !== CACHE).map((k) => caches.delete(k))))
      .then(() => self.clients.claim()),
  );
});

self.addEventListener('fetch', (event) => {
  const req = event.request;
  if (req.method !== 'GET') return;
  const url = new URL(req.url);
  if (url.origin !== self.location.origin) return;
  event.respondWith((async () => {
    const cache = await caches.open(CACHE);
    // navigations (and "?e2e" style variants) are served by the cached index.html
    const key = req.mode === 'navigate' ? new URL('index.html', self.registration.scope).href : url.origin + url.pathname;
    const hit = await cache.match(key);
    if (hit) return hit;
    try {
      const res = await fetch(req);
      if (res.ok && res.type === 'basic') cache.put(key, res.clone()).catch(() => undefined);
      return res;
    } catch (e) {
      if (req.mode === 'navigate') {
        const shell = await cache.match(new URL('index.html', self.registration.scope).href);
        if (shell) return shell;
      }
      throw e;
    }
  })());
});
```

```ts
import { _electron as electron, type ElectronApplication, type Page } from '@playwright/test';
import fs from 'node:fs';
import os from 'node:os';
import path from 'node:path';

/**
 * Launches the built app with a fresh data folder. By default the first-start level test is marked as already
 * taken (so the app opens on the settings tour, as before); pass { levelTest: true } to see the level test first.
 */
export async function launchApp(opts: { levelTest?: boolean } = {}): Promise<{ app: ElectronApplication; page: Page; userData: string }> {
  const userData = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'dream-read-e2e-'));
  if (!opts.levelTest) {
    fs.mkdirSync(path.join(userData, 'data'), { recursive: true });
    fs.writeFileSync(path.join(userData, 'data', 'settings.json'), JSON.stringify({ version: 1, level: { model: null, lastResult: null, testedAt: '2026-01-01T00:00:00.000Z' } }));
  }
  const app = await electron.launch({
    args: ['--no-sandbox', '--disable-gpu', path.resolve(__dirname, '../../dist/main/index.js')],
    env: { ...process.env, READALONG_USER_DATA: userData, READALONG_E2E: '1' },
  });
  const page = await app.firstWindow();
  await page.waitForLoadState('domcontentloaded');
  return { app, page, userData };
}
```

### `test/e2e/level-test.spec.ts` (65 lines)

```ts
import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test';
import { launchApp } from './helpers';

/**
 * The level test screen (src/renderer/views/LevelTest.tsx). The app routes to it for view === 'leveltest'
 * (LEVEL_TEST_VIEW_ID); until app.tsx shows it at first start and from Settings → Level, the screen cannot be
 * reached in the built app, so this spec is skipped. Enable it (remove `.skip`) once the route exists and
 * replace `openLevelTest` with the real way in (the first-start screen or the Settings → Level button).
 */
async function openLevelTest(page: import('@playwright/test').Page): Promise<void> {
  // Settings → Level & stops → "Test my level" (first start opens the test directly when no level is saved)
  // a fresh app already sits on the settings tour; otherwise open Settings from the title bar
  const settingsButton = page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Settings', exact: true });
  if (await settingsButton.count()) await settingsButton.click();
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Level & stops' }).click();
  await page.getByTestId('level-take').click();
}

test.describe('level test', () => {
  test('intro → 2 x 50 words → result → Use this level saves the level and the model', async () => {
    const { app, page } = await launchApp();
    await page.setViewportSize({ width: 1000, height: 760 });
    await openLevelTest(page);

    await expect(page.getByTestId('level-intro')).toBeVisible();
    await page.getByTestId('level-start').click();
    await expect(page.getByTestId('level-word')).toBeVisible({ timeout: 20000 });
    await expect(page.getByTestId('level-stage-text')).toHaveText('Stage 1 of 2');
    await expect(page.getByTestId('level-progress')).toHaveText('1 of 50');

    // stage 1: answer with the keyboard (Y / N) and the buttons
    for (let i = 0; i < 50; i++) {
      await expect(page.getByTestId('level-progress')).toHaveText(`${i + 1} of 50`);
      // say yes to one word in four: a pseudoword yes-rate near 25% keeps the result reliable (the limit is 30%)
      if (i % 4 === 0) await page.getByTestId('level-yes').click();
      else await page.keyboard.press(i % 2 ? 'KeyN' : 'ArrowLeft');
    }
    await expect(page.getByTestId('level-between')).toBeVisible();
    await page.keyboard.press('Enter');
    await expect(page.getByTestId('level-stage-text')).toHaveText('Stage 2 of 2');
    for (let i = 0; i < 50; i++) {
      await expect(page.getByTestId('level-progress')).toHaveText(`${i + 1} of 50`);
      await page.keyboard.press(i % 4 === 0 ? 'KeyY' : 'KeyN');
    }

    const result = page.getByTestId('level-result');
    await expect(result).toBeVisible();
    const level = await result.getAttribute('data-level');
    expect(level).toMatch(/^[ABC][12]$/);
    await page.getByTestId('level-use').click();
    // the level is saved: Settings → Level shows it selected
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Settings' }).click();
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: /Level/ }).click();
    await expect(page.getByTestId(`level-${level}`)).toHaveClass(/primary/);
    await app.close();
  });

  test('Skip for now keeps the current level', async () => {
    const { app, page } = await launchApp();
    await openLevelTest(page);
    await page.getByTestId('level-skip').click();
    await expect(page.getByTestId('level-test')).toHaveCount(0);
    await app.close();
  });
});
```

```ts
import { test, expect, type Page } from '@playwright/test';
import { launchApp } from './helpers';

const PARAS = [
  'The letter arrived the next morning. It contained a single, perplexing sentence. Elizabeth read it twice before folding it away.',
  "Mr. Darcy remained sanguine about the weather. The committee's deliberations were protracted and acrimonious, but a consensus emerged. The children went home.",
  'He was an old man who fished alone in a skiff in the Gulf Stream and he had gone eighty-four days now without taking a fish. In the first forty days a boy had been with him. But after forty days without a fish the boy\'s parents had told him that the old man was now definitely and finally salao, which is the worst form of unlucky.',
  'The old man was thin and gaunt with deep wrinkles in the back of his neck. The brown blotches of the benevolent skin cancer the sun brings from its reflection on the tropic sea were on his cheeks. Everything about him was old except his eyes and they were the same color as the sea and were cheerful and undefeated.',
];
/** three chapters, each long enough for several pages at 1200x800 */
const TEXT = [1, 2, 3].map((n) => `# Chapter ${n}: Part ${n}\n\n${Array.from({ length: 4 }, () => PARAS.join('\n\n')).join('\n\n')}`).join('\n\n');

async function importBook(page: Page, title = 'Test book'): Promise<void> {
  await page.getByTestId('paste-text').click();
  await page.getByTestId('paste-title').fill(title);
  await page.getByTestId('paste-body').fill(TEXT);
  await page.getByTestId('paste-import').click();
  await expect(page.getByTestId('reader')).toBeVisible({ timeout: 20000 });
}

test.describe('reader', () => {
  test('reading mode: pages, tap zones, hints, card, progress text; listening mode: lines, timeline, card; switching keeps the position', async () => {
    const { app, page } = await launchApp();
    await page.setViewportSize({ width: 1200, height: 800 });
    await page.getByTestId('finish-onboarding').click();
    await importBook(page);

    // a new book opens in Reading mode, full screen (no app title bar), with hard words highlighted and hinted
    await expect(page.getByTestId('reading')).toBeVisible();
    await expect(page.locator('.titlebar')).toHaveCount(0);
    await expect(page.locator('.w.hl-unknown').first()).toBeVisible();
    const hard = await page.locator('.w.hl-unknown').allTextContents();
    expect(hard.map((w) => w.toLowerCase())).toContain('acrimonious');
    expect(hard.map((w) => w.toLowerCase())).not.toContain('darcy');
    await expect(page.locator('.w[data-hint]').first()).toBeVisible();
    const hint = await page.locator('.w[data-lemma="acrimonious"][data-hint]').first().getAttribute('data-hint');
    expect(hint).toMatch(/[一-鿿]/);
    expect(hint!.length).toBeLessThanOrEqual(6);

    // progress text cycles on click
    await expect(page.getByTestId('progress-text')).toHaveText(/^Page 1 of \d+$/);
    await page.getByTestId('progress-text').click();
    await expect(page.getByTestId('progress-text')).toHaveText(/left in chapter$/);
    await page.getByTestId('progress-text').click();
    await expect(page.getByTestId('progress-text')).toHaveText(/left in book$/);
    await page.getByTestId('progress-text').click();
    await expect(page.getByTestId('progress-text')).toHaveText(/^\d+%$/);
    await page.getByTestId('progress-text').click();

    // tap the right fifth of the page: page 2 of the chapter
    await expect(page.locator('.page-count')).toHaveText(/^1 \/ \d+ in chapter$/);
    await page.getByTestId('doc').click({ position: { x: 1120, y: 400 } });
    await expect(page.locator('.page-count')).toHaveText(/^2 \/ \d+ in chapter$/);
    await page.getByTestId('doc').click({ position: { x: 60, y: 400 } });
    await expect(page.locator('.page-count')).toHaveText(/^1 \/ \d+ in chapter$/);
    await page.keyboard.press('PageDown');
    await expect(page.locator('.page-count')).toHaveText(/^2 \/ \d+ in chapter$/);

    // tap a word: the card opens under it and the spoken explanation starts at once; it closes by itself after the explanation
    await page.keyboard.press('PageUp');
    await expect(page.locator('.page-count')).toHaveText(/^1 \/ \d+ in chapter$/);
    const word = page.locator('.w[data-lemma="sanguine"]').first();
    await word.click();
    const card = page.getByTestId('card');
    await expect(card).toBeVisible();
    await expect(card).toContainText('/');
    await expect(card.locator('.zh')).toContainText(/[一-鿿]/);
    await expect(card.locator('.lvl').first()).toContainText(/C1|C2|B2/);
    await expect(card).toHaveAttribute('data-status', /thinking|speaking|done|error|skipped/, { timeout: 10000 });
    await expect(card).toHaveCount(0, { timeout: 20000 });
    // in Reading mode the voice stays paused after an explanation
    await expect(page.getByTestId('play')).toHaveAttribute('aria-label', 'Play');

    // "I know" from the card: the highlight and the hint disappear everywhere
    await page.locator('.w[data-lemma="acrimonious"]').first().click();
    await expect(card).toBeVisible();
    await card.getByTestId('card-known').click();
    await expect(page.locator('.w[data-lemma="acrimonious"].hl-unknown')).toHaveCount(0);
    await expect(page.locator('.w[data-lemma="acrimonious"][data-hint]')).toHaveCount(0);
    await expect(page.locator('.toast')).toContainText('marked known');

    // play: the sentence is highlighted while the voice reads and the position advances
    await page.getByTestId('play').click();
    await expect(page.locator('.reading.playing .s.cur')).toHaveCount(1);
    await expect(page.locator('.w.cur-w')).toHaveCount(1, { timeout: 5000 });
    const firstKey = await page.locator('.s.cur').getAttribute('data-key');
    await expect.poll(async () => page.locator('.s.cur').getAttribute('data-key'), { timeout: 15000 }).not.toBe(firstKey);
    await page.keyboard.press('Space');
    await expect(page.getByTestId('play')).toHaveAttribute('aria-label', 'Play');
    const keyBefore = await page.locator('.s.cur').getAttribute('data-key');

    // L: Listening mode, same position, the current sentence large
    await page.keyboard.press('KeyL');
    await expect(page.getByTestId('listening')).toBeVisible();
    await expect(page.locator('.listen-lines .s.cur')).toHaveAttribute('data-key', keyBefore!);
    const sizes = await page.evaluate(() => {
      const cur = document.querySelector('.listen-lines .s.cur')!;
      const other = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.listen-lines .para.k-p .s')).find((s) => s !== cur)!;
      return [parseFloat(getComputedStyle(cur).fontSize), parseFloat(getComputedStyle(other).fontSize)];
    });
    expect(sizes[0]).toBeGreaterThan(sizes[1] * 1.2);
    // timeline: chapter marks and a total time
    await expect(page.getByTestId('chapter-mark')).toHaveCount(2);
    await expect(page.getByTestId('clock-total')).toHaveText(/^\d+:\d\d$/);
    await expect(page.getByTestId('mic')).toBeEnabled();

    // play: the sentence advances and the text follows
    await page.getByTestId('play').click();
    await expect.poll(async () => page.locator('.listen-lines .s.cur').getAttribute('data-key'), { timeout: 15000 }).not.toBe(keyBefore);
    await page.keyboard.press('Space');
    await expect(page.getByTestId('play')).toHaveAttribute('aria-label', 'Play');

    // tap a word in Listening mode: card, explanation, auto-dismiss
    const w2 = page.locator('.listen-lines .w.hl-unknown').first();
    await w2.scrollIntoViewIfNeeded();
    await w2.click();
    await expect(card).toBeVisible();
    await expect(card).toHaveAttribute('data-status', /thinking|speaking|done|error|skipped/, { timeout: 10000 });
    await expect(card).toHaveCount(0, { timeout: 20000 });

    // help sheet
    await page.keyboard.press('Shift+Slash');
    await expect(page.getByTestId('help')).toBeVisible();
    await expect(page.getByTestId('help')).toContainText('Switch between Reading and Listening');
    await page.keyboard.press('Escape');
    await expect(page.getByTestId('help')).toHaveCount(0);

    // the switch button goes back to Reading mode at the same sentence
    const keyListen = await page.locator('.listen-lines .s.cur').getAttribute('data-key');
    await page.getByTestId('switch-mode').click();
    await expect(page.getByTestId('reading')).toBeVisible();
    await expect(page.locator('.pages .s.cur')).toHaveAttribute('data-key', keyListen!);

    // the mode is remembered per book: leave in Listening mode, reopen from the library
    await page.getByTestId('switch-mode').click();
    await expect(page.getByTestId('listening')).toBeVisible();
    await page.getByText('Library', { exact: true }).click();

    await expect(page.getByTestId('listening')).toBeVisible();

    expect(saved.lastMode).toBe('listening');
    expect(Object.values(saved.bookModes)).toContain('listening');
    await app.close();
  });

  test('listening mode: at a hard word the word, the 5-second window bar, the explanation with its card, then the sentence again', async () => {
    const { app, page } = await launchApp();
    await page.setViewportSize({ width: 1200, height: 800 });
    await page.getByTestId('finish-onboarding').click();
    await importBook(page, 'Stops');
    await page.keyboard.press('KeyL');
    await expect(page.getByTestId('listening')).toBeVisible();
    await page.getByTestId('play').click();
    // the first hard word: it is said, then the calm bar with the three answers and the countdown (nothing is said)
    const bar = page.getByTestId('command-bar');
    await expect(bar).toBeVisible({ timeout: 20000 });
    await expect(bar).toHaveAttribute('data-phase', 'before');
    await expect(page.getByTestId('cmd-know')).toContainText('I know');
    await expect(page.getByTestId('cmd-know')).toContainText('K');
    await expect(page.getByTestId('cmd-dont-know')).toContainText('I don’t know');
    await expect(page.getByTestId('cmd-go-on')).toContainText('Go on');
    await expect(page.getByTestId('cmd-go-on')).toContainText('Esc');
    await expect(bar).not.toContainText(/\bstop\b/i);
    await expect(page.locator('.command-countdown span')).toHaveCount(1);
    const stoppedAt = await page.locator('.listen-lines .s.cur').getAttribute('data-key');
    // silence: after the window the explanation starts and its card appears by itself
    const card = page.getByTestId('card');
    await expect(card).toBeVisible({ timeout: 20000 });
    await expect(card).toHaveAttribute('data-status', /thinking|speaking|done|error|skipped/);
    // after the explanation the window opens again; "Go on" ends it: the sentence is read again, then the book goes on
    await expect(bar).toHaveAttribute('data-phase', 'after', { timeout: 30000 });
    await page.getByTestId('cmd-go-on').click();
    await expect(bar).toHaveCount(0);
    await expect(page.getByTestId('play')).toHaveAttribute('aria-label', 'Pause');
    await expect.poll(async () => page.locator('.listen-lines .s.cur').getAttribute('data-key'), { timeout: 25000 }).not.toBe(stoppedAt);
    // the help sheet lists the window keys
    await page.keyboard.press('Space');
    await page.keyboard.press('Shift+Slash');
    await expect(page.getByTestId('help')).toContainText('At a hard word');
    await app.close();

  test('settings change theme, level and layout', async () => {
    const { app, page } = await launchApp();
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Level & stops' }).click();
    await page.getByTestId('level-C1').click();
    await expect(page.getByTestId('level-C1')).toHaveClass(/primary/);
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Reading look' }).click();
    await page.getByTestId('theme-light').click();
    await expect.poll(() => page.evaluate(() => document.documentElement.dataset.theme)).toBe('light');
    await page.getByTestId('theme-sepia').click();
    await expect.poll(() => page.evaluate(() => document.documentElement.dataset.theme)).toBe('sepia');
    // sizes: the slider updates the CSS variables at once and survives a settings round-trip
    await page.getByTestId('size-subtitle').fill('30');
    await expect.poll(() => page.evaluate(() => getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).getPropertyValue('--subtitle-size').trim())).toBe('30px');
    await page.getByTestId('layout').selectOption('scroll');
    const saved = await page.evaluate(() => window.readalong.getSettings());
    expect(saved.appearance.theme).toBe('sepia');
    expect(saved.appearance.subtitleSizePx).toBe(30);
    expect(saved.appearance.layout).toBe('scroll');
    expect(saved.appearance.maxLineChars).toBe(70);
    expect(saved.appearance.showTips).toBe(true);
    expect(saved.appearance.showHints).toBe(true);
    await page.getByTestId('finish-onboarding').click();
    await expect(page.getByTestId('library')).toBeVisible();
    await app.close();
  });
});
```

```ts
import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test';
import { launchApp } from './helpers';

const EDITED_PROMPT = 'Teach the word {{word}} in this sentence: {{sentence}} Keep it very simple.';

test.describe('explanation styles editor', () => {
  test('pick Teacher Style, edit its word prompt, duplicate it, set the copy to short, and everything survives a reload', async () => {
    const { app, page } = await launchApp();
    await page.getByTestId('nav-ai').click();
    const editor = page.getByTestId('styles-editor');
    await expect(editor).toBeVisible();
    // the ten built-in styles are listed, the custom one is active by default
    await expect(page.locator('[data-testid^="style-card-"]')).toHaveCount(10);
    await expect(page.getByTestId('style-card-custom').getByTestId('style-active-badge')).toBeVisible();

    // pick Teacher Style and make it the active one
    await page.getByTestId('style-card-teacher').click();
    await expect(page.getByTestId('style-name')).toHaveValue('Teacher Style');
    await page.getByTestId('style-use').click();
    await expect(page.getByTestId('style-card-teacher').getByTestId('style-active-badge')).toBeVisible();
    await expect(page.getByTestId('style-card-custom').getByTestId('style-active-badge')).toHaveCount(0);
    await expect.poll(() => page.evaluate(() => window.readalong.getSettings().then((s) => s.ai.activeStyle))).toBe('teacher');

    // edit the word prompt: saved 300 ms after the last keystroke (no blur, no save button)
    const wordPrompt = page.getByTestId('style-word-prompt');
    await wordPrompt.fill(EDITED_PROMPT);
    await expect.poll(() => page.evaluate(() => window.readalong.getSettings().then((s) => s.ai.styles.teacher?.wordPrompt)), { timeout: 5000 }).toBe(EDITED_PROMPT);
    // the sentence prompt and the shape are untouched (the patch carried only the changed field)
    const afterEdit = await page.evaluate(() => window.readalong.getSettings());
    expect(afterEdit.ai.styles.teacher?.sentencePrompt).toBeUndefined();

    // the preview shows exactly what is sent: the edited prompt, filled in, plus the knob sentences and the shared rules
    await page.getByTestId('style-preview').click();
    const user = page.getByTestId('preview-user');
    await expect(user).toContainText('Teach the word sanguine in this sentence: Mr. Darcy remained sanguine about the weather. Keep it very simple.');
    await expect(user).toContainText('about one hundred and thirty words');
    await expect(page.getByTestId('preview-system')).toContainText('The learner\'s first language is Chinese');
    await page.getByTestId('preview-sentence').click();
    await expect(user).toContainText('The sentence to teach is: Mr. Darcy remained sanguine about the weather.');

    // duplicate: a learner-made copy with the edited prompt, selected for editing but not active
    await page.getByTestId('style-duplicate').click();
    const copy = page.getByTestId('style-card-my-teacher-style-1');
    await expect(copy).toBeVisible();
    await expect(copy).toHaveClass(/selected/);
    await expect(copy).toContainText('Teacher Style (copy)');
    await expect(page.getByTestId('style-name')).toHaveValue('Teacher Style (copy)');
    await expect(page.getByTestId('style-word-prompt')).toHaveValue(EDITED_PROMPT);
    await expect(page.getByTestId('style-delete')).toBeVisible();
    await expect(page.getByTestId('style-reset')).toHaveCount(0);

    // set the copy's length to short, and its script shape
    await page.getByTestId('knob-length-short').click();
    await expect(page.getByTestId('knob-length-short')).toHaveClass(/on/);
    await page.getByTestId('shape-wordAfter').fill('1');
    await expect.poll(() => page.evaluate(() => window.readalong.getSettings().then((s) => s.ai.styles['my-teacher-style-1']?.length))).toBe('short');

    // shared context rules
    await page.getByTestId('context-before').fill('350');
    await expect.poll(() => page.evaluate(() => window.readalong.getSettings().then((s) => s.ai.contextWordsBefore))).toBe(350);

    // reload the renderer: settings come back from disk through the main process
    await page.reload();
    await page.waitForLoadState('domcontentloaded');
    await expect(page.getByTestId('settings')).toBeVisible();
    const saved = await page.evaluate(() => window.readalong.getSettings());
    expect(saved.ai.activeStyle).toBe('teacher');
    expect(saved.ai.styles.teacher?.wordPrompt).toBe(EDITED_PROMPT);
    expect(saved.ai.styles['my-teacher-style-1']?.length).toBe('short');
    expect(saved.ai.styles['my-teacher-style-1']?.userMade).toBe(true);
    expect(saved.ai.styles['my-teacher-style-1']?.wordPrompt).toBe(EDITED_PROMPT);
    expect(saved.ai.styles['my-teacher-style-1']?.shape?.wordAfter).toBe(1);
    expect(saved.ai.contextWordsBefore).toBe(350);
    expect(saved.ai.contextWordsAfter).toBe(200);

    // and the UI shows the same after the reload
    await page.getByTestId('nav-ai').click();
    await expect(page.getByTestId('style-card-teacher').getByTestId('style-active-badge')).toBeVisible();
    await expect(page.locator('[data-testid^="style-card-"]')).toHaveCount(11);
    await page.getByTestId('style-card-teacher').click();
    await expect(page.getByTestId('style-word-prompt')).toHaveValue(EDITED_PROMPT);
    await expect(page.getByTestId('style-use')).toBeDisabled();

    // reset the built-in: the prompt goes back to the default, the copy keeps the edit
    await page.getByTestId('style-reset').click();
    await expect(page.getByTestId('style-word-prompt')).not.toHaveValue(EDITED_PROMPT);
    await expect(page.getByTestId('style-word-prompt')).toHaveValue(/skilled English teacher/);
    await page.getByTestId('style-card-my-teacher-style-1').click();
    await expect(page.getByTestId('style-word-prompt')).toHaveValue(EDITED_PROMPT);

    // hide a built-in, restore it from the collapsed list; delete the copy
    await page.getByTestId('style-card-poetry').click();
    await page.getByTestId('style-hide').click();
    await expect(page.getByTestId('style-card-poetry')).toHaveCount(0);
    await expect(page.getByTestId('hidden-styles')).toContainText('Hidden styles (1)');
    await page.getByTestId('hidden-styles').locator('summary').click();
    await page.getByTestId('style-restore-poetry').click();
    await expect(page.getByTestId('style-card-poetry')).toBeVisible();
    await expect(page.getByTestId('hidden-styles')).toHaveCount(0);
    await page.getByTestId('style-card-my-teacher-style-1').click();
    await page.getByTestId('style-delete').click();
    await expect(page.getByTestId('style-card-my-teacher-style-1')).toHaveCount(0);
    await expect.poll(() => page.evaluate(() => window.readalong.getSettings().then((s) => s.ai.styles['my-teacher-style-1'] ?? null))).toBeNull();
    // new style from the custom defaults
    await page.getByTestId('style-new').click();
    await expect(page.getByTestId('style-card-my-style-1')).toHaveClass(/selected/);
    await expect(page.getByTestId('style-word-prompt')).toHaveValue(/Teach it like this, in one smooth spoken flow/);
    await app.close();
  });
});
```
