### `test/e2e/voice.spec.ts` (122 lines)

```ts
import { test, expect, type Page } from '@playwright/test';
import { launchApp } from './helpers';

// Voice chat under ?e2e=1: no real microphone; the speech engine is a no-op and transcripts are injected with
// window.__dreamVoice.inject(...). window.__dreamVoice.requests lists every AI request the reader sent.

const PARAS = [
  'The letter arrived the next morning. It contained a single, perplexing sentence. Elizabeth read it twice before folding it away.',
  "Mr. Darcy remained sanguine about the weather. The committee's deliberations were protracted and acrimonious, but a consensus emerged. The children went home.",
  'The old man was thin and gaunt with deep wrinkles in the back of his neck. Everything about him was old except his eyes and they were cheerful and undefeated.',
];
const TEXT = `# Chapter 1: Voices\n\n${Array.from({ length: 3 }, () => PARAS.join('\n\n')).join('\n\n')}`;
const SHOT = process.env.VOICE_SHOT ?? '';

interface Req { kind: string; target: string; question?: string; again?: boolean; history: unknown[] }
const requests = (page: Page) => page.evaluate(() => (window.__dreamVoice?.requests ?? []) as unknown as Req[]);
const line = (page: Page) => page.evaluate(() => window.__dreamVoice?.snapshot().line ?? 'none');
/** the phase of the commands window bar ('before' / 'after'), or null when it is hidden */
const phase = (page: Page) => page.evaluate(() => document.querySelector<HTMLElement>('[data-testid="command-bar"]')?.dataset.phase ?? null);
const inject = (page: Page, text: string, segmentId: string) => page.evaluate(([t, s]) => window.__dreamVoice!.inject({ type: 'final', text: t, segmentId: s }), [text, segmentId] as const);

test('voice chat: the pause window takes "I know", "I don\'t know" and questions; the typed box asks too', async () => {
  test.setTimeout(150_000);
  const { app, page } = await launchApp();
  await page.setViewportSize({ width: 1200, height: 800 });
  await page.getByTestId('finish-onboarding').click();
  await page.getByTestId('paste-text').click();
  await page.getByTestId('paste-title').fill('Voices');
  await page.getByTestId('paste-body').fill(TEXT);
  await page.getByTestId('paste-import').click();
  await expect(page.getByTestId('reader')).toBeVisible({ timeout: 20000 });

  // Reading mode has the round mic too (closed)
  await expect(page.getByTestId('mic')).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.getByTestId('mic')).toHaveAttribute('data-line', 'closed');
  await page.keyboard.press('KeyL');
  await expect(page.getByTestId('listening')).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.getByTestId('mic')).toBeVisible();

  // 1. listening pauses at a hard word: the word is said, then the 5 s window opens the voice line ("commands")
  //    before any explanation; "I know" = known, no explanation, the sentence is read again
  await page.getByTestId('play').click();
  await expect.poll(() => line(page), { timeout: 30000 }).toBe('window');
  await expect(page.getByTestId('mic')).toHaveAttribute('data-line', 'window');
  await expect(page.getByTestId('command-bar')).toHaveAttribute('data-phase', 'before');
  expect((await requests(page)).filter((r) => r.kind === 'word' || r.kind === 'phrase')).toHaveLength(0);
  const knownBefore = await page.evaluate(() => window.readalong.getVocab().then((v) => Object.keys(v.words).filter((k) => v.words[k] === 'known')));
  await inject(page, 'I know', 'e2e:1');
  // the word of this stop is known now (saved for good)
  await expect.poll(() => page.evaluate((before) => window.readalong.getVocab().then((v) => Object.keys(v.words).filter((k) => v.words[k] === 'known' && !before.includes(k)).length), knownBefore), { timeout: 3000 }).toBe(1);
  const lemma = await page.evaluate((before) => window.readalong.getVocab().then((v) => Object.keys(v.words).find((k) => v.words[k] === 'known' && !before.includes(k))!), knownBefore);
  await expect(page.locator(`.w[data-lemma="${lemma}"].hl-unknown`)).toHaveCount(0);
  await expect(page.getByTestId('command-bar')).toHaveCount(0);
  expect((await requests(page)).some((r) => r.target.toLowerCase() === lemma)).toBe(false);
  await expect(page.getByTestId('play')).toHaveAttribute('aria-label', 'Pause');
  expect(await line(page)).toBe('closed');

  // 2. the next hard word: anything else the learner says in the window is ignored (never sent to the AI);
  //    when the 5 seconds run out the explanation starts on its own
  await expect.poll(async () => (await line(page)) === 'window' && (await phase(page)) === 'before', { timeout: 40000 }).toBe(true);
  await inject(page, 'what is that', 'e2e:2');
  await expect.poll(async () => (await requests(page)).some((r) => r.kind === 'word' || r.kind === 'phrase'), { timeout: 15000 }).toBe(true);
  expect((await requests(page)).some((r) => r.question === 'what is that')).toBe(false);
  const second = (await requests(page)).filter((r) => r.kind === 'word' || r.kind === 'phrase').at(-1)!;

  // 3. after its explanation the window opens again: "I don't know" asks for a second, deeper explanation,
  //    then the window again, where anything else is a question about the sentence
  await expect.poll(async () => (await line(page)) === 'window' && (await phase(page)) === 'after', { timeout: 30000 }).toBe(true);
  await inject(page, "I don't know", 'e2e:3');
  await expect.poll(async () => (await requests(page)).some((r) => r.target === second.target && r.again === true), { timeout: 5000 }).toBe(true);
  await expect.poll(async () => (await line(page)) === 'window' && (await phase(page)) === 'after', { timeout: 30000 }).toBe(true);
  await inject(page, 'what does this mean', 'e2e:4');
  await page.waitForTimeout(500);
  expect((await requests(page)).some((r) => r.question === 'what does this mean')).toBe(false); // the window takes commands only

  // 3b. the keys work in the window too: D before the explanation starts it, Esc after it goes on
  await expect.poll(async () => (await phase(page)) === 'before', { timeout: 60000 }).toBe(true);
  const beforeD = (await requests(page)).length;
  await page.keyboard.press('KeyD');
  await expect.poll(async () => (await requests(page)).length > beforeD, { timeout: 5000 }).toBe(true);
  await expect.poll(async () => phase(page), { timeout: 30000 }).toBe('after');
  await page.keyboard.press('Escape');
  await expect(page.getByTestId('command-bar')).toHaveCount(0);

  // 4. the typed box (no mic needed) sends a question too, and the popover shows both sides
  await page.getByTestId('voice-more').click();
  await expect(page.getByTestId('voice-popover')).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.getByTestId('voice-popover')).toContainText('Pronunciation does not matter, you can type.');
  await expect(page.getByTestId('voice-popover')).not.toContainText(/\bstop\b/i);
  await page.getByTestId('voice-text').fill('Why is the committee angry?');
  await page.getByTestId('voice-send').click();
  await expect.poll(async () => (await requests(page)).some((r) => r.kind === 'question' && r.question === 'Why is the committee angry?'), { timeout: 5000 }).toBe(true);
  await expect(page.getByTestId('voice-popover')).toContainText('Why is the committee angry?');

  // 5. the explanations drawer shows You / Tutor
  await page.getByTestId('transcript-toggle').click();
  await expect(page.getByTestId('transcript')).toContainText('You');
  await expect(page.getByTestId('transcript')).toContainText('Why is the committee angry?');
  await expect(page.locator('.voice-dock.shifted')).toHaveCount(1);
  await page.getByTestId('transcript-toggle').click();

  // 6. the mic button opens a call (M too); a spoken question in the call; "bye bye" closes it
  await page.evaluate(() => (document.activeElement as HTMLElement | null)?.blur()); // the typed box may still have the focus
  await page.keyboard.press('Space'); // pause the book
  await page.keyboard.press('KeyM');
  await expect(page.getByTestId('mic')).toHaveAttribute('data-line', 'call');
  await page.evaluate(() => window.__dreamVoice!.inject({ type: 'speechStart', segmentId: 'e2e:5' }));
  await inject(page, 'is he happy', 'e2e:5');
  await expect.poll(async () => (await requests(page)).some((r) => r.kind === 'question' && r.question === 'is he happy'), { timeout: 5000 }).toBe(true);
  await page.waitForTimeout(1100); // commands are debounced (1 s)
  await inject(page, 'bye bye', 'e2e:6');
  await expect(page.getByTestId('mic')).toHaveAttribute('data-line', 'closed');

  if (SHOT) {
    await page.getByTestId('mic').click(); // the call is open again: the button pulses
    await expect(page.getByTestId('mic')).toHaveAttribute('data-line', 'call');
    await page.getByTestId('voice-text').fill('What does “acrimonious” mean here?');
    await page.waitForTimeout(400);
    await page.screenshot({ path: SHOT });
  }
  await app.close();
});
```

### `test/unit/ai-main.test.ts` (31 lines)

```ts
import { describe, it, expect, vi } from 'vitest';
import fs from 'node:fs';
import os from 'node:os';
import path from 'node:path';
const userData = vi.hoisted(() => { const fs = require('node:fs'); const os = require('node:os'); const path = require('node:path'); return fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'readalong-ai-test-')); });
vi.mock('electron', () => ({ ipcMain: { handle: vi.fn() }, BrowserWindow: class {}, safeStorage: { isEncryptionAvailable: () => false }, app: { getPath: () => userData } }));
import { estimateUsd, classifyError, periodStarts } from '../../src/main/ai';

describe('AI main helpers', () => {
  it('prices models by prefix and charges cached tokens at the cache rate', () => {
    expect(estimateUsd('claude-opus-5-5-20260601', 1_000_000, 0, 0)).toBeCloseTo(4);
    expect(estimateUsd('claude-opus-5-5', 1_000_000, 0, 1_000_000)).toBeCloseTo(0.2);
    expect(estimateUsd('gpt-5-mini-2026-01-01', 0, 1_000_000, 0)).toBeCloseTo(2);
  });
  it('classifies provider errors the learner can act on', () => {
    expect(classifyError(Object.assign(new Error('Request was aborted.'), { name: 'APIUserAbortError' })).code).toBe('cancelled');
    expect(classifyError({ status: 400, message: 'Your credit balance is too low to access the Anthropic API. Please go to Plans & Billing.' }).code).toBe('spend_limit');
    expect(classifyError({ status: 429, message: 'You exceeded your current quota, please check your plan and billing details.' }).code).toBe('spend_limit');
    expect(classifyError({ status: 529, message: 'Overloaded' }).code).toBe('rate_limit');
    expect(classifyError({ status: 401, message: 'invalid x-api-key' }).code).toBe('auth');
    expect(classifyError(new TypeError('fetch failed')).code).toBe('network');
  });
  it('measures the daily and monthly budget from local midnight', () => {
    const { day, month } = periodStarts();
    const d = new Date(day), m = new Date(month), now = new Date();
    expect([d.getHours(), d.getMinutes(), d.getDate(), d.getMonth()]).toEqual([0, 0, now.getDate(), now.getMonth()]);
    expect([m.getHours(), m.getDate(), m.getMonth()]).toEqual([0, 1, now.getMonth()]);
    expect(day <= now.toISOString()).toBe(true);
    expect(fs.existsSync(userData) || os.platform() === 'win32' || path.isAbsolute(userData)).toBe(true);
  });
});
```

```ts
import { describe, it, expect, vi, beforeEach } from 'vitest';

const ctx = vi.hoisted(() => {
  const fs = require('node:fs'); const os = require('node:os'); const path = require('node:path');
  return { userData: fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'readalong-aitest-')), keys: {} as Record<string, string | null> };

vi.mock('electron', () => ({ ipcMain: { handle: vi.fn() }, BrowserWindow: class {}, app: { getPath: () => ctx.userData }, safeStorage: { isEncryptionAvailable: () => false } }));
vi.mock('../../src/main/secrets', async (orig) => {
  const real = await orig<typeof import('../../src/main/secrets')>();
  return { ...real, getSecret: (n: string) => ctx.keys[n] ?? null, hasSecret: (n: string) => n in ctx.keys, getAzureCredentials: () => (ctx.keys.azure ? JSON.parse(ctx.keys.azure) : null) };
});
```

```ts
import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
import { createDictionary } from '@core/dict/dictionary';
import type { DictData, DictRaw } from '@shared/api';
import { annotateSentence, phraseLevel } from '@core/vocab/analysis';
import type { PhraseHit } from '@core/ai/hints';
import { makeBook } from './helpers';

const raw = (l: string, s = 'cefrj', t = 'n. 词'): DictRaw => ({ i: '', t, g: '', f: 5000, b: 5000, c: 3, o: 0, l, s });
const dict = createDictionary({
  w: {
    he: raw('A1'), paid: raw('A1'), lip: raw('A2'), service: raw('B1'), to: raw('A1'), it: raw('A1'), in: raw('A1'), spite: raw('B2'), of: raw('A1'),
    rain: raw('A1'), the: raw('A1'), pay: raw('A1'), was: raw('A1'), red: raw('A1', 'cefrj', 'a. 红的'), tape: raw('A2'), all: raw('A1'), heed: raw('C1'), take: raw('A1'),
    'lip service': raw('C1', 'est', 'n. 口惠'),
    'in spite of': raw('C1', 'est', '不管'),
    'red tape': raw('C1', 'est', 'phr. 官样文章'),
    'take heed': raw('C2', 'oct', '注意'),
    'look forward to': raw('B1', 'est', '期望'), look: raw('A1'), forward: raw('A2'),
  },
  f: { paid: 'pay' },
} as DictData);

const book = makeBook([{ title: 'x', paragraphs: ['He paid lip service to it. In spite of the rain. It was all red tape. Take heed.'] }]);
const para = book.chapters[0].paragraphs[0];
const ann = (si: number, learner: 'A2' | 'B1' | 'B2' | 'C1', hits: PhraseHit[] = []) => annotateSentence(para, para.sentences[si], dict, new Set(), learner, hits);
const hit = (si: number, start: number, end: number, lemma: string, level: PhraseHit['level']): PhraseHit => {
  const toks = para.sentences[si].tokens;
  return { sentenceKey: `0.0.${si}`, start, end, text: para.text.slice(toks[start].start, toks[end].end), lemma, level, zh: '意思' };
};

describe('phraseLevel', () => {
  it('derives an estimated phrase level from its hardest word, at least B1, never above the estimate', () => {
    expect(phraseLevel(dict.lookupPhrase(['lip', 'service'])!, dict)).toBe('B1');
    expect(phraseLevel(dict.lookupPhrase(['in', 'spite', 'of'])!, dict)).toBe('B2');
    expect(phraseLevel(dict.lookupPhrase(['red', 'tape'])!, dict)).toBe('B1');          // idiom-marked: the B1 floor
    expect(phraseLevel(dict.lookupPhrase(['look', 'forward', 'to'])!, dict)).toBe('B1');
  });
  it('keeps a level that comes from a CEFR list', () => {
    expect(phraseLevel(dict.lookupPhrase(['take', 'heed'])!, dict)).toBe('C2');
  });
});

describe('annotateSentence with the chapter job\'s phrases', () => {
  it('an estimated dictionary phrase is not above-level from its estimate alone', () => {
    const a = ann(0, 'B1');
    expect(a.phrases.map((p) => [p.result.lemma, p.level, p.confirmed, p.above])).toEqual([['lip service', 'B1', false, false]]);
    expect(ann(1, 'B1').phrases.map((p) => [p.result.lemma, p.above])).toEqual([['in spite of', true]]);   // B2 from 'spite'
    expect(ann(3, 'C1').phrases.map((p) => [p.result.lemma, p.above])).toEqual([['take heed', true]]);   // Octanove C2
  });
  it('the chapter job confirms a dictionary phrase with its own level', () => {
    const a = ann(0, 'B1', [hit(0, 2, 3, 'lip service', 'C1')]);
    expect(a.phrases.map((p) => [p.result.lemma, p.level, p.confirmed, p.above])).toEqual([['lip service', 'C1', true, true]]);
    expect(a.aiPhrases).toEqual([]);   // the same span is reported once, as the dictionary phrase
    // a confirmation by lemma over overlapping tokens counts too ("paid lip service" -> lemma "lip service")
    const b = ann(0, 'B1', [hit(0, 1, 3, 'lip service', 'B2')]);
    expect(b.phrases[0]).toMatchObject({ level: 'B2', confirmed: true, above: true });
    expect(b.aiPhrases.map((h) => h.text)).toEqual(['paid lip service']);
  });
  it('lists AI phrases with their above flag and leaves the words of an above-level one to the phrase', () => {
    const toks = para.sentences[0].tokens;
    const idx = (w: string) => toks.findIndex((t) => t.text === w);
    const h = hit(0, idx('paid'), idx('to'), 'pay lip service to', 'C1');
    const a = ann(0, 'A2', [h]);
    expect(a.aiPhrases).toEqual([{ ...h, above: true }]);
    for (let i = h.start; i <= h.end; i++) expect(a.hardTokens).not.toContain(i);
    // at C1 the phrase is not above
    const c = ann(0, 'C1', [h]);
    expect(c.aiPhrases[0].above).toBe(false);
  });
});
```

```ts
import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
import { gunzipSync } from 'node:zlib';
import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
import type { DictData, DictRaw } from '@shared/api';
import type { Book, Chapter, Paragraph, ParagraphKind, Sentence, Token } from '@core/model';
import { createDictionary } from '@core/dict/dictionary';
import { detectNames, nameKey } from '@core/dict/names';
import { analyzeToken, isAboveLevel, findPhrases, annotateSentence, type WordInfo } from '@core/vocab/analysis';
import { createSegmenter } from '@core/segment';

const DATA_PATH = fileURLToPath(new URL('../../resources/dict/dict.json.gz', import.meta.url));
const data = JSON.parse(gunzipSync(readFileSync(DATA_PATH)).toString('utf8')) as DictData;
const dict = createDictionary(data);

/* --- a tiny tokenizer / book builder for fixtures (the real Segmenter lives in another module) --- */

const TOKEN_RE = /[\p{L}\p{N}]+(?:['’-][\p{L}\p{N}]+)*|\s+|[^\s\p{L}\p{N}]/gu;

function tokenize(text: string, offset = 0): Token[] {
  const out: Token[] = [];
  for (const m of text.matchAll(TOKEN_RE)) {
    const t = m[0];
    const kind: Token['kind'] = /^\s/.test(t) ? 'space' : /^\p{N}/u.test(t) ? 'number' : /^\p{L}/u.test(t) ? 'word' : 'punct';
    out.push({ start: offset + m.index!, end: offset + m.index! + t.length, text: t, kind });
  }
  return out;
}

/** Each string is one sentence; the paragraph text joins them with single spaces. */
function para(sentences: string[], kind: ParagraphKind = 'p', index = 0): Paragraph {
  const text = sentences.join(' ');
  const out: Sentence[] = [];
  let pos = 0;
  sentences.forEach((s, i) => {
    out.push({ index: i, start: pos, end: pos + s.length, tokens: tokenize(s, pos) });
    pos += s.length + 1;
  });
  return { index, kind, text, sentences: out };
}

function book(paragraphs: Paragraph[]): Pick<Book, 'chapters'> {
  const chapter: Chapter = { index: 0, title: 'One', paragraphs: paragraphs.map((p, i) => ({ ...p, index: i })) };
  return { chapters: [chapter] };
}

const wordIdx = (tokens: Token[], text: string): number => tokens.findIndex((t) => t.text === text);

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ */

describe('detectNames', () => {
  const b = book([
    para(['CHAPTER I'], 'h1'),
    para(['The Meryton Assembly'], 'h2'),
    para([
      'It is a truth universally acknowledged that a single man must be in want of a wife.',
      'Mr. Darcy looked at Elizabeth, and Elizabeth looked back at him.',
      'The house at Netherfield was large.',
      'Netherfield is three miles from Longbourn.',
      '"Yes," said Jane, "He is very handsome."',
      'The truth was that the house was cold.',
      'Elizabeth laughed at Darcy’s pride.',
      'Miss Bennet smiled at Lady Catherine and Sir William.',
      'Will you come to the assembly on Monday?',
      'I will, said Will, who had the will to go.',
      'They walked to LONDON and back.',
    ]),
    para(['Chapter Two'], 'h1'),
    para(['He said: "The weather was fine." The weather was indeed fine, said He.']),
  ]);
  const names = detectNames(b, dict);

  it('finds titled, repeated and unknown proper nouns', () => {
    expect(names).toContain('darcy');        // after "Mr." and unknown to the dictionary
    expect(names).toContain('elizabeth');    // repeated mid-sentence (in the dictionary, bnc > 0)
    expect(names).toContain('netherfield');  // unknown to the dictionary, once mid-sentence
    expect(names).toContain('longbourn');
    expect(names).toContain('bennet');       // after "Miss"
    expect(names).toContain('catherine');    // after "Lady"
    expect(names).toContain('william');      // after "Sir"
    // 'Jane' occurs once mid-sentence and the dictionary knows it (BNC rank, est level): one sighting is not enough
    expect(names).not.toContain('jane');
  });

  it('accepts a dictionary-known name once it is seen twice where capitals are not conventional', () => {
    const b2 = book([para(['"Yes," said Jane, "he is handsome."', 'Then Jane left.', 'Everyone liked Jane.'])]);
    expect(detectNames(b2, dict)).toEqual(['jane']);
  });

  it('never marks sentence-initial, all-caps, quoted-initial or common words', () => {
    expect(names).not.toContain('the');
    expect(names).not.toContain('it');
    expect(names).not.toContain('he');       // only after an opening quote / colon / period
    expect(names).not.toContain('yes');
    expect(names).not.toContain('chapter');  // all-caps and heading-initial only
    expect(names).not.toContain('i');
    expect(names).not.toContain('will');     // used in lower case more often than as a name
    expect(names).not.toContain('assembly'); // in the dictionary with frequency, seen once in a heading only
    expect(names).not.toContain('london');   // ALL-CAPS only
    expect(names).not.toContain('mr');       // honorifics are never names
    expect(names).not.toContain('miss');

      { start: 0, end: 3, text: 'She', kind: 'word' }, { start: 3, end: 4, text: ' ', kind: 'space' },
      { start: 4, end: 7, text: 'met', kind: 'word' }, { start: 7, end: 8, text: ' ', kind: 'space' },
      { start: 8, end: 11, text: 'Mr.', kind: 'word' }, { start: 11, end: 12, text: ' ', kind: 'space' },
      { start: 12, end: 19, text: 'Collins', kind: 'word' }, { start: 19, end: 20, text: '.', kind: 'punct' },
    ] }] };
    expect(detectNames(book([p]), dict)).toEqual(['collins']);
  });

  it('marks words ECDICT knows only as obscure terms (no frequency, no BNC rank, no tags)', () => {
    // synthesise such an entry to assert the rule independently of what the real data happens to contain
    const d = createDictionary({ w: {
      the: { i: '', t: 'art. 那', g: 'zk', f: 1, b: 1, c: 5, o: 1, l: 'A1', s: 'cefrj' },
      darcy: { i: '', t: 'n. 达西(渗透率单位)', g: '', f: 0, b: 0, c: 0, o: 0, l: 'C2', s: 'est' },
      garden: { i: '', t: 'n. 花园', g: 'zk', f: 900, b: 900, c: 4, o: 1, l: 'A1', s: 'cefrj' },
    }, f: {} });
    const b4 = book([para(['They walked past Darcy into the Garden.'])]);
    expect(detectNames(b4, d)).toEqual(['darcy']);
  });

  it('handles an empty book', () => {
    expect(detectNames({ chapters: [] }, dict)).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('nameKey', () => {
    expect(nameKey("Darcy’s")).toBe('darcy');
    expect(nameKey('Mr.')).toBe('mr');
    expect(nameKey('I')).toBeNull();
    expect(nameKey("I'm")).toBeNull();
    expect(nameKey('A')).toBeNull();
    expect(nameKey('O’Brien')).toBe("o'brien");
    expect(nameKey('42')).toBeNull();
  });
});

describe('analyzeToken / isAboveLevel', () => {
  const names = new Set(['darcy', 'elizabeth', 'grace']);
  const tok = (text: string, kind: Token['kind'] = 'word'): Token => ({ start: 0, end: text.length, text, kind });

  it('fills WordInfo from the dictionary', () => {
    const info = analyzeToken(tok('houses'), false, dict, names);
    expect(info).toMatchObject({ lemma: 'house', level: data.w.house.l, levelSource: 'cefrj', isName: false, inDict: true });
    expect(info.entry!.word).toBe('house');
  });

  it('marks names only when capitalised, and unknown capitalised words mid-sentence', () => {
    expect(analyzeToken(tok('Darcy'), false, dict, names).isName).toBe(true);
    expect(analyzeToken(tok("Darcy's"), false, dict, names).isName).toBe(true);
    expect(analyzeToken(tok('Darcy'), true, dict, names).isName).toBe(true);     // in the book's list: also at sentence start
    expect(analyzeToken(tok('DARCY'), false, dict, names).isName).toBe(true);
    expect(analyzeToken(tok('Grace'), false, dict, names).isName).toBe(true);
    expect(analyzeToken(tok('grace'), false, dict, names).isName).toBe(false);   // lower case: the common noun
    expect(analyzeToken(tok('Pemberley'), false, dict, names).isName).toBe(true);  // unknown + capitalised + mid-sentence
    expect(analyzeToken(tok('Pemberley'), true, dict, names).isName).toBe(false);  // sentence start: no evidence
    expect(analyzeToken(tok('The'), true, dict, names).isName).toBe(false);
    expect(analyzeToken(tok('House'), false, dict, names).isName).toBe(false);
  });

  it('gives non-word and unknown tokens a null level and a fallback lemma', () => {
    expect(analyzeToken(tok('1813', 'number'), false, dict, names)).toMatchObject({ lemma: '1813', level: null, levelSource: null, inDict: false, entry: null, isName: false });
    expect(analyzeToken(tok('Xyzzyq'), true, dict, names)).toMatchObject({ lemma: 'xyzzyq', level: null, inDict: false });
    expect(analyzeToken(tok('Façades'), true, dict, names).lemma).toBe('facade');
  });

  const info = (o: Partial<WordInfo>): WordInfo => ({ lemma: 'x', level: 'C1', levelSource: 'cefrj', isName: false, inDict: true, entry: null, ...o });
  const entry = (o: Partial<NonNullable<WordInfo['entry']>>) => ({ word: 'x', ipa: '', zh: 'n. 东西', tags: [], frq: 10, bnc: 10, collins: 0, oxford: false, level: 'C1' as const, levelSource: 'cefrj' as const, ...o });

  it('isAboveLevel compares strictly and ignores names and unknown levels', () => {
    expect(isAboveLevel(info({ level: 'C1' }), 'B2')).toBe(true);
    expect(isAboveLevel(info({ level: 'B2' }), 'B2')).toBe(false);
    expect(isAboveLevel(info({ level: 'A1' }), 'B2')).toBe(false);
    expect(isAboveLevel(info({ level: 'C2' }), 'C2')).toBe(false);
    expect(isAboveLevel(info({ level: 'A2' }), 'A1')).toBe(true);
    expect(isAboveLevel(info({ level: null, levelSource: null, inDict: false }), 'A1')).toBe(false);
    expect(isAboveLevel(info({ level: 'C2', isName: true }), 'A1')).toBe(false);
  });

  it('treats estimated C2 with no corpus frequency as above only when there is a gloss', () => {
    const rare = info({ level: 'C2', levelSource: 'est', entry: entry({ level: 'C2', levelSource: 'est', frq: 0, zh: 'n. 稀有词' }) });
    expect(isAboveLevel(rare, 'B2')).toBe(true);
    const junk = info({ level: 'C2', levelSource: 'est', entry: entry({ level: 'C2', levelSource: 'est', frq: 0, zh: '  ' }) });
    expect(isAboveLevel(junk, 'B2')).toBe(false);
    const rareWithFreq = info({ level: 'C2', levelSource: 'est', entry: entry({ level: 'C2', levelSource: 'est', frq: 30000, zh: '' }) });
    expect(isAboveLevel(rareWithFreq, 'B2')).toBe(true);
    const listedC2 = info({ level: 'C2', levelSource: 'oct', entry: entry({ level: 'C2', levelSource: 'oct', frq: 0, zh: '' }) });
    expect(isAboveLevel(listedC2, 'B2')).toBe(true);
  });

  it('applies the rule to real entries', () => {
    const acr = analyzeToken(tok('acrimonious'), false, dict, names);
    expect(acr.level).toBe(data.w.acrimonious.l);
    expect(isAboveLevel(acr, 'B2')).toBe(acr.level === 'C1' || acr.level === 'C2');
    const house = analyzeToken(tok('house'), false, dict, names);
    expect(isAboveLevel(house, 'A1')).toBe(false);
    expect(isAboveLevel(analyzeToken(tok('ubiquitous'), false, dict, names), 'B1')).toBe(true);
  });
});

describe('findPhrases', () => {
  it('finds the longest non-overlapping dictionary phrases over space-separated words', () => {
    const tokens = tokenize('We look forward to seeing you, in spite of the rain, according to plan.');
    const found = findPhrases(tokens, dict);
    const lemmas = found.map((p) => p.result.lemma);
    expect(lemmas).toContain('look forward to');
    expect(lemmas).toContain('in spite of');
    expect(lemmas).toContain('according to');
    const lf = found.find((p) => p.result.lemma === 'look forward to')!;
    expect(lf.words).toBe(3);
    expect(tokens.slice(lf.start, lf.end).map((t) => t.text).join('')).toBe('look forward to');
    // non-overlapping and in order
    for (let i = 1; i < found.length; i++) expect(found[i].start).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(found[i - 1].end);
  });

  it('lemmatises the words of a phrase', () => {
    const tokens = tokenize('She was looking forward to it.');
    expect(findPhrases(tokens, dict).map((p) => p.result.lemma)).toEqual(['look forward to']);
    expect(findPhrases(tokens, dict)[0].result.via).toBe('form');
  });

  it('does not cross punctuation and copes with short input', () => {
    expect(findPhrases(tokenize('look, forward to'), dict).map((p) => p.result.lemma)).not.toContain('look forward to');
    expect(findPhrases(tokenize('look'), dict)).toEqual([]);
    expect(findPhrases([], dict)).toEqual([]);
    expect(findPhrases(tokenize('The old house stood alone.'), dict)).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('prefers the longest match at a position', () => {
    // 'in spite of' (3) beats any 2-word phrase starting at 'in'
    const tokens = tokenize('in spite of');
    const found = findPhrases(tokens, dict);
    expect(found).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(found[0].words).toBe(3);
  });
});

describe('annotateSentence', () => {
  const names = new Set(detectNames(book([para(['Elizabeth looked at Mr. Darcy.', 'Darcy and Elizabeth talked.', 'He liked Elizabeth.'])]), dict));
  const raw = (l: string, s = 'cefrj'): DictRaw => ({ i: '', t: 'n. 词', g: '', f: 100, b: 100, c: 0, o: 0, l, s });

  it('flags words above the learner level, not names or easy words', () => {
    const p = para(['Their acrimonious debate left the house in a melancholy silence, said Darcy.']);
    const s = p.sentences[0];
    const a = annotateSentence(p, s, dict, names, 'B2');
    expect(a.infos).toHaveLength(s.tokens.length);
    s.tokens.forEach((t, i) => expect(a.infos[i] === null).toBe(t.kind !== 'word'));
    const hard = a.hardTokens.map((i) => s.tokens[i].text);
    expect(hard).toContain('acrimonious');            // C1 in the data
    expect(hard).not.toContain('house');
    expect(hard).not.toContain('Darcy');
    expect(hard).not.toContain('Their');
    // 'melancholy' is C2 (Octanove) in this data set, so it IS above B2; it would not be for a C2 learner
    expect(data.w.melancholy.l).toBe('C2');
    expect(hard).toContain('melancholy');
    expect(annotateSentence(p, s, dict, names, 'C2').hardTokens).toEqual([]);
    const a1 = annotateSentence(p, s, dict, names, 'A1');
    expect(a1.hardTokens.map((i) => s.tokens[i].text)).toContain('debate');
    expect(a1.hardTokens.map((i) => s.tokens[i].text)).not.toContain('Darcy');
  });

  it('marks the first word token as sentence-first and names from the book list', () => {
    const p = para(['Darcy walked to Pemberley with Elizabeth.']);
    const s = p.sentences[0];
    const a = annotateSentence(p, s, dict, names, 'B2');
    expect(a.infos[wordIdx(s.tokens, 'Darcy')]!.isName).toBe(true);        // in the list, even at sentence start
    expect(a.infos[wordIdx(s.tokens, 'Pemberley')]!.isName).toBe(true);    // unknown mid-sentence
    expect(a.infos[wordIdx(s.tokens, 'Elizabeth')]!.isName).toBe(true);
    expect(a.infos[wordIdx(s.tokens, 'walked')]!.lemma).toBe('walk');
    expect(a.hardTokens).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('returns phrase spans with their own above-level flag and leaves their words to the phrase', () => {
    const p = para(['In spite of the rain we look forward to the trip.']);
    const s = p.sentences[0];
    const a = annotateSentence(p, s, dict, names, 'B2');
    const byLemma = Object.fromEntries(a.phrases.map((x) => [x.result.lemma, x]));
    expect(byLemma['in spite of']).toBeDefined();
    expect(byLemma['look forward to']).toBeDefined();
    // 'in spite of' is an estimated C1 in the data; its level is derived from its hardest word ('spite' B2)
    expect(data.w['in spite of'].s).toBe('est');
    expect(byLemma['in spite of'].level).toBe('B2');
    expect(byLemma['in spite of'].above).toBe(false);
    expect(byLemma['look forward to'].above).toBe(false);   // B1 in the data
    // words inside an above-level phrase are left to the phrase; words inside an easy phrase keep their own flag
    for (const ph of a.phrases) {
      for (let i = ph.start; i < ph.end; i++) {
        if (ph.above) expect(a.hardTokens).not.toContain(i);
        else if (a.infos[i] && isAboveLevel(a.infos[i]!, 'B2')) expect(a.hardTokens).toContain(i);
      }
    }
  });

  it('keeps word flags inside easy phrases and drops them inside hard phrases (synthetic levels)', () => {
    const d = createDictionary({ w: {
      we: raw('A1'), take: raw('A1'), heed: raw('C1'), 'take heed': raw('C2', 'oct'),
      in: raw('A1'), lieu: raw('C2', 'oct'), of: raw('A1'), 'in lieu of': raw('B1', 'est'), advice: raw('A2'),
    }, f: {} });
    const p = para(['We take heed in lieu of advice.']);
    const s = p.sentences[0];
    const a = annotateSentence(p, s, d, new Set(), 'B2');
    expect(a.phrases.map((x) => [x.result.lemma, x.above])).toEqual([['take heed', true], ['in lieu of', false]]);
    const hard = a.hardTokens.map((i) => s.tokens[i].text);
    expect(hard).toEqual(['lieu']);   // 'heed' (C1) is explained as part of 'take heed'; 'lieu' (C2) stays its own stop
  });

  it('handles a sentence with no word tokens', () => {
    const p = para(['...']);
    const a = annotateSentence(p, p.sentences[0], dict, names, 'B2');
    expect(a.infos.length).toBe(p.sentences[0].tokens.length);
    expect(a.infos.every((x) => x === null)).toBe(true);
    expect(a.phrases).toEqual([]);
    expect(a.hardTokens).toEqual([]);
  });
});

describe('phrase spans on real segmenter output (no whitespace tokens)', () => {
  const seg = createSegmenter();
  const realPara = (text: string): Paragraph => ({ index: 0, kind: 'p', text, sentences: seg.segmentParagraph(text) });
  const spans = (text: string, learner: 'A1' | 'B1' | 'B2' | 'C1' = 'B2') => {
    const p = realPara(text);
    return p.sentences.flatMap((s) => annotateSentence(p, s, dict, new Set(), learner).phrases.map((ph) => ({
      lemma: ph.result.lemma,
      above: ph.above,
      // `end` is exclusive: the covered text runs from tokens[start] to tokens[end - 1]
      text: p.text.slice(s.tokens[ph.start].start, s.tokens[ph.end - 1].end),
    })));
  };

  it('finds no phrase in the Old Man and the Sea sentences ("old man" is a free combination)', () => {
    expect(spans('He was an old man who fished alone in a skiff in the Gulf Stream and he had gone eighty-four days now without taking a fish.', 'A1')).toEqual([]);
    expect(spans("In the first forty days a boy had been with him. But after forty days without a fish the boy's parents had told him that the old man was now definitely and finally salao.", 'A1')).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('covers exactly the phrase words, never the following token', () => {
    const found = spans('In spite of the storm, he paid lip service to the rules and spoke of red tape.');
    expect(found.map((f) => f.text)).toEqual(['In spite of', 'lip service', 'red tape']);
    // all estimated C1 in the data; judged at their derived levels (in spite of B2, lip service B1, red tape B1)
    expect(found.every((f) => !f.above)).toBe(true);
    expect(spans('In spite of the storm, he paid lip service to the rules and spoke of red tape.', 'B1').map((f) => [f.lemma, f.above]))
      .toEqual([['in spite of', true], ['lip service', false], ['red tape', false]]);
    // 'look forward to' is B1: found, but not above a B1 learner
    expect(spans('We look forward to it.', 'B1')).toEqual([{ lemma: 'look forward to', above: false, text: 'look forward to' }]);
    expect(spans('We look forward to it.', 'A1')[0].above).toBe(true);
  });

  it('genuine phrases above B2 match; ones absent from the data do not', () => {
    // 'give up on' and 'take (sth) for granted' are not in this data set
    expect(data.w['give up on']).toBeUndefined();
    expect(data.w['take for granted']).toBeUndefined();
    expect(spans('Never give up on it; we take nothing for granted.')).toEqual([]);
    expect(spans('In spite of everything, his frame of mind improved.', 'B1').map((f) => [f.lemma, f.above])).toEqual([['in spite of', true], ['frame of mind', false]]);
    expect(spans('It was a bona fide offer.', 'C1').map((f) => [f.lemma, f.above])).toEqual([['bona fide', true]]);   // C2 (Octanove)
    expect(spans('In spite of everything.', 'C1')[0].above).toBe(false);
  });
});
```

```ts
import { describe, it, expect, beforeEach, afterEach, vi } from 'vitest';
import type { CloudTtsResult, WordTiming } from '@shared/api';
import { synthesisSegments, PRIORITY } from '@core/tts/segments';

/** An audio element that plays for SEG_SEC seconds of (fake) time and reports currentTime from the clock. */
const SEG_SEC = 2;
class FakeAudio {
  static instances: FakeAudio[] = [];
  preload = ''; preservesPitch = false; playbackRate = 1; duration = SEG_SEC;
  loads = 0; plays = 0; startedAt = -1; private timer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null;
  onplaying: (() => void) | null = null; onended: (() => void) | null = null; onerror: (() => void) | null = null;
  constructor(public src: string) { FakeAudio.instances.push(this); }
  get currentTime(): number { return this.startedAt < 0 ? 0 : Math.min(SEG_SEC, ((Date.now() - this.startedAt) / 1000) * this.playbackRate); }
  load() { this.loads++; }
  play() {
    this.plays++; this.startedAt = Date.now();
    this.onplaying?.();
    this.timer = setTimeout(() => this.onended?.(), (SEG_SEC * 1000) / this.playbackRate);
    return Promise.resolve();
  }
  pause() { if (this.timer) clearTimeout(this.timer); this.timer = null; }
}
Object.assign(globalThis, {
  Audio: FakeAudio,
  requestAnimationFrame: (cb: (t: number) => void) => setTimeout(() => cb(Date.now()), 16),
  cancelAnimationFrame: (id: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>) => clearTimeout(id),
});
const { AudioTtsEngine } = await import('@core/tts/audio');

/** word timings for a piece of text: one word every 0.3 s, as the main process returns them */
function timings(text: string): WordTiming[] {
  return [...text.matchAll(/[\p{L}\p{N}’']+/gu)].map((m, i) => ({ start: Math.min(SEG_SEC - 0.01, i * 0.1), end: Math.min(SEG_SEC, i * 0.1 + 0.08), charIndex: m.index!, charLength: m[0].length }));
}
const result = (text: string): CloudTtsResult => ({ audio: new ArrayBuffer(16), mime: 'audio/wav', timings: timings(text.trim()), durationSec: SEG_SEC });

/** a serial synthesizer like the main process: each request takes `ms` after the previous one */
function serialSynth(ms: number) {
  const calls: { text: string; at: number }[] = [];
  let free = 0;
  const fn = (_e: string, text: string) => {
    const start = Math.max(Date.now(), free);
    free = start + ms;
    calls.push({ text, at: Date.now() });
    return new Promise<CloudTtsResult>((r) => setTimeout(() => r(result(text)), free - Date.now()));
  };
  return { fn, calls };
}

const LONG = '“Why, my dear, you must know, Mrs. Long says that Netherfield is taken by a young man of large fortune from the north of England; that he came down on Monday in a chaise and four to see the place, and was so much delighted with it, that he agreed with Mr. Morris immediately; that he is to take possession before Michaelmas, and some of his servants are to be in the house by the end of next week.”';

describe('AudioTtsEngine: long sentences in segments', () => {
  beforeEach(() => { FakeAudio.instances.length = 0; vi.useFakeTimers({ now: 0 }); });
  afterEach(() => { vi.useRealTimers(); });

  it('starts after the first segment is synthesized and plays the rest back to back with sentence word offsets', async () => {
    const synth = serialSynth(1000); // 1 s of synthesis per segment
    const e = new AudioTtsEngine('kokoro', synth.fn, async () => [], true, { segment: true });
    const segs = synthesisSegments(LONG);
    expect(segs.length).toBe(3);
    const words: string[] = [];
    let startedAt = -1;
    const h = e.speak(LONG, { voiceId: 'bf_emma', rate: 1, onStart: () => { startedAt = Date.now(); }, onWord: (i, n) => words.push(LONG.slice(i, i + n)) });
    // every segment is requested at once, in order
    expect(synth.calls.map((c) => c.text)).toEqual(segs.map((s) => s.text));
    await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(1000);
    expect(startedAt).toBe(1000); // not 3000: the first segment plays while the others are synthesized
    expect(FakeAudio.instances.filter((a) => a.plays).length).toBe(1);
    await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(SEG_SEC * 1000 * 3 + 100);
    expect(await h.done).toBe('ended');
    const played = FakeAudio.instances.filter((a) => a.plays);
    expect(played.map((a) => a.startedAt)).toEqual([1000, 3000, 5000]); // no gap between segments
    expect(words).toEqual([...LONG.matchAll(/[\p{L}\p{N}’']+/gu)].map((m) => m[0])); // every word, in order, sentence offsets
  });

  it('a short sentence is one request, as before', async () => {
    const synth = serialSynth(500);
    const e = new AudioTtsEngine('kokoro', synth.fn, async () => [], true, { segment: true });
    const h = e.speak('A short one.', { voiceId: 'v', rate: 1 });
    await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(3000);
    expect(await h.done).toBe('ended');
    expect(synth.calls.map((c) => c.text)).toEqual(['A short one.']);
  });

  it('the speed set while a long sentence plays applies to its next segments', async () => {
    const synth = serialSynth(100);
    const e = new AudioTtsEngine('kokoro', synth.fn, async () => [], true, { segment: true });
    const h = e.speak(LONG, { voiceId: 'v', rate: 1 });
    await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(150);
    e.setRate(2);
    await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(10_000);
    expect(await h.done).toBe('ended');
    expect(FakeAudio.instances.filter((a) => a.plays).map((a) => a.playbackRate)).toEqual([2, 2, 2]);
  });
});

describe('AudioTtsEngine: the next sentence is ready before it is needed', () => {
  beforeEach(() => { FakeAudio.instances.length = 0; vi.useFakeTimers({ now: 0 }); });
  afterEach(() => { vi.useRealTimers(); });

  it('readAhead fetches and pre-decodes the next sentence; speak() then only calls play()', async () => {
    const synth = serialSynth(800);
    const prepared: unknown[][] = [];
    const prepare = async (items: unknown[]) => { prepared.push(items); return true; };
    const e = new AudioTtsEngine('kokoro', synth.fn, async () => [], true, { segment: true, prepare });
    const cur = e.speak('The current sentence.', { voiceId: 'v', rate: 1 });
    e.readAhead(['The next sentence.', 'And the one after.'], 'v', 1);
    await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(1700); // current ready at 800, next at 1600 (fetched after "ready")
    const next = FakeAudio.instances.find((a) => a.plays === 0)!;
    expect(next).toBeDefined();
    expect(next.loads).toBe(1); // loaded (decoded) while the current one plays
    expect(next.preload).toBe('auto');
    await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(SEG_SEC * 1000);
    expect(await cur.done).toBe('ended');
    const count = FakeAudio.instances.length;
    const h = e.speak('The next sentence.', { voiceId: 'v', rate: 1 });
    await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(0);
    expect(FakeAudio.instances.length).toBe(count); // no new element, no new request
    expect(next.plays).toBe(1);
    expect(e.lastStartDelayMs).toBe(0);
    expect(synth.calls.map((c) => c.text)).toEqual(['The current sentence.', 'The next sentence.']);
    h.cancel();
  });

  it('local voice: the read-ahead list replaces the previous one with priorities by distance; the next is awaited, never requested as now', async () => {
    const synth = serialSynth(100);
    const prepared: { text: string; priority?: number; wait?: boolean; replace?: boolean }[][] = [];
    let release!: (v: boolean) => void;
    const prepare = (items: { text: string }[]) => { prepared.push(items); return items.some((i) => (i as { wait?: boolean }).wait) ? new Promise<boolean>((r) => { release = r; }) : Promise.resolve(true); };
    const e = new AudioTtsEngine('kokoro', synth.fn, async () => [], true, { segment: true, prepare });
    e.readAhead(['B.', 'C.', 'D.'], 'v', 1);
    expect(prepared[0]).toEqual([{ text: '', replace: true }, { text: 'B.', voice: 'v', speed: 1, priority: PRIORITY.ahead - 1 }, { text: 'C.', voice: 'v', speed: 1, priority: PRIORITY.ahead - 2 }, { text: 'D.', voice: 'v', speed: 1, priority: PRIORITY.ahead - 3 }]);
    expect(prepared[1]).toEqual([{ text: 'B.', voice: 'v', speed: 1, priority: PRIORITY.next, wait: true }]);
    await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(500);
    expect(synth.calls).toEqual([]); // nothing requested as 'now' while the main process works on it
    release(true);
    await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(200);
    expect(synth.calls.map((c) => c.text)).toEqual(['B.']); // fetched (a memory hit in the main process) and decoded
    e.stopReadAhead();
    expect(prepared[2]).toEqual([{ text: '', replace: true }]);
  });

  it('a read-ahead dropped by the main process (false) is not fetched', async () => {
    const synth = serialSynth(100);
    const e = new AudioTtsEngine('kokoro', synth.fn, async () => [], true, { segment: true, prepare: async (items) => (items.some((i) => i.wait) ? false : true) });
    e.readAhead(['B.'], 'v', 1);
    await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(500);
    expect(synth.calls).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('cloud voices fetch only the next two sentences (they cost money)', async () => {
    const synth = serialSynth(100);
    const e = new AudioTtsEngine('edge', synth.fn, async () => [], true);
    e.readAhead(['B.', 'C.', 'D.', 'E.'], 'v', 1);
    await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(500);
    expect(synth.calls.map((c) => c.text)).toEqual(['B.', 'C.']);
  });

  it('cancelAll forgets requests nobody waits for and tells the local queue', async () => {
    const synth = serialSynth(1000);
    const prepared: unknown[][] = [];
    const e = new AudioTtsEngine('kokoro', synth.fn, async () => [], true, { segment: true, prepare: async (items) => { prepared.push(items); return true; } });
    const h = e.speak('First.', { voiceId: 'v', rate: 1 });
    e.cancelAll();
    expect(await h.done).toBe('cancelled');
    expect(prepared).toEqual([[{ text: '', release: true }]]);
    // a new speak() of the same text asks again (the main process re-raises its priority) instead of reusing the stale request
    e.speak('First.', { voiceId: 'v', rate: 1 }).cancel();
    expect(synth.calls.map((c) => c.text)).toEqual(['First.', 'First.']);
  });
});
```

### `test/unit/audio.test.ts` (58 lines)

```ts
import { describe, it, expect, beforeEach } from 'vitest';
import type { CloudTtsResult } from '@shared/api';

class FakeAudio {
  static instances: FakeAudio[] = [];
  preservesPitch = false; playbackRate = 1; currentTime = 0; duration = 2; played = 0;
  onplaying: (() => void) | null = null; onended: (() => void) | null = null; onerror: (() => void) | null = null;
  constructor(public src: string) { FakeAudio.instances.push(this); }
  play() { this.played++; this.onplaying?.(); return Promise.resolve(); }
  pause() { /* noop */ }
}
Object.assign(globalThis, {
  Audio: FakeAudio,
  requestAnimationFrame: (cb: (t: number) => void) => setTimeout(() => cb(performance.now()), 4),
  cancelAnimationFrame: (id: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>) => clearTimeout(id),
});
const { AudioTtsEngine } = await import('@core/tts/audio');
const sleep = (ms: number) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms));
const result = (timings: CloudTtsResult['timings']): CloudTtsResult => ({ audio: new ArrayBuffer(16), mime: 'audio/mpeg', timings, durationSec: null });

describe('AudioTtsEngine', () => {
  beforeEach(() => { FakeAudio.instances.length = 0; });

  it('cancelAll() while the audio is still being synthesized prevents it from playing later', async () => {
    let resolve!: (r: CloudTtsResult) => void;
    const e = new AudioTtsEngine('edge', () => new Promise((r) => { resolve = r; }), async () => [], true);
    const h = e.speak('Hello there', { voiceId: 'v', rate: 1 });
    e.cancelAll();
    resolve(result(null));
    expect(await h.done).toBe('cancelled');
    await sleep(10);
    expect(FakeAudio.instances.reduce((n, a) => n + a.played, 0)).toBe(0);
  });

  it('falls back to estimated word timing when the provider returns an empty timing list', async () => {
    const e = new AudioTtsEngine('elevenlabs', async () => result([]), async () => [], true);
    const words: number[] = [];
    const h = e.speak('Hello there friend', { voiceId: 'v', rate: 1, onWord: (i) => words.push(i) });
    await sleep(20);
    FakeAudio.instances[0].currentTime = 1.99;
    await sleep(20);
    expect(words).toEqual([0, 6, 12]);
    FakeAudio.instances[0].onended?.();
    expect(await h.done).toBe('ended');
  });

  it('maps provider timings back to the untrimmed text it was asked to speak', async () => {
    // the main process trims the text before synthesis; charIndex must still index the renderer's text
    const e = new AudioTtsEngine('edge', async () => result([{ start: 0, end: 0.1, charIndex: 0, charLength: 5 }, { start: 0.5, end: 0.6, charIndex: 6, charLength: 5 }]), async () => [], true);
    const words: number[] = [];
    const h = e.speak('  Hello there', { voiceId: 'v', rate: 1, onWord: (i) => words.push(i) });
    await sleep(20);
    FakeAudio.instances[0].currentTime = 1;
    await sleep(20);
    expect(words).toEqual([2, 8]);
    h.cancel();
  });
});
```

```ts
import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
import { Playback } from '@core/listen/playback';
import { ListenController, type ListenDeps, type CommandWindow, type ChapterPhrase } from '@core/listen/controller';
import { FakeTtsEngine } from '@core/tts/fake';
import type { Dictionary, DictEntry } from '@core/dict/types';
import type { ExplainRequest } from '@shared/api';
import type { Position } from '@core/model';
import { DEFAULT_SETTINGS, type Settings, type VocabState } from '@shared/settings';
import { makeBook } from './helpers';

const HARD: Record<string, string> = { sanguine: '乐观的', acrimonious: '尖刻的' };

function entry(word: string, level: DictEntry['level']): DictEntry {
  return { word, ipa: '', zh: HARD[word] ?? '词', tags: [], frq: 100, bnc: 100, collins: 1, oxford: false, level, levelSource: 'cefrj' };
}
const dict: Dictionary = {
  size: 1,
  lookup: (t) => { const w = t.toLowerCase(); return { entry: entry(w, HARD[w] ? 'C1' : 'A1'), lemma: w, via: 'exact' }; },
  lookupPhrase: () => null,
  lemmaOf: (t) => t.toLowerCase(),
};

function fakeAi() {
  const calls: { req: ExplainRequest; cancelled: boolean; resolve: (text: string) => void }[] = [];
  const explain: ListenDeps['explain'] = (req) => {
    let resolve!: (t: string) => void; let reject!: (e: Error) => void;
    const done = new Promise<string>((res, rej) => { resolve = res; reject = rej; }).then((text) => ({ text, usage: { usd: 0.001, dailyUsd: 0.01, monthlyUsd: 0.1 } }));
    done.catch(() => undefined);
    const call = { req, cancelled: false, resolve };
    calls.push(call);
    return { done, cancel: () => { call.cancelled = true; reject(Object.assign(new Error('cancelled'), { code: 'cancelled' })); } };
  };
  return { calls, explain };
}

const sleep = (ms: number) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms));
async function until(cond: () => boolean, ms = 3000): Promise<void> {
  const t0 = Date.now();
  while (!cond()) { if (Date.now() - t0 > ms) throw new Error('timeout waiting for condition'); await sleep(5); }
}

let mode: 'reading' | 'listening' = 'listening';
function setup(paragraphs: string[], patch: Partial<Settings['listen']> = {}, phrases?: (pos: Position) => ChapterPhrase[]) {
  const book = makeBook([{ title: 'One', paragraphs }]);
  const settings: Settings = structuredClone(DEFAULT_SETTINGS);
  settings.voice.pauseBetweenSentencesMs = 0;
  settings.ai.styles = { custom: { shape: { wordBefore: 1, wordAfter: 0, sentenceAfterWord: 0, sentenceBefore: 1, sentenceAfter: 1 } } };
  Object.assign(settings.listen, { pauseAfterExplainMs: 0, quizWaitMs: 40, commandWindowMs: 30 }, patch);
  mode = 'listening';
  const vocab: VocabState = { words: {}, marked: {} };
  const reader = new FakeTtsEngine(1);
  const explainer = new FakeTtsEngine(1);
  const zh = new FakeTtsEngine(1);
  const ai = fakeAi();
  const learning: string[] = [];
  const windows: boolean[] = [];
  const bars: (CommandWindow | null)[] = [];
  const playback = new Playback(book, { engine: () => reader, voice: () => ({ voiceId: 'fake-gb', rate: 1 }), pauseMs: () => 0 });
  const controller = new ListenController(playback, {
    book, dict, names: new Set(),
    settings: () => settings, vocab: () => vocab, marked: () => [],
    engine: () => reader, explainEngine: () => explainer, zhEngine: () => zh,
    voice: () => ({ voiceId: 'fake-gb', rate: 1 }), explainVoice: () => ({ voiceId: 'fake-gb', rate: 1 }), zhVoiceId: () => 'fake-zh',
    explain: ai.explain, onTranscript: () => undefined, onMarkLearning: (l) => learning.push(l), mode: () => mode,
    onPauseWindow: (open) => windows.push(open),
    onCommandWindow: (w) => bars.push(w),
    chapterPhrases: phrases,
  });
  controller.enabled = true;
  const states: string[] = [];
  playback.on('state', (s) => states.push(s));
  return { book, settings, vocab, reader, explainer, zh, ai, learning, playback, controller, states, windows, bars };
}

const REPLY = 'Sanguine means hopeful.\n\nIn this sentence he stays cheerful.';

describe('ListenController', () => {
  it('Listening: at a stop the word 3 times, the window, the explanation, the window, then the sentence again and on', async () => {
    const t = setup(['He was sanguine.', 'Then he left.']);
    const finished = new Promise<void>((r) => t.playback.on('finished', r));
    t.playback.play();
    await until(() => t.ai.calls.length === 1);
    expect(t.ai.calls[0].req).toMatchObject({ kind: 'word', target: 'sanguine', sentence: 'He was sanguine.', styleId: 'custom', position: { chapter: 0, paragraph: 0, sentence: 0 }, before: '', after: 'Then he left.' });
    t.ai.calls[0].resolve(REPLY);
    await finished;
    expect(t.explainer.spoken.map((s) => s.text)).toEqual(['Sanguine means hopeful.', 'In this sentence he stays cheerful.']);
    expect(t.zh.spoken.map((s) => s.text)).toEqual(['乐观的']);
    expect(t.reader.spoken.map((s) => s.text)).toEqual(['He was sanguine.', 'sanguine', 'sanguine', 'sanguine', 'He was sanguine.', 'Then he left.']);
    expect(t.learning).toEqual(['sanguine']);
    expect(t.windows).toEqual([true, false, true, false]);
    expect(t.bars.map((b) => b?.phase ?? null)).toEqual(['before', null, 'after', null]);
    expect(t.controller.busy).toBe(false);

  it('hold() (the learner starts talking) in the window ends the stop; release() re-reads the sentence once', async () => {
    const t = setup(['He was sanguine.', 'Then he left.'], { commandWindowMs: 5000, repeatWindowWords: 0 });
    const finished = new Promise<void>((r) => t.playback.on('finished', r));
    t.playback.play();
    await until(() => t.windows.length === 1);
    expect(t.controller.hold()).toBe(true);
    await sleep(30);
    expect(t.playback.state).toBe('paused');
    t.controller.release(true);
    await finished;
    expect(t.ai.calls.length).toBe(0);
    expect(t.reader.spoken.map((s) => s.text).filter((x) => x === 'Then he left.')).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(t.reader.spoken.map((s) => s.text).filter((x) => x === 'He was sanguine.')).toHaveLength(2);
  });

  it('dispose during the window closes it and nothing resumes', async () => {
    const t = setup(['He was sanguine.', 'Then he left.'], { commandWindowMs: 5000 });
    t.playback.play();
    await until(() => t.windows.length === 1);
    t.controller.dispose();
    t.playback.stop();
    await sleep(40);
    expect(t.windows).toEqual([true, false]);
    expect(t.bars.at(-1)).toBeNull();
    expect(t.playback.state).toBe('idle');
    expect(t.ai.calls.length).toBe(0);
  });

  it('chapter phrases above the level stop like words (the phrase 3 times, after its last word)', async () => {
    const phrases = (pos: Position): ChapterPhrase[] => (pos.paragraph === 0 ? [{ start: 1, end: 2, text: 'kicked off', lemma: 'kick off', level: 'C1', zh: '开始' }, { start: 4, end: 5, text: 'the party', lemma: 'the party', level: 'A1' }] : []);
    const t = setup(['They kicked off the party.', 'Then he left.'], { commandWindowMs: 5000 }, phrases);
    const trig = t.controller.triggersFor({ chapter: 0, paragraph: 0, sentence: 0 });
    expect(trig).toEqual([expect.objectContaining({ kind: 'phrase', token: 1, end: 2, target: 'kicked off', lemma: 'kick off', dict: { ipa: '', zh: '开始', level: 'C1' } })]);
    const finished = new Promise<void>((r) => t.playback.on('finished', r));
    t.playback.play();
    await until(() => t.windows.length === 1);
    expect(t.reader.spoken.map((s) => s.text)).toEqual(['They kicked off the party.', 'kicked off', 'kicked off', 'kicked off']);
    t.controller.answerWindow('dont_know');
    await until(() => t.ai.calls.length === 1);
    expect(t.ai.calls[0].req).toMatchObject({ kind: 'phrase', target: 'kicked off' });
    t.ai.calls[0].resolve('To kick off means to start.');
    await until(() => t.windows.length === 3);
    t.controller.answerWindow('bye');
    await finished;
    expect(t.learning).toEqual(['kick off']);
  });

  it('answerWindow is false when no commands window of a stop is open', () => {
    const t = setup(['He was calm.']);
    expect(t.controller.answerWindow('know')).toBe(false);
    expect(t.controller.stopWindow).toBeNull();
  });

  it('explains a lemma once per sentence even when it appears twice', () => {
    const t = setup(['The sanguine man met a sanguine woman.']);
    expect(t.controller.triggersFor({ chapter: 0, paragraph: 0, sentence: 0 }).map((x) => x.token)).toEqual([1]);
  });
});

describe('5-second window is commands only', () => {
  it('speech in the window is never sent to the AI; go on marks learning without explaining', async () => {
    const t = setup(['He was sanguine.', 'Then he left.'], { commandWindowMs: 200 } as never);
    t.playback.play();
    await until(() => t.controller.stopWindow === 'before', 8000);
    expect(t.controller.answerWindow({ text: 'sanguine sanguine what is this' })).toBe(true);
    expect(t.ai.calls.length).toBe(0);
    expect(t.controller.answerWindow('bye')).toBe(true);
    await until(() => t.learning.includes('sanguine'), 4000);
    expect(t.ai.calls.length).toBe(0);
    t.playback.stop();
  });
});
```

```ts
import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
import { gunzipSync } from 'node:zlib';
import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
import type { DictData, DictRaw } from '@shared/api';
import {
  createDictionary, normalizeToken, foldAccents, stripPossessive, suffixCandidates, parseGloss, firstGloss,
  classifyPhrase, droppedPhrases,
} from '@core/dict/dictionary';
import type { DictEntry } from '@core/dict/types';

// Real data, loaded once per test file (~7 MB of JSON).
const DATA_PATH = fileURLToPath(new URL('../../resources/dict/dict.json.gz', import.meta.url));
const data = JSON.parse(gunzipSync(readFileSync(DATA_PATH)).toString('utf8')) as DictData;
const dict = createDictionary(data);

/** Builds a tiny DictData from headwords (+ optional raw overrides) and an inflection map. */
function synth(words: Record<string, Partial<DictRaw> | null>, forms: Record<string, string> = {}): DictData {
  const w: Record<string, DictRaw> = {};
  for (const [k, o] of Object.entries(words)) {
    w[k] = { i: '', t: `n. ${k}`, g: '', f: 100, b: 100, c: 0, o: 0, l: 'A1', s: 'cefrj', ...(o ?? {}) };
  }
  return { w, f: forms };
}

describe('normalisation helpers', () => {
  it('normalizeToken trims, lower-cases, straightens apostrophes and strips surrounding punctuation', () => {
    expect(normalizeToken('  "Hello,"  ')).toBe('hello');
    expect(normalizeToken('Darcy’s')).toBe("darcy's");
    expect(normalizeToken('(well-known)')).toBe('well-known');
    expect(normalizeToken("parents'.")).toBe("parents'");   // trailing apostrophe after a letter is kept
    expect(normalizeToken("'tis")).toBe('tis');             // leading apostrophe is not
    expect(normalizeToken("hello.'")).toBe('hello');        // apostrophe not after a letter is punctuation
    expect(normalizeToken('—')).toBe('');
    expect(normalizeToken('look   forward\tto')).toBe('look forward to');
  });

  it('foldAccents removes diacritics and maps ligatures', () => {
    expect(foldAccents('façade')).toBe('facade');
    expect(foldAccents('naïve')).toBe('naive');
    expect(foldAccents('résumé')).toBe('resume');
    expect(foldAccents('straße')).toBe('strasse');
    expect(foldAccents('plain')).toBe('plain');
  });

  it('stripPossessive handles both possessive forms', () => {
    expect(stripPossessive("darcy's")).toBe('darcy');
    expect(stripPossessive("parents'")).toBe('parents');
    expect(stripPossessive('darcy')).toBeNull();
    expect(stripPossessive("'s")).toBeNull();
  });

  it('suffixCandidates proposes stems most-specific first and never strips -ness/-ment', () => {
    expect(suffixCandidates('running')).toContain('run');
    expect(suffixCandidates('making')).toContain('make');
    expect(suffixCandidates('cities')).toEqual(['citie', 'city']);
    expect(suffixCandidates('tried')).toEqual(['trie', 'try']);
    expect(suffixCandidates('lying')[0]).toBe('lie');
    expect(suffixCandidates('kindness')).toEqual([]);
    expect(suffixCandidates('movement')).toEqual([]);
    expect(suffixCandidates('kiss')).toEqual([]);           // -ss is not a plural
    expect(suffixCandidates('Running')).toEqual([]);        // expects normalised input
  });
});

      ly: null, basic: null, movie: null, sky: null, fill: null, kiss: null, control: null, cafe: null, tomorrow: null,
      cooperate: null, child: null, children: { l: 'B2', s: 'est', f: 0 }, boring: { l: 'A1', s: 'cefrj' },
      bore: { l: 'B1', s: 'cefrj' }, good: null, better: { l: 'A1', s: 'cefrj' }, "don't": null,

describe('createDictionary with real data', () => {
  it('loads the full dictionary', () => {
    expect(dict.size).toBeGreaterThan(49_000);
    expect(dict.size).toBe(Object.keys(data.w).length);
  });

  it('lemmatises common inflections', () => {
    expect(dict.lookup('running')!.lemma).toBe('run');
    expect(dict.lookup('children')!.lemma).toBe('child');
    expect(dict.lookup('children')!.entry.level).toBe('A1');   // not the estimated B2 of the 'children' entry
    expect(dict.lookup('went')).toMatchObject({ lemma: 'go', via: 'form' });
    // 'better' is its own A1 headword (kept as the entry) and a listed form of 'good' (the vocabulary lemma)
    const better = dict.lookup('better')!;
    expect(better.lemma).toBe('good');
    expect(better.entry.word).toBe('better');
    expect(dict.lookup('stopped')!.lemma).toBe('stop');
    expect(dict.lookup('stopped')!.entry.level).toBe('A1');    // the 'stopped' entry itself is an estimated C2
    expect(dict.lookup('Parents’')!.lemma).toBe('parent');
    expect(dict.lookup('makes')!.lemma).toBe('make');
    expect(dict.lookup('lying')!.lemma).toBe('lie');
  });

  it('uses suffix rules for inflections the data does not list', () => {
    // these surface forms are in neither the headword nor the inflection map (verified against the data)
    for (const t of ['acrimoniously', 'counterattacking', 'finessing', 'finessed', 'atlases', 'cheesier', 'cheesiest', 'blurrily', 'despicably']) {
      expect(data.w[t]).toBeUndefined();
      expect(data.f[t]).toBeUndefined();
    }
    expect(dict.lookup('acrimoniously')).toMatchObject({ lemma: 'acrimonious', via: 'suffix' });
    expect(dict.lookup('counterattacking')).toMatchObject({ lemma: 'counterattack', via: 'suffix' });
    expect(dict.lookup('finessing')).toMatchObject({ lemma: 'finesse', via: 'suffix' });
    expect(dict.lookup('finessed')).toMatchObject({ lemma: 'finesse', via: 'suffix' });
    expect(dict.lookup('atlases')).toMatchObject({ lemma: 'atlas', via: 'suffix' });
    expect(dict.lookup('cheesier')).toMatchObject({ lemma: 'cheesy', via: 'suffix' });
    expect(dict.lookup('cheesiest')).toMatchObject({ lemma: 'cheesy', via: 'suffix' });
    expect(dict.lookup('blurrily')).toMatchObject({ lemma: 'blurry', via: 'suffix' });
    expect(dict.lookup('despicably')).toMatchObject({ lemma: 'despicable', via: 'suffix' });
  });

  it('handles names, accents and odd input without crashing', () => {
    // 'darcy' is not in this data set at all (ECDICT proper would gloss it as a permeability unit)
    expect(dict.lookup("Darcy's")).toBeNull();
    expect(dict.lemmaOf("Darcy's")).toBe('darcy');
    expect(dict.lookup('façade')).toMatchObject({ lemma: 'facade', via: 'fold' });
    expect(dict.lookup('naïve')).toMatchObject({ lemma: 'naive', via: 'fold' });
    expect(dict.lookup('fiancée')).toMatchObject({ lemma: 'fiancee', via: 'fold' });
    expect(dict.lookup('to-morrow')).toMatchObject({ lemma: 'tomorrow', via: 'fold' });
    expect(dict.lookup('well-known')).toMatchObject({ lemma: 'well-known', via: 'exact' });
    expect(dict.lookup('—')).toBeNull();
    expect(dict.lookup('12')).toBeNull();
    expect(dict.lookup("don’t")).toMatchObject({ lemma: "don't", via: 'exact' });
  });

  it('exposes CEFR levels and entry fields', () => {
    const ub = dict.lookup('ubiquitous')!;
    expect(['B2', 'C1', 'C2']).toContain(ub.entry.level);
    expect(ub.entry.level).toBe(data.w.ubiquitous.l);
    const house = dict.lookup('house')!;
    expect(['A1', 'A2']).toContain(house.entry.level);
    expect(house.entry).toMatchObject({ word: 'house', oxford: true, collins: 5, levelSource: 'cefrj' });
    expect(house.entry.tags).toEqual(['zk', 'gk', 'toefl', 'ielts']);
    expect(house.entry.ipa).toBe('/haus/');
    expect(dict.lookup('the')!.entry.ipa).toBe('/ðə/');   // unbalanced slash in the data is repaired
    expect(dict.lookup('the')!.entry.frq).toBe(1);
    expect(dict.lookup('mr')!.entry.zh).toContain('先生');   // capitalised headwords (Mr, Tuesday, London) are kept lower-cased
  });

  it('returns the same entry object for repeated lookups', () => {
    expect(dict.lookup('house')!.entry).toBe(dict.lookup('House')!.entry);
  });

  it('finds multi-word phrases present in the data', () => {
    const phraseKeys = Object.keys(data.w).filter((k) => k.includes(' '));
    expect(phraseKeys.length).toBeGreaterThan(500);
    expect(data.w['give up']).toBeUndefined();          // not in this data set; use phrases that are
    expect(data.w['look forward to']).toBeDefined();
    expect(data.w['in spite of']).toBeDefined();
    expect(dict.lookupPhrase(['look', 'forward', 'to'])).toMatchObject({ lemma: 'look forward to', via: 'exact' });
    expect(dict.lookupPhrase(['Looking', 'forward', 'to'])).toMatchObject({ lemma: 'look forward to', via: 'form' });
    expect(dict.lookupPhrase(['In', 'spite', 'of'])).toMatchObject({ lemma: 'in spite of', via: 'exact' });
    expect(dict.lookupPhrase(['according', 'to'])).toMatchObject({ lemma: 'according to' });
    expect(dict.lookupPhrase(['the', 'house'])).toBeNull();
    expect(dict.lookupPhrase(['green', 'house', 'door'])).toBeNull();
    // every learnable phrase key in the data is found by its own words; dropped ones never are
    const dropped = new Set(droppedPhrases(data).map((x) => x.key));
    for (const k of phraseKeys) {
      if (dropped.has(k)) expect(dict.lookupPhrase(k.split(' '))).toBeNull();
      else expect(dict.lookupPhrase(k.split(' '))?.lemma).toBe(k);
    }
  });

  it('drops free adjective+noun combinations and placeholder entries from phrase matching', () => {
    const dropped = droppedPhrases(data);
    const keys = new Set(dropped.map((x) => x.key));
    // "old man" is an estimated-C1 ECDICT entry; "old" and "man" are both A1 and the gloss is theirs
    expect(data.w['old man']).toMatchObject({ l: 'C1', s: 'est' });
    for (const k of ['old man', 'old lady', 'big city', 'fresh air', 'short story']) expect(keys.has(k)).toBe(true);
    for (const k of ['pick sth up', 'put sth on']) expect(dropped.find((x) => x.key === k)?.reason).toBe('placeholder');
    // idioms, prepositional phrases, phrasal verbs and CEFR-listed compounds are kept
    for (const k of ['red tape', 'big deal', 'lip service', 'in spite of', 'in case', 'on purpose', 'look forward to', 'fast food', 'ice cream', 'high ground'])
      expect(keys.has(k)).toBe(false);
    expect(dropped.length).toBe(95);   // of 888 phrase headwords: 87 free combinations + 8 placeholders
    expect(dict.lookupPhrase(['old', 'man'])).toBeNull();
    expect(dict.lookupPhrase(['old', 'men'])).toBeNull();
    expect(dict.lookup('old')).not.toBeNull();   // single-word lookups are unaffected
  });

  it('matches phrases token for token, lemmatising only the first and last word', () => {
    expect(dict.lookupPhrase(['old', 'man', 'who'])).toBeNull();
    expect(dict.lookupPhrase(['old', 'man', 'was'])).toBeNull();
    expect(dict.lookupPhrase(['in', 'spite', 'of', 'the'])).toBeNull();
    expect(dict.lookupPhrase(['In', 'spite'])).toBeNull();
    expect(dict.lookupPhrase(['took', 'part'])).toMatchObject({ lemma: 'take part', via: 'form' });
    expect(dict.lookupPhrase(['takes', 'advantage', 'of'])).toMatchObject({ lemma: 'take advantage of', via: 'form' });
    expect(dict.lookupPhrase(['human', 'beings'])).toMatchObject({ lemma: 'human being', via: 'form' });
    // a suppletive comparative is never lemmatised: "better for" is not the entry "good for"
    expect(data.w['good for']).toBeDefined();
    expect(dict.lookupPhrase(['better', 'for'])).toBeNull();
  });

  it('is fast enough for whole-book analysis', () => {
    const tokens = ['The', 'acrimoniously', 'children', 'went', "Darcy's", 'façade', 'running', 'xyzzyfoo', 'unbelievably', 'houses'];
    const t0 = performance.now();
    let hits = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < 20_000; i++) if (dict.lookup(tokens[i % tokens.length])) hits++;
    const ms = performance.now() - t0;
    expect(hits).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(20_000 / tokens.length * 8);
    expect(ms).toBeLessThan(2_000);   // ~0.01 ms per lookup on a laptop; generous bound to avoid flakiness
  });
});

describe('gloss helpers', () => {
  it('parseGloss splits lines and leading POS tags', () => {
    expect(parseGloss('n. 房子, 住宅\nvt. 给...房子住\nvi. 住, 躲藏')).toEqual([
      { pos: 'n.', zh: '房子, 住宅' }, { pos: 'vt.', zh: '给...房子住' }, { pos: 'vi.', zh: '住, 躲藏' },
    ]);
    expect(parseGloss('a. 温和的\n[医] 温和的\n[网络] 文雅')).toEqual([
      { pos: 'a.', zh: '温和的' }, { pos: '[医]', zh: '温和的' }, { pos: '[网络]', zh: '文雅' },
    ]);
    expect(parseGloss('vt.& vi. 跑\nad. 快地\nprep. 在\nconj. 和')).toEqual([
      { pos: 'vt.&vi.', zh: '跑' }, { pos: 'ad.', zh: '快地' }, { pos: 'prep.', zh: '在' }, { pos: 'conj.', zh: '和' },
    ]);
    expect(parseGloss(' 期望, 盼望; 瞩望')).toEqual([{ pos: '', zh: '期望, 盼望; 瞩望' }]);
    expect(parseGloss('abide的过去式和过去分词')).toEqual([{ pos: '', zh: 'abide的过去式和过去分词' }]);
    expect(parseGloss('第一个字母 A; 一个\r')).toEqual([{ pos: '', zh: '第一个字母 A; 一个' }]);
    expect(parseGloss('')).toEqual([]);
    expect(parseGloss('\n\n')).toEqual([]);
    expect(parseGloss(dict.lookup('run')!.entry.zh)[0]).toEqual({ pos: 'n.', zh: '跑, 赛跑, 奔跑, 奔跑的路程, 趋向, 流出, 运转时间, 连续' });
  });

  it('firstGloss returns the first sense line, truncated at a sense boundary', () => {
    const house = dict.lookup('house')!.entry;
    expect(firstGloss(house, 200)).toBe('n. 房子, 住宅, 机构, 议院, 家族, 家庭');
    const short = firstGloss(house, 12);
    expect(short.length).toBeLessThanOrEqual(12);
    expect(short).toBe('n. 房子, 住宅…');
    expect(firstGloss(house)).toBe('n. 房子, 住宅, 机构, 议院, 家族, 家庭');
    expect(firstGloss({ zh: '' })).toBe('');
    expect(firstGloss(null)).toBe('');
    expect(firstGloss({ zh: '\n[医] 儿童' })).toBe('[医] 儿童');
    const e: DictEntry = dict.lookup('mr')!.entry;
    expect(firstGloss(e)).toBe('先生');
    // hard cut when there is no separator early enough
    expect(firstGloss({ zh: 'n. 无所不在的到处存在的普遍存在的' }, 8)).toBe('n. 无所不在…');
  });
});
```

### `test/unit/epub.test.ts` (554 lines)

```ts
import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
import JSZip from 'jszip';
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { performance } from 'node:perf_hooks';
import { epubImporter, xhtmlToParagraphs, parseXml, decodeEntities, resolvePath, DRM_ERROR_MESSAGE } from '@core/import/epub';
import type { ImportContext } from '@core/import/types';
import type { Segmenter } from '@core/segment';
import type { Book, Sentence, Token } from '@core/model';

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Test segmenter stub (the real one is written concurrently): sentences on . ! ?, tokens by regex.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

function stubSegmenter(): Segmenter {
  const tokenize = (text: string, base: number): Token[] => {
    const out: Token[] = [];
    const re = /[\p{L}\p{N}][\p{L}\p{N}'’-]*|[^\s\p{L}\p{N}]+/gu;
    let m: RegExpExecArray | null;
    while ((m = re.exec(text))) {
      const kind = /^\p{L}/u.test(m[0]) ? 'word' : /^\p{N}/u.test(m[0]) ? 'number' : 'punct';
      out.push({ start: base + m.index, end: base + m.index + m[0].length, text: m[0], kind });
    }
    return out;
  };
  return {
    segmentParagraph(text: string): Sentence[] {
      const out: Sentence[] = [];
      const re = /[^.!?]+[.!?]+["”’)]*|[^.!?]+$/g;
      let m: RegExpExecArray | null;
      while ((m = re.exec(text))) {
        const raw = m[0];
        const start = m.index + (raw.length - raw.trimStart().length);
        const end = m.index + raw.trimEnd().length;
        if (end <= start) continue;
        out.push({ index: out.length, start, end, tokens: tokenize(text.slice(start, end), start) });
      }
      return out;
    },
    tokenize(text: string): Token[] { return tokenize(text, 0); },
  };
}

const ctx = (): ImportContext => ({ segmenter: stubSegmenter(), id: 'abc123', sourcePath: '/books/test.epub' });

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Fixture builder
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

interface FixtureFile { path: string; content: string | Uint8Array; store?: boolean }

async function buildZip(files: FixtureFile[], opts: { mimetype?: boolean } = {}): Promise<Uint8Array> {
  const zip = new JSZip();
  if (opts.mimetype !== false) zip.file('mimetype', 'application/epub+zip', { compression: 'STORE' });
  for (const f of files) zip.file(f.path, f.content, { compression: f.store ? 'STORE' : 'DEFLATE' });
  return zip.generateAsync({ type: 'uint8array', compression: 'DEFLATE' });
}

const CONTAINER = (opf: string): string => `<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<container version="1.0" xmlns="urn:oasis:names:tc:opendocument:xmlns:container">

</container>`;

<head><title>${title}</title><style>p { color: red; }</style><link rel="stylesheet" href="../style.css"/></head>

/** EPUB 2 with an NCX, text/html chapters, a UTF-8 BOM, and a manifest href whose case differs from the zip entry. */
function epub2Fixture(): FixtureFile[] {
  const opf = `<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<package version="2.0" xmlns="http://www.idpf.org/2007/opf" unique-identifier="BookId">

  </spine>

<ncx xmlns="http://www.daisy.org/z3986/2005/ncx/" version="2005-1">

    </navPoint>

  const c1 = '﻿' + xhtml(`<p>Chapter one without a heading.</p>`);

const encryptionXml = (entries: { algorithm: string; uri: string }[]): string => `<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<encryption xmlns="urn:oasis:names:tc:opendocument:xmlns:container" xmlns:enc="http://www.w3.org/2001/04/xmlenc#">
${entries.map((e) => `  <enc:EncryptedData><enc:EncryptionMethod Algorithm="${e.algorithm}"/><enc:CipherData><enc:CipherReference URI="${e.uri}"/></enc:CipherData></enc:EncryptedData>`).join('\n')}
</encryption>`;

const AES = 'http://www.w3.org/2001/04/xmlenc#aes128-cbc';

/** Structural invariants every imported book must satisfy. */
function checkBook(book: Book): void {
  expect(book.names).toEqual([]);
  let paragraphs = 0, sentences = 0, words = 0;
  book.chapters.forEach((ch, ci) => {
    expect(ch.index).toBe(ci);
    expect(ch.title.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    expect(ch.paragraphs.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    ch.paragraphs.forEach((p, pi) => {
      expect(p.index).toBe(pi);
      expect(p.text.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
      expect(p.text).toBe(p.text.trim());
      expect(p.text).not.toMatch(/\s\s|[\t\n ]/);
      expect(p.sentences.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
      paragraphs++;
      sentences += p.sentences.length;
      for (const s of p.sentences) for (const t of s.tokens) if (t.kind === 'word' || t.kind === 'number') words++;
    });
  });
  expect(book.stats).toEqual({ words, paragraphs, sentences });
}
```
