```ts
import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
import { buildPrompt, parseExplanation, spokenEnglish, spokenChinese } from '@core/ai/prompts';

describe('prompts', () => {
  it('builds a word prompt with context and labels', () => {
    const p = buildPrompt({ kind: 'word', target: 'sanguine', sentence: 'He remained sanguine.', before: 'It rained.', after: 'It stopped.', book: { title: 'B', chapter: 'One' }, dict: { ipa: '/x/', zh: '乐观的', level: 'C1' }, history: [] }, { level: 'B2', instructions: 'Be kind.', length: 'normal' });
    expect(p.system).toContain('B2');
    expect(p.system).toContain('Be kind.');
    expect(p.user).toContain('Sentence: He remained sanguine.');
    expect(p.user).toContain('DEFINITION:');
    expect(p.user).toContain('CHINESE:');
    expect(p.user).toContain('乐观的');
    expect(p.maxTokens).toBeGreaterThan(100);
  });
  it('short length omits the example', () => {
    const p = buildPrompt({ kind: 'word', target: 'x', sentence: 'x', before: '', after: '', book: { title: 'B', chapter: '' }, history: [] }, { level: 'A2', instructions: '', length: 'short' });
    expect(p.user).not.toContain('EXAMPLE:');
  });
  it('parses labelled replies, including markdown bold and Chinese colon', () => {
    const parts = parseExplanation('**DEFINITION:** Sanguine means hopeful.\nIN THIS SENTENCE： He stays positive even though it rains.\nEXAMPLE: She was sanguine about the exam.\nCHINESE: 乐观的', 'word');
    expect(parts.definition).toBe('Sanguine means hopeful.');
    expect(parts.inSentence).toContain('positive');
    expect(parts.example).toContain('exam');
    expect(parts.chinese).toBe('乐观的');
    expect(spokenEnglish(parts)).toHaveLength(3);
    expect(spokenChinese(parts)).toEqual(['乐观的']);
  });
  it('parses hard words lists', () => {
    const parts = parseExplanation('MEANING: He was angry.\nHARD WORDS: acrimonious, full of anger, 尖刻的; grudge, a lasting bad feeling, 怨恨', 'sentence');
    expect(parts.hardWords).toHaveLength(2);
    expect(parts.hardWords![0]).toEqual({ word: 'acrimonious', meaning: 'full of anger', zh: '尖刻的' });
    expect(spokenChinese(parts)).toEqual(['acrimonious, 尖刻的', 'grudge, 怨恨']);
    expect(parseExplanation('MEANING: Easy.\nHARD WORDS: none', 'sentence').hardWords).toEqual([]);
  });
  it('falls back to free text when no labels are present', () => {
    const parts = parseExplanation('Just a plain answer.', 'question');
    expect(parts.free).toBe('Just a plain answer.');
    expect(spokenEnglish(parts)).toEqual(['Just a plain answer.']);
  });
});

describe('parseExplanation tolerance', () => {
  it('finds labels that the model put on one line', () => {
    const parts = parseExplanation('DEFINITION: Sanguine means hopeful. IN THIS SENTENCE: He stays positive. CHINESE: 乐观的', 'word');
    expect(parts.definition).toBe('Sanguine means hopeful.');
    expect(parts.inSentence).toBe('He stays positive.');
    expect(parts.chinese).toBe('乐观的');
  });
  it('accepts bullets, numbering, bold labels and dashes instead of colons', () => {
    const parts = parseExplanation('- **Definition** — Sanguine means hopeful.\n2. In this sentence - He stays positive.\n* Chinese: 乐观的', 'word');
    expect(parts.definition).toBe('Sanguine means hopeful.');
    expect(parts.inSentence).toBe('He stays positive.');
    expect(parts.chinese).toBe('乐观的');
  });
  it('keeps only the Chinese characters of the CHINESE line (no pinyin for the Chinese voice)', () => {
    expect(parseExplanation('DEFINITION: x\nCHINESE: 乐观的 (lèguān de)', 'word').chinese).toBe('乐观的');
    expect(parseExplanation('DEFINITION: x\nCHINESE: 乐观的、充满希望的。', 'word').chinese).toBe('乐观的、充满希望的');
  });
  it('treats "there are none" style hard-word lines as empty and skips items without a meaning', () => {
    expect(parseExplanation('MEANING: Easy.\nHARD WORDS: There are none.', 'sentence').hardWords).toEqual([]);
    expect(parseExplanation('MEANING: Easy.\nHARD WORDS: None in this sentence.', 'sentence').hardWords).toEqual([]);
    const parts = parseExplanation('MEANING: Easy.\nHARD WORDS: grudge, a lasting bad feeling, 怨恨; sulk', 'sentence');
    expect(parts.hardWords).toEqual([{ word: 'grudge', meaning: 'a lasting bad feeling', zh: '怨恨' }]);
    expect(spokenEnglish(parts)).toEqual(['Easy.', 'grudge: a lasting bad feeling']);
  });
});
```

### `test/unit/render-hints.test.ts` (50 lines)

```ts
import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
import type { WordInfo } from '../../src/core/vocab/analysis';
import type { DictEntry } from '../../src/core/dict/types';
import { hintText, hintFor, wantsHint, HINT_MAX_CHARS } from '../../src/renderer/reader/hints';
import { firstSentences } from '../../src/renderer/reader/WordCard';

const entry = (zh: string, level: DictEntry['level'] = 'C1'): DictEntry => ({ word: 'x', ipa: '', zh, tags: [], frq: 100, bnc: 100, collins: 0, oxford: false, level, levelSource: 'cefrj' });
const info = (zh: string, level: DictEntry['level'] = 'C1', extra: Partial<WordInfo> = {}): WordInfo => ({ lemma: 'x', level, levelSource: 'cefrj', isName: false, inDict: true, entry: entry(zh, level), ...extra });

describe('hint text', () => {
  it('takes the first sense of the first gloss line, without the part of speech', () => {
    expect(hintText('n. 房子, 住宅\nvt. 给...房子住')).toBe('房子');
    expect(hintText('a. 乐观的；自信的')).toBe('乐观的');
    expect(hintText('vt.& vi. 持续、继续')).toBe('持续');
  });
  it('drops bracketed notes and cuts long hints', () => {
    expect(hintText('n. [医]传染病')).toBe('传染病');
    expect(hintText('n. 一个非常非常长的解释文本')).toBe('一个非常非…');
    expect(hintText('n. 一个非常非常长的解释文本').length).toBe(HINT_MAX_CHARS);
    expect(hintText('')).toBe('');
    expect(hintText('n. ')).toBe('');
  });
});

describe('which words get a hint', () => {
  it('above the learner level, not a name, not already known/learning/ignored, in the dictionary', () => {
    expect(wantsHint(info('n. 房子'), 'B2', {})).toBe(true);
    expect(wantsHint(info('n. 房子', 'B1'), 'B2', {})).toBe(false);
    expect(wantsHint(info('n. 房子'), 'B2', { x: 'known' })).toBe(false);
    expect(wantsHint(info('n. 房子'), 'B2', { x: 'learning' })).toBe(false);
    expect(wantsHint(info('n. 房子'), 'B2', { x: 'ignored' })).toBe(false);
    expect(wantsHint(info('n. 房子', 'C1', { isName: true }), 'B2', {})).toBe(false);
    expect(wantsHint(info('n. 房子', 'C1', { entry: null, inDict: false }), 'B2', {})).toBe(false);
    expect(wantsHint(null, 'B2', {})).toBe(false);
  });
  it('an override (a later AI hint) replaces the dictionary text', () => {
    expect(hintFor(info('n. 房子, 住宅'), 'B2', {})).toBe('房子');
    expect(hintFor(info('n. 房子, 住宅'), 'B2', {}, '住所')).toBe('住所');
    expect(hintFor(info('n. 房子, 住宅'), 'B2', {}, '一个非常非常长的解释')).toBe('一个非常非…');
    expect(hintFor(info('n. 房子, 住宅'), 'C2', {}, '住所')).toBe('');
  });
});

describe('card explanation preview', () => {
  it('keeps short text and cuts long text at a sentence end', () => {
    expect(firstSentences('Short.', 50)).toBe('Short.');
    expect(firstSentences('A sanguine person is hopeful. They expect good things. And more text that goes on and on and on.', 60)).toBe('A sanguine person is hopeful. They expect good things.');
    expect(firstSentences('x'.repeat(100), 20)).toBe('x'.repeat(20) + '…');
  });
});
```

### `test/unit/render-progress.test.ts` (99 lines)

```ts
import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
import { makeBook } from './helpers';
import { indexBook, wordsBefore, timeAt, totalTime, positionAtTime, positionAtWords, chapterMarks, fractionAt, wordsLeft, formatMinutes, formatClock, progressText, nextProgressKind, wordsPerMinute, clampRate, bookPages, sentenceIndexAt } from '../../src/renderer/reader/progress';

const book = makeBook([
  { title: 'One', paragraphs: ['Alpha beta gamma. Delta epsilon.', 'Zeta eta theta iota.'] }, // 5 + 4 = 9 words
  { title: 'Two', paragraphs: ['Kappa lambda mu nu xi omicron.'] }, // 6 words
  { title: 'Three', paragraphs: ['Pi rho sigma tau upsilon.'] }, // 5 words
]);

describe('book index', () => {
  it('counts words per sentence and chapter', () => {
    const idx = indexBook(book);
    expect(idx.totalWords).toBe(20);
    expect(idx.sentences.map((s) => s.words)).toEqual([3, 2, 4, 6, 5]);
    expect(idx.chapters.map((c) => [c.before, c.words])).toEqual([[0, 9], [9, 6], [15, 5]]);
  });
  it('maps positions to word offsets and back', () => {
    const idx = indexBook(book);
    expect(wordsBefore(idx, { chapter: 0, paragraph: 0, sentence: 1 })).toBe(3);
    expect(wordsBefore(idx, { chapter: 2, paragraph: 0, sentence: 0 })).toBe(15);
    expect(sentenceIndexAt(idx, { chapter: 1, paragraph: 0, sentence: 0 })).toBe(3);
    expect(positionAtWords(idx, 0)).toEqual({ chapter: 0, paragraph: 0, sentence: 0 });
    expect(positionAtWords(idx, 4)).toEqual({ chapter: 0, paragraph: 0, sentence: 1 });
    expect(positionAtWords(idx, 9)).toEqual({ chapter: 1, paragraph: 0, sentence: 0 });
    expect(positionAtWords(idx, 999)).toEqual({ chapter: 2, paragraph: 0, sentence: 0 });
    expect(positionAtWords(indexBook(makeBook([])), 3)).toBeNull();
  });
});

describe('timeline', () => {
  const idx = indexBook(book);
  it('time at a position and total time follow the words per minute', () => {
    expect(totalTime(idx, 60)).toBe(20); // 20 words at 60 wpm = 20 s
    expect(timeAt(idx, { chapter: 1, paragraph: 0, sentence: 0 }, 60)).toBe(9);
    expect(timeAt(idx, { chapter: 0, paragraph: 0, sentence: 0 }, 60)).toBe(0);
  });
  it('seeking by time lands on the sentence being read then', () => {
    expect(positionAtTime(idx, 0, 60)).toEqual({ chapter: 0, paragraph: 0, sentence: 0 });
    expect(positionAtTime(idx, 3.5, 60)).toEqual({ chapter: 0, paragraph: 0, sentence: 1 });
    expect(positionAtTime(idx, 9, 60)).toEqual({ chapter: 1, paragraph: 0, sentence: 0 });
    expect(positionAtTime(idx, 100, 60)).toEqual({ chapter: 2, paragraph: 0, sentence: 0 });
    expect(positionAtTime(idx, -5, 60)).toEqual({ chapter: 0, paragraph: 0, sentence: 0 });
  });
  it('chapter marks are fractions of the book', () => {
    expect(chapterMarks(idx)).toEqual([{ index: 0, title: 'One', at: 0 }, { index: 1, title: 'Two', at: 0.45 }, { index: 2, title: 'Three', at: 0.75 }]);
    expect(fractionAt(idx, { chapter: 2, paragraph: 0, sentence: 0 })).toBe(0.75);
  });
  it('words left in chapter and book', () => {
    expect(wordsLeft(idx, { chapter: 0, paragraph: 0, sentence: 1 })).toEqual({ chapter: 6, book: 17 });
    expect(wordsLeft(idx, { chapter: 2, paragraph: 0, sentence: 0 })).toEqual({ chapter: 5, book: 5 });
  });
  it('wpm: the voice pace when listening or playing, 200 when reading silently', () => {
    expect(wordsPerMinute('listening', 1, false)).toBe(160);
    expect(wordsPerMinute('listening', 1.5, true)).toBe(240);
    expect(wordsPerMinute('reading', 1.5, false)).toBe(200);
    expect(wordsPerMinute('reading', 1.5, true)).toBe(240);
    expect(wordsPerMinute('listening', NaN, true)).toBe(160);
  });
});

describe('formatting', () => {
  it('minutes', () => {
    expect(formatMinutes(0.3)).toBe('less than a minute');
    expect(formatMinutes(12.4)).toBe('12 min');
    expect(formatMinutes(130)).toBe('2 h 10 min');
    expect(formatMinutes(65)).toBe('1 h 05 min');
    expect(formatMinutes(120)).toBe('2 h');
  });
  it('clock', () => {
    expect(formatClock(5020)).toBe('1:23:40');
    expect(formatClock(33120)).toBe('9:12:00');
    expect(formatClock(65)).toBe('1:05');
    expect(formatClock(0)).toBe('0:00');
  });
  it('progress text cycles through its four kinds', () => {
    const p = { page: 12, pageCount: 240, wordsLeftChapter: 2400, wordsLeftBook: 26000, wpm: 200, fraction: 0.345 };
    expect(progressText('page', p)).toBe('Page 12 of 240');
    expect(progressText('chapter', p)).toBe('12 min left in chapter');
    expect(progressText('book', p)).toBe('2 h 10 min left in book');
    expect(progressText('percent', p)).toBe('34%');
    expect(nextProgressKind('page')).toBe('chapter');
    expect(nextProgressKind('percent')).toBe('page');
  });
  it('rates clamp to 0.5–2.0 in tenths', () => {
    expect(clampRate(0.1 + 0.2 + 1)).toBe(1.3);
    expect(clampRate(0.2)).toBe(0.5);
    expect(clampRate(3)).toBe(2);
    expect(clampRate(NaN)).toBe(1);
  });
  it('whole-book pages are extrapolated from the laid-out chapter', () => {
    const idx = indexBook(book);
    // chapter 1 (9 words) shown as 3 pages -> 3 words per page -> 20 words = 7 pages
    expect(bookPages(idx, 0, 0, 3)).toEqual({ page: 1, total: 7, wordsPerPage: 3 });
    expect(bookPages(idx, 0, 2, 3)).toEqual({ page: 3, total: 7, wordsPerPage: 3 });
    expect(bookPages(idx, 1, 0, 2)).toEqual({ page: 4, total: 7, wordsPerPage: 3 });
    expect(bookPages(idx, 2, 5, 1).page).toBe(4);
  });
});
```

### `test/unit/review-script.test.ts` (88 lines)

```ts
import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
import type { ExplainRequest } from '../../src/shared/api';
import type { ReviewItem, ReviewPlan, ContextGroup } from '../../src/core/vocab/review';
import { reviewIntro, buildReviewRequests, estimateReviewMinutes, PASSAGE_REVIEW_QUESTION } from '../../src/core/vocab/reviewScript';

const item = (lemma: string, reason: ReviewItem['reason'] = 'session', o: Partial<ReviewItem> = {}): ReviewItem => ({
  lemma, word: lemma, sentence: `The ${lemma} was there.`, chinese: '东西', explanation: `${lemma}: a thing`, reason, ...o,
});

function plan(items: ReviewItem[], context: ContextGroup[] = []): ReviewPlan {
  return {
    target: Math.max(3, items.length), items, context,
    sessionCount: items.filter((i) => i.reason === 'session').length,
    dueCount: items.filter((i) => i.reason === 'due').length,
  };
}

const group = (chapter: string, lemmas: string[], bookTitle = 'The Old Man and the Sea'): ContextGroup => ({
  bookId: 'b1', bookTitle, chapter, sentences: lemmas.map((l) => ({ lemma: l, word: l, sentence: `The ${l} was there.` })),
});

describe('reviewIntro', () => {
  it('counts the words and mentions the story when there is context', () => {
    const p = plan(['a', 'b', 'c', 'd', 'e', 'f'].map((l) => item(l)), [group('Part 1', ['a'])]);
    expect(reviewIntro(p)).toBe("Let's review 6 words from today, then the story so far.");
  });
  it('splits today and earlier words, handles one word, no story and an empty plan', () => {
    expect(reviewIntro(plan([item('a'), item('b', 'due')], [group('1', ['a'])]))).toBe("Let's review 2 words: 1 from today and 1 from earlier, then the story so far.");
    expect(reviewIntro(plan([item('a', 'due')]))).toBe("Let's review 1 word from earlier sessions.");
    expect(reviewIntro(plan([item('a')]))).toBe("Let's review 1 word from today.");
    expect(reviewIntro(plan([]))).toBe('Nothing to review right now. Well done!');
  });
});

describe('buildReviewRequests', () => {
  it('emits one word request per item, then one passage request per context group, in order', () => {
    const p = plan([item('skiff'), item('salao', 'due', { word: 'Salao', chinese: '' })], [group('Part 1', ['skiff', 'salao']), group('Part 2', ['skiff'])]);
    const reqs = buildReviewRequests(p, { bookTitle: 'The Old Man and the Sea' });
    expect(reqs.map((r) => [r.kind, r.target])).toEqual([
      ['word', 'skiff'],
      ['word', 'Salao'],
      ['passage', 'The skiff was there. The salao was there.'],
      ['passage', 'The skiff was there.'],
    ]);
    const w: ExplainRequest = reqs[0];
    expect(w).toEqual({
      kind: 'word', target: 'skiff', sentence: 'The skiff was there.', before: '', after: '',
      book: { title: 'The Old Man and the Sea', chapter: 'Part 1' }, dict: { zh: '东西' }, history: [], again: false,
    });
    expect(reqs[1].dict).toBeUndefined();   // no Chinese meaning stored: no dict hint
    const ps = reqs[2];
    expect(ps).toMatchObject({ kind: 'passage', sentence: ps.target, before: '', after: '', book: { title: 'The Old Man and the Sea', chapter: 'Part 1' }, history: [], again: false });
    expect(ps.question).toBe(PASSAGE_REVIEW_QUESTION);
    expect(ps.question).toMatch(/retell/i);
    expect(ps.question).toMatch(/one short question/);
    expect(ps.question).toMatch(/\[PAUSE\] followed by the answer\.$/);
    expect(reqs[3].book.chapter).toBe('Part 2');
  });

  it('falls back to the given title, skips empty groups and handles an empty plan', () => {
    const p = plan([item('orphan')], [group('Ch 1', [], ''), { ...group('Ch 2', ['x'], ''), sentences: [{ lemma: 'x', word: 'x', sentence: '  ' }] }]);
    const reqs = buildReviewRequests(p, { bookTitle: 'Fallback' });
    expect(reqs).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(reqs[0].book).toEqual({ title: 'Fallback', chapter: '' });
    const withTitle = buildReviewRequests(plan([], [group('Ch 3', ['y'], '')]), { bookTitle: 'Fallback' });
    expect(withTitle[0].book).toEqual({ title: 'Fallback', chapter: 'Ch 3' });
    expect(buildReviewRequests(plan([]), { bookTitle: 'X' })).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('is pure: the plan is not modified', () => {
    const p = plan([item('a')], [group('1', ['a'])]);
    const before = JSON.stringify(p);
    buildReviewRequests(p, { bookTitle: 'T' });
    reviewIntro(p);
    estimateReviewMinutes(p);
    expect(JSON.stringify(p)).toBe(before);
  });
});

describe('estimateReviewMinutes', () => {
  it('is 0.75 min per word plus 1 min per context group, rounded up', () => {
    expect(estimateReviewMinutes(plan([]))).toBe(0);
    expect(estimateReviewMinutes(plan([item('a')]))).toBe(1);
    expect(estimateReviewMinutes(plan(['a', 'b', 'c', 'd'].map((l) => item(l))))).toBe(3);
    expect(estimateReviewMinutes(plan(['a', 'b', 'c', 'd', 'e', 'f'].map((l) => item(l)), [group('1', ['a']), group('2', ['b'])]))).toBe(7);   // 4.5 + 2
    expect(estimateReviewMinutes(plan(['a', 'b', 'c', 'd', 'e'].map((l) => item(l)), [group('1', ['a'])]))).toBe(5);   // 3.75 + 1
  });
});
```

### `test/unit/script-rules.test.ts` (41 lines)

```ts
import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
import { cleanSpokenProse } from '@core/ai/prompts';
import { DEFAULT_CONTEXT_RULES, LEGACY_CONTEXT_RULES, DEFAULT_STYLES } from '@shared/styles';
import { DEFAULT_SETTINGS, migrateSettings } from '@shared/settings';
import { toChapterPhraseMap } from '../../src/renderer/reader/phrases';

describe('the 19 Oct listening rules', () => {
  it('the shared rules forbid filler and say spoken transcripts may be badly recognised', () => {
    expect(DEFAULT_CONTEXT_RULES).toContain('"great question"');
    expect(DEFAULT_CONTEXT_RULES).toContain('Never ask them to repeat');
    expect(DEFAULT_CONTEXT_RULES.startsWith(LEGACY_CONTEXT_RULES[0])).toBe(true);
  });

  it('stored rules equal to the old default get the new one; edited rules stay', () => {
    type Stored = { ai: { contextRules: string }; listen: { pauseAfterExplainMs: number } };
    const mig = (o: object): Stored => migrateSettings(o as { appearance?: { theme?: string } }) as unknown as Stored;
    expect(mig({ ai: { contextRules: LEGACY_CONTEXT_RULES[0] } }).ai.contextRules).toBe(DEFAULT_CONTEXT_RULES);
    expect(mig({ ai: { contextRules: 'my own rules' } }).ai.contextRules).toBe('my own rules');
    expect(mig({ listen: { pauseAfterExplainMs: 7000 } }).listen.pauseAfterExplainMs).toBe(5000);
    expect(DEFAULT_SETTINGS.listen).toMatchObject({ commandWindowMs: 5000, pauseAfterExplainMs: 5000, wordRepeats: 3 });
  });

  it('built-in styles: the word 3 times, nothing said after the explanation (the sentence is re-read instead)', () => {
    for (const s of DEFAULT_STYLES) expect(s.shape).toMatchObject({ wordBefore: 3, wordAfter: 0, sentenceAfterWord: 0 });
  });

  it('opening filler is stripped from spoken replies', () => {
    expect(cleanSpokenProse('Great question! Let me explain. Sanguine means hopeful.')).toBe('Sanguine means hopeful.');
    expect(cleanSpokenProse('As I said, it is a feeling.')).toBe('It is a feeling.');
    expect(cleanSpokenProse('Now, the man is hopeful.')).toBe('The man is hopeful.');
    expect(cleanSpokenProse('Now means at this moment.')).toBe('Now means at this moment.');
  });

  it('the chapter phrase adapter takes the bridge map tolerantly', () => {
    const hit = { sentenceKey: '2.1.0', start: 1, end: 2, text: 'kicked off', lemma: 'kick off', level: 'C1', zh: '开始' };
    expect(toChapterPhraseMap({ '2.1.0': [hit, { bad: true }] }, 2)).toEqual({ '2.1.0': [{ start: 1, end: 2, text: 'kicked off', lemma: 'kick off', level: 'C1', zh: '开始' }] });
    expect(toChapterPhraseMap([hit], 2)['2.1.0']).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(toChapterPhraseMap({ 2: { '1.0': [hit] } }, 2)['2.1.0']).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(toChapterPhraseMap(null, 2)).toEqual({});
  });
});
```

### `test/unit/script.test.ts` (41 lines)

```ts
import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
import { wordScript, sentenceScript, aiSteps } from '@core/listen/script';

const s = { wordRepeats: 3, sentenceRepeatsAfterWord: 2, sentenceRepeatsForPhrase: 2, speakChinese: true };

describe('scripts', () => {
  it('word script: word x3, AI, word x3, sentence x2', () => {
    const steps = wordScript('sanguine', 'He remained sanguine.', s).filter((x) => x.type !== 'pause');
    expect(steps.map((x) => (x.type === 'say' ? `${x.role}:${x.text}` : 'ai'))).toEqual([

    ]);
  });
  it('sentence script: sentence, AI, sentence', () => {
    const steps = sentenceScript('A long sentence.', s).filter((x) => x.type !== 'pause');
    expect(steps.map((x) => (x.type === 'say' ? x.role : 'ai'))).toEqual(['sentence', 'ai', 'sentence']);
  });
  it('AI steps speak English parts then Chinese with a Chinese voice', () => {
    const steps = aiSteps({ definition: 'Means hopeful.', inSentence: 'He stays positive.', chinese: '乐观的' }, s, true).filter((x) => x.type === 'say');
    expect(steps.map((x) => (x.type === 'say' ? x.lang : ''))).toEqual(['en', 'en', 'zh']);
    expect(aiSteps({ definition: 'x', chinese: '乐' }, s, false).filter((x) => x.type === 'say')).toHaveLength(1);
  });
});

import { proseSteps, splitByScript, twoMeanings } from '@core/listen/script';
describe('Chinese in explanations', () => {
  it('splits Chinese runs out of English text', () => {
    expect(splitByScript('It means 尖刻的 here, okay.')).toEqual([{ text: 'It means', zh: false }, { text: '尖刻的', zh: true }, { text: 'here, okay.', zh: false }]);
  });
  it('keeps two clean meanings', () => {
    expect(twoMeanings('a. 尖刻的, 讥讽的, 激烈的')).toBe('尖刻的，讥讽的');
    expect(twoMeanings(['刻薄的', ''])).toBe('刻薄的');
    expect(twoMeanings('n. (pl.) 血红色; 红粉笔 sth')).toBe('血红色，红粉笔');
  });
  it('speaks Chinese with the Chinese voice, at the end, and drops it when off', () => {
    const on = proseSteps('Sharp words. In Chinese 尖刻的.', { zh: 'a. 尖刻的, 讥讽的, 激烈的', speakChinese: true, zhAvailable: true });
    const says = on.filter((s) => s.type === 'say') as { text: string; lang: string }[];
    expect(says.map((s) => [s.lang, s.text])).toEqual([['en', 'Sharp words. In Chinese'], ['zh', '尖刻的'], ['zh', '尖刻的，讥讽的']]);
    const off = proseSteps('Sharp words. In Chinese 尖刻的.', { zh: '尖刻的', speakChinese: false, zhAvailable: true });
    expect((off.filter((s) => s.type === 'say') as { lang: string }[]).every((s) => s.lang === 'en')).toBe(true);
  });
});
```

### `test/unit/secrets.test.ts` (160 lines)

```ts
import { describe, it, expect, vi, beforeEach, afterEach } from 'vitest';
import fs from 'node:fs';
import os from 'node:os';
import path from 'node:path';

// A fresh userData folder per test; the mocked safeStorage can be switched between "works" and "broken" (the re-signed-app case).
const ctx = vi.hoisted(() => {
  const fs = require('node:fs'); const os = require('node:os'); const path = require('node:path');
  const c = { userData: fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'readalong-secrets-')), safeWorks: true, decryptCalls: 0 };
  return c;
});
vi.mock('electron', () => ({
  ipcMain: { handle: vi.fn() },
  app: { getPath: () => ctx.userData },
  safeStorage: {
    isEncryptionAvailable: () => true,
    encryptString: (s: string) => Buffer.from(`keychain:${s}`, 'utf8'),
    decryptString: (b: Buffer) => { ctx.decryptCalls++; if (!ctx.safeWorks) throw new Error('Decryption failed'); return b.toString('utf8').replace(/^keychain:/, ''); },
  },
}));

import * as secrets from '../../src/main/secrets';
import { SECRET_NAMES } from '../../src/shared/api';

const dataDir = () => path.join(ctx.userData, 'data');
const secretsFile = () => path.join(dataDir(), 'secrets.json');
const keyFile = () => path.join(dataDir(), 'secret.key');
const SAMPLE: Record<string, string> = {
  anthropic: 'sk-ant-api03-abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789',
  openai: 'sk-proj-0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz',
  elevenlabs: 'sk_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef',
  azure: JSON.stringify({ key: 'A1b2C3d4E5f6G7h8I9j0K1l2M3n4O5p6', region: 'uksouth' }),
  google: 'AIzaSyA-0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstu',
};

beforeEach(() => {
  ctx.userData = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'readalong-secrets-'));
  ctx.safeWorks = true;
  ctx.decryptCalls = 0;
  secrets.resetSecretsCache();
});
afterEach(() => { vi.restoreAllMocks(); fs.rmSync(ctx.userData, { recursive: true, force: true }); });

describe('secrets: app-folder encryption', () => {
  it('round-trips all five keys through AES-256-GCM and survives a cache reset', () => {
    for (const name of SECRET_NAMES) expect(secrets.setSecret(name, SAMPLE[name]).warning).toBeNull();
    for (const name of SECRET_NAMES) expect(secrets.getSecret(name)).toBe(SAMPLE[name]);
    // nothing on disk is plaintext or the old Keychain format
    const raw = fs.readFileSync(secretsFile(), 'utf8');
    for (const name of SECRET_NAMES) expect(raw).not.toContain(SAMPLE[name].slice(4, 20));
    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw) as Record<string, { v: number; iv: string; tag: string; data: string }>;
    for (const name of SECRET_NAMES) expect(parsed[name]).toMatchObject({ v: 2 });
    expect(parsed.anthropic.iv).not.toBe(parsed.openai.iv);
    // a fresh process (new cache) reads the same values back with the key file
    secrets.resetSecretsCache();
    for (const name of SECRET_NAMES) expect(secrets.getSecret(name)).toBe(SAMPLE[name]);
    const status = secrets.secretStatus();
    for (const name of SECRET_NAMES) expect(status[name]).toEqual({ saved: true, verified: true, lostAtStartup: false });
    expect(secrets.getAzureCredentials()).toEqual({ key: 'A1b2C3d4E5f6G7h8I9j0K1l2M3n4O5p6', region: 'uksouth' });
  });

  it('creates the key file with mode 0600 and 32 random bytes', () => {
    secrets.setSecret('openai', SAMPLE.openai);
    const st = fs.statSync(keyFile());
    expect(st.size).toBe(32);
    if (process.platform !== 'win32') expect(st.mode & 0o777).toBe(0o600);
    // a different key file means the stored value cannot be read (and is reported, not returned)
    fs.writeFileSync(keyFile(), Buffer.alloc(32, 7));
    secrets.resetSecretsCache();
    expect(secrets.getSecret('openai')).toBeNull();
    expect(secrets.secretStatus().openai).toEqual({ saved: true, verified: false, lostAtStartup: false });
    const after = secrets.checkSecrets();
    expect(after.openai).toEqual({ saved: false, verified: false, lostAtStartup: true });
  });

  it('trims pasted whitespace and warns about keys that look wrong, but still saves them', () => {
    expect(secrets.setSecret('anthropic', `  ${SAMPLE.anthropic}\n`).warning).toBeNull();
    expect(secrets.getSecret('anthropic')).toBe(SAMPLE.anthropic);
    expect(secrets.setSecret('anthropic', 'sk-proj-looks-like-openai').warning).toMatch(/start with "sk-ant-"/);
    expect(secrets.getSecret('anthropic')).toBe('sk-proj-looks-like-openai');
    expect(secrets.setSecret('openai', 'sk-ant-xyz').warning).toMatch(/looks like an Anthropic key/);
    expect(secrets.setSecret('elevenlabs', 'not-hex').warning).toMatch(/32 or more hexadecimal/);
    expect(secrets.setSecret('google', 'nope').warning).toMatch(/start with "AIza"/);
    expect(secrets.setSecret('azure', '{"key":"short","region":"uksouth"}').warning).toMatch(/32 or more letters/);
    expect(secrets.setSecret('azure', 'A1b2C3d4E5f6G7h8I9j0K1l2M3n4O5p6').warning).toBeNull();
    expect(secrets.getAzureCredentials()).toEqual({ key: 'A1b2C3d4E5f6G7h8I9j0K1l2M3n4O5p6', region: 'uksouth' });
    // a key wrapped over two lines by an email client is joined again
    expect(secrets.setSecret('openai', 'sk-proj-abc\ndef').warning).toBeNull();
    expect(secrets.getSecret('openai')).toBe('sk-proj-abcdef');
    // empty removes
    secrets.setSecret('openai', '   ');
    expect(secrets.hasSecret('openai')).toBe(false);
    expect(secrets.getSecret('openai')).toBeNull();
  });

  it('throws and keeps nothing when the written key cannot be read back', () => {
    secrets.setSecret('openai', SAMPLE.openai);
    const realRead = fs.readFileSync;
    // the verification read sees a file in which the fresh record was mangled on the way to disk
    vi.spyOn(fs, 'readFileSync').mockImplementation(((p: fs.PathOrFileDescriptor, o?: unknown) => {
      const out = realRead(p, o as never);
      if (String(p).endsWith('secrets.json')) {
        const j = JSON.parse(String(out)) as Record<string, { data: string }>;
        if (j.anthropic) j.anthropic.data = Buffer.from('tampered').toString('base64');
        return JSON.stringify(j);
      }
      return out;
    }) as never);
    expect(() => secrets.setSecret('anthropic', SAMPLE.anthropic)).toThrow(/could not be read back/);
    vi.restoreAllMocks();
    expect(secrets.hasSecret('anthropic')).toBe(false);
    expect(secrets.getSecret('openai')).toBe(SAMPLE.openai);
    secrets.resetSecretsCache();
    expect(secrets.hasSecret('anthropic')).toBe(false);
  });

  it('migrates old Keychain-format records when safeStorage still works', () => {
    fs.mkdirSync(dataDir(), { recursive: true });
    fs.writeFileSync(secretsFile(), JSON.stringify({
      anthropic: { enc: true, data: Buffer.from(`keychain:${SAMPLE.anthropic}`).toString('base64') },
      elevenlabs: { enc: false, data: Buffer.from(SAMPLE.elevenlabs).toString('base64') },
    }));
    expect(secrets.getSecret('anthropic')).toBe(SAMPLE.anthropic);
    expect(secrets.getSecret('elevenlabs')).toBe(SAMPLE.elevenlabs);
    expect(ctx.decryptCalls).toBe(1);
    const parsed = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(secretsFile(), 'utf8')) as Record<string, { v?: number; enc?: boolean }>;
    expect(parsed.anthropic.v).toBe(2); expect(parsed.anthropic.enc).toBeUndefined();
    expect(parsed.elevenlabs.v).toBe(2);
    const status = secrets.checkSecrets();
    expect(status.anthropic).toEqual({ saved: true, verified: true, lostAtStartup: false });
    expect(status.openai).toEqual({ saved: false, verified: false, lostAtStartup: false });
    // the next start no longer needs the Keychain at all
    ctx.safeWorks = false; secrets.resetSecretsCache();
    expect(secrets.getSecret('anthropic')).toBe(SAMPLE.anthropic);
  });

  it('drops unrecoverable Keychain records and reports them as lost until the key is pasted again', () => {
    ctx.safeWorks = false;
    fs.mkdirSync(dataDir(), { recursive: true });
    fs.writeFileSync(secretsFile(), JSON.stringify({
      anthropic: { enc: true, data: Buffer.from('keychain:gone').toString('base64') },
      openai: { enc: true, data: Buffer.from('keychain:gone').toString('base64') },
    }));
    const status = secrets.checkSecrets();
    expect(status.anthropic).toEqual({ saved: false, verified: false, lostAtStartup: true });
    expect(status.openai).toEqual({ saved: false, verified: false, lostAtStartup: true });
    expect(status.google.lostAtStartup).toBe(false);
    expect(secrets.getSecret('anthropic')).toBeNull();
    expect(JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(secretsFile(), 'utf8'))).toEqual({});
    // pasting the key again clears the notice for that key only
    secrets.setSecret('anthropic', SAMPLE.anthropic);
    expect(secrets.secretStatus().anthropic).toEqual({ saved: true, verified: true, lostAtStartup: false });
    expect(secrets.secretStatus().openai.lostAtStartup).toBe(true);
    secrets.dismissLostKeys();
    expect(secrets.secretStatus().openai.lostAtStartup).toBe(false);
    // and the notice does not come back on the next start: the record is gone
    secrets.resetSecretsCache();
    expect(secrets.checkSecrets().openai).toEqual({ saved: false, verified: false, lostAtStartup: false });
  });
});
```

### `test/unit/segment.test.ts` (508 lines)

```ts
import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
import { createSegmenter } from '@core/segment';
import type { Sentence, Token } from '@core/segment';

const seg = createSegmenter();

/** Sentence texts as the reader would render them. */
function sentences(text: string): string[] {
  return seg.segmentParagraph(text).map((s) => text.slice(s.start, s.end));
}

/** "kind:text" for every token of every sentence. */
function tokenList(text: string): string[] {
  return seg.segmentParagraph(text).flatMap((s) => s.tokens.map((t) => `${t.kind}:${t.text}`));
}

function words(text: string): string[] {
  return seg.segmentParagraph(text).flatMap((s) => s.tokens.filter((t) => t.kind !== 'punct').map((t) => t.text));
}

/** The structural invariants every result must satisfy, whatever the input. */
function checkInvariants(text: string, out: Sentence[] = seg.segmentParagraph(text)): Sentence[] {
  let prevEnd = -1;
  out.forEach((s, i) => {
    expect(s.index).toBe(i);
    expect(s.start).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(0);
    expect(s.end).toBeLessThanOrEqual(text.length);
    expect(s.end).toBeGreaterThan(s.start); // never empty
    expect(s.start).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(prevEnd); // sorted, non-overlapping
    prevEnd = s.end;
    const st = text.slice(s.start, s.end);
    expect(st).toBe(st.trim()); // trimmed
    checkTokens(text, s.tokens, s);
  });
  return out;
}

function checkTokens(text: string, tokens: Token[], within?: { start: number; end: number }): void {
  let prevEnd = within ? within.start : 0;
  for (const t of tokens) {
    expect(t.text).toBe(text.slice(t.start, t.end));
    expect(t.end).toBeGreaterThan(t.start);
    expect(t.start).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(prevEnd);
    expect(t.kind).not.toBe('space'); // convention: whitespace is never a token
    expect(/^\s+$/.test(t.text)).toBe(false);
    if (within) expect(t.end).toBeLessThanOrEqual(within.end);
    prevEnd = t.end;
  }
}

describe('createSegmenter', () => {
  it('returns an object implementing the Segmenter interface', () => {
    expect(typeof seg.segmentParagraph).toBe('function');
    expect(typeof seg.tokenize).toBe('function');
  });
});

describe('sentence segmentation: the spec cases', () => {
  it('keeps a title abbreviation and a.m./p.m. inside one sentence', () => {
    const t = 'Mr. Darcy arrived at 5 p.m. on Tuesday.';
    expect(sentences(t)).toEqual([t]);
    checkInvariants(t);
  });

  it('splits after a closing quote that ends a question, and keeps the quote inside the sentence', () => {
    const t = '“Is it true,” she asked, “that you never dance?” He said nothing.';
    expect(sentences(t)).toEqual(['“Is it true,” she asked, “that you never dance?”', 'He said nothing.']);
    checkInvariants(t);
  });

  it('merges "Dr." and keeps an ellipsis followed by lowercase inside the sentence', () => {
    const t = 'Dr. Smith remained sanguine: the weather, he insisted, would improve by Thursday... or at least by Friday!';
    expect(sentences(t)).toEqual([t]);
    checkInvariants(t);
  });

  it('treats initials as part of the name', () => {
    const t = 'It was J. R. R. Tolkien who wrote it. Nobody else.';
    expect(sentences(t)).toEqual(['It was J. R. R. Tolkien who wrote it.', 'Nobody else.']);
    checkInvariants(t);
  });

  it('does not treat a decimal number as an abbreviation', () => {
    const t = 'He paid $3.50. Then he left.';
    expect(sentences(t)).toEqual(['He paid $3.50.', 'Then he left.']);
    expect(tokenList(t)).toEqual(['word:He', 'word:paid', 'punct:$', 'number:3.50', 'punct:.', 'word:Then', 'word:he', 'word:left', 'punct:.']);
    checkInvariants(t);
  });

  it('keeps "... and" together and splits at the real period', () => {
    const t = 'She whispered... and then stopped. Silence.';
    expect(sentences(t)).toEqual(['She whispered... and then stopped.', 'Silence.']);
    expect(tokenList(t)).toContain('punct:...');
    checkInvariants(t);
  });

  it('handles "Fig." and "p." followed by numbers', () => {
    const t = 'See Fig. 3 and p. 12 for details. Done.';
    expect(sentences(t)).toEqual(['See Fig. 3 and p. 12 for details.', 'Done.']);
    checkInvariants(t);
  });

  it('keeps U.S. / U.K. inside their sentences and still splits between them', () => {
    const t = 'The U.S. economy grew. The U.K. did not.';
    expect(sentences(t)).toEqual(['The U.S. economy grew.', 'The U.K. did not.']);
    expect(words(t)).toEqual(['The', 'U.S', 'economy', 'grew', 'The', 'U.K', 'did', 'not']);
    checkInvariants(t);
  });

  it('keeps "the U.S. Then" split (non-title abbreviation followed by an uppercase word)', () => {
    const t = 'He went to the U.S. Then he left.';
    expect(sentences(t)).toEqual(['He went to the U.S.', 'Then he left.']);
    checkInvariants(t);
  });

  it('makes a paragraph with no terminal punctuation one sentence', () => {
    const t = 'WAR AND PEACE';
    const out = checkInvariants(t);
    expect(sentences(t)).toEqual([t]);
    expect(out[0].tokens.map((k) => k.text)).toEqual(['WAR', 'AND', 'PEACE']);
    expect(out[0].tokens.every((k) => k.kind === 'word')).toBe(true);
  });

  it('splits "Hello?! Really?!" and collapses the punctuation runs', () => {
    const t = 'Hello?! Really?!';
    expect(sentences(t)).toEqual(['Hello?!', 'Really?!']);
    expect(tokenList(t)).toEqual(['word:Hello', 'punct:?!', 'word:Really', 'punct:?!']);
    checkInvariants(t);
  });

  it('splits very short sentences', () => {
    const t = 'One. Two. Three.';
    expect(sentences(t)).toEqual(['One.', 'Two.', 'Three.']);
    checkInvariants(t);
  });

  it('keeps e.g. / i.e. / etc. inside one sentence', () => {
    const t = 'e.g. apples, i.e. fruit, etc. are fine.';
    expect(sentences(t)).toEqual([t]);
    checkInvariants(t);
  });
});

describe('sentence segmentation: abbreviations and quotes', () => {
  it('always merges title abbreviations, including in ALL CAPS headings', () => {
    expect(sentences('Mrs. Bennet and Ms. Lucas met Prof. Brown at St. James. Later.')).toEqual([
      'Mrs. Bennet and Ms. Lucas met Prof. Brown at St. James.', 'Later.',
    ]);
    expect(sentences('MR. DARCY ARRIVED. HE LEFT.')).toEqual(['MR. DARCY ARRIVED.', 'HE LEFT.']);
    expect(sentences('Capt. Wentworth, Col. Brandon, Gen. Tilney and Lt. Price. All of them.')).toEqual([
      'Capt. Wentworth, Col. Brandon, Gen. Tilney and Lt. Price.', 'All of them.',
    ]);
    expect(sentences('Rev. Collins wrote to Sr. Pedro and Jr. Pedro and the Hon. Mr. Smith. Done.')).toEqual([
      'Rev. Collins wrote to Sr. Pedro and Jr. Pedro and the Hon. Mr. Smith.', 'Done.',
    ]);
    expect(sentences('Messrs. Lee and Mme. Dupont and Mlle. Odile left. Yes.')).toEqual([
      'Messrs. Lee and Mme. Dupont and Mlle. Odile left.', 'Yes.',
    ]);
    expect(sentences('We climbed Mt. Fuji and Sgt. Pepper sang. Yes.')).toEqual(['We climbed Mt. Fuji and Sgt. Pepper sang.', 'Yes.']);
  });

  it('always merges "vs." (even before an uppercase word)', () => {
    expect(sentences('Brown vs. Board of Education was decided. Done.')).toEqual(['Brown vs. Board of Education was decided.', 'Done.']);
    expect(sentences('e.g. Apples are good. Yes.')).toEqual(['e.g. Apples are good.', 'Yes.']);
  });

  it('keeps conditional abbreviations split when a capitalised sentence follows', () => {
    expect(sentences('at 5 p.m. He left.')).toEqual(['at 5 p.m.', 'He left.']);
    expect(sentences('apples, pears, etc. The rest stayed.')).toEqual(['apples, pears, etc.', 'The rest stayed.']);
    expect(sentences('Apple Inc. The company grew.')).toEqual(['Apple Inc.', 'The company grew.']);
    expect(sentences('Smith et al. The study found it. Yes.')).toEqual(['Smith et al.', 'The study found it.', 'Yes.']);
  });

  it('merges conditional abbreviations followed by numbers, lowercase or symbols', () => {
    expect(sentences('No. 5 is here. Fine.')).toEqual(['No. 5 is here.', 'Fine.']);
    expect(sentences('Jan. 5, 2020 was cold. Dec. 24 was not. Yes.')).toEqual(['Jan. 5, 2020 was cold.', 'Dec. 24 was not.', 'Yes.']);
    expect(sentences('See ch. 3, vol. 2, pp. 10-12 and ed. 4 (approx. 50 pages). Then stop.')).toEqual([
      'See ch. 3, vol. 2, pp. 10-12 and ed. 4 (approx. 50 pages).', 'Then stop.',
    ]);
    expect(sentences('It was 300 B.C. or A.D. 50, around 10 a.m. or 2 p.m. in the U.S.A. and Ltd. and Co. and Corp. entities. Done.')).toEqual([
      'It was 300 B.C. or A.D. 50, around 10 a.m. or 2 p.m. in the U.S.A. and Ltd. and Co. and Corp. entities.', 'Done.',
    ]);
    expect(sentences('Born Feb. 2, Mar. 3, Apr. 4, Jun. 6, Jul. 7, Aug. 8, Sep. 9, Sept. 9, Oct. 10, Nov. 11. Fine.')).toEqual([
      'Born Feb. 2, Mar. 3, Apr. 4, Jun. 6, Jul. 7, Aug. 8, Sep. 9, Sept. 9, Oct. 10, Nov. 11.', 'Fine.',
    ]);
    expect(sentences('cf. the appendix. Then stop.')).toEqual(['cf. the appendix.', 'Then stop.']);
  });

  it('does not mistake ordinary words that end in an abbreviation for abbreviations', () => {
    // "first" ends with "st", "it" is not "it." abbreviation, "fig" lower-case + uppercase next stays split
    expect(sentences('He came first. Then second.')).toEqual(['He came first.', 'Then second.']);
    expect(sentences('It is a fig. The tree is old.')).toEqual(['It is a fig.', 'The tree is old.']);
    expect(sentences('She said no. He said yes.')).toEqual(['She said no.', 'He said yes.']);
  });

  it('does not treat a trailing ellipsis after an abbreviation-like word as an abbreviation', () => {
    expect(sentences('He wanted apples, pears, etc... Then he left.')).toEqual(['He wanted apples, pears, etc...', 'Then he left.']);
  });

  it('treats single capital letters as initials, except the pronoun "I"', () => {
    expect(sentences('J. K. Rowling and A. A. Milne wrote books. True.')).toEqual(['J. K. Rowling and A. A. Milne wrote books.', 'True.']);
    expect(sentences('It was I. Nobody else.')).toEqual(['It was I.', 'Nobody else.']);
    expect(sentences('J. I. Packer wrote it. Done.')).toEqual(['J. I. Packer wrote it.', 'Done.']);
    expect(sentences('Dr. I. Smith wrote it. Done.')).toEqual(['Dr. I. Smith wrote it.', 'Done.']);
  });

  it('merges when the next segment starts with a lowercase letter', () => {
    expect(sentences('"Stop!" he said. "Now." Then silence.')).toEqual(['"Stop!" he said.', '"Now."', 'Then silence.']);
    expect(sentences('Wait! what? no.')).toEqual(['Wait! what? no.']);
    expect(sentences('She whispered… and then stopped. Silence.')).toEqual(['She whispered… and then stopped.', 'Silence.']);
  });

  it('splits after "..." when an uppercase word follows', () => {
    expect(sentences('She whispered... And then stopped.')).toEqual(['She whispered...', 'And then stopped.']);
  });

  it('keeps the single-character ellipsis (U+2026) inside the sentence, as ICU does', () => {
    // ICU does not treat U+2026 as a sentence terminator; splitting there would be a guess.
    expect(sentences('It ended… Nothing more.')).toEqual(['It ended… Nothing more.']);
    expect(sentences('It ended… nothing more. Done.')).toEqual(['It ended… nothing more.', 'Done.']);
  });

  it('attaches a closing quote or bracket at the start of the next segment to the previous sentence', () => {
    expect(sentences('He said. ” Then.')).toEqual(['He said. ” Then.']);
    expect(sentences('He said. ) Then.')).toEqual(['He said. ) Then.']);
    expect(sentences('He said. ] Then.')).toEqual(['He said. ] Then.']);
    expect(sentences('He said. » Then.')).toEqual(['He said. » Then.']);
    expect(sentences('He said. " Then.')).toEqual(['He said. " Then.']);
    expect(sentences("He said. ' Then.")).toEqual(["He said. ' Then."]);
    expect(sentences('He said. ’ Then.')).toEqual(['He said. ’ Then.']);
  });

  it('does not attach an opening quote that starts the next sentence', () => {
    expect(sentences("'Hello,' she said. 'Bye.' He left.")).toEqual(["'Hello,' she said.", "'Bye.'", 'He left.']);
    expect(sentences('"Hello," she said. "Bye." He left.')).toEqual(['"Hello," she said.', '"Bye."', 'He left.']);
    expect(sentences('He left. ’Tis the season.')).toEqual(['He left.', '’Tis the season.']);
    expect(sentences('“Go.” “Now.” Then.')).toEqual(['“Go.”', '“Now.”', 'Then.']);
    expect(sentences('(He left.) Then he sat.')).toEqual(['(He left.)', 'Then he sat.']);
  });

  it('attaches an unmatched straight quote to the previous sentence even before a letter', () => {
    // the previous sentence has an unmatched " so the next " closes it
    expect(sentences('He said "stop. "Then he left.')).toEqual(['He said "stop. "Then he left.']);
  });

  it('moves an opening quote that ICU glued to the previous sentence into the next one', () => {
    const t = 'end.”“Start again.';
    expect(sentences(t)).toEqual(['end.”', '“Start again.']);
    const out = checkInvariants(t);
    expect(out[0].tokens.map((k) => `${k.kind}:${k.text}`)).toEqual(['word:end', 'punct:.”']);
    expect(out[1].tokens.map((k) => `${k.kind}:${k.text}`)).toEqual(['punct:“', 'word:Start', 'word:again', 'punct:.']);
  });

  it('handles an abbreviation at the very end of the text', () => {
    expect(sentences('Mr.')).toEqual(['Mr.']);
    expect(sentences('a.m.')).toEqual(['a.m.']);
    expect(sentences('He met Mr. ')).toEqual(['He met Mr.']);
  });

  it('splits at sentence punctuation with no following space', () => {
    expect(sentences('Wait!What?')).toEqual(['Wait!', 'What?']);
  });
});

describe('sentence segmentation: whitespace and odd input', () => {
  it('returns no sentences for an empty string', () => {
    expect(seg.segmentParagraph('')).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('returns no sentences for whitespace-only input', () => {
    expect(seg.segmentParagraph('   ')).toEqual([]);
    expect(seg.segmentParagraph('\t\n  \n')).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('makes a string of only punctuation one sentence with one punct token', () => {
    const t = '...!!!';
    const out = checkInvariants(t);
    expect(sentences(t)).toEqual([t]);
    expect(out[0].tokens).toEqual([{ start: 0, end: 6, text: '...!!!', kind: 'punct' }]);
  });

  it('treats a newline before an uppercase word as a boundary and keeps the offsets exact', () => {
    const t = 'He left.\nShe stayed.';
    const out = checkInvariants(t);
    expect(sentences(t)).toEqual(['He left.', 'She stayed.']);
    expect(out[1].start).toBe(9);
    expect(out.flatMap((s) => s.tokens.map((k) => k.text))).toEqual(['He', 'left', '.', 'She', 'stayed', '.']);
  });

  it('keeps a line wrapped inside a sentence (newline before lowercase) as one sentence', () => {
    const t = 'the quick brown\nfox jumps.';
    expect(sentences(t)).toEqual([t]);
    expect(words(t)).toEqual(['the', 'quick', 'brown', 'fox', 'jumps']);
  });

  it('handles double spaces: offsets are exact and spaces are not tokens', () => {
    const t = 'Double  spaces here.  And more.';
    const out = checkInvariants(t);
    expect(sentences(t)).toEqual(['Double  spaces here.', 'And more.']);
    expect(out[0]).toMatchObject({ start: 0, end: 20 });
    expect(out[1]).toMatchObject({ start: 22, end: 31 });
    expect(out[0].tokens.map((k) => [k.start, k.end])).toEqual([[0, 6], [8, 14], [15, 19], [19, 20]]);
  });

  it('trims leading and trailing whitespace from sentence boundaries', () => {
    const t = '  Leading spaces. Trailing.  ';
    const out = checkInvariants(t);
    expect(sentences(t)).toEqual(['Leading spaces.', 'Trailing.']);
    expect(out[0].start).toBe(2);
    expect(out[1].end).toBe(27);
  });

  it('handles CJK punctuation and words', () => {
    const t = '你好。再见！Hello world.';
    const out = checkInvariants(t);
    expect(sentences(t)).toEqual(['你好。', '再见！', 'Hello world.']);
    expect(out[0].tokens.map((k) => `${k.kind}:${k.text}`)).toEqual(['word:你好', 'punct:。']);
    expect(out[1].tokens.map((k) => `${k.kind}:${k.text}`)).toEqual(['word:再见', 'punct:！']);
  });

  it('ignores zero-width and directional format characters', () => {
    const t = '\u200BHello\u200B world.\u200E';
    const out = checkInvariants(t);
    expect(sentences(t)).toEqual(['Hello\u200B world.']);
    expect(out[0].tokens.map((k) => k.text)).toEqual(['Hello', 'world', '.']);
  });

  it('treats non-breaking spaces as whitespace', () => {
    const t = 'Mr.\u00A0Darcy left.\u00A0He did.';
    expect(words(t)).toEqual(['Mr', 'Darcy', 'left', 'He', 'did']);
    checkInvariants(t);
  });

  it('keeps emoji and symbols as punct tokens', () => {
    const t = 'Hello 😀 world → done 100%';
    const out = checkInvariants(t);
    expect(out[0].tokens.map((k) => `${k.kind}:${k.text}`)).toEqual(['word:Hello', 'punct:😀', 'word:world', 'punct:→', 'word:done', 'number:100', 'punct:%']);
  });
});

describe('tokens', () => {
  it('joins word + single hyphen + word into one token, including chains', () => {
    const t = 'A well-known re-entry and a state-of-the-art device.';
    expect(words(t)).toEqual(['A', 'well-known', 're-entry', 'and', 'a', 'state-of-the-art', 'device']);
    expect(tokenList(t).filter((k) => k.startsWith('punct'))).toEqual(['punct:.']);
    checkInvariants(t);
  });

  it('joins across the non-breaking hyphen (U+2011) and the hyphen (U+2010)', () => {
    expect(words('x\u2011y and a\u2010b')).toEqual(['x\u2011y', 'and', 'a\u2010b']);
  });

  it('does not join across spaces, double hyphens, dashes or mixed hyphen runs', () => {
    expect(tokenList('a - b')).toEqual(['word:a', 'punct:-', 'word:b']);
    expect(tokenList('a--b')).toEqual(['word:a', 'punct:--', 'word:b']);
    expect(tokenList('a—b')).toEqual(['word:a', 'punct:—', 'word:b']);
    expect(tokenList('a–b')).toEqual(['word:a', 'punct:–', 'word:b']);
    expect(tokenList('a-\u2011b')).toEqual(['word:a', 'punct:-\u2011', 'word:b']);
    expect(tokenList('-a')).toEqual(['punct:-', 'word:a']);
    expect(tokenList('a-')).toEqual(['word:a', 'punct:-']);
  });

  it('classifies joined number-word compounds as words and number-number as numbers', () => {
    expect(tokenList('a 5-year-old and pages 10-12')).toEqual(['word:a', 'word:5-year-old', 'word:and', 'word:pages', 'number:10-12']);
  });

  it('keeps internal apostrophes (curly and straight)', () => {
    expect(words('don’t touch Darcy’s hat, it isn\'t Smith\'s')).toEqual(['don’t', 'touch', 'Darcy’s', 'hat', 'it', "isn't", "Smith's"]);
  });

  it('classifies numbers with decimal points and thousands separators', () => {
    expect(tokenList('3 or 3.50 or 1,000 or 3,000.5 but 5th and 10am')).toEqual([
      'number:3', 'word:or', 'number:3.50', 'word:or', 'number:1,000', 'word:or', 'number:3,000.5', 'word:but', 'word:5th', 'word:and', 'word:10am',
    ]);
  });

  it('collapses runs of punctuation into one token', () => {
    expect(tokenList('“Really?!” she said...')).toEqual(['punct:“', 'word:Really', 'punct:?!”', 'word:she', 'word:said', 'punct:...']);
    expect(tokenList('(yes) [no] «hi»')).toEqual(['punct:(', 'word:yes', 'punct:)', 'punct:[', 'word:no', 'punct:]', 'punct:«', 'word:hi', 'punct:»']);
  });

  it('does not collapse punctuation separated by whitespace', () => {
    expect(tokenList('end. — start')).toEqual(['word:end', 'punct:.', 'punct:—', 'word:start']);
  });

  it('keeps dotted abbreviations as the segmenter produces them', () => {
    expect(tokenList('U.S.A. and e.g. this')).toEqual(['word:U.S.A', 'punct:.', 'word:and', 'word:e.g', 'punct:.', 'word:this']);
  });

  it('keeps every token inside its sentence', () => {
    const t = 'Mr. Darcy said, “No.” She left (quickly)! Then... silence?! Yes.';
    const out = checkInvariants(t);
    expect(out.length).toBe(4);
    for (const s of out) expect(s.tokens.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
  });
});

describe('soft hyphens', () => {
  it('segments the intact word but keeps original offsets and the soft hyphen inside the token', () => {
    const t = 'ab\u00ADsolutely fine. Next.';
    const out = checkInvariants(t);
    expect(sentences(t)).toEqual(['ab\u00ADsolutely fine.', 'Next.']);
    expect(out[0].tokens[0]).toEqual({ start: 0, end: 11, text: 'ab\u00ADsolutely', kind: 'word' });
    expect(out[0].tokens.map((k) => k.text)).toEqual(['ab\u00ADsolutely', 'fine', '.']);
    expect(out[1]).toMatchObject({ start: 18, end: 23 });
  });

  it('never starts or ends a token or sentence with a soft hyphen', () => {
    const t = '\u00ADThe end.\u00AD Next\u00AD one.\u00AD';
    const out = checkInvariants(t);
    // a sentence is a slice of the original text, so an internal soft hyphen stays in it
    expect(sentences(t)).toEqual(['The end.', 'Next\u00AD one.']);
    const text = (x: Sentence): string => t.slice(x.start, x.end);
    for (const x of out) {
      expect(text(x).startsWith('\u00AD')).toBe(false);
      expect(text(x).endsWith('\u00AD')).toBe(false);
      for (const k of x.tokens) {
        expect(k.text.startsWith('\u00AD')).toBe(false);
        expect(k.text.endsWith('\u00AD')).toBe(false);
      }
    }
    expect(out.flatMap((s) => s.tokens.map((k) => k.text))).toEqual(['The', 'end', '.', 'Next', 'one', '.']);
  });

  it('does not split a soft-hyphenated word that straddles a would-be boundary', () => {
    // without stripping, ICU would see "Mr" + soft hyphen and could misclassify
    const t = 'Mr. Dar\u00ADcy ar\u00ADrived. He left.';
    expect(sentences(t)).toEqual(['Mr. Dar\u00ADcy ar\u00ADrived.', 'He left.']);
    expect(words(t)).toEqual(['Mr', 'Dar\u00ADcy', 'ar\u00ADrived', 'He', 'left']);
  });

  it('handles a string that is only soft hyphens', () => {
    expect(seg.segmentParagraph('\u00AD\u00AD')).toEqual([]);
    expect(seg.tokenize('\u00AD')).toEqual([]);
  });
});

describe('tokenize()', () => {
  it('returns [] for an empty string and whitespace', () => {
    expect(seg.tokenize('')).toEqual([]);
    expect(seg.tokenize('   ')).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('tokenises arbitrary text with the same conventions as segmentParagraph', () => {
    const t = 'ab\u00ADsolutely well-known, "Hi!" don’t 3.50';
    const out = seg.tokenize(t);
    checkTokens(t, out);
    expect(out.map((k) => `${k.kind}:${k.text}@${k.start}-${k.end}`)).toEqual([
      'word:ab\u00ADsolutely@0-11', 'word:well-known@12-22', 'punct:,@22-23', 'punct:"@24-25', 'word:Hi@25-27', 'punct:!"@27-29', 'word:don’t@30-35', 'number:3.50@36-40',
    ]);
  });

  it('spans sentence boundaries without splitting punctuation runs at them', () => {
    const t = 'One. Two.';
    expect(seg.tokenize(t).map((k) => k.text)).toEqual(['One', '.', 'Two', '.']);
  });

  it('agrees with segmentParagraph on a multi-sentence paragraph', () => {
    const t = 'Mr. Darcy said, “No.” She left (quickly)! Then... silence?! Yes.';
    const fromSentences = seg.segmentParagraph(t).flatMap((s) => s.tokens);
    expect(seg.tokenize(t)).toEqual(fromSentences);
  });
});

describe('performance', () => {
  function makeParagraph(wordCount: number): string {
    const vocab = ['the', 'quick', 'brown', 'fox', 'jumps', 'over', 'lazy', 'dog', 'Mr.', 'Darcy', 'well-known', 'don’t', '3.50', 'etc.', 'Dr.', 'Smith', '“quoted”', 'U.S.', 'J.', 'K.'];
    const out: string[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < wordCount; i++) {
      let w = vocab[i % vocab.length];
      if (i % 13 === 12) w += '.';
      out.push(w);
    }
    return out.join(' ');
  }

  it('segments a 5,000-word paragraph in well under 500 ms', () => {
    const big = makeParagraph(5000);
    expect(big.split(' ').length).toBe(5000);
    seg.segmentParagraph(makeParagraph(500)); // warm up ICU and the JIT
    const t0 = performance.now();
    const out = seg.segmentParagraph(big);
    const ms = performance.now() - t0;
    expect(ms).toBeLessThan(500);
    expect(out.length).toBeGreaterThan(100);
    const tokens = out.reduce((n, s) => n + s.tokens.length, 0);
    expect(tokens).toBeGreaterThan(5000);
    checkInvariants(big, out);
  });

  it('tokenizes a 5,000-word paragraph in well under 500 ms', () => {
    const big = makeParagraph(5000);
    const t0 = performance.now();
    const out = seg.tokenize(big);
    expect(performance.now() - t0).toBeLessThan(500);
    expect(out.length).toBeGreaterThan(5000);
    checkTokens(big, out);
  });

  it('is linear: the merge pass does not rescan the whole sentence at every boundary', () => {
    // Long run of initials forces ~2,500 merges into one growing sentence.
    const t = Array.from({ length: 2500 }, () => 'J.').join(' ') + ' Tolkien wrote it. Done.';
    const t0 = performance.now();
    const out = seg.segmentParagraph(t);
    expect(performance.now() - t0).toBeLessThan(500);
    expect(out.length).toBe(2);
  });
});
```

```ts
import { describe, it, expect, vi } from 'vitest';
import { DEFAULT_SETTINGS, migrateSettings, isDarkTheme } from '@shared/settings';
import { resolveStyle, resolveStyles } from '@shared/styles';
import type { Settings } from '@shared/settings';
vi.mock('electron', () => ({ app: { getPath: () => '/tmp/dream-read-settings-test' }, safeStorage: { isEncryptionAvailable: () => false } }));
import { deepMerge } from '../../src/main/settings';

/** A settings.json written by the first version (ReadAlong): no Dream Read fields, theme 'dark'. */
const STORED_V1 = {
  version: 1, onboarded: true, learnerLevel: 'C1', nativeLanguage: 'zh',
  ai: { provider: 'openai', anthropicModel: 'claude-opus-5-5', openaiModel: 'gpt-5.4-mini', instructions: 'Be brief.', explanationLength: 'short', speakChinese: false, dailyWarnUsd: 2, monthlyStopUsd: 20 },
  voice: { engine: 'webspeech', voiceId: 'Daniel', explainEngine: null, explainVoiceId: null, rate: 1.2, pauseBetweenSentencesMs: 300 },
  listen: { autoExplainWords: true, autoExplainPhrases: false, firstOccurrencePerChapterOnly: true, maxStopsPer10Min: 5, wordRepeats: 2, sentenceRepeatsAfterWord: 1, sentenceRepeatsForPhrase: 2, lastSecondsWindow: 40, tapHighlightCancels: false },
  appearance: {
    theme: 'dark', layout: 'scroll', fontFamily: 'sans', fontSizePx: 24, lineHeight: 1.8, marginPx: 64, bandEnabled: false, bandHeightPct: 25,
    highlightsDark: { unknown: '#111111', learning: '#222222', sentence: '#333333', word: '#444444', marked: '#555555' },
    highlightsLight: { unknown: '#aaaaaa', learning: '#bbbbbb', sentence: '#cccccc', word: '#dddddd', marked: '#eeeeee' },
    underlineOnly: true,
  },
  shortcuts: { playPause: 'KeyP' },
};

function load(stored: object): Settings {
  // same steps as getSettings() in src/main/settings.ts
  return migrateSettings(deepMerge(structuredClone(DEFAULT_SETTINGS), migrateSettings(structuredClone(stored) as never)));
}

describe('settings merge and migration', () => {
  it('fills in every Dream Read appearance field for a v1 settings file and keeps the learner\'s values', () => {
    const s = load(STORED_V1);
    expect(s.appearance.subtitleSizePx).toBe(DEFAULT_SETTINGS.appearance.subtitleSizePx);
    expect(s.appearance.explainSizePx).toBe(DEFAULT_SETTINGS.appearance.explainSizePx);
    expect(s.appearance.uiScale).toBe(1);
    expect(s.appearance.maxLineChars).toBe(70);
    expect(s.appearance.listenMaxLineChars).toBe(90);
    expect(s.appearance.showTips).toBe(true);
    // the learner's own values survive
    expect(s.appearance.fontSizePx).toBe(24);
    expect(s.appearance.lineHeight).toBe(1.8);
    expect(s.appearance.layout).toBe('scroll');
    expect(s.appearance.underlineOnly).toBe(true);
    expect(s.appearance.highlightsDark.unknown).toBe('#111111');
    expect(s.learnerLevel).toBe('C1');
    expect(s.ai.provider).toBe('openai');
    expect(s.listen.lastSecondsWindow).toBe(40);
    // nested objects merge, so shortcuts that were not stored keep their defaults
    expect(s.shortcuts.playPause).toBe('KeyP');
    expect(s.shortcuts.nextSentence).toBe('ArrowRight');
    // fields other versions added are present too
    expect(s.ai.activeStyle).toBe(DEFAULT_SETTINGS.ai.activeStyle);
    expect(s.listen.pauseAfterExplainMs).toBe(DEFAULT_SETTINGS.listen.pauseAfterExplainMs);
  });
  it('reads the old theme "dark" as "night" and leaves the other ids alone', () => {
    expect(load(STORED_V1).appearance.theme).toBe('night');
    for (const theme of ['night', 'sepia', 'light', 'grey', 'system'] as const) expect(load({ appearance: { theme } }).appearance.theme).toBe(theme);
    expect(migrateSettings({ appearance: { theme: 'dark' } }).appearance.theme).toBe('night');
    expect(migrateSettings({} as { appearance?: { theme?: string } }).appearance).toBeUndefined();
  });
  it('every new field round-trips through a settings:set style patch', () => {
    const base = load(STORED_V1);
    const patch: Partial<Settings> = { appearance: { ...base.appearance, theme: 'grey', subtitleSizePx: 28, explainSizePx: 17, uiScale: 1.2, maxLineChars: 60, listenMaxLineChars: 110, showTips: false } };
    const next = migrateSettings(deepMerge(base, migrateSettings(patch)));
    expect(next.appearance).toMatchObject({ theme: 'grey', subtitleSizePx: 28, explainSizePx: 17, uiScale: 1.2, maxLineChars: 60, listenMaxLineChars: 110, showTips: false });
    // a JSON round-trip (what the store writes and reads) keeps them
    const again = load(JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(next)));
    expect(again.appearance).toEqual(next.appearance);
  });
  it('DEFAULT_SETTINGS use night and the dark highlight palette applies to night and grey only', () => {
    expect(DEFAULT_SETTINGS.appearance.theme).toBe('night');
    expect(isDarkTheme('night')).toBe(true);
    expect(isDarkTheme('grey')).toBe(true);
    expect(isDarkTheme('sepia')).toBe(false);
    expect(isDarkTheme('light')).toBe(false);
  });
  it('minimal nested patches (StylesEditor), full-section patches and null style resets all merge correctly', () => {
    let s = load({});
    const set = (patch: object) => { s = migrateSettings(deepMerge(s, migrateSettings(structuredClone(patch) as never))); s = load(JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(s))); };
    set({ ai: { styles: { teacher: { wordPrompt: 'P1', shape: { wordBefore: 4 } } } } });
    set({ ai: { styles: { teacher: { shape: { wordAfter: 5 } } } } }); // a second knob: the first edit stays
    expect(s.ai.styles.teacher).toMatchObject({ wordPrompt: 'P1', shape: { wordBefore: 4, wordAfter: 5 } });
    set({ ai: { ...s.ai, monthlyStopUsd: 7 } }); // Settings.tsx patches the whole section
    expect(s.ai.monthlyStopUsd).toBe(7);
    expect(s.ai.styles.teacher?.wordPrompt).toBe('P1');
    set({ ai: { styles: { 'my-x-1': { userMade: true, name: 'Mine' } } } });
    expect(resolveStyles(s.ai.styles).some((st) => st.id === 'my-x-1')).toBe(true);
    set({ ai: { styles: { teacher: null, 'my-x-1': null } } }); // reset / delete
    expect(resolveStyle('teacher', s.ai.styles).wordPrompt).not.toBe('P1');
    expect(resolveStyles(s.ai.styles).some((st) => st.id === 'my-x-1')).toBe(false);
    // other new fields: contextRules, skip, voiceChat, bookModes, lastMode, hintsModel, level
    set({ ai: { contextRules: 'R', hintsModel: 'claude-haiku-5-5' }, skip: { ...s.skip }, voiceChat: { alwaysOn: true }, bookModes: { b1: 'listening' }, lastMode: 'listening' });
    set({ bookModes: { ...s.bookModes, b2: 'reading' } });
    expect(s.ai.contextRules).toBe('R');
    expect(s.ai.hintsModel).toBe('claude-haiku-5-5');
    expect(s.voiceChat).toMatchObject({ alwaysOn: true, model: DEFAULT_SETTINGS.voiceChat.model, pushToTalkKey: 'KeyM' });
    expect(s.bookModes).toEqual({ b1: 'listening', b2: 'reading' });
    expect(s.lastMode).toBe('listening');
    set({ ai: { hintsModel: null } });
    expect(s.ai.hintsModel).toBeNull();
    // arrays are replaced, never merged index by index
    set({ level: { model: { version: 1, alpha: [1, 2, 3], beta: [1, 2, 3], falseAlarmRate: 0, seen: ['a', 'b'], updatedAt: null, testedAt: null } } });
    set({ level: { model: { version: 1, alpha: [9], beta: [9], falseAlarmRate: 0, seen: [], updatedAt: null, testedAt: null } } });
    expect(s.level.model).toMatchObject({ alpha: [9], beta: [9], seen: [] });
  });
});
```

### `test/unit/skip.test.ts` (114 lines)

```ts
import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
import type { Paragraph } from '@core/model';
import { classifySkippable, buildSkipContext, skippedSentences, stripInline, toOriginalRange, isCitation, DEFAULT_SKIP, skipAll, allSkipped, SKIP_OPTIONS, type SkipSettings } from '@core/import/skip';
import { DEFAULT_SETTINGS } from '@shared/settings';
import { makeBook } from './helpers';

const para = (text: string, kind: Paragraph['kind'] = 'p'): Paragraph => ({ index: 0, kind, text, sentences: [] });
const only = (...on: (keyof SkipSettings)[]): SkipSettings => ({ ...skipAll(false), ...Object.fromEntries(on.map((c) => [c, true])) });

describe('skip settings', () => {
  it('defaults to page numbers only and is persisted in settings', () => {
    expect(Object.entries(DEFAULT_SKIP).filter(([, v]) => v).map(([k]) => k)).toEqual(['pageNumbers']);
    expect(DEFAULT_SETTINGS.skip).toEqual(DEFAULT_SKIP);
  });
  it('skipAll toggles every category; options follow Speechify order', () => {
    expect(allSkipped(skipAll())).toBe(true);
    expect(Object.values(skipAll(false)).some(Boolean)).toBe(false);
    expect(SKIP_OPTIONS.slice(0, 8).map((o) => o.label)).toEqual(['Headers', 'Footers', 'Footnotes', 'Braces', 'Citations', 'Parentheses', 'Brackets', 'URLs']);
  });
});

describe('classifySkippable', () => {
  it('page numbers', () => {
    for (const t of ['12', '- 12 -', 'Page 12', 'page 3 of 10', 'xii', '— 7 —']) expect(classifySkippable(para(t)), t).toBe('pageNumbers');
    for (const t of ['I', 'It was 12 o’clock.', '1984 was a year.']) expect(classifySkippable(para(t)), t).toBeNull();
  });
  it('table of contents lines', () => {
    expect(classifySkippable(para('Chapter 1: The Beginning ........ 7'))).toBe('toc');
    expect(classifySkippable(para('Preface . . . . . ix'))).toBe('toc');
    expect(classifySkippable(para('He waited... 3 hours.'))).toBeNull();
  });
  it('captions', () => {
    expect(classifySkippable(para('Figure 1: The water cycle.'))).toBe('captions');
    expect(classifySkippable(para('Table 2. Results by year'))).toBe('captions');
    expect(classifySkippable(para('Fig. 3 – A map of London'))).toBe('captions');
    expect(classifySkippable(para('A picture of a cat', 'caption'))).toBe('captions');
    expect(classifySkippable(para('Table 2 shows the results.'))).toBeNull();
  });
  it('footnotes', () => {
    expect(classifySkippable(para('1 See the appendix for details.'))).toBe('footnotes');
    expect(classifySkippable(para('[3] Smith, J. A History of Tea.'))).toBe('footnotes');
    expect(classifySkippable(para('^2 Ibid.'))).toBe('footnotes');
    expect(classifySkippable(para('* Not his real name.'))).toBe('footnotes');
    expect(classifySkippable(para('12 men walked in.'))).toBeNull();
    expect(classifySkippable(para('1 First step', 'li'))).toBeNull();
  });
  it('citation-only paragraphs', () => {
    expect(classifySkippable(para('[12]'))).toBe('citations');
    expect(classifySkippable(para('[1, 3–5]'))).toBe('citations');
  });
  it('running headers and footers repeated across the book', () => {
    const book = makeBook([
      { title: 'One', paragraphs: ['Pride and Prejudice', 'It is a truth universally acknowledged.', '© 2020 Penguin Books', 'More text here.', 'Pride and Prejudice'] },
      { title: 'Two', paragraphs: ['Pride and Prejudice 23', 'Another story begins.', '© 2020 Penguin Books'] },
      { title: 'Three', paragraphs: ['Chapter Three', 'Text.', '© 2020 Penguin Books'] },
    ]);
    book.chapters[2].paragraphs[0].kind = 'h1';
    const repeated = buildSkipContext(book);
    expect(classifySkippable(book.chapters[1].paragraphs[0], { repeated })).toBe('headers');
    expect(classifySkippable(book.chapters[0].paragraphs[2], { repeated })).toBe('footers');
    expect(classifySkippable(book.chapters[0].paragraphs[1], { repeated })).toBeNull();
    expect(classifySkippable(book.chapters[2].paragraphs[0], { repeated })).toBeNull();
    // without the book context nothing is a running header
    expect(classifySkippable(book.chapters[1].paragraphs[0])).toBeNull();
  });
});

describe('skippedSentences', () => {
  it('returns c.p.s keys of skipped paragraphs and of sentences left empty by inline stripping', () => {
    const book = makeBook([{ title: 'A', paragraphs: ['14', 'Hello there. (See Figure 2.) Bye now.', 'Figure 2: A cat.'] }]);
    expect([...skippedSentences(book, DEFAULT_SKIP)]).toEqual(['0.0.0']);
    expect([...skippedSentences(book, only('parentheses', 'captions'))].sort()).toEqual(['0.1.1', '0.2.0']);
    expect(skippedSentences(book, skipAll(false)).size).toBe(0);
  });
});

describe('stripInline', () => {
  it('removes parentheses, brackets and braces only when switched on', () => {
    const t = 'He left (quickly) and [sadly] went {home}.';
    expect(stripInline(t, only('parentheses')).text).toBe('He left and [sadly] went {home}.');
    expect(stripInline(t, only('brackets')).text).toBe('He left (quickly) and went {home}.');
    expect(stripInline(t, only('braces')).text).toBe('He left (quickly) and [sadly] went.');
    expect(stripInline(t, skipAll(false)).text).toBe(t);
  });
  it('removes citations but keeps other parentheses', () => {
    const t = 'Tea is popular (Smith, 2020) and cheap (mostly) [12], says Lee (2019).';
    expect(stripInline(t, only('citations')).text).toBe('Tea is popular and cheap (mostly), says Lee.');
    expect(isCitation('Smith et al. 2019; Lee & Park, 2021, p. 4', '(')).toBe(true);
    expect(isCitation('1, 3–5', '[')).toBe(true);
    expect(isCitation('mostly', '(')).toBe(false);
  });
  it('removes URLs without the sentence full stop', () => {
    const r = stripInline('Visit https://example.com/a?b=1. Or www.test.org today.', only('urls'));
    expect(r.text).toBe('Visit. Or today.');
  });
  it('removes superscript note markers with footnotes on', () => {
    expect(stripInline('It was true.¹ Really²', only('footnotes')).text).toBe('It was true. Really');
  });
  it('handles nesting and unmatched brackets', () => {
    expect(stripInline('A (b (c) d) e.', only('parentheses')).text).toBe('A e.');
    expect(stripInline('A b) c (d', only('parentheses')).text).toBe('A b) c (d');
    expect(stripInline('(Note) Start here.', only('parentheses')).text).toBe('Start here.');
  });
  it('maps stripped offsets back to the original text', () => {
    const t = 'He left (quickly) and went home.';
    const r = stripInline(t, only('parentheses'));
    expect(r.text).toBe('He left and went home.');
    expect(r.map.length).toBe(r.text.length + 1);
    for (let i = 0; i < r.text.length; i++) expect(t[r.map[i]]).toBe(r.text[i]);
    const andAt = r.text.indexOf('and');
    expect(toOriginalRange(r, andAt, 3)).toEqual({ charIndex: t.indexOf('and'), charLength: 3 });
    expect(r.removed).toEqual([[7, 17]]);
  });
});
```

### `test/unit/stt-session.test.ts` (153 lines)

```ts
import { describe, it, expect, vi } from 'vitest';
import { VoiceSession, type SttEngineEvent, type SttEventSource } from '../../src/core/voice/session';
import type { CommandEvent, QuestionEvent } from '../../src/core/voice/turns';

/** A fake stt:event stream: `emit` pushes to every attached listener. */
function fakeSource(): { source: SttEventSource; emit: (e: SttEngineEvent) => void; listeners: number } {
  const set = new Set<(e: SttEngineEvent) => void>();
  const api = {
    source: ((l: (e: SttEngineEvent) => void) => { set.add(l); return () => set.delete(l); }) as SttEventSource,
    emit: (e: SttEngineEvent) => { for (const l of [...set]) l(e); },
    get listeners() { return set.size; },
  };
  return api;
}

const S = 'mic1';
const final = (text: string, segmentId: string, confidence?: number): SttEngineEvent => ({ type: 'final', text, segmentId, sessionId: S, confidence });
const partial = (text: string, segmentId: string): SttEngineEvent => ({ type: 'partial', text, segmentId, sessionId: S });

function setup(mode: 'commands' | 'conversation' | 'off', now = { t: 0 }) {
  const src = fakeSource();
  const vs = new VoiceSession({ mode, listener: { now: () => now.t } });
  const commands: CommandEvent[] = [], questions: QuestionEvent[] = [], starts: string[] = [], partials: string[] = [], modes: string[] = [];
  vs.on('command', (c) => commands.push(c));
  vs.on('question', (q) => questions.push(q));
  vs.on('speechStart', (e) => starts.push(e.segmentId));
  vs.on('partial', (p) => partials.push(p.text));
  vs.on('mode', (to, from) => modes.push(`${from}>${to}`));
  vs.attach(src.source);
  return { src, vs, commands, questions, starts, partials, modes, now };
}

describe('VoiceSession in commands mode', () => {
  it('fires the three commands from finals', () => {
    const { src, commands, questions } = setup('commands');
    const now = { t: 0 };
    void now;
    src.emit(final('I know', 's1'));
    expect(commands.map((c) => c.intent)).toEqual(['know']);
    expect(questions).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('fires once per segment, debounced, and from two agreeing partials', () => {
    const { src, commands, now } = setup('commands');
    src.emit(partial('i don', 's1'));
    src.emit(partial("i don't know", 's1'));
    src.emit(partial("i don't know", 's1'));
    expect(commands.map((c) => [c.intent, c.via])).toEqual([['dont_know', 'partials']]);
    src.emit(final("I don't know", 's1')); // same segment: nothing more
    expect(commands).toHaveLength(1);
    now.t = 500;
    src.emit(final('I know', 's2')); // inside the 1 s debounce: dropped
    expect(commands).toHaveLength(1);
    now.t = 2000;
    src.emit(final('I know', 's3'));
    expect(commands.map((c) => c.intent)).toEqual(['dont_know', 'know']);
  });

  it('turns any other final into a question and ignores empty finals', () => {
    const { src, commands, questions } = setup('commands');
    src.emit(final('What does this word mean?', 's1', 0.9));
    src.emit(final('', 's2'));
    src.emit(final('um', 's3'));
    expect(commands).toEqual([]);
    expect(questions).toEqual([{ text: 'What does this word mean?', segmentId: 's1', confidence: 0.9 }]);
  });

  it('"bye bye" fires and switches to off; nothing fires afterwards', () => {
    const { src, vs, commands, questions, starts, modes, now } = setup('commands');
    src.emit(final('bye bye', 's1'));
    expect(commands.map((c) => c.intent)).toEqual(['bye']);
    expect(vs.mode).toBe('off');
    expect(modes).toEqual(['commands>off']);
    now.t = 5000;
    src.emit({ type: 'speechStart', sessionId: S, segmentId: 's2' });
    src.emit(final('I know', 's2'));
    src.emit(final('tell me more', 's3'));
    expect(commands).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(questions).toEqual([]);
    expect(starts).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('re-emits speechStart / speechEnd and partial text for the UI', () => {
    const { src, starts, partials, vs } = setup('commands');
    const ends: string[] = [];
    vs.on('speechEnd', (e) => ends.push(e.segmentId));
    src.emit({ type: 'speechStart', sessionId: S, segmentId: 's1' });
    src.emit(partial('hello th', 's1'));
    src.emit(partial('  ', 's1'));
    src.emit({ type: 'speechEnd', sessionId: S, segmentId: 's1' });
    expect(starts).toEqual(['s1']);
    expect(ends).toEqual(['s1']);
    expect(partials).toEqual(['hello th']);
  });
});

describe('VoiceSession in conversation mode', () => {
  it('routes "I know" / "I don\'t know" finals to the AI as questions, keeps "bye bye" as a command', () => {
    const { src, vs, commands, questions, now } = setup('conversation');
    src.emit(final('I know', 's1'));
    now.t = 3000;
    src.emit(final("I don't know", 's2'));
    expect(commands).toEqual([]);
    expect(questions.map((q) => q.text)).toEqual(['I know', "I don't know"]);
    now.t = 6000;
    src.emit(final('bye bye', 's3'));
    expect(commands.map((c) => c.intent)).toEqual(['bye']);
    expect(vs.mode).toBe('off');
  });

  it('does not let agreeing partials swallow the final', () => {
    const { src, commands, questions } = setup('conversation');
    src.emit(partial('i know', 's1'));
    src.emit(partial('i know', 's1'));
    expect(commands).toEqual([]);
    src.emit(final('I know the answer is seven', 's1'));
    expect(questions.map((q) => q.text)).toEqual(['I know the answer is seven']);
  });
});

describe('VoiceSession plumbing', () => {
  it('filters by session id and forwards errors even when off', () => {
    const src = fakeSource();
    const vs = new VoiceSession({ mode: 'commands', sessionId: 'a' });
    const commands: CommandEvent[] = []; const errors: string[] = [];
    vs.on('command', (c) => commands.push(c));
    vs.on('error', (e) => errors.push(e.message));
    vs.attach(src.source);
    src.emit({ type: 'final', text: 'I know', segmentId: 'x', sessionId: 'b' });
    expect(commands).toEqual([]);
    src.emit({ type: 'final', text: 'I know', segmentId: 'y', sessionId: 'a' });
    expect(commands).toHaveLength(1);
    vs.setMode('off');
    src.emit({ type: 'error', sessionId: 'a', message: 'boom' });
    expect(errors).toEqual(['boom']);
  });

  it('setMode resets pending partials and detach unsubscribes', () => {
    const { src, vs, commands } = setup('commands');
    src.emit(partial('i know', 's1'));
    vs.setMode('conversation');
    vs.setMode('commands');
    src.emit(partial('i know', 's1'));
    expect(commands).toEqual([]); // the pending partial from before the mode change was forgotten
    expect(src.listeners).toBe(1);
    vs.detach();
    expect(src.listeners).toBe(0);
    const spy = vi.fn();
    vs.on('command', spy);
    src.emit(final('I know', 's9'));
    expect(spy).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });
});
```
